name: Cslib.Automata.DA.FinAcc.unique_minimal
statement:
theorem unique_minimal [Finite State]
    (l : Language α) (hr : l.IsRegular) (hm : M.IsMinimalAutomaton l) :
    ∃! φ : State ≃ l.NerodeQuotient, ∀ x, φ (M.mtr M.start x) = ⟦ x ⟧
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rfl, hc⟩ := hm
  have := Language.IsRegular.iff_finite_nerodeQuotient.mp hr
  let φ : State → Quotient ((language M).NerodeCongruence).eq :=
    fun s ↦ ⟦ Classical.epsilon (fun x : List α ↦ M.mtr M.start x = s) ⟧
  have hφ (x : List α) : φ (M.mtr M.start x) = ⟦ x ⟧ := by
    apply Quotient.sound
    apply stateCongruence_le_nerodeCongruence
    intro z
    have := @Classical.epsilon_spec _ (fun y : List α ↦ M.mtr M.start y = M.mtr M.start x) ⟨x, rfl⟩
    grind [FLTS.mtr]
  have hφ_surj : Function.Surjective φ := fun q ↦ q.inductionOn (fun x ↦ ⟨M.mtr M.start x, hφ x⟩)
  have hφ_inj : Function.Injective φ := by
    have eqT := Classical.inhabited_of_nonempty <| Finite.card_eq.mp hc
    apply hφ_surj.injective_of_finite eqT.default
  use Equiv.ofBijective φ ⟨hφ_inj, hφ_surj⟩, hφ
  intro ψ hψ
  ext s
  induction h : φ s using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h x => grind [hφ_inj ((hφ x).trans h.symm)]

statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem omegaPow_of_sub_one [Inhabited α] : (l - 1)^ω = l^ω
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [omegaPow_def]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.zero_omegaPow
statement:
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem zero_omegaPow [Inhabited α] : (0 : Language α)^ω = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [omegaPow_def, bot_def]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.one_omegaPow
statement:
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem one_omegaPow [Inhabited α] : (1 : Language α)^ω = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← omegaPow_of_sub_one, tsub_self, zero_omegaPow]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_of_le_one
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem omegaPow_of_le_one [Inhabited α] (h : l ≤ 1) : l^ω = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  cases (Language.le_one_iff_eq.mp h) <;> simp_all

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_eq_empty
statement: theorem omegaPow_eq_empty [Inhabited α] (h : l^ω = ⊥) : l ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro x h_x
  by_contra h_contra
  suffices h' : (const x).flatten ∈ l^ω by
    simp [h, mem_def, bot_def] at h'
  use const x, rfl
  exact fun _ => ⟨h_x, h_contra⟩

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.hmul_seq_prop
statement: theorem hmul_seq_prop : l * p = { s : ωSequence α | ∃ k, s.take k ∈ l ∧ s.drop k ∈ p }
proof:
:= by
  ext s; constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, h_x, t, h_t, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨x.length, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [take_append_of_le_length]
    · simpa [drop_append_ωSequence]
  · rintro ⟨k, h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨s.take k, h1, s.drop k, h2, by simp⟩

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_seq_prop
proof:
:= by
  ext s; constructor
  · rintro ⟨xs, rfl, h_xs⟩
    simp [forall_and, List.ne_nil_iff_length_pos] at h_xs
    refine ⟨xs.cumLen, by grind [cumLen_strictMono], by simp [cumLen_zero], ?_⟩
    grind
  · rintro ⟨f, hm, h0, he⟩
    refine ⟨(fun m ↦ s.extract (f m) (f (m + 1))), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply strictMono_flatten hm h0
    · intro m
      change s.extract (f m) (f (m + 1)) ∈ l - 1
      simp only [he, Language.mem_sub_one, ne_eq, extract_eq_nil_iff, not_le, true_and]
      apply hm; omega

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_coind'
statement: theorem omegaPow_coind' [Inhabited α] (h_nn : [] ∉ l) (h_le : p ≤ l * p) : p ≤ l^ω
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_def]
  intro s h_s
  have h_nxt m (hm : s.drop m ∈ p) : ∃ n > m, s.extract m n ∈ l ∧ s.drop n ∈ p := by
    obtain ⟨k, _⟩ := hmul_seq_prop ▸ h_le hm
    grind [extract_eq_drop_take]
  choose nxt_n nxt_p using h_nxt
  let f := iter_helper (fun n ↦ s.drop n ∈ p) nxt_n
  have h_f (n) : f n < f (n + 1) ∧ s.extract (f n) (f (n + 1)) ∈ l ∧ s.drop (f (n + 1)) ∈ p := by
    induction n <;> grind [iter_helper]
  rw [omegaPow_seq_prop]
  use f
  grind [strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ, iter_helper]

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_coind
statement: theorem omegaPow_coind [Inhabited α] (h_le : p ≤ (l - 1) * p) : p ≤ l^ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [← omegaPow_of_sub_one]
  refine omegaPow_coind' ?_ h_le
  simp

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow'
statement:
theorem omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow' [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) :
    l^ω ≤ (l - 1) * l^ω
proof:
:= by
  rintro s ⟨xs, rfl, h_xs⟩
  refine ⟨xs.head, h_xs 0, xs.tail.flatten, ⟨xs.tail, rfl, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · grind
  · apply cons_flatten
    intro k
    apply List.length_pos_iff.mpr
    exact h_xs k |>.right

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow
statement: theorem omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) : l^ω ≤ l * l^ω
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow' l
  refine le_trans h1 ?_
  refine le_hmul_congr ?_ ?_
  · apply sdiff_le
  · apply le_refl

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.hmul_omegaPow_le_omegaPow
statement: theorem hmul_omegaPow_le_omegaPow [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) : l * l^ω ≤ l^ω
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : l * l^ω ≤ (l - 1) * (l * l^ω) by exact omegaPow_coind h
  rw [← mul_hmul, Language.sub_one_mul, ← Language.mul_sub_one, mul_hmul]
  refine le_hmul_congr ?_ ?_
  · apply le_refl
  · apply omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow'

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.hmul_omegaPow_eq_omegaPow
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem hmul_omegaPow_eq_omegaPow [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) : l * l^ω = l^ω
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply hmul_omegaPow_le_omegaPow
  · apply omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaPow_le_kstar_omegaPow
statement: theorem omegaPow_le_kstar_omegaPow [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) : l^ω ≤ (l∗)^ω
proof:
:= by
  simp [le_omegaPow_congr]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.kstar_omegaPow_le_omegaPow
statement: theorem kstar_omegaPow_le_omegaPow [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) : (l∗)^ω ≤ l^ω
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : (l∗)^ω ≤ (l - 1) * (l∗)^ω by exact omegaPow_coind h
  calc
    _ ≤ (l∗ - 1) * (l∗)^ω := omegaPow_le_hmul_omegaPow' _
    _ = (l - 1) * l∗ * (l∗)^ω := by simp [Language.kstar_sub_one]
    _ = (l - 1) * (l∗ * (l∗)^ω) := mul_hmul
    _ = _ := by simp

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.kstar_omegaPow_eq_omegaPow
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem kstar_omegaPow_eq_omegaPow [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) : (l∗)^ω = l^ω
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply kstar_omegaPow_le_omegaPow
  · apply omegaPow_le_kstar_omegaPow

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.kstar_hmul_omegaPow_eq_omegaPow
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem kstar_hmul_omegaPow_eq_omegaPow [Inhabited α] (l : Language α) : l∗ * l^ω = l^ω
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = l∗ * (l∗)^ω := by simp
    _ = (l∗)^ω := by rw [hmul_omegaPow_eq_omegaPow]
    _ = _ := by simp

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.omegaLim_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem omegaLim_zero : (0 : Language α)↗ω = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [omegaLim_def, bot_def]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.map_id
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem map_id (p : ωLanguage α) : map id p = p
proof:
:= by
  unfold map
  change { toSet := id '' p.toSet } = p
  simp

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.map_map
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem map_map (g : β → γ) (f : α → β) (p : ωLanguage α) : map g (map f p) = map (g ∘ f) p
proof:
:= by
  simp [map, image_image]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.isRegular_iff
statement:
theorem isRegular_iff {p : ωLanguage Symbol} :
    p.IsRegular ↔ ∃ (σ : Type v) (_ : Finite σ) (na : NA.Buchi σ Symbol), language na = p
proof:
:=
  ⟨isRegular_iff.helper, isRegular_iff.helper⟩

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.of_da_buchi
statement:
theorem IsRegular.of_da_buchi {State : Type} [Finite State] (da : DA.Buchi State Symbol) :
    (language da).IsRegular
proof:
:=
  ⟨State, inferInstance, da.toNABuchi, DA.Buchi.toNABuchi_language_eq⟩

/
where the automaton is not even required to be finite-state. -/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.not_da_buchi
statement:
theorem IsRegular.not_da_buchi :
  ∃ (Symbol : Type) (p : ωLanguage Symbol), p.IsRegular ∧
    ¬ ∃ (State : Type) (da : DA.Buchi State Symbol), language da = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Fin 2, Example.eventuallyZero, ?_, ?_⟩
  · use Fin 2, inferInstance, Example.eventuallyZeroNa,
      Example.eventuallyZero_accepted_by_na_buchi
  · rintro ⟨State, ⟨da, acc⟩, _⟩
    have := Example.eventuallyZero_not_omegaLim
    grind [DA.buchi_eq_finAcc_omegaLim]

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.regular_omegaLim
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨State, _, ⟨da, acc⟩, rfl⟩ := Language.IsRegular.iff_dfa.mp h
  grind [IsRegular.of_da_buchi, =_ DA.buchi_eq_finAcc_omegaLim]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.bot : (⊥ : ωLanguage Symbol).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  let na : NA.Buchi Unit Symbol := {
    Tr _ _ _ := False
    start := ∅
    accept := ∅ }
  use Unit, inferInstance, na
  apply mem_ext
  intro xs
  simp [na, Accepts]

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.top : (⊤ : ωLanguage Symbol).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  let na : NA.Buchi Unit Symbol := {
    Tr _ _ _ := True
    start := univ
    accept := univ }
  use Unit, inferInstance, na
  apply mem_ext
  intro xs
  simp +instances only [na, NA.Buchi.instωAcceptor, mem_language, mem_univ,
    frequently_true_iff_neBot, atTop_neBot, and_true, mem_top, iff_true]
  use const ()
  grind [NA.Run]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.sup
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨State1, h_fin1, ⟨na1, acc1⟩, rfl⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨State2, h_fin1, ⟨na2, acc2⟩, rfl⟩ := h2
  let State : Fin 2 → Type
    | 0 => State1 | 1 => State2
  let na : (i : Fin 2) → NA (State i) Symbol
    | 0 => na1 | 1 => na2
  let acc : (i : Fin 2) → Set (State i)
    | 0 => acc1 | 1 => acc2
  have : ∀ i, Finite (State i) := by grind
  use (Σ i : Fin 2, State i), inferInstance, ⟨(NA.iSum na), (⋃ i, Sigma.mk i '' (acc i))⟩
  apply mem_ext
  intro xs
  simp only [iSum_language_eq, mem_sup, mem_language]
  rw [mem_iSup, Fin.exists_fin_two]
  rfl

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.inf
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨State1, h_fin1, ⟨na1, acc1⟩, rfl⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨State2, h_fin1, ⟨na2, acc2⟩, rfl⟩ := h2
  let State : Bool → Type
    | false => State1 | true => State2
  let na : (i : Bool) → NA (State i) Symbol
    | false => na1 | true => na2
  let acc : (i : Bool) → Set (State i)
    | false => acc1 | true => acc2
  have : ∀ i, Finite (State i) := by grind
  use (Π i : Bool, State i) × Bool, inferInstance, ⟨(interNA na acc), interAccept acc⟩
  apply mem_ext
  intro xs
  simp only [inter_language_eq, mem_inf, mem_language]
  rw [mem_iInf, Bool.forall_bool]
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.iSup
proof:
:= by
  generalize h_n : s.ncard = n
  induction n generalizing s
  case zero =>
    have := ncard_eq_zero (s := s)
    grind [IsRegular.bot, iSup_bot]
  case succ n h_ind =>
    obtain ⟨i, t, h_i, rfl, rfl⟩ := (ncard_eq_succ).mp h_n
    rw [iSup_insert]
    grind [IsRegular.sup]

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.iInf
proof:
:= by
  generalize h_n : s.ncard = n
  induction n generalizing s
  case zero =>
    have := ncard_eq_zero (s := s)
    grind [IsRegular.top, iInf_top]
  case succ n h_ind =>
    obtain ⟨i, t, h_i, rfl, rfl⟩ := (ncard_eq_succ).mp h_n
    rw [iInf_insert]
    grind [IsRegular.inf]

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.hmul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨State1, h_fin1, ⟨na1, acc1⟩, rfl⟩ := Language.IsRegular.iff_nfa.mp h1
  obtain ⟨State2, h_fin1, ⟨na2, acc2⟩, rfl⟩ := h2
  use State1 ⊕ State2, inferInstance, ⟨NA.concat ⟨na1, acc1⟩ na2, inr '' acc2⟩
  exact NA.Buchi.concat_language_eq

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.omegaPow
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨State, h_fin, na, rfl⟩ := Language.IsRegular.iff_nfa.mp h
  use Unit ⊕ State, inferInstance, ⟨na.loop, {inl ()}⟩
  exact NA.Buchi.loop_language_eq

/
where all `L`s and `M`s are regular languages. -/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.eq_fin_iSup_hmul_omegaPow
statement:
theorem IsRegular.eq_fin_iSup_hmul_omegaPow [Inhabited Symbol] (p : ωLanguage Symbol) :
    p.IsRegular ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ l m : Fin n → Language Symbol,
      (∀ i, (l i).IsRegular ∧ (m i).IsRegular) ∧ p = ⨆ i, (l i) * (m i)^ω
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨State, _, na, rfl⟩
    rw [NA.Buchi.language_eq_fin_iSup_hmul_omegaPow na]
    have eq_start := Finite.equivFin ↑na.start
    have eq_accept := Finite.equivFin ↑na.accept
    have eq_prod := eq_start.prodCongr eq_accept
    have eq := (eq_prod.trans finProdFinEquiv).symm
    refine ⟨Nat.card ↑na.start * Nat.card ↑na.accept,
      fun i ↦ na.pairLang (eq i).1 (eq i).2,
      fun i ↦ na.pairLang (eq i).2 (eq i).2,
      by grind [LTS.pairLang_regular], ?_⟩
    apply mem_ext
    intro xs
    simp only [mem_iSup]
    refine ⟨?_, by grind⟩
    rintro ⟨s, h_s, t, h_t, h_mem⟩
    use eq.invFun (⟨s, h_s⟩, ⟨t, h_t⟩)
    have := Equiv.apply_symm_apply eq
    simp_all
  · rintro ⟨n, l, m, _, rfl⟩
    rw [← iSup_univ]
    apply IsRegular.iSup
    grind [IsRegular.hmul, IsRegular.omegaPow]

/
then it is an ω-regular language. -/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.fin_cover_saturates
statement:
theorem IsRegular.fin_cover_saturates {I : Type*} [Finite I]
    {p : I → ωLanguage Symbol} {q : ωLanguage Symbol}
    (hs : Saturates (fun i ↦ (p i).toSet) q.toSet)
    (hc : ⨆ i, p i = ⊤) (hr : ∀ i, (p i).IsRegular) : q.IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  suffices hu : q = ⨆ i ∈ {i | ((p i) ⊓ q).toSet.Nonempty}, (p i) by
    rw [hu]
    apply IsRegular.iSup
    grind
  have hc' : ⋃ i, (p i).toSet = univ := by grind [iSup_def, top_def]
  have hq := saturates_eq_biUnion hs hc'
  ext : 1
  rw [hq]
  simp [iSup_def, inf_def]

/
then its complement is an ω-regular language. -/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.fin_cover_saturates_compl
statement:
theorem IsRegular.fin_cover_saturates_compl {I : Type*} [Finite I]
    {p : I → ωLanguage Symbol} {q : ωLanguage Symbol}
    (hs : Saturates (fun i ↦ (p i).toSet) q.toSet)
    (hc : ⨆ i, p i = ⊤) (hr : ∀ i, (p i).IsRegular) : (qᶜ).IsRegular
proof:
:=
  IsRegular.fin_cover_saturates (saturates_compl hs) hc hr

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.IsRegular.compl
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨State, h_fin, na, rfl⟩ := h
  have : Finite (Quotient na.BuchiCongruence.eq) := buchiCongruence_fin_index
  have h_sat := buchiFamily_saturation (na := na)
  have h_cov := buchiFamily_cover (na := na)
  apply IsRegular.fin_cover_saturates_compl h_sat h_cov
  have := Language.IsRegular.congr_fin_index (c := na.BuchiCongruence)
  grind [buchiFamily, IsRegular.hmul, IsRegular.omegaPow]

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.iff_dfa
statement:
theorem IsRegular.iff_dfa {l : Language Symbol} :
    l.IsRegular ↔ ∃ State : Type, ∃ _ : Finite State,
      ∃ dfa : DA.FinAcc State Symbol, language dfa = l
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨State, h_fin, ⟨tr, start, acc⟩, rfl⟩
    let dfa := DA.FinAcc.mk {tr, start} acc
    use State, Fintype.finite h_fin, dfa
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨State, h_fin, ⟨⟨flts, start⟩, acc⟩, rfl⟩
    let dfa := DFA.mk flts.tr start acc
    use State, Fintype.ofFinite State, dfa
    rfl

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.iff_nfa
statement:
theorem IsRegular.iff_nfa {l : Language Symbol} :
    l.IsRegular ↔ ∃ State : Type, ∃ _ : Finite State,
      ∃ nfa : NA.FinAcc State Symbol, language nfa = l
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨State, h_fin, ⟨da, acc⟩, rfl⟩
    use State, h_fin, ⟨da.toNA, acc⟩
    grind
  · rintro ⟨State, _, na, rfl⟩
    use Set State, inferInstance, na.toDAFinAcc
    grind

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.compl
statement: theorem IsRegular.compl {l : Language Symbol} (h : l.IsRegular) : (lᶜ).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨State, _, ⟨da, acc⟩, rfl⟩ := h
  use State, inferInstance, ⟨da, accᶜ⟩
  #adaptation_note
  /
  ext
  simp only [language, Accepts]
  rfl

/
automaton with finitely many states. -/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.iff_twoWayNA
statement:
theorem IsRegular.iff_twoWayNA {l : Language Symbol} :
    l.IsRegular ↔ ∃ State : Type, ∃ _ : Finite State,
      ∃ a : TwoWayNA State Symbol, language a = l
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [IsRegular.iff_nfa] at h
    obtain ⟨State, hfin, na, rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨State, hfin, NA.FinAcc.toTwoWayNA na, TwoWayNA.language_toTwoWayNA na⟩
  · rintro ⟨State, hfin, a, rfl⟩
    have := hfin
    have hc : (language a)ᶜ.IsRegular := by
      rw [IsRegular.iff_nfa]
      exact ⟨Set State × Set State, inferInstance, a.complToNA, a.language_complToNA⟩
    simpa using hc.compl

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.zero : (0 : Language Symbol).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa]
  let flts := FLTS.mk (fun () (_ : Symbol) ↦ ())
  use Unit, inferInstance, ⟨DA.mk flts (), ∅⟩
  #adaptation_note
  /
  ext
  simp only [language, Accepts]
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.one : (1 : Language Symbol).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa]
  let flts := FLTS.mk (fun (_ : Fin 2) (_ : Symbol) ↦ 1)
  use Fin 2, inferInstance, ⟨DA.mk flts 0, {0}⟩
  ext; constructor
  #adaptation_note
  /
  · intro h; by_contra h'
    have := dropLast_append_getLast h'
    grind [Accepts]
  · grind [Accepts, Language.mem_one]

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.top : (⊤ : Language Symbol).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  have : (⊥ᶜ : Language Symbol).IsRegular := IsRegular.compl <| IsRegular.zero
  rwa [← compl_bot]

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.inf
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa] at h1 h2 ⊢
  obtain ⟨State1, h_fin1, ⟨da1, acc1⟩, rfl⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨State2, h_fin1, ⟨da2, acc2⟩, rfl⟩ := h2
  use State1 × State2, inferInstance, ⟨da1.prod da2, fst ⁻¹' acc1 ∩ snd ⁻¹' acc2⟩
  #adaptation_note
  /
  ext; grind [Accepts, Language.mem_inf]

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.add
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa] at h1 h2 ⊢
  obtain ⟨State1, h_fin1, ⟨da1, acc1⟩, rfl⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨State2, h_fin1, ⟨da2, acc2⟩, rfl⟩ := h2
  use State1 × State2, inferInstance, ⟨da1.prod da2, fst ⁻¹' acc1 ∪ snd ⁻¹' acc2⟩
  #adaptation_note
  /
  ext; grind [Accepts, Language.mem_add]

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.iInf
proof:
:= by
  generalize h_n : s.ncard = n
  induction n generalizing s
  case zero => simp_all [ncard_eq_zero (s := s)]
  case succ n h_ind =>
    obtain ⟨i, t, h_i, rfl, rfl⟩ := (ncard_eq_succ (s := s)).mp h_n
    rw [iInf_insert]
    grind [IsRegular.inf]

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.iSup
proof:
:= by
  generalize h_n : s.ncard = n
  induction n generalizing s
  case zero =>
    obtain ⟨rfl⟩ := (ncard_eq_zero (s := s)).mp h_n
    simp only [mem_empty_iff_false, not_false_eq_true, iSup_neg, iSup_bot]
    exact IsRegular.zero
  case succ n h_ind =>
    obtain ⟨i, t, h_i, rfl, rfl⟩ := (ncard_eq_succ (s := s)).mp h_n
    rw [iSup_insert]
    apply IsRegular.add <;> grind

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain (he | hne) := isEmpty_or_nonempty Symbol
  · obtain (rfl | rfl) := Language.eq_zero_or_one_ofIsEmpty l1 <;>
    obtain (rfl | rfl) := Language.eq_zero_or_one_ofIsEmpty l2 <;> simp
  · have := Classical.inhabited_of_nonempty hne
    rw [IsRegular.iff_nfa] at h1 h2 ⊢
    obtain ⟨State1, h_fin1, nfa1, rfl⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨State2, h_fin1, nfa2, rfl⟩ := h2
    use Option State1 ⊕ Option State2, inferInstance,
      ⟨finConcat nfa1 nfa2, inr '' (some '' nfa2.accept)⟩
    exact finConcat_language_eq

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.kstar
proof:
:= by
  obtain (he | hne) := isEmpty_or_nonempty Symbol
  · obtain (rfl | rfl) := Language.eq_zero_or_one_ofIsEmpty l <;> simp
  · have := Classical.inhabited_of_nonempty hne
    by_cases h_l : l = 0
    · simp [h_l]
    · rw [IsRegular.iff_nfa] at h ⊢
      obtain ⟨State, h_fin, nfa, rfl⟩ := h
      use Unit ⊕ Option State, inferInstance, ⟨finLoop nfa, {inl ()}⟩, loop_language_eq h_l

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.congr_fin_index
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.congr_fin_index {Symbol : Type}
    [c : RightCongruence Symbol] [Finite (Quotient c.eq)]
    (a : Quotient c.eq) : (eqvCls a).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa]
  use Quotient c.eq, inferInstance, ⟨c.toDA, {a}⟩
  exact DA.FinAcc.congr_language_eq

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.reverse
statement: theorem IsRegular.reverse {l : Language Symbol} (h : l.IsRegular) : l.reverse.IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_nfa] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨State, h_fin, nfa, rfl⟩ := h
  use State, inferInstance, nfa.reverse, nfa.reverse_language_eq

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.reverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.reverse_iff {l : Language Symbol} : l.reverse.IsRegular ↔ l.IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using IsRegular.reverse h
  · exact IsRegular.reverse

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.preimage
statement:
theorem IsRegular.preimage (f : Hom Symbol' Symbol) {l : Language Symbol} (h : l.IsRegular) :
    (l.preimage f).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_nfa] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨State, h_fin, nfa, rfl⟩ := h
  use State, inferInstance, nfa.preimage f, nfa.preimage_language_eq f

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.char
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRegular.char (a : Symbol) : ({[a]} : Language Symbol).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRegular.iff_dfa]
  classical
  let flts := FLTS.mk (fun (s : Fin 3) (x : Symbol) ↦ if (s = 0 ∧ x = a) then 1 else 2)
  have h_eq1 (s : Fin 3) (x : Symbol) : flts.tr s x = 1 ↔ s = 0 ∧ x = a := by grind
  have h_ne_0 (s : Fin 3) (x : Symbol) : flts.tr s x ≠ 0 := by grind
  use Fin 3, inferInstance, ⟨DA.mk flts 0, {1}⟩
  ext xs
  induction xs using List.reverseRec with
  | nil => grind [Accepts, Language.mem_singleton]
  | append_singleton xs x ih =>
    obtain (rfl | ⟨xs, x, rfl⟩) : xs = [] ∨ ∃ xs' x, xs = xs' ++ [x] := xs.eq_nil_or_concat'
    · simp [Accepts, flts, FLTS.mtr]
    · simp_rw [Language.mem_singleton, mem_language, Accepts, FLTS.mtr_concat_eq,
        Set.mem_singleton_iff, h_eq1, h_ne_0, false_and, append_assoc, false_iff]
      intro h
      simpa using congr(List.length $h)

/

name: Cslib.Language.IsRegular.regex
statement:
theorem IsRegular.regex {r : RegularExpression Symbol} :
    r.matches'.IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | epsilon => simp
  | char a => simp [IsRegular.char a]
  | plus P Q hP hQ => grind [RegularExpression.matches', IsRegular.add]
  | comp P Q hP hQ => grind [RegularExpression.matches', IsRegular.mul]
  | star P hP => grind [RegularExpression.matches', IsRegular.kstar]

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.isSafety_iff
statement:
theorem isSafety_iff (p : ωLanguage α) :
    p.IsSafety ↔ ∀ xs, xs ∉ p → ∃ n, ∀ ys, (xs.take n) ++ω ys ∉ p
proof:
:= by
  simp [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff, mem_def]

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.isLiveness_iff
statement:
theorem isLiveness_iff (p : ωLanguage α) :
    p.IsLiveness ↔ ∀ (xs : ωSequence α) (n : ℕ), ∃ ys, (xs.take n) ++ω ys ∈ p
proof:
:= by
  exact dense_iff p.toSet

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.isSafety_closure
statement:
theorem isSafety_closure (p : ωLanguage α) :
    p.closure.IsSafety
proof:
:= by
  exact isClosed_closure

/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.isLiveness_sup_compl_closure
statement:
theorem isLiveness_sup_compl_closure (p : ωLanguage α) :
    (p ⊔ p.closureᶜ).IsLiveness
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sup_def, closure, compl_def, dense_iff_closure_eq, closure_union,
    ← compl_subset_iff_union, subset_closure]

/
a liveness property (namely, `p ⊔ p.closureᶜ`). -/

name: Cslib.ωLanguage.exists_safetyLivenessDecomposition
statement:
theorem exists_safetyLivenessDecomposition (p : ωLanguage α) :
    ∃ q r : ωLanguage α, q.IsSafety ∧ r.IsLiveness ∧ p = q ⊓ r
proof:
:= by
  use p.closure, p ⊔ p.closureᶜ
  split_ands
  · exact isSafety_closure p
  · exact isLiveness_sup_compl_closure p
  · simp [ωLanguage.ext_iff, sup_def, closure, compl_def, inf_def,
      inter_union_distrib_left, subset_closure]

name: Language.slice_eq_true_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem slice_eq_true_iff {L : Language α} {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → α} :
    L.slice n x = true ↔ List.ofFn x ∈ L

name: Language.mem_ofSlices
statement:
theorem mem_ofSlices {f : ∀ n, (Fin n → α) → Bool} {w : List α} :
    w ∈ ofSlices f ↔ f w.length (w[·])
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Language.ofFn_mem_ofSlices
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofFn_mem_ofSlices {f : ∀ n, (Fin n → α) → Bool} {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → α} :
    .ofFn x ∈ ofSlices f ↔ f n x
proof:
:= by
  congrm f $List.length_ofFn $((Fin.heq_fun_iff List.length_ofFn).mpr ?_)
  simp

name: Language.slice_ofSlices
statement:
@[simp] theorem slice_ofSlices (f : ∀ n, (Fin n → α) → Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    (ofSlices f).slice n = f n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, slice_eq_true_iff, ofFn_mem_ofSlices]

name: Language.IsRegular.iff_finite_syntacticMonoid
statement:
theorem IsRegular.iff_finite_syntacticMonoid (l : Language α) :
    l.IsRegular ↔ Finite (l.SyntacticMonoid)
proof:
:=
  IsRegular.iff_finite_myhillQuotient l

/

name: Language.homSyntacticMonoid_iff_myhillCongruence
statement:
theorem homSyntacticMonoid_iff_myhillCongruence {l : Language α} {x y : List α} :
    l.homSyntacticMonoid (ofList x) = l.homSyntacticMonoid (ofList y) ↔
    l.MyhillCongruence.eq x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Con.coe_mk', Con.eq]
  rfl

/
under a monoid homomorphism from the free monoid on its alphabet to `M`. -/

name: Language.IsRegular.exists_finite_monoid
statement:
theorem IsRegular.exists_finite_monoid {l : Language α} (h : l.IsRegular) :
    ∃ M : Type, ∃ _ : Monoid M, ∃ _ : Finite M, ∃ f : FreeMonoid α →* M, ∃ s : Set M,
    (f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' s = l
proof:
:= by
  use l.SyntacticMonoid, Con.monoid _, (iff_finite_syntacticMonoid l).mp h,
    l.homSyntacticMonoid, (l.homSyntacticMonoid ∘ ofList) '' l
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨y, hy, heq⟩
    have heq := homSyntacticMonoid_iff_myhillCongruence.mp heq
    specialize heq [] []
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil] at heq
    exact heq.mp hy
  · exact Set.subset_preimage_image _ _

name: Language.inducedCongr_ofList
statement:
theorem inducedCongr_ofList (x : List α) :
    (f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' {(f ∘ ofList) x} = (inducedCongr f).eqvCls ⟦ x ⟧
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp [Quotient.eq]

/
from the free monoid to `M` is regular. -/

name: Language.IsRegular.of_finite_monoid_singleton
statement:
theorem IsRegular.of_finite_monoid_singleton [Finite M]
    (m : M) : IsRegular ((f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' {m})
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' {m} = ∅
  · rw [h]
    exact IsRegular.zero
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr h
    rw [inducedCongr_ofList]
    exact IsRegular.congr_fin_index (c := inducedCongr f) _

/
from the free monoid to `M` is regular. -/

name: Language.IsRegular.of_finite_monoid
statement:
theorem IsRegular.of_finite_monoid [Finite M]
    (s : Set M) : IsRegular ((f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' s = ⨆ m ∈ s, (f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' {m} := by
    simp only [Set.iSup_eq_iUnion, Set.biUnion_preimage_singleton]
  rw [h]
  apply IsRegular.iSup
  simp [IsRegular.of_finite_monoid_singleton]

name: Language.IsRegular.iff_finite_monoid
statement:
theorem IsRegular.iff_finite_monoid {l : Language α} :
    l.IsRegular ↔
    ∃ M : Type, ∃ _ : Monoid M, ∃ _ : Finite M, ∃ f : FreeMonoid α →* M, ∃ s : Set M,
    (f ∘ ofList) ⁻¹' s = l
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  case mp =>
    intro h
    exact IsRegular.exists_finite_monoid h
  case mpr =>
    rintro ⟨M, _, _, f, s, rfl⟩
    exact IsRegular.of_finite_monoid f s

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.mem_encPrefixes
statement:
lemma mem_encPrefixes {p : List Bool} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ S) (h : p <+: encIn a) :
    p ∈ encPrefixes encIn S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [encPrefixes, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_biUnion, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_inits]
  exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, h⟩

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.prefix_mem_encPrefixes
statement:
lemma prefix_mem_encPrefixes {p q : List Bool} (h : p ∈ encPrefixes encIn S) (hq : q <+: p) :
    q ∈ encPrefixes encIn S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [encPrefixes, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_biUnion, List.mem_toFinset,
    List.mem_inits] at h ⊢
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨a, ha, hp⟩
  · exact Or.inl (List.prefix_nil.mp hq)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, hq.trans hp⟩

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.suffix_out_mem_outSuffixes
statement:
lemma suffix_out_mem_outSuffixes {w : List Bool} (h : w <:+ out) :
    w ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out
proof:
:= by
  simp only [outSuffixes, Finset.mem_union, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_tails]
  exact Or.inl h

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.mem_outSuffixes
statement:
lemma mem_outSuffixes {w : List Bool} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ S) (h : w <:+ encOut (f a)) :
    w ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out
proof:
:= by
  simp only [outSuffixes, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_tails]
  exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, h⟩

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.suffix_mem_outSuffixes
statement:
lemma suffix_mem_outSuffixes {v w : List Bool} (h : w ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out) (hv : v <:+ w) :
    v ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out
proof:
:= by
  simp only [outSuffixes, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion, List.mem_toFinset,
    List.mem_tails] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | ⟨a, ha, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl (hv.trans h)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, hv.trans h⟩

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.tail_mem_outSuffixes
statement:
lemma tail_mem_outSuffixes {w : List Bool} (h : w ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out) :
    w.tail ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out
proof:
:=
  suffix_mem_outSuffixes h (List.tail_suffix w)

/
among the suffixes. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encOut_mem_outSuffixes
statement:
lemma encOut_mem_outSuffixes (h : ∀ a ∉ S, encOut (f a) = out) (a : α) :
    encOut (f a) ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a ∈ S
  · exact mem_outSuffixes ha (List.suffix_refl _)
  · rw [h a ha]
    exact suffix_out_mem_outSuffixes (List.suffix_refl _)

/
part of the output that still has to be emitted. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encodedFun_enc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma encodedFun_enc {a : α} (ha : a ∈ S) :
    encodedFun encIn encOut f S out (encIn a) = encOut (f a)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ a' ∈ S, encIn a' = encIn a := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rw [encodedFun, dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hex), encIn.injective hex.choose_spec.2]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encodedFun_enc_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp]
lemma encodedFun_enc_of_notMem {a : α} (ha : a ∉ S) :
    encodedFun encIn encOut f S out (encIn a) = out
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ¬ ∃ a' ∈ S, encIn a' = encIn a := by
    rintro ⟨a', ha', h⟩
    exact ha (encIn.injective h ▸ ha')
  rw [encodedFun, dite_eq_right_of_eq_false (eq_false hex)]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encodedFun_mem_outSuffixes
statement:
lemma encodedFun_mem_outSuffixes (p : List Bool) :
    encodedFun encIn encOut f S out p ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out
proof:
:= by
  rw [encodedFun]
  split
  · next h => exact mem_outSuffixes h.choose_spec.1 (List.suffix_refl _)
  · exact suffix_out_mem_outSuffixes (List.suffix_refl _)

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_read
statement:
lemma runFrom_read (a : α) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ (encIn a).length)
    (hmem : (encIn a).take j ∈ encPrefixes encIn S) :
    (almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out).runFrom
        ((almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out).initCfg (encIn a)) j =
      { state := some (Sum.inl ⟨(encIn a).take j, hmem⟩),
        inputPos := ⟨1 + j, by omega⟩,
        workTapes := fun _ _ => none,
        workTapePos := fun _ => 0,
        output := [] }
proof:
:= by
  simp only [runFrom]
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, initCfg, List.take_zero]
    ext <;> simp [almostConstTM]
  | succ j ih =>
    have hprefix : (encIn a).take j <+: (encIn a).take (j + 1) := by
      simp
    have hmem' : (encIn a).take j ∈ encPrefixes encIn S := prefix_mem_encPrefixes hmem hprefix
    have hcat : (encIn a).take j ++ [(encIn a)[j]] ∈ encPrefixes encIn S := by
      grind [List.take_concat_get']
    have hmove : moveInputPos (⟨1 + j, by omega⟩ : Fin ((encIn a).length + 2)) SignType.pos
        = ⟨1 + (j + 1), by omega⟩ := by
      grind [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right]
    have hstart : 1 + j ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hend : 1 + j ≠ (encIn a).length + 1 := by omega
    have hprev : 1 + j - 1 = j := by omega
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega) hmem']
    simp only [step, Action.apply, almostConstTM, Cfg.inputSymbol, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero,
      hstart, hend, hprev, reduceDIte, hcat]
    exact Cfg.ext_zero_tapes (by grind [List.take_concat_get']) hmove (by simp)

/
configuration that is about to emit `w`. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_write
statement:
lemma runFrom_write {input : List Bool} (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Bool)
    {w : List Bool} (hw : w ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ w.length) :
    (almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out).runFrom
        { state := some (Sum.inr ⟨w, hw⟩), inputPos := pos, workTapes := fun _ _ => none,
          workTapePos := fun _ => 0, output := o } i =
      { state := some (Sum.inr ⟨w.drop i, suffix_mem_outSuffixes hw (w.drop_suffix i)⟩),
        inputPos := pos,
        workTapes := fun _ _ => none,
        workTapePos := fun _ => 0,
        output := o ++ w.take i }
proof:
:= by
  simp only [runFrom]
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    have hilt : i < w.length := by omega
    have htake := List.take_concat_get' w i hilt
    have hnotdone : ¬ (w.length ≤ i) := by omega
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega)]
    simp only [step, Action.apply, almostConstTM, List.head?_drop,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem hilt, List.drop_eq_nil_iff, hnotdone, reduceIte, List.tail_drop,
      moveInputPos_zero, Option.toList_some]
    exact Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl rfl (by grind)

/
steps, having emitted `w`. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_write_halted
statement:
lemma runFrom_write_halted {input : List Bool} (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Bool)
    {w : List Bool} (hw : w ∈ outSuffixes encOut f S out) :
    (almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out).runFrom
        { state := some (Sum.inr ⟨w, hw⟩), inputPos := pos, workTapes := fun _ _ => none,
          workTapePos := fun _ => 0, output := o } (w.length + 1) =
      { state := none,
        inputPos := pos,
        workTapes := fun _ _ => none,
        workTapePos := fun _ => 0,
        output := o ++ w }
proof:
:= by
  rw [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← runFrom, runFrom_write pos o hw le_rfl]
  simp only [step, Action.apply, almostConstTM, List.drop_length, reduceIte, List.head?_nil,
    moveInputPos_zero, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil, List.take_length]
  exact Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl rfl (by simp)

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.length_le_sup_of_mem_encPrefixes
statement:
lemma length_le_sup_of_mem_encPrefixes {p : List Bool} (h : p ∈ encPrefixes encIn S) :
    p.length ≤ S.sup fun a => (encIn a).length + (encOut (f a)).length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [encPrefixes, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_biUnion, List.mem_toFinset,
    List.mem_inits] at h
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨a, ha, hp⟩
  · simp
  · have hsup : (encIn a).length + (encOut (f a)).length ≤
        S.sup fun a => (encIn a).length + (encOut (f a)).length :=
      Finset.le_sup (f := fun a => (encIn a).length + (encOut (f a)).length) ha
    have := hp.length_le
    omega

/
of steps that is bounded independently of the input. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.reaches_write
statement:
lemma reaches_write (h : ∀ a ∉ S, encOut (f a) = out) (a : α) :
    ∃ (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ (encIn a).length),
      j + (encOut (f a)).length ≤
        out.length + S.sup (fun a => (encIn a).length + (encOut (f a)).length) ∧
      (almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out).runFrom
          ((almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out).initCfg (encIn a)) (j + 1) =
        { state := some (Sum.inr ⟨encOut (f a), encOut_mem_outSuffixes h a⟩),
          inputPos := ⟨1 + j, by omega⟩,
          workTapes := fun _ _ => none,
          workTapePos := fun _ => 0,
          output := [] }
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set j := Nat.findGreatest (fun j => (encIn a).take j ∈ encPrefixes encIn S) (encIn a).length
    with hjdef
  have hmem : (encIn a).take j ∈ encPrefixes encIn S :=
    Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := fun j => (encIn a).take j ∈ encPrefixes encIn S)
      (Nat.zero_le _) (by simp [encPrefixes])
  have hjle : j ≤ (encIn a).length := Nat.findGreatest_le _
  have hjsup : j ≤ S.sup fun a => (encIn a).length + (encOut (f a)).length := by
    have hlen := length_le_sup_of_mem_encPrefixes (encOut := encOut) (f := f) hmem
    rw [List.length_take] at hlen
    omega
  use j, hjle
  constructor
  · by_cases ha : a ∈ S
    · grind [Finset.le_sup (f := fun a => (encIn a).length + (encOut (f a)).length) ha]
    · grind [h a ha]
  rw [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← runFrom, runFrom_read a hjle hmem]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hjle with heq | hlt
  ·
    have hend : 1 + j = (encIn a).length + 1 := by omega
    have hdec : encodedFun encIn encOut f S out ((encIn a).take j) = encOut (f a) := by
      rw [heq, List.take_length]
      by_cases ha : a ∈ S
      · exact encodedFun_enc ha
      · rw [encodedFun_enc_of_notMem ha, h a ha]
    simp only [step, almostConstTM, Cfg.inputSymbol, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero, hend,
      reduceDIte, dite_eq_ite, ite_self, hdec]
    exact Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl (by simp) (by simp)
  ·
    have hend : 1 + j ≠ (encIn a).length + 1 := by omega
    have hprev : 1 + j - 1 = j := by omega
    have hnotmem : (encIn a).take (j + 1) ∉ encPrefixes encIn S :=
      Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest (hjdef ▸ Nat.lt_succ_self j) (by omega)
    have hcat : (encIn a).take j ++ [(encIn a)[j]] ∉ encPrefixes encIn S := by
      grind [List.take_concat_get']
    have ha : a ∉ S := fun ha => hnotmem (mem_encPrefixes ha ((encIn a).take_prefix _))
    have hstart : 1 + j ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp only [step, Action.apply, almostConstTM, Cfg.inputSymbol, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero,
      hstart, hend, hprev, reduceDIte, hcat, moveInputPos_zero]
    refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes ?_ (by simp) (by simp)
    simp only [Option.some.injEq, Sum.inr.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq]
    exact (h a ha).symm

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.computesFunInTimeAndSpace_almostConstTM
statement:
lemma computesFunInTimeAndSpace_almostConstTM (h : ∀ a ∉ S, encOut (f a) = out) :
    ComputesFunInTimeAndSpace (almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out) encIn encOut f
      (fun _ => almostConstTime encIn encOut f S out) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨j, hjle, hj, hrun⟩ := reaches_write (encIn := encIn) h a
  use j + 1 + ((encOut (f a)).length + 1)
  refine ⟨?_, 0, le_rfl, ?_⟩
  · change j + 1 + ((encOut (f a)).length + 1) ≤ almostConstTime encIn encOut f S out
    rw [almostConstTime]
    omega
  · unfold ComputesInTimeAndSpace
    simp only [runFrom] at hrun ⊢
    rw [Nat.add_comm (j + 1), Function.iterate_add_apply, hrun, ← runFrom, runFrom_write_halted]
    simp

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInTimeAndSpace_almostConstTime
statement:
theorem computableInTimeAndSpace_almostConstTime
    (f : α → β) (S : Finset α) (out : List Bool) (h : ∀ a ∉ S, encOut (f a) = out) :
    ComputableInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut
      (fun _ => almostConstTime encIn encOut f S out) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, AlmostConstState encIn encOut f S out, inferInstance, almostConstTM encIn encOut f S out,
    computesFunInTimeAndSpace_almostConstTM h⟩

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInTimeAndSpace_of_exists_finite_ne
statement:
theorem computableInTimeAndSpace_of_exists_finite_ne
    {f : α → β} (h : ∃ b : β, {a : α | f a ≠ b}.Finite) :
    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut (fun _ => c) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h
  refine ⟨_, computableInTimeAndSpace_almostConstTime f hb.toFinset (encOut b) ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_not] at ha
  rw [ha]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInTimeAndSpace_of_const
statement:
theorem computableInTimeAndSpace_of_const {α β : Type*}
    {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} (b : β) :
    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace (Function.const α b) encIn encOut
      (fun _ => c) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:=
  computableInTimeAndSpace_of_exists_finite_ne ⟨b, by simp⟩

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableInTimeAndSpace_finiteFunTime
statement:
theorem computableInTimeAndSpace_finiteFunTime {α β : Type*} [Finite α]
    {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} (f : α → β) :
    ComputableInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut
      (fun _ => finiteFunTime encIn encOut f) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:=
  computableInTimeAndSpace_almostConstTime f (@Finset.univ α (Fintype.ofFinite α)) []
    fun a ha => absurd (@Finset.mem_univ α (Fintype.ofFinite α) a) ha

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.Copy.step_scan
statement:
lemma step_scan {n : ℕ} (hn : n < input.length) :
    copy.step (cfg input (some ()) n) = cfg input (some ()) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : (cfg input (some ()) n).inputSymbol = some input[n] :=
    inputSymbolInner n (by simp [cfg]; omega) hn
  rw [step_apply_of_state rfl, hsym]
  apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes (by rfl)
  · simp [cfg, copy, moveInputPos]
    grind
  · simp only [cfg, copy, Action.apply, Option.toList_some]
    grind [List.take_add_one]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.Copy.step_halt
statement:

    copy.step (cfg input (some ()) input.length) = cfg input none input.length
proof:

  have hsym : (cfg input (some ()) input.length).inputSymbol = none :=
    inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (Or.inr (by simp [cfg]))
  rw [step_apply_of_state rfl, hsym]
  apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes <;> simp [cfg, copy, Action.apply]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.Copy.runFrom_scan
statement:
lemma runFrom_scan (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ input.length) :
    copy.runFrom (copy.initCfg input) n = cfg input (some ()) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl rfl rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← runFrom, ih (by omega), step_scan (by omega)]

copied to the output. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.Copy.runFrom_full
statement:

    copy.runFrom (copy.initCfg input) (input.length + 1) = cfg input none input.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← runFrom, runFrom_scan _ le_rfl, step_halt]

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.Copy.computesInTimeAndSpace
statement:

    ComputesInTimeAndSpace copy input input (input.length + 1) 0
proof:

    copy.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero _ _ rfl⟩

name: Turing.Storage.toBounded_injOn
statement:
lemma Storage.toBounded_injOn (w : Fin k → ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (Storage.toBounded (Symbol := Symbol) (State := State) · w) {x | x.FitsIn w}
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨_, _⟩ y ⟨_, _⟩ hxy
  simp only [Storage.toBounded, Prod.mk.injEq] at hxy
  obtain ⟨hstate, htapes, hpos⟩ := hxy
  apply Storage.ext hstate (funext₂ fun j z => ?_) (funext fun j => ?_)
  · by_cases hz : z ∈ window (w j)
    · exact congrFun (congrFun htapes j) ⟨z, hz⟩
    · grind
  · grind [congrFun hpos j]

/-! ## Counting storages

This section is purely combinatorial: it counts how many values a `Storage` restricted to given
windows can take, without reference to a machine or a run.
-/

/
at most `s` cells of total work-tape space, over the given alphabet and state set. The `(2s + 1)^k`
factor counts the possible head positions; the dominant factor `(|Symbol| + 1)^(2s + k)` uses the
*total* space `s` in the exponent (the `k` tapes share the space budget). -/

name: Turing.card_boundedStorage_le
statement:
lemma card_boundedStorage_le [Fintype Symbol] [Fintype State]
    {w : Fin k → ℕ} {s : ℕ} (hsum : ∑ i, w i ≤ s) :
    Fintype.card (BoundedStorage Symbol State w) ≤ storageBound Symbol State k s
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ i, w i ≤ s := fun i =>
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (w i)) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans hsum
  simp only [BoundedStorage, storageBound, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_option,
    Fintype.card_pi, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, card_window]
  rw [mul_comm (∏ i, (Fintype.card Symbol + 1) ^ (2 * w i + 1)), Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  have hsc : ∑ i : Fin k, (2 * w i + 1) = 2 * (∑ i, w i) + k := by
    simp [two_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  gcongr
  · simpa using Finset.prod_le_pow_card Finset.univ (fun i => 2 * w i + 1) (2 * s + 1)
      fun i _ => by have := hle i; omega
  · omega
  · omega

/
positions stay within per-tape windows of total size at most `s` can take at most
`storageBound Symbol State k s` different values. -/

name: Turing.encard_fitsIn_le
statement:
theorem encard_fitsIn_le [Fintype Symbol] [Fintype State]
    {w : Fin k → ℕ} {s : ℕ} (hsum : ∑ i, w i ≤ s) :
    {x : Storage Symbol State k | x.FitsIn w}.encard
      ≤ storageBound Symbol State k s
proof:
:= by
  calc {x : Storage Symbol State k | x.FitsIn w}.encard
      = ((Storage.toBounded · w) '' {x | x.FitsIn w}).encard :=
        ((Storage.toBounded_injOn w).encard_image).symm
    _ ≤ (Set.univ : Set (BoundedStorage Symbol State w)).encard :=
        Set.encard_le_encard (Set.subset_univ _)
    _ = Fintype.card (BoundedStorage Symbol State w) := by
        simp [Set.encard_univ, ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card]
    _ ≤ storageBound Symbol State k s := by
        exact_mod_cast card_boundedStorage_le hsum

/-! ### The exponential form of `storageBound`

This proves that `storageBound` is exponential in the space `s`.
 -/

/

name: Turing.storageBound_le_base_mul_pow
statement:
lemma storageBound_le_base_mul_pow [Fintype Symbol] [Fintype State] (s : ℕ) :
    storageBound Symbol State k s
      ≤ storageBoundBase Symbol State k * 2 ^ (storageBoundExp Symbol k * s)
proof:
:= by
  set syms := Fintype.card Symbol + 1 with hB
  set states := Fintype.card State + 1 with hQ




  have hB2 : syms ≤ 2 ^ syms := Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
  have h2s1 : 2 * s + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1) := by grind [pow_succ, Nat.lt_two_pow_self]
  calc storageBound Symbol State k s
      = states * ((2 * s + 1) ^ k * syms ^ (2 * s + k)) := rfl
    _ ≤ states * ((2 ^ (s + 1)) ^ k * (2 ^ syms) ^ (2 * s + k)) := by gcongr <;> omega
    _ = states * 2 ^ ((s + 1) * k + syms * (2 * s + k)) := by ring
    _ = states * 2 ^ ((syms * k + k) + (2 * syms + k) * s) := by ring_nf
    _ = states * 2 ^ (syms * k + k) * 2 ^ ((2 * syms + k) * s) := by ring

/
(depending on the machine's alphabet, state set and tape count) with
`storageBound Symbol State k s ≤ a * 2 ^ (c * s)` for all `s`. -/

name: Turing.storageBound_le_pow
statement:
lemma storageBound_le_pow [Fintype Symbol] [Fintype State] :
    ∃ a c : ℕ, ∀ s : ℕ, storageBound Symbol State k s ≤ a * 2 ^ (c * s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, _, storageBound_le_base_mul_pow⟩

/-! ## The storage and the core of a configuration

Now we relate `Cfg` and `Storage` by giving the projection.
-/

/
write-only output tape. -/

name: Turing.core_step_eq_of_core_eq
statement:
lemma core_step_eq_of_core_eq {c₁ c₂ : Cfg k Symbol State input} (h : c₁.core = c₂.core) :
    (tm.step c₁).core = (tm.step c₂).core
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Cfg.core, Cfg.storage, Prod.mk.injEq, Storage.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨hpos, hstate, hwt, hwp⟩ := h
  have hsym : c₁.inputSymbol = c₂.inputSymbol := by simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, hpos]
  have hws : c₁.workTapeSymbols = c₂.workTapeSymbols := by
    funext i
    simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hwt, hwp]
  simp only [Cfg.core, Cfg.storage, MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hsym, hws]
  cases c₂.state <;> simp [hpos, hstate, hwt, hwp]

/-! ## The storages and cores of a space-bounded run

These are the main results giving upper bounds on the number of storages and configuration cores
reachable in bounded space.
-/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.storage_fitsIn
statement:
lemma storage_fitsIn (t : ℕ) :
    (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).storage.FitsIn (tm.spaceUsedByTape (tm.initCfg input) t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro j
    simpa [Cfg.storage] using tm.natAbs_le_spaceUsedByTape_of_mem_visited
      (tm.mem_visitedByTapeHead_self (tm.initCfg input) t j)
  · intro j
    exact content_natAbs_le_spaceUsedByTape t

/
at most `storageBound Symbol State k s` different storages during its whole run — independently of
the length of the input and of how long it runs. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encard_storages_le
statement:
theorem encard_storages_le [Fintype Symbol] [Fintype State] {s : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ t, tm.spaceUsed (tm.initCfg input) t ≤ s) :
    (Set.range fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).storage).encard
      ≤ storageBound Symbol State k s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := tm.exists_spaceUsedByTape_max (tm.initCfg input) hs
  refine le_trans (Set.encard_le_encard ?_) (encard_fitsIn_le (hs T))
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  exact Storage.FitsIn_mono (fun i => hT t i) (tm.storage_fitsIn t)

/
`(n + 2) * storageBound Symbol State k s`, where `n` is the length of the input. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encard_cores_le
statement:
theorem encard_cores_le [Fintype Symbol] [Fintype State] {s : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ t, tm.spaceUsed (tm.initCfg input) t ≤ s) :
    (Set.range fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).core).encard
      ≤ (input.length + 2) * storageBound Symbol State k s
proof:
:= by
  calc (Set.range fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).core).encard
      ≤ ((Set.univ : Set (Fin (input.length + 2)))
          ×ˢ (Set.range fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).storage)).encard := by
        apply Set.encard_le_encard
        rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, t, rfl⟩
    _ = (Set.univ : Set (Fin (input.length + 2))).encard
          * (Set.range fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).storage).encard := Set.encard_prod
    _ ≤ (input.length + 2) * storageBound Symbol State k s := by
        refine mul_le_mul' ?_ (tm.encard_storages_le hs)
        simp [Set.encard_univ, ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card]

/
passes through is at most `2 ^ (O(s))`, with constants depending only on the machine. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encard_storages_le_pow
statement:
theorem encard_storages_le_pow [Finite Symbol] [Finite State] :
    ∃ a c : ℕ, ∀ (input : List Symbol) (s : ℕ),
      (∀ t, tm.spaceUsed (tm.initCfg input) t ≤ s) →
      (Set.range fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).storage).encard ≤ a * 2 ^ (c * s)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype Symbol := Fintype.ofFinite Symbol
  have : Fintype State := Fintype.ofFinite State
  obtain ⟨a, c, hpow⟩ := storageBound_le_pow (Symbol := Symbol) (State := State) (k := k)
  refine ⟨a, c, fun input s hs => (tm.encard_storages_le hs).trans ?_⟩
  exact_mod_cast hpow s

/
is at most `(n + 2) * 2 ^ (O(s))`, with constants depending only on the machine and not on the
input. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.encard_cores_le_pow
statement:
theorem encard_cores_le_pow [Finite Symbol] [Finite State] :
    ∃ a c : ℕ, ∀ (input : List Symbol) (s : ℕ),
      (∀ t, tm.spaceUsed (tm.initCfg input) t ≤ s) →
      (Set.range fun t => (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).core).encard
        ≤ (input.length + 2) * a * 2 ^ (c * s)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype Symbol := Fintype.ofFinite Symbol
  have : Fintype State := Fintype.ofFinite State
  obtain ⟨a, c, hpow⟩ := storageBound_le_pow (Symbol := Symbol) (State := State) (k := k)
  refine ⟨a, c, fun input s hs => (tm.encard_cores_le hs).trans ?_⟩
  calc ((input.length + 2) * storageBound Symbol State k s : ℕ∞)
      ≤ ((input.length + 2) * (a * 2 ^ (c * s)) : ℕ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hpow s)
    _ = (input.length + 2) * a * 2 ^ (c * s) := by push_cast; ring

name: Turing.Cfg.ext_zero_tapes
statement:
lemma Cfg.ext_zero_tapes {Symbol State : Type*} {input : List Symbol}
    {cfg₁ cfg₂ : Cfg 0 Symbol State input} (state : cfg₁.state = cfg₂.state)
    (inputPos : cfg₁.inputPos = cfg₂.inputPos) (output : cfg₁.output = cfg₂.output) :
    cfg₁ = cfg₂
proof:

  Cfg.ext state inputPos (funext fun i => i.elim0) (funext fun i => i.elim0) output

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt
statement:
@[simp]
lemma step_of_halt {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} (h : cfg.state = none) :
    tm.step cfg = cfg
proof:
:= by
  unfold step
  rw [h]

/
If the Turing machine halts, it will stay at the halting configuration. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_halt
statement:
lemma runFrom_eq_of_halt
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) {τ t : ℕ} (hle : τ ≤ t)
    (hhalt : (tm.runFrom cfg τ).state = none) :
    tm.runFrom cfg t = tm.runFrom cfg τ
proof:
:= by
  rw [runFrom, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel hle, Function.iterate_add_apply]
  exact Function.iterate_fixed (step_of_halt hhalt) _

/
halted after any smaller number of steps. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.HaltsAt.halted
statement: lemma halted (h : tm.HaltsAt cfg t) : (tm.runFrom cfg t).Halted

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.HaltsAt.not_halted
statement: lemma not_halted (h : tm.HaltsAt cfg t) (hs : s < t) : ¬(tm.runFrom cfg s).Halted
proof:
:= h.2 s hs

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.HaltsAt.le_of_halted
statement: lemma le_of_halted (h : tm.HaltsAt cfg t) (hs : (tm.runFrom cfg s).Halted) : t ≤ s
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hlt => h.not_halted hlt hs

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.HaltsAt.unique
statement: lemma unique (h₁ : tm.HaltsAt cfg s) (h₂ : tm.HaltsAt cfg t) : s = t
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_antisymm (h₁.le_of_halted h₂.halted) (h₂.le_of_halted h₁.halted)

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.HaltsAt.runFrom_eq
statement: lemma runFrom_eq (h : tm.HaltsAt cfg t) (hts : t ≤ s) : tm.runFrom cfg s = tm.runFrom cfg t
proof:
:=
  runFrom_eq_of_halt tm cfg hts h.halted

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_haltsAt
statement:
lemma exists_haltsAt {input : List Symbol} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} {t : ℕ}
    (hhalt : (tm.runFrom cfg t).Halted) : ∃ u ≤ t, tm.HaltsAt cfg u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n, (tm.runFrom cfg n).Halted := ⟨t, hhalt⟩
  exact ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_min' hex hhalt, Nat.find_spec hex,
    fun s hs => Nat.find_min hex hs⟩

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.existsUnique_haltsAt
statement:
lemma existsUnique_haltsAt {input : List Symbol} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} {t : ℕ}
    (hhalt : (tm.runFrom cfg t).Halted) : ∃! u, tm.HaltsAt cfg u
proof:
:=
  let ⟨u, _, hu⟩ := exists_haltsAt hhalt
  ⟨u, hu, fun _ h => h.unique hu⟩

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.inputPos_runFrom_le
statement:
lemma inputPos_runFrom_le (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t : ℕ) :
    ((tm.runFrom cfg t).inputPos : ℕ) ≤ (cfg.inputPos : ℕ) + t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [runFrom]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← runFrom]
    by_cases hq : (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none
    · rw [step_of_halt hq]
      omega
    · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hq
      have h : ((tm.step (tm.runFrom cfg t)).inputPos : ℕ) ≤
          ((tm.runFrom cfg t).inputPos : ℕ) + 1 := by
        rw [step_inputPos_of_state hq]
        exact val_moveInputPos_le _ _
      omega

/

proof:

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.length_output_runFrom_le
statement:
theorem length_output_runFrom_le (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t : ℕ) :
    (tm.runFrom cfg t).output.length ≤ cfg.output.length + t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [runFrom]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← runFrom, step_output, List.length_append]
    have := (tm.outputSymbol (tm.runFrom cfg t)).length_toList_le
    omega

/
and uses exactly `s` space.
Note that this does not require the alphabet or state set to be finite. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputesFunInTimeAndSpace.mono
proof:
:= fun a => by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hc⟩ := h a
  exact ⟨u, hu.trans (ht a), v, hv.trans (hs a), hc⟩

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInTimeAndSpace.mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, tm, htm⟩ := h
  exact ⟨k, State, hfinite, tm, htm.mono ht hs⟩

/
longer than its time bound. This is the only bound available on the length of an intermediate
result: a machine can produce an output much longer than the space it uses. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInTimeAndSpace.length_encOut_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, State, _, tm, htm⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨t', ht', s', _, _, hout, _⟩ := htm a
  have hlen := length_output_runFrom_le tm (tm.initCfg (encIn a)) t'
  rw [hout] at hlen
  have h0 : (tm.initCfg (encIn a)).output.length = 0 := rfl
  omega

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.relatesInSteps_iff_runFrom_eq
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma relatesInSteps_iff_runFrom_eq
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (cfg₁ cfg₂ : Cfg k Symbol State input)
    (t : ℕ) :
    RelatesInSteps tm.TransitionRelation cfg₁ cfg₂ t ↔ tm.runFrom cfg₁ t = cfg₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold runFrom
  induction t generalizing cfg₁ cfg₂ with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [RelatesInSteps.succ_iff, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    constructor
    · grind
    · intro h_runFrom
      use tm.step^[t] cfg₁
      grind

/
because the sequence between the two configurations will loop forever.
Note that this can be applied to two arbitrary and different time steps `t` and `t + Δ`
using `Function.iterate_add_apply`. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.not_halts_of_repeat_nonhalt
statement:
lemma not_halts_of_repeat_nonhalt
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input)
    (h_not_halt : cfg.state ≠ none)
    (t : ℕ)
    (heq : tm.runFrom cfg (t + 1) = cfg) :
    ∀ t', (tm.runFrom cfg t').state ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  intro t'

  have hloop : ∀ n, tm.runFrom cfg (n * (t + 1)) = cfg := by
    intro n
    unfold runFrom
    rw [Nat.mul_comm, Function.iterate_mul]
    exact Function.iterate_fixed heq n
  by_contra hnh

  have h₁ : (tm.runFrom cfg (t' * (t + 1))).state = none := by
    have hle : t' ≤ t' * (t + 1) := by grind
    rwa [tm.runFrom_eq_of_halt cfg hle hnh]
  simp [hloop t', h_not_halt] at h₁

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_embed
statement:
lemma step_embed (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol)
    (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) :
    (tm.extendTapes e).step (embed e cfg extraTapes extraPos)
      = embed e (tm.step cfg) extraTapes extraPos
proof:
:= by
  cases hq : cfg.state with
  | none => simp [embed, hq]
  | some q =>
    rw [step_apply_of_state (cfg := embed e cfg extraTapes extraPos) hq, step_apply_of_state hq]
    simp only [extendTapes, embed_inputSymbol, embed_workTapeSymbols_embed]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext l <;> simp only [Action.apply, embed] <;>
      cases partialInv e l <;> simp

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_embed
statement:
lemma runFrom_embed (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol)
    (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (tm.extendTapes e).runFrom (embed e cfg extraTapes extraPos) n
      = embed e (tm.runFrom cfg n) extraTapes extraPos
proof:
:=
  (Function.Semiconj.iterate_right (f := (embed e · extraTapes extraPos))
    (fun c => (step_embed tm e c extraTapes extraPos).symm) n cfg).symm

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_embed_of_not_range
statement:
lemma workTapePos_embed_of_not_range (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol)
    (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) (n : ℕ) {l : Fin k'} (hl : l ∉ Set.range e) :
    ((tm.extendTapes e).runFrom (embed e cfg extraTapes extraPos) n).workTapePos l
      = extraPos l
proof:
:= by
  rw [runFrom_embed]
  simp only [embed, partialInv_eq_none e hl]

/
each of the remaining `k' - k` tapes never moves and contributes at most one cell. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_embed_le
statement:
lemma spaceUsed_embed_le (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol)
    (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (tm.extendTapes e).spaceUsed (embed e cfg extraTapes extraPos) n
      ≤ tm.spaceUsed cfg n + (k' - k)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using tm.spaceUsed_le_of_workTapePos_embedding e cfg _ 1
    (fun m _ j => by rw [runFrom_embed, embed_workTapePos_embed])
    fun l hl => spaceUsedByTape_le_one _ fun m _ => by
      rw [workTapePos_embed_of_not_range tm e cfg extraTapes extraPos m hl]
      simp only [embed, partialInv_eq_none e hl]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.embed_tapeEmb
statement:
lemma embed_tapeEmb (i : Fin k) (cfg : Cfg 1 Symbol State input)
    (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) :
    embed (tapeEmb i) cfg tapes heads =
      ⟨cfg.state, cfg.inputPos, Function.update tapes i (cfg.workTapes 0),
        Function.update heads i (cfg.workTapePos 0), cfg.output⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext l <;> by_cases hl : l = i <;> simp [embed, hl]

tape `i`, with everything else as it is. -/

    embed (tapeEmb i) (oneTapeCfg i cfg) cfg.workTapes cfg.workTapePos = cfg
proof:
:= by
  rw [embed_tapeEmb]
  simp [oneTapeCfg]

/
configuration, placed back on tape `i`; every other tape and head keeps its starting value. Combine
with `embed_tapeEmb` to read off the resulting configuration. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_tapeEmb
statement:
lemma runFrom_tapeEmb (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 Symbol State) (i : Fin k)
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (n : ℕ) :
    (tm.extendTapes (tapeEmb i)).runFrom cfg n =
      embed (tapeEmb i) (tm.runFrom (oneTapeCfg i cfg) n) cfg.workTapes cfg.workTapePos
proof:
:= by
  rw [← runFrom_embed, embed_oneTapeCfg]

/
one cell for each tape the machine does not use. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_tapeEmb_le
statement:
lemma spaceUsed_tapeEmb_le (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 Symbol State) (i : Fin k)
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (n : ℕ) :
    (tm.extendTapes (tapeEmb i)).spaceUsed cfg n ≤ tm.spaceUsed (oneTapeCfg i cfg) n + (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← embed_oneTapeCfg i cfg]
  exact spaceUsed_embed_le _ _ _ _ _ _

/
word on that tape as it did on its own tape and leaves every other word alone; each remaining tape
costs one cell. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.TransformsTapes.tapeEmb
proof:
:= by
  intro input ws out hP
  obtain ⟨v, hrun, hQ, hspace⟩ := h input (fun _ => ws i) out hP
  simp only [wordsCfg] at hrun hspace
  refine ⟨Function.update ws i (v 0), ?_, ⟨v, hQ, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [extendTapes_q₀, runFrom_tapeEmb]
    simp only [oneTapeCfg, wordsCfg, hrun]
    rw [embed_tapeEmb]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext l <;> by_cases hl : l = i <;> simp [hl]
  · rw [extendTapes_q₀]
    exact (spaceUsed_tapeEmb_le _ _ _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hspace _)

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.inCfg_workTapeSymbols_vip
proof:
:= by
  have := c.inputPos.isLt
  rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, inCfg_workTapes_vip, inCfg_workTapePos_natAdd]
  obtain h | h | h : c.inputPos.val = 0 ∨ c.inputPos.val = input.length + 1 ∨
      (0 < c.inputPos.val ∧ c.inputPos.val < input.length + 1) := by omega
  · rw [inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (.inl h), h]
    exact tapeOfList_negSucc input 0
  · rw [inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (.inr h), h]; simp
  · rw [inputSymbolInner (c.inputPos.val - 1) (by omega) (by omega),
      show (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1 = (c.inputPos.val - 1 : ℕ) by omega, tapeOfList_ofNat,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.inCfg_workTapeSymbols_flag
statement:
@[simp]
public lemma inCfg_workTapeSymbols_flag (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) :
    (inCfg mark c outerInput).workTapeSymbols (Fin.natAdd k 1) =
      if c.inputPos.val = 0 then some mark else none
proof:
:= by
  simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, Function.update_apply]

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.val_moveInputPos_sub_one_eq_clampMove
statement:
lemma val_moveInputPos_sub_one_eq_clampMove (mark : Symbol) (c : Cfg k Symbol State input)
    (m : SignType) :
    ((moveInputPos c.inputPos m).val : ℤ) - 1 =
      ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) +
        (clampMove c.inputSymbol (if c.inputPos.val = 0 then some mark else none) m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have := c.inputPos.isLt
  rw [val_moveInputPos_eq]
  obtain h | h | h : c.inputPos.val = 0 ∨ c.inputPos.val = input.length + 1 ∨
      (0 < c.inputPos.val ∧ c.inputPos.val < input.length + 1) := by omega
  ·
    rw [inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (.inl h), ite_eq_left h]
    rcases m with _ | _ | _ <;> simp only [clampMove, SignType.cast] <;> omega
  ·
    rw [inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (.inr h), ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    rcases m with _ | _ | _ <;> simp only [clampMove, SignType.cast] <;> omega
  ·
    rw [inputSymbolInner (c.inputPos.val - 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
    rcases m with _ | _ | _ <;> simp only [clampMove, SignType.cast] <;> omega

/
the virtual tape mirrors one step of the original, under the embedding `inCfg`. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_inCfg
statement:
lemma step_inCfg (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (mark : Symbol)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (outerInput : List Symbol) :
    tm.inputFromTape.step (inCfg mark c outerInput) =
      inCfg mark (tm.step c) outerInput
proof:
:= by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none => simp [inCfg, hq]
  | some q =>
    rw [step_apply_of_state (cfg := inCfg mark c outerInput) hq, step_apply_of_state hq]
    simp only [inputFromTape, inCfg_workTapeSymbols_vip, inCfg_workTapeSymbols_flag,
      inCfg_workTapeSymbols_castAdd]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (by simp [inCfg]) ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext l <;>
      induction l using Fin.addCases <;> simp [inCfg, val_moveInputPos_sub_one_eq_clampMove mark]

/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_inCfg
statement:
lemma runFrom_inCfg (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (mark : Symbol)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (outerInput : List Symbol) (n : ℕ) :
    tm.inputFromTape.runFrom (inCfg mark c outerInput) n =
      inCfg mark (tm.runFrom c n) outerInput
proof:
:=
  (Function.Semiconj.iterate_right (f := (inCfg mark · outerInput))
    (fun c => (step_inCfg tm mark c outerInput).symm) n c).symm

/
does; the two extra tapes (virtual input, flag) each move only with the simulated input head,
which stays within `[-1, input.length]` — so they add at most `2 * (input.length + 2)`. -/

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_inputFromTape
statement:
lemma spaceUsed_inputFromTape (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (mark : Symbol)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol State input) (outerInput : List Symbol) (n : ℕ) :
    tm.inputFromTape.spaceUsed (inCfg mark c outerInput) n ≤
      tm.spaceUsed c n + 2 * (input.length + 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using tm.spaceUsed_le_of_workTapePos_embedding (Fin.castAddEmb 2) c
    (inCfg mark c outerInput) (input.length + 2) (fun m _ j => by simp [runFrom_inCfg])
    fun l hl => by
      induction l using Fin.addCases with
      | left j => exact absurd ⟨j, rfl⟩ hl
      | right i =>
        refine (spaceUsedByTape_le_card _ (S := .Icc (-1) input.length) fun m _ => ?_).trans
          (by rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega)
        have := (tm.runFrom c m).inputPos.isLt
        simp only [runFrom_inCfg, inCfg_workTapePos_natAdd, Finset.mem_Icc]
        omega

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.outCfg_inputSymbol
proof: := rfl

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.outCfg_workTapes_last
proof:
:= by
  simp [outCfg]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.outCfg_workTapes_castSucc
proof:
:= by
  simp [outCfg]

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.outCfg_workTapePos_last
proof:
:= by

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.outCfg_workTapePos_castSucc
proof:
:= by

name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.outCfg_workTapeSymbols_castSucc
proof:
:= by
