name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run_toStateM
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_toStateM {α : Type u} (comp : FreeState σ α) (s₀ : σ) :
    (toStateM comp).run s₀ = pure (run comp s₀)
proof:
:= by
  induction comp generalizing s₀ with
  | pure a => rfl
  | liftBind op cont ih =>
    cases op <;> apply ih

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_pure (a : α) (s₀ : σ) :
    run (pure a : FreeState σ α) s₀ = (a, s₀)
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run_get
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_get (s₀ : σ) :
    run (lift .get) s₀ = (s₀, s₀)
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run_set
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_set (s' : σ) (s₀ : σ) :
    run (lift (.set s')) s₀ = (.unit, s')
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_bind (x : FreeState σ α) (f : α → FreeState σ β) (s₀ : σ) :
    run (x.bind f) s₀ = let p
proof:
:= x.run s₀; (f p.1).run p.2 := by
  induction x using FreeM.induction generalizing f s₀ with
  | pure => simp
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    simp_rw [FreeM.bind_assoc]
    cases op <;> simp [← liftBind_eq, run, ih]

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run'_toStateM
statement:
theorem run'_toStateM {α : Type u} (comp : FreeState σ α) (s₀ : σ) :
    (toStateM comp).run' s₀ = pure (run' comp s₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [run', StateT.run'_eq, run_toStateM]
  rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run'_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run'_pure (a : α) (s₀ : σ) :
    run' (pure a : FreeState σ α) s₀ = a
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run'_get
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run'_get (s₀ : σ) :
    run' (lift .get) s₀ = s₀
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run'_set
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run'_set (s' : σ) (s₀ : σ) :
    run' (lift (.set s')) s₀ = .unit
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeState.run'_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run'_bind (x : FreeState σ α) (f : α → FreeState σ β) (s₀ : σ) :
    run' (x.bind f) s₀ = let p
proof:
:= x.run s₀; (f p.1).run' p.2 :=
  congr_arg Prod.fst <| run_bind _ _ _

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.toWriterT_unique
statement:
theorem toWriterT_unique {α : Type u} [Monoid ω] (g : FreeWriter ω α → WriterT ω Id α)
    (h : Interprets writerInterp g) : g = toWriterT
proof:
:= h.eq

/
Writes a log entry. This creates an effectful node in the computation tree.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.tell_def
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tell_def (w : ω) :
    tell w = .lift (.tell w)
proof:
:= rfl

/
Interprets a `FreeWriter` computation by recursively traversing the tree, accumulating
log entries with the monoid operation, and returns the final value paired with the accumulated log.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.run_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_pure [Monoid ω] (a : α) :
    run (pure a : FreeWriter ω α) = (a, 1)
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.run_lift_tell
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_lift_tell [Monoid ω] (w : ω) :
    run (lift (.tell w)) = (.unit, w)
proof: := Prod.ext rfl <| mul_one _

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.run_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_bind [Monoid ω] (x : FreeWriter ω α) (f : α → FreeWriter ω β) :
    run (x.bind f) = let p
proof:
:= run x; ((f p.1).run.1, p.2 * (f p.1).run.2) := by
  induction x using FreeM.induction generalizing f with
  | pure => simp
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    simp_rw [FreeM.bind_assoc]
    cases op
    simp [← liftBind_eq, run, ih, mul_assoc]

/
The canonical interpreter `toWriterT` derived from `liftM` agrees with the hand-written
recursive interpreter `run` for `FreeWriter`.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.run_toWriterT
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_toWriterT {α : Type u} [Monoid ω] (comp : FreeWriter ω α) :
    (toWriterT comp).run = pure (run comp)
proof:
:= by
  induction comp using FreeM.induction with
  | pure _ => simp [toWriterT]
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    simp only [toWriterT, run_bind] at *
    ext : 1
    cases op
    simp [ih]

/
`listen` captures the log produced by a subcomputation incrementally. It traverses the computation,
emitting log entries as encountered, and returns the accumulated log as a result.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.listen_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma listen_pure [Monoid ω] (a : α) :
    listen (pure a : FreeWriter ω α) = .pure (a, 1)
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.listen_lift_tell_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma listen_lift_tell_bind [Monoid ω] (w : ω)
    (k : PUnit → FreeWriter ω α) :
    listen (lift (.tell w) >>= k) =
      lift (.tell w) >>= (fun _ =>
        listen (k .unit) >>= fun (a, w') =>
          pure (a, w * w'))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

/
`pass` allows a subcomputation to modify its own log. After traversing the computation and
accumulating its log, the resulting function is applied to rewrite the accumulated log
before re-emission.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeWriter.pass_def
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pass_def [Monoid ω] (m : FreeWriter ω (α × (ω → ω))) :
    pass m = let ((a, f), w)
proof: := run m; liftBind (.tell (f w)) fun _ => .pure a := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeCont.toContT_unique
statement:
theorem toContT_unique {α : Type u} (g : FreeCont r α → ContT r Id α)
    (h : Interprets contInterp g) : g = toContT
proof:
:= h.eq

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeCont.run_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_pure (a : α) (k : α → r) :
    run (pure a : FreeCont r α) k = k a
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeCont.run_lift_callCC
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_lift_callCC (g : (α → r) → r) (k : α → r) :
    run (lift (.callCC g)) k = g k
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeCont.run_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_bind (x : FreeCont r α) (f : α → FreeCont r β) (k : β → r) :
    run (x.bind f) k = run x (fun i => run (f i) k)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeM.induction generalizing k with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    rw [FreeM.bind_assoc]
    cases op
    simp [← liftBind_eq, run, ih]

/
The canonical interpreter `toContT` derived from `liftM` agrees with the hand-written
recursive interpreter `run` for `FreeCont`.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeCont.run_toContT
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_toContT {α : Type u} (comp : FreeCont r α) (k : α → r) :
    (toContT comp).run k = pure (run comp k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toContT]
  induction comp using FreeM.induction with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    cases op
    simp_rw [run_bind]
    simp [ih]

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeCont.run_callCC
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_callCC (f : MonadCont.Label α (FreeCont r) β → FreeCont r α) (k : α → r) :
    run (callCC f) k = run (f ⟨fun x => lift (.callCC fun _ => k x)⟩) k
proof:
:= by
  simp [callCC]

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.read_def
statement: lemma read_def : (read : FreeReader σ σ) = .lift .read
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.toReaderM_unique
statement:
theorem toReaderM_unique {α : Type u} (g : FreeReader σ α → ReaderM σ α)
    (h : Interprets readInterp g) : g = toReaderM
proof:
:= h.eq

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.run_toReaderM
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_toReaderM {α : Type u} (comp : FreeReader σ α) (s : σ) :
    (toReaderM comp).run s = pure (run comp s)
proof:
:= by
  induction comp generalizing s with
  | pure a => rfl
  | liftBind op cont ih =>
    cases op; apply ih

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.run_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_pure (a : α) (s₀ : σ) :
    run (pure a : FreeReader σ α) s₀ = a
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.run_read
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_read (s₀ : σ) :
    run read s₀ = s₀
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.run_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma run_bind (x : FreeReader σ α) (f : α → FreeReader σ β) (s₀ : σ) :
    run (x >>= f) s₀ = run (f <| run x s₀) s₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Id.run_pure (run _ _), ← run_toReaderM, toReaderM, liftM_bind, ReaderT.run_bind,
    Id.run_bind, run_toReaderM, run_toReaderM, Id.run_pure, Id.run_pure]

name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.run_withReader
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_withReader (f : σ → σ) (m : FreeReader σ α) (s : σ) :
    run (withTheReader σ f m) s = run m (f s)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing s with
  | pure a => rfl
  | liftBind op cont ih =>
    cases op
    simpa [withTheReader, instMonadWithReaderOf, run] using! (ih (f s) s)

name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_pure
    (onValue : α → β)
    (onEffect : {ι : Type u} → F ι → (ι → β) → β)
    (a : α) : foldFreeM onValue onEffect (pure a) = onValue a
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_lift_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_lift_bind
    (onValue : α → β)
    (onEffect : {ι : Type u} → F ι → (ι → β) → β)
    (op : F ι) (k : ι → FreeM F α) :
      foldFreeM onValue onEffect ((lift op).bind k)
      = onEffect op (fun x => foldFreeM onValue onEffect (k x))
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_lift_bind'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_lift_bind' {F : Type w → Type v} {ι : Type w}
    (onValue : α → β)
    (onEffect : {ι : Type w} → F ι → (ι → β) → β)
    (op : F ι) (k : ι → FreeM F α) :
      foldFreeM onValue onEffect (lift op >>= k)
      = onEffect op (fun x => foldFreeM onValue onEffect (k x))
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_lift
    (onValue : ι → β)
    (onEffect : {ι : Type u} → F ι → (ι → β) → β)
    (op : F ι) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect (lift op) = onEffect op onValue
proof:
:=
  rfl

/
**Universal Property**: If `h : FreeM F α → β` satisfies:
* `h (pure a) = onValue a`
* `h ((lift op).bind k) = onEffect op (fun x => h (k x))`

then `h` is equal to `foldFreeM onValue onEffect`.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_unique
statement:
theorem foldFreeM_unique
    (onValue : α → β)
    (onEffect : {ι : Type u} → F ι → (ι → β) → β)
    (h : FreeM F α → β)
    (h_pure : ∀ a, h (pure a) = onValue a)
    (h_liftBind : ∀ {ι} (op : F ι) (k : ι → FreeM F α),
      h ((lift op).bind k) = onEffect op (fun x => h (k x))) :
    h = foldFreeM onValue onEffect
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  induction x with
  | pure a =>
    rw [foldFreeM_pure, h_pure]
  | lift_bind op k ih =>
    rw [foldFreeM_lift_bind, h_liftBind]
    grind

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_bind
statement:
theorem foldFreeM_bind (onValue : β → γ)
    (onEffect : {ι : Type u} → F ι → (ι → γ) → γ)
    (x : FreeM F α) (k : α → FreeM F β) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect (x.bind k) =
      foldFreeM (fun a => foldFreeM onValue onEffect (k a)) onEffect x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op cont ih => exact congrArg (onEffect op) (funext ih)

name: Cslib.FreeM.foldFreeM_map
statement:
theorem foldFreeM_map (onValue : β → γ)
    (onEffect : {ι : Type u} → F ι → (ι → γ) → γ) (f : α → β) (x : FreeM F α) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect (map f x) = foldFreeM (onValue ∘ f) onEffect x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bind_pure_comp, foldFreeM_bind]
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_eq_foldFreeM
proof:
:=
  foldFreeM_unique _ _ _ (liftM_pure interp) (fun _ _ => rfl)

name: Cslib.FreeM.pure_eq_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pure_eq_pure : FreeM.pure = (pure : α → FreeM F α)
proof:
:= rfl

/

The builtin `>>=` notation should be preferred when `α` and `β` are in the same universe. -/

name: Cslib.FreeM.bind_eq_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_eq_bind {α β : Type w} : (FreeM.bind : FreeM F α → _ → FreeM F β) = Bind.bind
proof:
:= rfl

/

The builtin `<$>` notation should be preferred when `α` and `β` are in the same universe. -/

name: Cslib.FreeM.map_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_map {α β : Type w} : FreeM.map (F := F) (α := α) (β := β) = Functor.map
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftBind_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftBind_eq (op : F ι) :
    liftBind op cont = (lift op : FreeM F ι).bind cont
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.induction
statement:
@[induction_eliminator]
protected theorem induction {motive : FreeM F α → Prop}
    (pure : ∀ a, motive (pure a))
    (lift_bind : ∀ {ι} (op : F ι) (cont : ι → FreeM F α) (ih : ∀ i, motive (cont i)),
      motive ((lift op).bind cont)) : ∀ x, motive x
  | .pure a => pure a
  | liftBind _ _ => lift_bind _ _ fun _ => FreeM.induction pure lift_bind _

end notations

protected theorem bind_assoc (x : FreeM F α) (f : α → FreeM F β) (g : β → FreeM F γ) :
    (x.bind f).bind g = x.bind (fun x => (f x).bind g)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op cont ih => simp [← liftBind_eq, FreeM.bind, ih] at *

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.bind_assoc
statement:
theorem bind_assoc (x : FreeM F α) (f : α → FreeM F β) (g : β → FreeM F γ) :
    (x.bind f).bind g = x.bind (fun x => (f x).bind g)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind op cont ih => simp [← liftBind_eq, FreeM.bind, ih] at *

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.pure_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pure_bind (a : α) (f : α → FreeM F β) : (pure a : FreeM F α).bind f = f a
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.bind_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bind_pure : ∀ x : FreeM F α, x.bind pure = x
  | .pure a => rfl
  | liftBind op k => by simp [FreeM.bind, bind_pure, -bind_eq_bind]

@[simp]

name: Cslib.FreeM.bind_pure_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bind_pure_comp (f : α → β) : ∀ x : FreeM F α, x.bind (pure ∘ f) = map f x
  | .pure a => rfl
  | liftBind op k => by simp only [FreeM.bind, map, bind_pure_comp]

@[simp]

name: Cslib.FreeM.map_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_pure (f : α → β) (x : α) : map f (pure x : FreeM F α) = pure (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.map_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bind (f : β → γ) (x : FreeM F α) (c : α → FreeM F β) :
    map f (x.bind c) = x.bind fun a => (c a).map f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← bind_pure_comp, FreeM.bind_assoc]

name: Cslib.FreeM.id_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_map : ∀ x : FreeM F α, map id x = x
  | .pure a => rfl
  | .liftBind op cont => by simp [map, id_map]

name: Cslib.FreeM.comp_map
statement:
theorem comp_map (h : β → γ) (g : α → β) : ∀ x : FreeM F α, map (h ∘ g) x = map h (map g x)
  | .pure a => rfl
  | .liftBind op cont => by simp [map, comp_map]

instance : LawfulFunctor (FreeM F) where
  map_const
proof:
:= rfl
  id_map := id_map
  comp_map _ _ := comp_map _ _

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_pure (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (a : α) :
    (pure a : FreeM F α).liftM interp = pure a
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_lift_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_lift_bind (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (op : F β) (cont : β → FreeM F α) :
    ((lift op) >>= cont).liftM interp = (do let b ← interp op; (cont b).liftM interp)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_lift
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_lift [LawfulMonad m] (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (op : F β) :
    (lift op).liftM interp = interp op
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift, FreeM.liftM]
  simp

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_bind [LawfulMonad m]
    (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (x : FreeM F α) (f : α → FreeM F β) :
    (x >>= f).liftM interp = (do let a ← x.liftM interp; (f a).liftM interp)
proof:
:= by
  induction x generalizing f with
  | pure a => simp only [liftM_pure, LawfulMonad.pure_bind]
  | lift_bind op cont ih => simp [← ih]

/

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_freeMLiftM
statement:
theorem _root_.Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_freeMLiftM [Monad n]
    {f : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n f)
    (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (x : FreeM F α) :
    f (x.liftM interp) = x.liftM (fun op => f (interp op))
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => exact hf.map_pure a
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    simp only [bind_eq_bind, liftM_lift_bind, hf.map_bind, ih]

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.isMonadHom_liftM
statement:
theorem isMonadHom_liftM [LawfulMonad m] (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) :
    IsMonadHom (FreeM F) m (FreeM.liftM interp)
proof:
:=
  IsMonadHom.mk' (liftM_pure interp) (liftM_bind interp)

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_map [LawfulMonad m]
    (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (f : α → β) (x : FreeM F α) :
    (f <$> x).liftM interp = f <$> x.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_map _ _

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_seq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_seq [LawfulMonad m]
    (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (x : FreeM F (α → β)) (y : FreeM F α) :
    (x <*> y).liftM interp = x.liftM interp <*> y.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_seq _ _

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_seqLeft
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_seqLeft [LawfulMonad m]
    (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (x : FreeM F α) (y : FreeM F β) :
    (x <* y).liftM interp = x.liftM interp <* y.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_seqLeft _ _

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_seqRight
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_seqRight [LawfulMonad m]
    (interp : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (x : FreeM F α) (y : FreeM F β) :
    (x *> y).liftM interp = x.liftM interp *> y.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_seqRight _ _

/
A predicate stating that `interp : FreeM F α → m α` is an interpreter for the effect
handler `handler : ∀ {α}, F α → m α`.

This means that `interp` is a monad morphism from the free monad `FreeM F` to the
monad `m`, and that it extends the interpretation of individual operations
given by `f`.

Formally, `interp` satisfies the two equations:
- `interp (pure a) = pure a`
- `interp (liftBind op k) = handler op >>= fun x => interp (k x)`
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.Interprets.eq
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  induction x with
  | pure a => exact h.apply_pure a
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    simp [h.apply_lift_bind, ih]

name: Cslib.FreeM.Interprets.liftM
statement:
theorem Interprets.liftM (handler : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) :
    Interprets handler (·.liftM handler : FreeM F α → _) where
  apply_pure _
proof:
:= rfl
  apply_lift_bind _ _ := rfl

/
The universal property of the free monad `FreeM`.

That is, `liftM handler` is the unique interpreter that extends the effect handler `handler` to
interpret `FreeM F` computations in a monad `m`.
-/

name: Cslib.FreeM.Interprets.iff
statement:
theorem Interprets.iff (handler : {ι : Type u} → F ι → m ι) (interp : FreeM F α → m α) :
    Interprets handler interp ↔ interp = (·.liftM handler)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.eq), fun h => h ▸ Interprets.liftM _⟩

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_lift_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftM_lift_eq_self {α : Type u} (x : FreeM F α) : FreeM.liftM lift x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure _ => rfl
  | lift_bind _ _ ih => simp [ih]

/

name: Cslib.FreeM.liftM_comp
statement:
theorem liftM_comp {m : Type u → Type w} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    {G : Type u → Type w'} {α : Type u} (x : FreeM F α)
    (first : {ι : Type u} → F ι → FreeM G ι) (second : {ι : Type u} → G ι → m ι) :
    (x.liftM first).liftM second = x.liftM fun op => (first op).liftM second
proof:
:=
  (isMonadHom_liftM second).map_freeMLiftM first x

name: Cslib.IsApplicativeHom.map_listMapA
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listMapA {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsApplicativeHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} {β : Type u} (f : α → m β) (l : List α) :
    F (l.mapA f) = l.mapA (F ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with grind [List.mapA]

name: Cslib.IsApplicativeHom.map_listForA
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listForA {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsApplicativeHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} (l : List α) (f : α → m PUnit) :
    F (l.forA f) = l.forA (F ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with grind [List.forA]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listMapM'
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listMapM'
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} {β : Type u} (f : α → m β) (l : List α) :
    F (l.mapM' f) = l.mapM' (F ∘ f)
proof:
:= by

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listMapMLoop
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listMapMLoop
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} {β : Type u} (f : α → m β) (l : List α) (acc : List β) :
    F (List.mapM.loop f l acc) = List.mapM.loop (F ∘ f) l acc
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => exact hf.map_pure _
  | cons a l ih => simp only [List.mapM.loop, hf.map_bind, ih, Function.comp_def]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listMapM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listMapM
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} {β : Type u} (f : α → m β) (l : List α) :
    F (l.mapM f) = l.mapM (F ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  grind [List.mapM]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listForM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listForM {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} (l : List α) (f : α → m PUnit) :
    F (l.forM f) = l.forM (F ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with grind [List.forM]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listFoldlM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listFoldlM {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {s : Type u} {α : Type v} (f : s → α → m s) (init : s) (l : List α) :
    F (l.foldlM f init) = l.foldlM (fun s a => F (f s a)) init
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing init with grind [List.foldlM]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listFoldrM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listFoldrM {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {s : Type u} {α : Type v} (f : α → s → m s) (init : s) (l : List α) :
    F (l.foldrM f init) = l.foldrM (fun a s => F (f a s)) init
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.foldrM]
  exact hf.map_listFoldlM (fun s a => f a s) init l.reverse

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listFindSomeM?
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listFindSomeM?
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} {β : Type u} (f : α → m (Option β)) (l : List α) :
    F (l.findSomeM? f) = l.findSomeM? (F ∘ f)
proof:

  induction l with grind

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listFindM?
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listFindM? {m n : Type → Type v} [Monad m] [Monad n]
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type} (p : α → m Bool) (l : List α) :
    F (l.findM? p) = l.findM? (F ∘ p)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with grind [List.findM?]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listAnyM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listAnyM {m n : Type → Type v} [Monad m] [Monad n]
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} (p : α → m Bool) (l : List α) :
    F (l.anyM p) = l.anyM (F ∘ p)

:= by
  induction l with grind [List.anyM]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listAllM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listAllM {m n : Type → Type v} [Monad m] [Monad n]
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type v} (p : α → m Bool) (l : List α) :
    F (l.allM p) = l.allM (F ∘ p)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with grind [List.allM]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listFilterAuxM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listFilterAuxM {m n : Type → Type v} [Monad m] [Monad n]
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type} (p : α → m Bool) (l acc : List α) :
    F (List.filterAuxM p l acc) = List.filterAuxM (F ∘ p) l acc
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with grind [List.filterAuxM]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listFilterM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listFilterM {m n : Type → Type v} [Monad m] [Monad n]
    {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsMonadHom m n F)
    {α : Type} (p : α → m Bool) (l : List α) :
    F (l.filterM p) = l.filterM (F ∘ p)
proof:
:= by
  grind [List.filterM]

name: Cslib.IsAlternativeHom.map_listFirstM
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem map_listFirstM {F : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : IsAlternativeHom m n F)

    F (l.firstM f) = l.firstM (F ∘ f)
proof:
:= by

name: Cslib.IsApplicativeHom.map_listSingleton
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem IsApplicativeHom.map_listSingleton
    {F : ∀ {α}, List α → List α} (hf : IsApplicativeHom List List F) {α} (a : α) :
    F ([a] : List α) = [a]
proof: := hf.map_pure _

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_listFlatMap
statement:
theorem IsMonadHom.map_listFlatMap
    {F : ∀ {α}, List α → List α} (hf : IsMonadHom List List F) {α β} (l : List α) (g : α → List β) :
    F (l.flatMap g) = (F l).flatMap (F <| g ·)
proof: := hf.map_bind _ _

name: Cslib.IsFunctorHom.map_listNil
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem IsFunctorHom.map_listNil {F : ∀ {α}, List α → List α} (hf : IsFunctorHom List List F) {α} :
    F ([] : List α) = []
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Subsingleton.elim (F ([] : List PEmpty)) []]

name: List.isMonadHom_reverse
statement: theorem _root_.List.isMonadHom_reverse : IsMonadHom List List List.reverse
proof:
:=
  .mk' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => List.reverse_flatMap)

name: Cslib.isMonadHom_list_iff
statement:
theorem isMonadHom_list_iff (f : ∀ {α : Type u}, List α → List α) :
    IsMonadHom List List @f ↔ @f = (@id <| List ·) ∨ @f = @List.reverse
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h_append {α} (xs ys : List α) :
        f (xs ++ ys) = (f [Two.a, Two.b]).flatMap (fun | .a => f xs | .b => f ys) := by
      have : xs ++ ys = [Two.a, Two.b].flatMap (fun | .a => xs | .b => ys) := by
        simp
      rw [this, h.map_listFlatMap]
      congr 1; funext x; cases x <;> rfl
    refine (eq_ab_or_ba (f [Two.a, Two.b]) ?_ ?_).imp (fun hL => ?_) (fun hL => ?_)
    · simpa [h.map_listNil, h.map_listSingleton] using (h_append [Two.a] []).symm
    · simpa [h.map_listNil, h.map_listSingleton] using (h_append [] [Two.b]).symm
    · funext α l
      induction l using List.nil_singleton_append_induction with grind
    · funext α l
      induction l using List.nil_singleton_append_induction with grind
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact .id _
    · exact List.isMonadHom_reverse

name: Cslib.IsFunctorHom.mk'
statement:
theorem mk' [LawfulFunctor m] [LawfulFunctor n] {f : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (map_map : ∀ {α β} (g : α → β) (x : m α), f (g <$> x) = g <$> f x) :
    IsFunctorHom m n f where
  map_map
proof:
:= map_map
  map_mapConst := map_mapConst_of_map_map f map_map

name: Cslib.IsFunctorHom.id
statement:
theorem id : IsFunctorHom m m id where
  map_map _ _
proof:
:= rfl
  map_mapConst _ _ := rfl

name: Cslib.IsFunctorHom.comp
statement:
theorem comp {f : ∀ {α}, n α → p α} {g : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (hf : IsFunctorHom n p f) (hg : IsFunctorHom m n g) :
    IsFunctorHom m p (f ∘ g) where
  map_map _ _
proof:
:= by simp [hf.map_map, hg.map_map]
  map_mapConst _ _ := by simp [hf.map_mapConst, hg.map_mapConst]

name: Cslib.IsApplicativeHom.mk'
statement:
theorem mk' [LawfulApplicative m] [LawfulApplicative n] {f : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (map_pure : ∀ {α} (a : α), f (pure a) = pure a)
    (map_seq : ∀ {α β} (x : m (α → β)) (y : Unit → m α),
      f (Seq.seq x y) = Seq.seq (f x) (f <| y ·)) :
    IsApplicativeHom m n f where
  map_pure
  toIsFunctorHom
proof:
:= .mk' (map_map_of_map_pure_map_seq f map_pure map_seq)
  map_seq
  map_seqLeft := map_seqLeft_of_map_seq_map_map f
    (map_map_of_map_pure_map_seq f map_pure map_seq) map_seq
  map_seqRight := map_seqRight_of_map_seq_map_map f
    (map_map_of_map_pure_map_seq f map_pure map_seq) map_seq

name: Cslib.IsApplicativeHom.id
statement:
theorem id : IsApplicativeHom m m id where
  map_pure _
proof:
:= rfl
  toIsFunctorHom := IsFunctorHom.id m
  map_seq _ _ := rfl
  map_seqLeft _ _ := rfl
  map_seqRight _ _ := rfl

name: Cslib.IsApplicativeHom.comp
statement:
theorem comp {f : ∀ {α}, n α → p α} {g : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (hf : IsApplicativeHom n p f) (hg : IsApplicativeHom m n g) :
    IsApplicativeHom m p (f ∘ g) where
  map_pure _
proof:
:= by simp [hf.map_pure, hg.map_pure]
  toIsFunctorHom := hf.toIsFunctorHom.comp hg.toIsFunctorHom
  map_seq _ _ := by simp [hf.map_seq, hg.map_seq]
  map_seqLeft _ _ := by simp [hf.map_seqLeft, hg.map_seqLeft]
  map_seqRight _ _ := by simp [hf.map_seqRight, hg.map_seqRight]

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.mk'
statement:
theorem mk' [LawfulMonad m] [LawfulMonad n] {f : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (map_pure : ∀ {α} (a : α), f (pure a) = pure a)
    (map_bind : ∀ {α β} (x : m α) (y : α → m β), f (x >>= y) = f x >>= (f <| y ·)) :
    IsMonadHom m n f where

proof: := .mk' map_pure (map_seq_of_map_pure_map_bind f map_pure map_bind)

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.comp
statement:
theorem comp {f : ∀ {α}, n α → p α} {g : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}

name: Cslib.IsAlternativeHom.mk'
statement:
theorem mk' [LawfulApplicative m] [LawfulApplicative n] {f : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (map_pure : ∀ {α} (a : α), f (pure a) = pure a)
    (map_seq : ∀ {α β} (x : m (α → β)) (y : Unit → m α),
      f (Seq.seq x y) = Seq.seq (f x) (f <| y ·))
    (map_failure : ∀ {α}, f (Alternative.failure : m α) = Alternative.failure)
    (map_orElse : ∀ {α} (x : m α) (y : Unit → m α),
      f (HOrElse.hOrElse x y) = HOrElse.hOrElse (f x) (f <| y ·)) :
    IsAlternativeHom m n f where
  toIsApplicativeHom
proof:
:= .mk' map_pure map_seq
  map_failure
  map_orElse

name: Cslib.IsAlternativeHom.comp
statement:
theorem comp {f : ∀ {α}, n α → p α} {g : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (hf : IsAlternativeHom n p f) (hg : IsAlternativeHom m n g) :
    IsAlternativeHom m p (f ∘ g) where

proof:

  map_failure := by simp [hf.map_failure, hg.map_failure]
  map_orElse _ _ := by simp [hf.map_orElse, hg.map_orElse]

name: Cslib.IsAlternativeMonadHom.mk'
statement:
theorem mk' [LawfulMonad m] [LawfulMonad n] {f : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (map_pure : ∀ {α} (a : α), f (pure a) = pure a)
    (map_bind : ∀ {α β} (x : m α) (y : α → m β), f (x >>= y) = f x >>= (f <| y ·))
    (map_failure : ∀ {α}, f (Alternative.failure : m α) = Alternative.failure)
    (map_orElse : ∀ {α} (x : m α) (y : Unit → m α),
      f (HOrElse.hOrElse x y) = HOrElse.hOrElse (f x) (f <| y ·)) :
    IsAlternativeMonadHom m n f where
  toIsMonadHom
proof:
:= .mk' map_pure map_bind
  map_failure
  map_orElse

name: Cslib.IsAlternativeMonadHom.id
statement:
theorem id : IsAlternativeMonadHom m m id where
  toIsMonadHom
proof:
:= IsMonadHom.id m

name: Cslib.IsAlternativeMonadHom.comp
statement:
theorem comp {f : ∀ {α}, n α → p α} {g : ∀ {α}, m α → n α}
    (hf : IsAlternativeMonadHom n p f) (hg : IsAlternativeMonadHom m n g) :

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, _, rfl, rfl⟩

first yields a valid chain. -/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.append_tail
proof:
:= by
    have hb : chain.dropLast ++ [b] = chain :=
      hc.getLast_eq ▸ chain.dropLast_append_getLast hc.ne_nil
    have hb' : [b] ++ chain'.tail = chain' := by simp [←hc'.head_eq]
    rw [←hb] at hc ⊢
    exact hc.isChain.append_overlap (l₃ := chain'.tail) (hb'.symm ▸ hc'.isChain) (cons_ne_nil b [])
  ne_nil := append_ne_nil_of_left_ne_nil hc.ne_nil _
  head_eq := head_append_left hc.ne_nil |>.trans hc.head_eq
  getLast_eq := by grind

/

the end point of the first chain yields a valid chain. -/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.append_dropLast
statement:

    (hc' : chain'.IsChainFromTo r b c) : (chain.dropLast ++ chain').IsChainFromTo r a c
proof:
:= by
  convert hc.append_tail hc' using 1
  nth_rw 1 [←chain'.cons_head_tail hc'.ne_nil, hc'.head_eq, append_cons, ←hc.getLast_eq,
    dropLast_concat_getLast hc.ne_nil]

/
`chain[i]`. -/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.take
statement:
lemma IsChainFromTo.take (hc : chain.IsChainFromTo r a b) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < chain.length) :
    (chain.take (i + 1)).IsChainFromTo r a chain[i]
proof:
:= by
  have : chain.take (i + 1) ≠ [] := by grind only [length_nil, min_def, length_take]
  exact ⟨hc.isChain.take _, this, by grind, by grind [chain.getLast_take this]⟩

/
point. -/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.drop
statement:
lemma IsChainFromTo.drop (hc : chain.IsChainFromTo r a b) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < chain.length) :
    (chain.drop i).IsChainFromTo r chain[i] b
proof:
:= by
  have : chain.drop i ≠ [] := ne_nil_iff_length_pos.mpr <| chain.lt_length_drop hi
  refine ⟨hc.isChain.drop _, this, chain.head_drop this, hc.getLast_eq ▸ chain.getLast_drop this⟩

name: List.IsChainFromTo.head_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma IsChainFromTo.head_induction_on
    {motive : ∀ {chain : List α} {a b : α}, chain.IsChainFromTo r a b → Prop}
    (h_refl : ∀ {a : α}, motive (isChainFromTo_singleton (r := r) (a := a)))
    (h_head : ∀ {a b c : α} {chain : List α} (hab : r a b) (hc : chain.IsChainFromTo r b c),
      motive hc → motive (hc.cons hab))
    {chain : List α} {a b : α} (hc : chain.IsChainFromTo r a b) : motive hc
proof:
:= by
  induction htail : chain.tail generalizing chain a with
  | nil => grind => have : chain = [a]; finish
  | cons a' tail ih =>
    obtain rfl : chain = a :: a' :: tail := by grind
    obtain ⟨hrel, hchain⟩ := isChain_cons_cons.mp hc.isChain
    have : (a' :: tail).IsChainFromTo r a' b := hc.of_cons_cons
    exact h_head hrel this (ih this rfl)

/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.reflTransGen_of_mem
statement:
lemma IsChainFromTo.reflTransGen_of_mem (hc : chain.IsChainFromTo r a b) {x : α} (mem : x ∈ chain) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen r a x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem mem
  exact (hc.take hi).reflTransGen

/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.reflTransGen_of_mem'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem mem
  exact (hc.drop hi).reflTransGen

/
from `a` to `b` (the one that skips the part between the duplicates). -/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.exists_length_lt_of_not_nodup
statement:
lemma IsChainFromTo.exists_length_lt_of_not_nodup
    (hc : chain.IsChainFromTo r a b)
    (h_dup : ¬ chain.Nodup) :
    ∃ chain' : List α, chain'.IsChainFromTo r a b ∧ chain'.length < chain.length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nodup_iff_getElem?_ne_getElem?, not_forall, not_not] at h_dup
  obtain ⟨i, j, h_ij, h_lt, h_eq⟩ := h_dup
  use chain.take i ++ chain.drop j
  split_ands
  · apply IsChainFromTo.mk ..
    · apply (hc.isChain.take _).append (hc.isChain.drop _)
      grind [List.head?_drop, hc.isChain.getElem (i := i - 1)]
    · grind [append_eq_nil_iff, drop_eq_nil_iff]
    · grind
    · grind
  · grind

/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.exists_nodup
statement:
lemma IsChainFromTo.exists_nodup (hc : chain.IsChainFromTo r a b) :
    ∃ chain' : List α, chain'.IsChainFromTo r a b ∧ chain'.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : chain.length using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing chain with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases h_dup : chain.Nodup
    · use chain, hc, h_dup
    · obtain ⟨chain', hc', hlen⟩ := hc.exists_length_lt_of_not_nodup h_dup
      exact ih chain'.length (hn ▸ hlen) hc' rfl

name: Nat.eventually_mul_pow_le_pow
statement:
theorem eventually_mul_pow_le_pow (c k : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c * n ^ k ≤ b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have h := Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff_nat_mul_le.mp
    (isLittleO_pow_const_const_pow_of_one_lt (R := ℝ) k hbR) c
  filter_upwards [h] with n hn
  exact_mod_cast (by simpa using hn : (c : ℝ) * n ^ k ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ n)

/
at least the input plus one. -/

name: Nat.eventually_add_one_le_pow_div
statement:
theorem eventually_add_one_le_pow_div {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n + 1 ≤ b ^ n / n
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_mul_pow_le_pow 2 2 hb, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hn0
  apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).mpr
  nlinarith

/
the input. -/

name: Nat.eventually_mul_log_le
statement:
theorem eventually_mul_log_le (c : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c * log b n ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (eventually_mul_pow_le_pow c 1 hb)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (b ^ N)] with n hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ((pow_pos (by omega) N).trans_le hn)
  have hh : c * log b n ≤ b ^ log b n := by
    simpa using hN (log b n) (le_log_of_pow_le hb hn)
  exact hh.trans (pow_log_le_self b hn0)

/

name: Nat.eventually_mul_log2_le
statement:
theorem eventually_mul_log2_le (c : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c * log2 n ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [log2_eq_log_two] using eventually_mul_log_le c one_lt_two

name: Nat.mul_log_sub_le_log_factorial
statement:
theorem mul_log_sub_le_log_factorial (n : ℕ) :
    (n : ℝ) * Real.log n - n ≤ Real.log n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  · simp
  have h := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ n / n.factorial)
    (Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (n : ℝ) (by positivity) n)
  rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_exp] at h
  linarith

name: Nat.strictMono_infinite
statement:
theorem strictMono_infinite (hm : StrictMono f) :
    (range f).Infinite
proof:
:=
  infinite_range_of_injective hm.injective

/

name: Nat.infinite_strictMono
statement:
theorem infinite_strictMono {ns : Set ℕ} (h : ns.Infinite) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono f ∧ range f = ns
proof:
:=
  ⟨nth (· ∈ ns), nth_strictMono h, range_nth_of_infinite h⟩

/
assuming `p` (as a set) is infinite. -/

name: Nat.nth_succ_gap
statement:
theorem nth_succ_gap {p : ℕ → Prop} (hf : (ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k < nth p (n + 1) - nth p n, 0 < k → ¬ p (k + nth p n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro k h_k1 h_k0 h_p_k
  let m := count p (k + nth p n)
  have h_k_ex : nth p m = k + nth p n := by simp [m, nth_count h_p_k]
  have h_n_m : n < m := by apply (nth_lt_nth hf).mp; omega
  have h_m_n : m < n + 1 := by apply (nth_lt_nth hf).mp; omega
  omega

/
element of the range of `f`. -/

name: Nat.nth_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem nth_of_strictMono (hm : StrictMono f) (n : ℕ) :
    f n = nth (· ∈ range f) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nth_comp_of_strictMono hm]
  · simp
  · simp
  · #adaptation_note
    /
    intros
    have : (range f).Infinite := strictMono_infinite hm
    contradiction

name: Nat.count_notMem_range_pos
statement:
theorem count_notMem_range_pos (h0 : f 0 = 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∉ range f) :
    0 < count (· ∈ range f) n
proof:
:= by
  have := count_monotone (· ∈ range f) (show 1 ≤ n by grind)
  grind

/
`f m` and ` f (m + 1)` is in the range of `f`. -/

name: Nat.strictMono_range_gap
statement:
theorem strictMono_range_gap (hm : StrictMono f) {m k : ℕ}
    (hl : f m < k) (hu : k < f (m + 1)) : k ∉ range f
proof:
:= by
  rw [nth_of_strictMono hm m] at hl
  rw [nth_of_strictMono hm (m + 1)] at hu
  have h_inf := strictMono_infinite hm
  have h_gap := nth_succ_gap (p := (· ∈ range f)) h_inf m
    (k - nth (· ∈ range f) m) (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [(show k - nth (· ∈ range f) m + nth (· ∈ range f) m = k by omega)] at h_gap
  exact h_gap

/

name: Nat.segment_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segment_idem (hm : StrictMono f) (k : ℕ) :
    segment f (f k) = k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := count_nth_of_infinite (p := (· ∈ range f)) <| strictMono_infinite hm
  have := nth_of_strictMono hm
  grind [segment]

/

name: Nat.segment_pre_zero
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem segment_pre_zero (hm : StrictMono f) {k : ℕ} (h : k < f 0) :
    segment f k = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 : count (· ∈ range f) (k + 1) = 0 := by
    apply count_of_forall_not
    rintro n h_n ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have := StrictMono.monotone hm <| zero_le i
    omega
  rw [segment, h1]

/

name: Nat.segment_zero
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem segment_zero (hm : StrictMono f) (h0 : f 0 = 0) :
    segment f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc _ = segment f (f 0) := by simp [h0]
       _ = _ := by simp [segment_idem hm]

name: Nat.segment_plus_one
statement:
theorem segment_plus_one (h0 : f 0 = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    segment f k + 1 = count (· ∈ range f) (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices _ : count (· ∈ range f) (k + 1) ≠ 0 by unfold segment; omega
  apply count_ne_iff_exists.mpr; use 0; grind

/
`k < f (segment f k + 1)` for all `k : ℕ`. -/

name: Nat.segment_upper_bound
statement:
theorem segment_upper_bound (hm : StrictMono f) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    k < f (segment f k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [nth_of_strictMono hm (segment f k + 1), segment_plus_one h0 k]
  suffices _ : k + 1 ≤ nth (· ∈ range f) (count (· ∈ range f) (k + 1)) by omega
  apply le_nth_count
  exact strictMono_infinite hm

/
`f (segment f k) ≤ k` for all `k : ℕ`. -/

name: Nat.segment_lower_bound
statement:
theorem segment_lower_bound (hm : StrictMono f) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    f (segment f k) ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [nth_of_strictMono hm (segment f k), segment]
  rcases Classical.em (k ∈ range f) with h_k | h_k
  · simp_all [count_succ_eq_succ_count]
  · have h1 : 0 < count (· ∈ range f) k := count_notMem_range_pos h0 k h_k
    have h2 : count (· ∈ range f) (k + 1) = count (· ∈ range f) k :=
      count_succ_eq_count h_k
    rw [h2]
    suffices _ : nth (· ∈ range f) (count (· ∈ range f) k - 1) < k by omega
    apply nth_lt_of_lt_count
    omega

/
has `segment f k = m`. -/

name: Nat.segment_range_val
statement:
theorem segment_range_val (hm : StrictMono f) {m k : ℕ}
    (hl : f m ≤ k) (hu : k < f (m + 1)) : segment f k = m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain (rfl | hu') := show f m = k ∨ f m < k by omega
  · exact segment_idem hm m
  · obtain ⟨j, h_j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j < f (m + 1) - f m - 1, k = j + f m + 1 := ⟨k - f m - 1, by omega⟩
    induction j
    case zero =>
      #adaptation_note
      /
      have := strictMono_range_gap hm (show f m < f m + 1 by grind)
      have : count (· ∈ range f) (f m + 1 + 1) = count (· ∈ range f) (f m + 1) := by grind
      have := nth_of_strictMono hm m
      have := count_succ (· ∈ range f)
      simp_all only [segment, mem_range]
      split
      · grind [count_nth_of_infinite (strictMono_infinite hm) m]
      · grind
    case succ j _ =>
      have := strictMono_range_gap hm (show f m < j + 1 + f m     by grind)
      have := strictMono_range_gap hm (show f m < j + 1 + f m + 1 by grind)
      grind

/
`f` and `segment f` form a Galois connection. -/

name: Nat.segment_galois_connection
statement:
theorem segment_galois_connection (hm : StrictMono f) (h0 : f 0 = 0) :
    GaloisConnection f (segment f)
proof:
:= by
  intro m k; constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra! h_con
    have h1 : segment f k + 1 ≤ m := by omega
    have := (StrictMono.le_iff_le hm).mpr h1
    have := segment_upper_bound hm h0 k
    omega
  · intro h
    by_contra! h_con
    have := (StrictMono.le_iff_le hm).mpr h
    have := segment_lower_bound hm h0 k
    omega

/
It facilitates the proofs of some theorems below. -/

name: Nat.base_zero_strictMono
statement:
theorem base_zero_strictMono (hm : StrictMono f) :
    StrictMono (f · - f 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h_m_n; simp
  have := hm h_m_n
  have : f 0 ≤ f m := by simp [StrictMono.le_iff_le hm]
  have : f 0 ≤ f n := by simp [StrictMono.le_iff_le hm]
  omega

/
`segment' f` and `segment f` are actually equal. -/

name: Nat.segment'_eq_segment
statement:
theorem segment'_eq_segment (hm : StrictMono f) :
    segment' f = segment f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext k; unfold segment'
  obtain (h_k | h_k) : k < f 0 ∨ f 0 ≤ k := k.lt_or_ge (f 0)
  · grind
  unfold segment; congr 1
  simp only [count_eq_card_filter_range]
  suffices h : ∃ g, BijOn g
      ({x ∈ Finset.range (k - f 0 + 1) | x ∈ range fun x => f x - f 0})
      ({x ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) | x ∈ range f}) by
    grind [BijOn.finsetCard_eq, Finset.coe_filter]
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ n + f 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n; simp only [mem_range, Finset.mem_range]
    rintro ⟨h_n, i, rfl⟩
    have := StrictMono.monotone hm <| zero_le i
    refine ⟨?_, i, ?_⟩ <;> omega
  · grind [injOn_of_injective, Injective]
  · intro n; simp only [mem_range, Finset.mem_range, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_image]
    rintro ⟨h_n, i, rfl⟩
    have := StrictMono.monotone hm <| zero_le i
    grind

/

name: Nat.segment_zero'
statement:
theorem segment_zero' (hm : StrictMono f) {k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ f 0) :
    segment f k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← segment'_eq_segment hm, segment', (show k - f 0 = 0 by omega)]
  grind

/

name: Nat.segment_upper_bound'
statement:
theorem segment_upper_bound' (hm : StrictMono f) {k : ℕ} (h : f 0 ≤ k) :
    k < f (segment f k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← segment'_eq_segment hm, segment']
  have := segment_upper_bound (base_zero_strictMono hm) (base_zero_shift f) (k - f 0)
  omega

/

name: Nat.segment_lower_bound'
statement:
theorem segment_lower_bound' (hm : StrictMono f) {k : ℕ} (h : f 0 ≤ k) :
    f (segment f k) ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← segment'_eq_segment hm, segment']
  have := segment_lower_bound (base_zero_strictMono hm) (base_zero_shift f) (k - f 0)
  omega

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cumLen_zero
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem cumLen_zero {ls : ωSequence (List α)} :
    ls.cumLen 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cumLen_succ
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem cumLen_succ (ls : ωSequence (List α)) (k : ℕ) :
    ls.cumLen (k + 1) = ls.cumLen k + (ls k).length
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cumLen_one_add_drop
statement:
theorem cumLen_one_add_drop (ls : ωSequence (List α)) (k : ℕ) :
    ls.cumLen (1 + k) = (ls 0).length + (ls.drop 1).cumLen k
proof:
:= by
  induction k <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cumLen_strictMono
statement:
theorem cumLen_strictMono {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length) :
    StrictMono ls.cumLen
proof:
:= by
  grind [strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cumLen_segment_zero
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem cumLen_segment_zero {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length)
    (n : ℕ) (h_n : n < (ls 0).length) : segment ls.cumLen n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ls.cumLen 0 ≤ n := by simp [cumLen_zero]
  have h1 : n < ls.cumLen 1 := by simpa [cumLen_succ, cumLen_zero]
  exact segment_range_val (cumLen_strictMono h_ls) h0 h1

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cumLen_segment_one_add
statement:
theorem cumLen_segment_one_add {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length)
    (n : ℕ) (h_n : (ls 0).length ≤ n) :
    segment ls.cumLen n = 1 + segment (ls.drop 1).cumLen (n - (ls 0).length)
proof:
:= by
  have h_mono := cumLen_strictMono (ls := ls.drop 1) (fun k => h_ls (k + 1))
  have h_lower := segment_lower_bound h_mono rfl (n - (ls 0).length)
  have h_upper := segment_upper_bound h_mono rfl (n - (ls 0).length)
  apply segment_range_val (cumLen_strictMono h_ls) <;>
    simp only [Nat.add_assoc, cumLen_one_add_drop] <;> lia

/
formed by the concatenation of all of them.  For the definition to make proper
sense, we will consistently assume that all lists in `ls` are nonempty. -/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.flatten_def
statement:
theorem flatten_def [Inhabited α] (ls : ωSequence (List α)) (n : ℕ) :
    flatten ls n = (ls (segment ls.cumLen n))[n - ls.cumLen (segment ls.cumLen n)]!
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Cslib.ωSequence.flatten_get_add
proof:
:= by
  have := segment_range_val (cumLen_strictMono hpos) (ls.cumLen n |>.le_add_right k)
    (by lia [cumLen_succ])
  simp [flatten_def, this, hk]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.flatten_get_cumLen
statement:
theorem flatten_get_cumLen [Inhabited α] (ls : ωSequence (List α)) {n : ℕ}
    (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < (ls n).length) : ls.flatten (ls.cumLen n) = (ls n)[0]'(hpos n)
proof:
:=
  ls.flatten_get_add (hpos n) hpos

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cons_flatten
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem cons_flatten [Inhabited α] {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length) :
    ls.head ++ω ls.tail.flatten = ls.flatten
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rw [flatten_def, head, tail_eq_drop]
  obtain (h_n | h_n) : n < (ls 0).length ∨ (ls 0).length ≤ n := n.lt_or_ge (ls 0).length
  · simp [get_append_left _ _ _ h_n, cumLen_segment_zero h_ls n h_n, cumLen_zero,
      getElem?_pos (ls 0) n h_n]
  · simp [get_append_right' h_n, flatten_def, cumLen_segment_one_add h_ls _ h_n,
      cumLen_one_add_drop]
    grind

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.append_flatten
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem append_flatten [Inhabited α] {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length)
    (n : ℕ) : (ls.take n).flatten ++ω (ls.drop n).flatten = ls.flatten
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing ls <;> grind [tail_eq_drop, take_succ]

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.map_length_take_sum
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem map_length_take_sum {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (n : ℕ) :
    (List.map List.length (take n ls)).sum = ls.cumLen n
proof:
:= by
  induction n <;> grind [take_succ']

/
and `(ls.drop n).flatten` is `ls.flatten.drop (ls.cumLen n)`. -/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.flatten_take_drop
statement:
theorem flatten_take_drop [Inhabited α]
    {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length) (n : ℕ) :
    (ls.take n).flatten = ls.flatten.take (ls.cumLen n) ∧
    (ls.drop n).flatten = ls.flatten.drop (ls.cumLen n)
proof:
:= by
  apply append_left_right_injective
  · rw [append_flatten h_ls n, append_take_drop (ls.cumLen n) ls.flatten]
  · simp

name: Cslib.ωSequence.flatten_take
statement:
theorem flatten_take [Inhabited α]
    {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length) (n : ℕ) :
    (ls.take n).flatten = ls.flatten.take (ls.cumLen n)
proof:
:=
  (flatten_take_drop h_ls n).1

name: Cslib.ωSequence.flatten_drop
statement:
theorem flatten_drop [Inhabited α]
    {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length) (n : ℕ) :
    (ls.drop n).flatten = ls.flatten.drop (ls.cumLen n)
proof:
:=
  (flatten_take_drop h_ls n).2

/
of `ls.flatten` -/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_flatten
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem extract_flatten [Inhabited α] {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length)
    (n : ℕ) : ls.flatten.extract (ls.cumLen n) (ls.cumLen (n + 1)) = ls n
proof:
:= by
  have h_ls' : ∀ k, 0 < (ls.drop n k).length := by grind
  have h_drop := flatten_drop h_ls n
  have h_take := flatten_take h_ls' 1
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take]

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.forall_flatten_iff
statement:
theorem forall_flatten_iff [Inhabited α] {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, 0 < (ls k).length)
    (p : α → Prop) : (∀ n, p (ls.flatten n)) ↔ ∀ k, (ls k).Forall p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [List.forall_iff_forall_mem, List.forall_mem_iff_getElem, ← extract_flatten h_ls]
    grind
  · have := segment_upper_bound (cumLen_strictMono h_ls)
    grind [List.forall_iff_forall_mem, flatten_def]

/
whose `n`-th element is the list `s.extract (f n) (f (n + 1))`.  In all its uses, the
function `f` will always be assumed to be strictly monotonic with `f 0 = 0`. -/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.toSegs_def
statement:
theorem toSegs_def (s : ωSequence α) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    s.toSegs f n = s.extract (f n) (f (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.segment_toSegs_cumLen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segment_toSegs_cumLen {f : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hm : StrictMono f) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (s : ωSequence α) :
    (s.toSegs f).cumLen = f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  have (n' : ℕ) := hm (show n' < n' + 1 by lia)
  induction n <;> grind [toSegs_def]

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.strictMono_flatten
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem strictMono_flatten [Inhabited α] {f : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hm : StrictMono f) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (s : ωSequence α) :
    (s.toSegs f).flatten = s
proof:
:= by
  ext k; rw [flatten_def, segment_toSegs_cumLen hm h0, toSegs_def]
  have := segment_lower_bound hm h0 k
  have := segment_upper_bound hm h0 k
  grind

name: Cslib.ωSequence.frequently_iff_strictMono
statement:
theorem frequently_iff_strictMono {p : ℕ → Prop} :
    (∃ᶠ n in atTop, p n) ↔ ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono f ∧ ∀ m, p (f m)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact extraction_of_frequently_atTop h
  · rintro ⟨f, h_mono, h_p⟩
    rw [Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite]
    have h_range : range f ⊆ {n | p n} := by grind
    grind [Infinite.mono, infinite_range_of_injective, StrictMono.injective]

/
some element in the set occurs infinitely often. -/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.frequently_in_finite_type
statement:
theorem frequently_in_finite_type [Finite α] {s : Set α} {xs : ωSequence α} :
    (∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ s) ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h_inf
    rw [Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite] at h_inf
    have : Infinite (xs ⁻¹' s) := h_inf.to_subtype
    let rf := Set.restrictPreimage s xs
    obtain ⟨⟨x, h_x⟩, h_inf'⟩ := Finite.exists_infinite_fiber rf
    rw [← Set.infinite_range_iff (Subtype.val_injective.comp Subtype.val_injective)] at h_inf'
    simp only [range, comp_apply, Subtype.exists, mem_preimage, mem_singleton_iff,
      restrictPreimage_mk, Subtype.mk.injEq, ← Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite, rf] at h_inf'
    grind
  · rintro ⟨_, _, h_inf⟩
    apply Frequently.mono h_inf
    grind

name: Cslib.ωSequence.frequently_in_strictMono
proof:
:= by
  apply frequently_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  obtain ⟨k, _, _⟩ := frequently_atTop.mp hf (f m)
  use segment f k
  have h0 : f 0 ≤ k := by grind [StrictMono.monotone hm (show 0 ≤ m by grind)]
  split_ands
  · by_contra
    have h1 : segment f k + 1 ≤ m := by grind
    grind [(StrictMono.le_iff_le hm).mpr h1, segment_upper_bound' hm h0]
  · use k - f (segment f k)
    grind [segment_lower_bound' hm h0, segment_upper_bound' hm h0]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.strictMono_of_infinite
statement:
theorem strictMono_of_infinite {ns : Set ℕ} (h : ns.Infinite) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ range φ = ns
proof:
:=
  ⟨nth (· ∈ ns), nth_strictMono h, range_nth_of_infinite h⟩

theorem getElem?_take {s : ωSequence α} : ∀ {k n}, k < n → (s.take n)[k]? = s k
  | 0, _+1, _ => by simp only [length_take, zero_lt_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem]; rfl
  | k+1, n+1, h => by
    rw [take_succ, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_take (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h), get_succ k s]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.getElem?_take_succ
statement:
theorem getElem?_take_succ (n : ℕ) (s : ωSequence α) :
    (take (succ n) s)[n]? = some (s n)
proof:
:=
  getElem?_take (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

name: Cslib.ωSequence.dropLast_take
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem dropLast_take {n : ℕ} {xs : ωSequence α} :
    (ωSequence.take n xs).dropLast = ωSequence.take (n-1) xs
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n => rw [take_succ', List.dropLast_concat, Nat.add_one_sub_one]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.append_take_drop
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem append_take_drop (n : ℕ) (s : ωSequence α) : appendωSequence (take n s) (drop n s) = s
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>rw [take_succ, drop_succ, cons_append_ωSequence, ih (tail s), ωSequence.eta]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.append_take
statement: lemma append_take : x ++ (a.take n) = (x ++ω a).take (x.length + n)
proof:
:= by
  induction x <;> simp [take, Nat.add_comm, cons_append_ωSequence, *]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_get
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma take_get (h : m < (a.take n).length) : (a.take n)[m] = a m
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← append_take_drop n a]; rw [get_append_left]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_append_of_le_length
statement:
theorem take_append_of_le_length (h : n ≤ x.length) :
    (x ++ω a).take n = x.take n
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem (by simp [h])
  intro _ _ _; rw [List.getElem_take, take_get, get_append_left]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_add
statement: lemma take_add : a.take (m + n) = a.take m ++ (a.drop m).take n
proof:
:= by
  apply append_left_injective _ _ (a.drop (m + n)) ((a.drop m).drop n) <;>
    simp [- drop_drop]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_prefix_take_left
statement: @[gcongr] lemma take_prefix_take_left (h : m ≤ n) : a.take m <+: a.take n
proof:
:= by
  rw [(by simp [h] : a.take m = (a.take n).take m)]
  apply List.take_prefix

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_prefix
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma take_prefix : a.take m <+: a.take n ↔ m ≤ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h.length_le, take_prefix_take_left m n a⟩

name: Cslib.ωSequence.map_take
statement: lemma map_take (f : α → β) : (a.take n).map f = (a.map f).take n
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem <;> simp

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_drop
statement: lemma take_drop : (a.drop m).take n = (a.take (m + n)).drop m
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem <;> simp

name: Cslib.ωSequence.drop_append_of_le_length
statement:
lemma drop_append_of_le_length (h : n ≤ x.length) :
    (x ++ω a).drop n = x.drop n ++ω a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  ext k; rcases lt_or_ge k m with _ | hk
  · rw [get_drop, get_append_left, get_append_left, List.getElem_drop]; simpa [hm]
  · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hk
    have hm' : m = (x.drop n).length := by simp [hm]
    simp_rw [get_drop, ← Nat.add_assoc, ← hm, get_append_right, hm', get_append_right]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.drop_append_of_ge_length
statement:
theorem drop_append_of_ge_length {xl : List α} {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ n) :
    (xl ++ω xs).drop n = xs.drop (n - xl.length)
proof:
:= by
  ext k; simp (disch := omega) only [get_drop, get_append_right']
  congr; omega

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_theorem
statement: theorem take_theorem (s₁ s₂ : ωSequence α) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, take n s₁ = take n s₂) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [take] using h 1
  | succ n =>
    have h₁ : some (s₁ (succ n)) = some (s₂ (succ n)) := by
      rw [← getElem?_take_succ, ← getElem?_take_succ, h (succ (succ n))]
    injection h₁

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_eq_drop_take
statement:
theorem extract_eq_drop_take {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = take (n - m) (xs.drop m)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_eq_ofFn
statement:
theorem extract_eq_ofFn {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (n - m) ↦ xs (m + k))
proof:
:= by
  ext k; cases Decidable.em (k < n - m) <;>
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, getElem?_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_eq_extract
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extract_eq_ofFn, List.ofFn_inj', Sigma.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨h_eq, h_fun⟩ := h
  rw [← h_eq] at h_fun
  simp_all [funext_iff, Fin.forall_iff]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_eq_take
statement:
theorem extract_eq_take {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract 0 n = xs.take n
proof:
:= by
  simp [extract_eq_drop_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.append_extract_drop
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem append_extract_drop {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract 0 n) ++ω (xs.drop n) = xs
proof:
:= by
  simp [extract_eq_take, append_take_drop]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_append_right_right
statement:
theorem extract_append_right_right {xl : List α} {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ m) :
    (xl ++ω xs).extract m n = xs.extract (m - xl.length) (n - xl.length)
proof:
:= by
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, drop_append_of_ge_length]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_append_zero_right
statement:
theorem extract_append_zero_right {xl : List α} {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ n) :
    (xl ++ω xs).extract 0 n = xl ++ (xs.extract 0 (n - xl.length))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = xl.length + k := ⟨n - xl.length, by omega⟩
  simp [extract_eq_take, ← append_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_drop
statement:
theorem extract_drop {xs : ωSequence α} {k m n : ℕ} :
    (xs.drop k).extract m n = xs.extract (k + m) (k + n)
proof:
:= by
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.length_extract
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem length_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract m n).length = n - m
proof:
:= by
  simp [extract_eq_drop_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem extract_eq_nil {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract n n = []
proof:
:= by
  simp [extract_eq_drop_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_eq_nil_iff
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem extract_eq_nil_iff {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = [] ↔ n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← List.length_eq_zero_iff]
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.get_extract
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem get_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k < n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n)[k]'(by simp [h]) = xs (m + k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [extract_eq_drop_take]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.append_extract_extract
statement:
theorem append_extract_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {k m n : ℕ} (h_km : k ≤ m) (h_mn : m ≤ n) :
    (xs.extract k m) ++ (xs.extract m n) = xs.extract k n
proof:
:= by
  have : n - k = (m - k) + (n - m) := by grind
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, take_add]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_succ_right
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem extract_succ_right {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} (h_mn : m ≤ n) :
    xs.extract m (n + 1) = xs.extract m n ++ [xs n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← append_extract_extract h_mn] <;>
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, add_tsub_cancel_left]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_lu_extract_lu
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem extract_lu_extract_lu {xs : ωSequence α} {m n i j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n).extract i j = xs.extract (m + i) (m + j)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  cases Decidable.em (k < j - i) <;> grind [extract_eq_ofFn]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_0u_extract_lu
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem extract_0u_extract_lu {xs : ωSequence α} {n i j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    (xs.extract 0 n).extract i j = xs.extract i j
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: Cslib.ωSequence.extract_0u_extract_l
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem extract_0u_extract_l {xs : ωSequence α} {n i : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract 0 n).extract i = xs.extract i n
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: Cslib.ωSequence.take_extract
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem take_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n).take k = xs.extract m (m + k)
proof:
:= by
  grind [extract_lu_extract_lu (xs := xs) (i := 0) h]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.drop_extract
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem drop_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n).drop k = xs.extract (m + k) n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases m ≤ n
  · grind only [extract_lu_extract_lu, length_extract, List.length_drop, List.take_length]
  · have : k = 0 := by grind only
    grind only [List.drop_zero]

name: Cslib.ωSequence.Step.mk
statement: theorem Step.mk {xs : ωSequence α} (h : ∀ k, xs k ∈ p → xs (k + 1) ∈ q) : Step xs p q

name: Cslib.ωSequence.LeadsTo.mk
statement:
theorem LeadsTo.mk {xs : ωSequence α} (h : ∀ k, xs k ∈ p → ∃ k', k ≤ k' ∧ xs k' ∈ q) :
    LeadsTo xs p q

name: Cslib.ωSequence.step_leadsTo
statement: theorem step_leadsTo {p q : Set α} (h : xs.Step p q) : xs.LeadsTo p q
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: Cslib.ωSequence.leadsTo_trans
statement:
theorem leadsTo_trans {p q r : Set α}
    (h1 : xs.LeadsTo p q) (h2 : xs.LeadsTo q r) : xs.LeadsTo p r
proof:
:= by
  grind only [LeadsTo]

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.leadsTo_cases_or
statement:
theorem leadsTo_cases_or {p q r s : Set α}
    (h1 : xs.LeadsTo (p ∩ q) r) (h2 : xs.LeadsTo (p ∩ qᶜ) s) : xs.LeadsTo p (r ∪ s)
proof:
:= by
  grind

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.until_frequently_not_leadsTo
statement:
theorem until_frequently_not_leadsTo {p q : Set α}
    (h1 : xs.Step (p ∩ qᶜ) p) (h2 : ∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∉ p) : xs.LeadsTo p q
proof:
:= by
  intro k h_p
  by_contra! h_q
  suffices ∀ k' ≥ k, xs k' ∈ p by
    have := frequently_atTop.mp h2 k
    grind
  intro k' h_k'
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h_k'
  induction n <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.until_frequently_leadsTo_and
statement:
theorem until_frequently_leadsTo_and {p q : Set α}
    (h1 : xs.Step (p ∩ qᶜ) p) (h2 : ∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ q) : xs.LeadsTo p (p ∩ q)
proof:
:= by
  intro k h_p
  by_contra! h_not_pq
  suffices ∀ k' ≥ k, xs k' ∈ p ∩ qᶜ by
    have := frequently_atTop.mp h2 k
    grind
  intro k' h_k'
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h_k'
  induction n <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.frequently_leadsTo_frequently
statement:
theorem frequently_leadsTo_frequently {p q : Set α}
    (h1 : ∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ p) (h2 : xs.LeadsTo p q) : ∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [frequently_atTop] at h1 ⊢
  intro k0
  have := h1 k0
  grind

name: Cslib.ωSequence.drop_frequently_iff_frequently
statement:
theorem drop_frequently_iff_frequently {p : Set α} (n : ℕ) :
    (∃ᶠ k in atTop, (xs.drop n) k ∈ p) ↔ (∃ᶠ k in atTop, xs k ∈ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frequently_atTop, get_drop]
  constructor
  · intro h m
    grind [h m]
  · intro h m
    obtain ⟨k, _⟩ := h (m + n)
    use k - n
    grind

name: Cslib.ωSequence.homeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homeomorph_apply (xs : ωSequence α) (i : Nat) :
    homeomorph xs i = .toTopology ⊥ (xs i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Cslib.ωSequence.homeomorph_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homeomorph_symm_apply (f : ℕ → WithDiscreteTopology α) :
    homeomorph.symm f = ωSequence.mk fun i => (f i).ofTopology
proof:
:=
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cylinder_def
statement:
theorem cylinder_def (xs : ωSequence α) (n : ℕ) :
    xs.cylinder n = { ys | ∀ k, k < n → ys k = xs k }
proof:
:= by
  simp [cylinder, PiNat.cylinder]

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.cylinder_eq_prepend_range
statement:
theorem cylinder_eq_prepend_range (xs : ωSequence α) (n : ℕ) :
    xs.cylinder n = range (xs.take n ++ω ·)
proof:
:= by
  ext ys
  simp only [cylinder_def, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro h
    use ys.drop n
    suffices xs.take n = ys.take n by grind
    apply List.ext_get <;> grind
  · grind [get_append_left]

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.isTopologicalBasis_cylinders
statement:
theorem isTopologicalBasis_cylinders :
    IsTopologicalBasis { s | ∃ (xs : ωSequence α) (n : ℕ), s = xs.cylinder n }
proof:
:= by
  convert Topology.IsInducing.isTopologicalBasis homeomorph.isInducing <|
    PiNat.isTopologicalBasis_cylinders _
  ext
  constructor
  · grind [cylinder]
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨xs, n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    use (discharger := rfl) homeomorph.symm xs, n

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.isOpen_cylinder
statement:
theorem isOpen_cylinder (xs : ωSequence α) (n : ℕ) :
    IsOpen (xs.cylinder n)
proof:
:= homeomorph.continuous.isOpen_preimage _ (PiNat.isOpen_cylinder ..)

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.nhds_cylinders
statement:
theorem nhds_cylinders {xs : ωSequence α} {s : Set (ωSequence α)} (hx : xs ∈ s) (hs : IsOpen s) :
    ∃ (ys : ωSequence α) (n : ℕ), xs ∈ ys.cylinder n ∧ ys.cylinder n ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨ys, n, rfl⟩, hx', hy⟩:= isTopologicalBasis_cylinders.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx hs
  use ys, n

/
extensions are also in the set. -/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.isOpen_iff
statement:
theorem isOpen_iff (s : Set (ωSequence α)) :
    IsOpen s ↔ ∀ xs, xs ∈ s → ∃ n, ∀ ys, (xs.take n) ++ω ys ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsTopologicalBasis.isOpen_iff isTopologicalBasis_cylinders,
    cylinder_eq_prepend_range, mem_ofPred_eq, ↓existsAndEq, mem_range, true_and]
  constructor <;> intro h xs hxs
  · obtain ⟨_, n, ⟨_, rfl⟩, _⟩ := h xs hxs
    use n
    grind [take_append_of_le_length]
  · obtain ⟨n, _⟩ := h xs hxs
    use xs, n, ⟨xs.drop n, ?_⟩ <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.ωSequence.dense_iff
statement:
theorem dense_iff (s : Set (ωSequence α)) :
    Dense s ↔ ∀ (xs : ωSequence α) (n : ℕ), ∃ ys, (xs.take n) ++ω ys ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsTopologicalBasis.dense_iff isTopologicalBasis_cylinders, cylinder_eq_prepend_range,
    mem_ofPred_eq, forall_exists_index]
  constructor
  · intro h xs n
    obtain ⟨ys, h1, _⟩ := h (xs.cylinder n) xs n
      (by simp [cylinder_eq_prepend_range]) (by use xs; simp [cylinder_def])
    use ys.drop n
    suffices xs.take n = ys.take n by grind
    grind [cylinder_eq_prepend_range, take_append_of_le_length]
  · rintro h c xs n rfl ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ys, _⟩ := h xs n
    use xs.take n ++ω ys
    grind

name: PFunctor.ext
statement:
@[ext (iff := false)]
theorem ext {P Q : PFunctor.{uA, uB}} (h : P.A = Q.A) (h' : ∀ a, P.B a = Q.B (h ▸ a)) :
    P = Q
proof:
:= by
  cases P; cases Q; simp only [mk.injEq] at h h' ⊢; subst h
  simp_all only [heq_eq_eq, true_and]; funext; exact h' _

/

name: PFunctor.const_apply
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem const_apply {P : PFunctor} (a : P.A) (x : α) (i : P.B a) : PFunctor.const a x i = x
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.monomial_A
statement: lemma monomial_A (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) : (monomial A B).A = A
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.monomial_B

lemma monomial_B (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB) (a : (monomial A B).A) :
    (monomial A B).B a = B
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.C_pempty
statement: @[simp] lemma C_pempty : C PEmpty = 0
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.C_punit
statement: @[simp] lemma C_punit : C PUnit = 1
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.linear_punit
statement: @[simp] lemma linear_punit : linear PUnit = y
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.selfMonomial_punit
statement: @[simp] lemma selfMonomial_punit : selfMonomial PUnit = y

name: PFunctor.purePower_punit
statement: @[simp] lemma purePower_punit : purePower PUnit = y
