name: PFunctor.add_eq_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma add_eq_add (P : PFunctor.{uA₁, uB}) (Q : PFunctor.{uA₂, uB}) :
    P.add Q = P + Q
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.prod_eq_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma prod_eq_mul (P : PFunctor.{uA₁, uB₁}) (Q : PFunctor.{uA₂, uB₂}) :
    P.prod Q = P * Q
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.Unary.fun_eq_const
statement:
theorem Unary.fun_eq_const [Unary P]
    (a : P.A) (f : P.B a → α) : f = fun _ => f default
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact congrArg f (Subsingleton.elim i default)

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.foldFreeM_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_pure (onValue : α → β) (onEffect : (a : P.A) → (P.B a → β) → β) (a : α) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect (pure a) = onValue a
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.foldFreeM_lift_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_lift_bind (onValue : α → β) (onEffect : (a : P.A) → (P.B a → β) → β)
    (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect ((lift a).bind (α := no_index (P.B a)) cont) =
      onEffect a (fun b => foldFreeM onValue onEffect (cont b))
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.foldFreeM_lift_bind'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_lift_bind' {α : Type uB} (onValue : α → β)
    (onEffect : (a : P.A) → (P.B a → β) → β) (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect (Bind.bind (α := no_index (P.B a)) (lift a) cont) =
      onEffect a (fun b => foldFreeM onValue onEffect (cont b))
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.foldFreeM_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldFreeM_lift (a : P.A) (onValue : P.B a → β)
    (onEffect : (a : P.A) → (P.B a → β) → β) :
    foldFreeM (α := no_index (P.B a)) onValue onEffect (lift a) = onEffect a onValue
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.foldFreeM_unique
statement:
theorem foldFreeM_unique (onValue : α → β) (onEffect : (a : P.A) → (P.B a → β) → β)
    (h : P.FreeM α → β) (h_pure : ∀ a, h (pure a) = onValue a)
    (h_lift_bind : ∀ (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α),
      h ((lift a).bind cont) = onEffect a (fun b => h (cont b))) :
    h = foldFreeM onValue onEffect
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  induction x with
  | pure a => exact h_pure a
  | lift_bind a cont ih =>
    exact (h_lift_bind a cont).trans (congrArg (onEffect a) (funext ih))

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.foldFreeM_bind
statement:
theorem foldFreeM_bind (onValue : β → γ) (onEffect : (a : P.A) → (P.B a → γ) → γ)
    (x : P.FreeM α) (k : α → P.FreeM β) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect (x.bind k) =
      foldFreeM (fun a => foldFreeM onValue onEffect (k a)) onEffect x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind a cont ih => exact congrArg (onEffect a) (funext ih)

name: PFunctor.FreeM.foldFreeM_map
statement:
theorem foldFreeM_map (onValue : β → γ) (onEffect : (a : P.A) → (P.B a → γ) → γ)
    (f : α → β) (x : P.FreeM α) :
    foldFreeM onValue onEffect (map f x) = foldFreeM (onValue ∘ f) onEffect x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bind_pure_comp, foldFreeM_bind]
  rfl

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_eq_foldFreeM
proof:
:=
  foldFreeM_unique _ _ _ (liftM_pure interp) (fun _ _ => rfl)

name: PFunctor.FreeM.toWOfIsEmpty_lift_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FreeM.toWOfIsEmpty_lift_bind [IsEmpty α] (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) :
    toWOfIsEmpty ((lift a).bind (α := no_index (P.B a)) cont) =
      W.mk (.mk a fun b => toWOfIsEmpty (cont b))
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.toWOfIsEmpty_lift_bind'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FreeM.toWOfIsEmpty_lift_bind' {α : Type uB} [IsEmpty α] (a : P.A)
    (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) :
    toWOfIsEmpty (Bind.bind (α := no_index (P.B a)) (lift a) cont) =
      W.mk (.mk a fun b => toWOfIsEmpty (cont b))
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.W.toFreeM_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem W.toFreeM_mk (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.W) :
    toFreeM (α := α) (W.mk (.mk a cont)) =
      (FreeM.lift a).bind (fun b => toFreeM (cont b))
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.toWOfIsEmpty_toFreeM
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FreeM.toWOfIsEmpty_toFreeM [IsEmpty α] (x : P.W) :
    toWOfIsEmpty (W.toFreeM (α := α) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | mk a cont ih => exact congrArg (WType.mk a) (funext ih)

name: PFunctor.W.toFreeM_toWOfIsEmpty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem W.toFreeM_toWOfIsEmpty [IsEmpty α] (x : P.FreeM α) :
    toFreeM (FreeM.toWOfIsEmpty x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => exact isEmptyElim a
  | lift_bind a cont ih => exact congrArg (FreeM.liftBind a) (funext ih)

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.pure_eq_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pure_eq_pure : (FreeM.pure : α → P.FreeM α) = pure
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.lift_ne_pure
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_ne_pure (a : P.A) (y : P.B a) :
    (lift a : P.FreeM (P.B a)) ≠ pure y
proof: := by simp [lift]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.pure_ne_lift
statement:
@[simp] lemma pure_ne_lift (a : P.A) (y : P.B a) :
    pure y ≠ (lift a : P.FreeM (P.B a))
proof:
:= by simp [lift]

/

The builtin `>>=` notation should be preferred when `α` and `β` are in the same universe. -/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.bind_eq_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_eq_bind {α β : Type v} :
    (FreeM.bind : P.FreeM α → _ → P.FreeM β) = Bind.bind
proof:
:= rfl

/

The builtin `<$>` notation should be preferred when `α` and `β` are in the same universe. -/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.map_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_map {α β : Type v} :
    FreeM.map (P := P) (α := α) (β := β) = Functor.map
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftBind_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftBind_eq (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) :
    FreeM.liftBind a cont = (FreeM.lift a).bind cont
proof:
:= rfl

/

This lifts the shape `x.1` with `lift` and relabels the responses with `x.2`. We use the
universe-polymorphic `FreeM.map` rather than `<$>`, since the response type `P.B x.1` and the
target `α` need not lie in the same universe. -/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftObj_ne_pure
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftObj_ne_pure (x : P.Obj α) (y : α) :
    (liftObj x : P.FreeM α) ≠ pure y
proof: := by simp [liftObj, lift, map, -liftBind_eq]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.pure_ne_liftObj
statement:
@[simp] lemma pure_ne_liftObj (x : P.Obj α) (y : α) :
    pure y ≠ (liftObj x : P.FreeM α)
proof: := by simp [liftObj, lift, map, -liftBind_eq]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.monadLift_eq_liftObj
statement: lemma monadLift_eq_liftObj (x : P.Obj α) : (x : P.FreeM α) = FreeM.liftObj x
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.induction
statement:
@[induction_eliminator]
protected theorem induction {motive : P.FreeM α → Prop}
    (pure : ∀ a, motive (pure a))
    (lift_bind : ∀ (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) (ih : ∀ i, motive (cont i)),
      motive ((FreeM.lift a).bind cont)) : ∀ x, motive x
  | .pure a => pure a
  | liftBind a cont => lift_bind a cont fun u => FreeM.induction pure lift_bind (cont u)

protected theorem bind_assoc (x : P.FreeM α) (f : α → P.FreeM β) (g : β → P.FreeM γ) :
    (x.bind f).bind g = x.bind (fun a => (f a).bind g)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind a cont ih => simp [← liftBind_eq, FreeM.bind, ih] at *

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.bind_assoc
statement:
theorem bind_assoc (x : P.FreeM α) (f : α → P.FreeM β) (g : β → P.FreeM γ) :
    (x.bind f).bind g = x.bind (fun a => (f a).bind g)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => rfl
  | lift_bind a cont ih => simp [← liftBind_eq, FreeM.bind, ih] at *

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.pure_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pure_bind (a : α) (f : α → P.FreeM β) :
    (pure a : P.FreeM α).bind f = f a
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.bind_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bind_pure : ∀ x : P.FreeM α, x.bind pure = x
  | .pure a => rfl
  | .liftBind a cont => by
    simp only [FreeM.bind]; congr 1; funext u; exact bind_pure (cont u)

@[simp]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.bind_pure_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bind_pure_comp (f : α → β) : ∀ x : P.FreeM α, x.bind (pure ∘ f) = map f x
  | .pure a => rfl
  | .liftBind a cont => by simp only [FreeM.bind, map, bind_pure_comp]

@[simp]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.map_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_pure (f : α → β) (x : α) : map f (pure x : P.FreeM α) = pure (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.map_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bind (f : β → γ) (x : P.FreeM α) (cont : α → P.FreeM β) :
    map f (x.bind cont) = x.bind fun a => (cont a).map f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← bind_pure_comp, FreeM.bind_assoc]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftBind_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftBind_bind (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM β) (f : β → P.FreeM γ) :
    ((FreeM.lift a).bind cont).bind f = (FreeM.lift a).bind (fun u ↦ (cont u).bind f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lift]
  exact FreeM.bind_assoc (FreeM.liftBind a pure) cont f

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftObj_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftObj_bind (x : P.Obj α) (f : α → P.FreeM β) :
    (FreeM.liftObj x).bind f = FreeM.liftBind x.1 (fun a ↦ f (x.2 a))
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.bind_eq_pure_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma bind_eq_pure_iff (x : P.FreeM α) (f : α → P.FreeM β) (b : β) :
    x.bind f = pure b ↔ ∃ a, x = pure a ∧ f a = pure b
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | pure a => exact ⟨fun h => ⟨a, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h, hf⟩ => by cases h; exact hf⟩
  | liftBind a cont =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      cases h
    · rintro ⟨_, h, _⟩
      cases h

name: PFunctor.FreeM.pure_eq_bind_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma pure_eq_bind_iff (x : P.FreeM α) (f : α → P.FreeM β) (b : β) :
    pure b = x.bind f ↔ ∃ a, x = pure a ∧ pure b = f a
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | pure a => exact ⟨fun h => ⟨a, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h, hf⟩ => by cases h; exact hf⟩
  | liftBind a cont =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      cases h
    · rintro ⟨_, h, _⟩
      cases h

name: PFunctor.FreeM.id_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_map : ∀ x : P.FreeM α, map id x = x
  | .pure a => rfl
  | .liftBind a cont => by
    simp only [map]
    congr 1
    funext u
    exact id_map (cont u)

name: PFunctor.FreeM.comp_map
statement:
theorem comp_map (h : β → γ) (g : α → β) :
    ∀ x : P.FreeM α, map (h ∘ g) x = map h (map g x)
  | .pure a => rfl
  | .liftBind a cont => by
    simp only [map]
    congr 1
    funext u
    exact comp_map h g (cont u)

instance : LawfulMonad (P.FreeM)
proof:
:= LawfulMonad.mk'
  (bind_pure_comp := bind_pure_comp)
  (id_map := id_map)
  (pure_bind := pure_bind)
  (bind_assoc := FreeM.bind_assoc)

name: PFunctor.FreeM.pure_inj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pure_inj (a b : α) : (pure a : P.FreeM α) = pure b ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h
    rfl
  · rintro rfl; rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftBind_inj
statement:
lemma liftBind_inj (a a' : P.A)
    (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) (cont' : P.B a' → P.FreeM α) :
    FreeM.liftBind a cont = FreeM.liftBind a' cont' ↔ ∃ h : a = a', h ▸ cont = cont'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_pure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_pure (a : α) : (Pure.pure a : P.FreeM α).liftM interp = Pure.pure a
proof: := rfl

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_lift_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_lift_bind (a : P.A) (cont : P.B a → P.FreeM α) :
    FreeM.liftM interp (FreeM.lift a >>= cont) =
      (do let u ← interp a; (cont u).liftM interp)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [FreeM.liftM, FreeM.bind, FreeM.lift]
  rfl

/
A predicate stating that `eval : P.FreeM α → m α` is an interpreter for the polynomial
effect handler `handler : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)`.

This means that `eval` is a monad morphism from the free monad `P.FreeM` to the
monad `m`, and that it extends the interpretation of individual operations given by
`handler`.
-/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.Interprets.eq
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  induction x with
  | pure a => exact h.apply_pure a
  | lift_bind a cont ih =>
    rw [h.apply_lift_bind]
    conv_rhs => simp only [bind_eq_bind, liftM_lift_bind]
    simp only [ih]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.Interprets.liftM
statement:
theorem Interprets.liftM (handler : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) :
    Interprets handler (·.liftM handler : P.FreeM α → _) where
  apply_pure _
proof:
:= rfl
  apply_lift_bind _ _ := rfl

/
The universal property of the free monad `P.FreeM`.

That is, `liftM handler` is the unique interpreter that extends the effect handler `handler` to
interpret `P.FreeM` computations in a monad `m`.
-/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.Interprets.iff
statement:
theorem Interprets.iff (handler : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) (eval : P.FreeM α → m α) :
    Interprets handler eval ↔ eval = (·.liftM handler)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.eq), fun h => h ▸ Interprets.liftM _⟩

/

name: Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_pfunctorFreeMLiftM
statement:
theorem _root_.Cslib.IsMonadHom.map_pfunctorFreeMLiftM [Monad n]
    {f : ∀ {α}, m α → n α} (hf : Cslib.IsMonadHom m n f) (interp : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a))
    (x : P.FreeM α) :
    f (x.liftM interp) = x.liftM (fun op => f (interp op))
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure a => exact hf.map_pure a
  | lift_bind op cont ih =>
    simp only [bind_eq_bind, liftM_lift_bind, hf.map_bind, ih]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_bind
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_bind {α β : Type uB} (x : P.FreeM α) (f : α → P.FreeM β) :
    (x >>= f).liftM interp = (do let u ← x.liftM interp; (f u).liftM interp)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure _ => simp only [liftM_pure, LawfulMonad.pure_bind]
  | lift_bind a cont h =>
    simp_rw [bind_eq_bind]
    rw [LawfulMonad.bind_assoc, liftM_lift_bind]
    simp_rw [liftM_lift_bind, LawfulMonad.bind_assoc]
    congr 1
    funext u
    exact h u

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.isMonadHom_liftM
statement: theorem isMonadHom_liftM : Cslib.IsMonadHom P.FreeM m (FreeM.liftM interp)
proof:
:=
  .mk' (liftM_pure interp) (liftM_bind interp)

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_map {α β : Type uB} (f : α → β) (interp : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) (x : P.FreeM α) :
    (f <$> x).liftM interp = f <$> x.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_map _ _

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_seq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_seq {α β : Type uB}
    (interp : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) (x : P.FreeM (α → β)) (y : P.FreeM α) :
    (x <*> y).liftM interp = x.liftM interp <*> y.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_seq _ _

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_seqLeft
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_seqLeft {α β : Type uB}
    (interp : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) (x : P.FreeM α) (y : P.FreeM β) :
    (x <* y).liftM interp = x.liftM interp <* y.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_seqLeft _ _

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_seqRight
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_seqRight {α β : Type uB}
    (interp : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) (x : P.FreeM α) (y : P.FreeM β) :
    (x *> y).liftM interp = x.liftM interp *> y.liftM interp
proof:
:=
  isMonadHom_liftM interp |>.map_seqRight _ _

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_lift
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_lift (interp : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) (a : P.A) :
    (FreeM.lift a).liftM interp = interp a
proof:
:= by
  simpa [bind_pure] using
    (liftM_lift_bind (interp := interp) (a := a) (cont := pure))

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_liftObj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftM_liftObj (interp : (a : P.A) → m (P.B a)) (x : P.Obj α) :
    (FreeM.liftObj x).liftM interp = x.2 <$> interp x.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftObj]

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_lift_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftM_lift_eq_self {α : Type uB} (x : P.FreeM α) : FreeM.liftM FreeM.lift x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | pure _ => rfl
  | lift_bind _ _ ih => simp [ih]

/

name: PFunctor.FreeM.liftM_comp
statement:
theorem liftM_comp {m : Type uB → Type v} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    {Q : PFunctor.{u, uB}} {α : Type uB} (x : P.FreeM α)
    (first : (a : P.A) → Q.FreeM (P.B a)) (second : (a : Q.A) → m (Q.B a)) :
    (x.liftM first).liftM second = x.liftM fun a => (first a).liftM second
proof:
:=
  (isMonadHom_liftM second).map_pfunctorFreeMLiftM first x

name: Set.saturates_compl
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind .]
theorem saturates_compl (hs : Saturates f s) : Saturates f sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rintro i ⟨_, _⟩ y _ _
  have : (f i ∩ s).Nonempty := ⟨y, by grind⟩
  grind [Saturates]

/

name: Set.saturates_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem saturates_eq_biUnion (hs : Saturates f s) (hc : ⋃ i, f i = univ) :
    s = ⋃ i ∈ {i | (f i ∩ s).Nonempty}, f i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · intro h_x
    obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp <| univ_subset_iff.mpr hc <| mem_univ x
    use i, ⟨x, by grind⟩, by grind
  · rintro ⟨i, h_i, _⟩
    grind [hs i h_i]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.empty_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma empty_eq_nil : (∅ : StackTape Symbol) = nil
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.nil_toList
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma nil_toList : (nil : StackTape Symbol).toList = []
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.cons_none_nil_toList
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma cons_none_nil_toList : (cons none (nil : StackTape Symbol)).toList = []
proof:
:= by
  grind only [nil, cons]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.cons_some_toList
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cons_some_toList (a : Symbol) (l : StackTape Symbol) :
    (cons (some a) l).toList = some a :: l.toList
proof:
:= by simp only [cons]

/

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.eq_iff
statement:
lemma eq_iff (l1 l2 : StackTape Symbol) :
    l1 = l2 ↔ l1.head = l2.head ∧ l1.tail = l2.tail
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · grind
  · intro ⟨hhead, htail⟩
    cases l1 with | mk as1 h1 =>
    cases l2 with | mk as2 h2 =>
    cases as1 <;> cases as2 <;> grind [nil]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.head_cons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma head_cons (o : Option Symbol) (l : StackTape Symbol) : (cons o l).head = o
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none =>
    cases l with | mk toList hl =>
    cases toList <;> grind [cons]
  | some a => grind [cons_some_toList]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.tail_cons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tail_cons (o : Option Symbol) (l : StackTape Symbol) : (cons o l).tail = l
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none =>
    cases l with | mk toList h =>
    cases toList <;> grind [nil, cons]
  | some a =>
    simp only [cons, tail]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.cons_head_tail
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cons_head_tail (l : StackTape Symbol) :
    cons (l.head) (l.tail) = l
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_iff]
  simp

/

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.length_tail_le
statement: lemma length_tail_le (l : StackTape Symbol) : l.tail.length ≤ l.length
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.length_cons_none
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma length_cons_none (l : StackTape Symbol) :
    (cons none l).length = l.length + if l.length = 0 then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  cases l with | mk toList h =>
  cases toList <;> grind [cons]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.length_cons_some
statement:
lemma length_cons_some (a : Symbol) (l : StackTape Symbol) :
    (cons (some a) l).length = l.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  grind [cons_some_toList]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.length_cons_le
statement:
lemma length_cons_le (o : Option Symbol) (l : StackTape Symbol) :
    (cons o l).length ≤ l.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases o <;> grind [cons_some_toList]

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.length_mapSome
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma length_mapSome (l : List Symbol) : (mapSome l).length = l.length
proof: := by grind

name: Cslib.Turing.StackTape.length_nil
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma length_nil : (nil : StackTape Symbol).length = 0
proof: := by grind

name: Cslib.Logic.InferenceSystem.DerivableIn.fromDerivation
statement: theorem DerivableIn.fromDerivation [InferenceSystem S α] {a : α} (d : S⇓a) : DerivableIn S a
proof:
:=
  Nonempty.intro d

name: Cslib.Logic.finiteAnd_nil
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem finiteAnd_nil [HasAnd α] [Top α] : ⋀([] : List α) = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.Logic.finiteAnd_cons
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem finiteAnd_cons [HasAnd α] [Top α] (a : α) (as : List α) :
    ⋀(a :: as) = (a ∧ ⋀as)
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.Logic.finiteOr_nil
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem finiteOr_nil [HasOr α] [Bot α] : ⋁([] : List α) = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.Logic.finiteOr_cons

statement:
theorem HasFiniteSupport.exists_eq_sum_smul_dirac {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (μ : Measure α) [HasFiniteSupport μ] :
    ∃ s : Finset α, μ = ∑ a ∈ s, μ {a} • Measure.dirac a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hμ⟩ := HasFiniteSupport.exists_finite_measure_compl_zero (μ := μ)
  refine ⟨hs.toFinset, Measure.ae_mem_finset_iff.mp ?_⟩
  change μ (hs.toFinset : Set α)ᶜ = 0
  simpa using hμ

/

    (t : Set α) : NullMeasurableSet t μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hμ⟩ := HasFiniteSupport.exists_finite_measure_compl_zero (μ := μ)
  rw [← inter_union_sdiff t s]
  exact (hs.subset inter_subset_right).measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet.union_null
    (measure_mono_null (sdiff_subset_compl t s) hμ)

name: Relation.commute_equivalents
statement:
theorem commute_equivalents :
    [SemiCommute r₁ r₂, Commute r₁ r₂, IsTrans α (Join₂ (ReflTransGen r₁) (ReflTransGen r₂)),
      ReflTransGen (r₁ ⊔ swap r₂) ≤ Join₂ (ReflTransGen r₁) (ReflTransGen r₂),
      ReflTransGen (r₁ ⊔ swap r₂) = Join₂ (ReflTransGen r₁) (ReflTransGen r₂)].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := SemiCommute.to_commute
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := Commute.isTrans_join₂_reflTransGen
  tfae_have 3 → 4 := fun h => reflTransGen_le_of_le <|
    sup_le left_le_join₂_reflTransGen swap_right_le_join₂_reflTransGen
  tfae_have 4 → 5 := fun h => h.antisymm <|
    join₂_reflTransGen_le (le_sup_left.trans le_reflTransGen) (le_sup_right.trans le_reflTransGen)
  tfae_have 5 → 1 := by
    intro h a b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂
    rw [Join₂.swap_iff, ← h]
    exact (ReflTransGen.mono le_sup_right _ _ <| reflTransGen_swap.mpr h₂).tail (Or.inl h₁)
  tfae_finish

name: Relation.Normalizing.confluent_iff_forall_unique_normal
statement:
theorem Normalizing.confluent_iff_forall_unique_normal (hn : Normalizing r) :
    Confluent r ↔ ∀ a : α, ∃! n : α, ReflTransGen r a n ∧ Normal r n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hc a
    apply existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique (hn a)
    rintro n₁ n₂ ⟨hr₁, hn₁⟩ ⟨hr₂, hn₂⟩
    have hj : Join (ReflTransGen r) n₁ n₂ := hc hr₁ hr₂
    obtain ⟨m, h₁, h₂⟩ := hj
    rw [Normal.reflTransGen_eq hn₁ h₁, Normal.reflTransGen_eq hn₂ h₂]
  · intro h a b c hab hac
    obtain ⟨na, ⟨han, hnnor⟩, H⟩ := h a
    use na
    obtain ⟨nb, hbnb, hnb⟩ := hn b
    obtain ⟨nc, hcnc, hnc⟩ := hn c
    have hanb : (ReflTransGen r) a nb := ReflTransGen.trans hab hbnb
    have hanc : (ReflTransGen r) a nc := ReflTransGen.trans hac hcnc
    grind

name: Relation.LocallyCommute.commute_of_terminating_sup
statement:
theorem LocallyCommute.commute_of_terminating_sup (hlc : LocallyCommute r₁ r₂)
    (ht : Terminating (r₁ ⊔ r₂)) : Commute r₁ r₂
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using ht.induction with
  | h x ih =>
    intro y z hy hz
    rcases hy.cases_head with (rfl | ⟨y', hy, hy'⟩)
    · use z
    · rcases hz.cases_head with (rfl | ⟨z', hz, hz'⟩)
      · use y
      · obtain ⟨u, hyu, hzu⟩ := hlc hy hz
        obtain ⟨v, hyv, huv⟩ := ih y' (join_inl hy) hy' hyu
        obtain ⟨w, hvw, hzw⟩ := ih z' (join_inr hz) (hzu.trans huv) hz'
        exact ⟨w, hyv.trans hvw, hzw⟩

/

name: Relation.LocallyConfluent.terminating_toConfluent
statement:
theorem LocallyConfluent.terminating_toConfluent (hlc : LocallyConfluent r) (ht : Terminating r) :

name: Relation.StronglyCommute.extend
statement:
theorem StronglyCommute.extend (h : StronglyCommute r₁ r₂) (xy : ReflTransGen r₁ x y)
    (xz : r₂ x z) : ∃ w, ReflGen r₂ y w ∧ ReflTransGen r₁ z w
proof:
:= by
  induction xy with
  | refl => exact ⟨z, .single xz, .refl⟩
  | @tail b c _ bc ih =>
    obtain ⟨w, bw, zw⟩ := ih
    cases bw with
    | refl => exact ⟨c, .refl, zw.tail bc⟩
    | single bw => cases h bc bw; grind [ReflTransGen.trans]

name: Relation.StronglyCommute.to_commute
statement: theorem StronglyCommute.to_commute (h : StronglyCommute r₁ r₂) : Commute r₁ r₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [comm (r := Commute)]
  apply SemiCommute.to_commute
  intro a b c hab hac
  obtain ⟨d, hcd, hbd⟩ := h.extend hac hab
  exact ⟨d, hbd, hcd.to_reflTransGen⟩

name: Relation.DiamondCommute.join_left
statement:
lemma DiamondCommute.join_left (c₁ : DiamondCommute r₁ r₃) (c₂ : DiamondCommute r₂ r₃) :
    DiamondCommute (r₁ ⊔ r₂) r₃
proof:
:= by
  rintro a b c (hab | hab) hac
  · exact Join₂.mono le_rfl le_sup_left _ _ (c₁ hab hac)
  · exact Join₂.mono le_rfl le_sup_right _ _ (c₂ hab hac)

name: Relation.Commute.join_left
statement: lemma Commute.join_left (c₁ : Commute r₁ r₃) (c₂ : Commute r₂ r₃) : Commute (r₁ ⊔ r₂) r₃
proof:
:= by
  apply SemiCommute.to_commute
  rintro a b c (hab | hab) hac
  · exact Join₂.mono le_rfl (ReflTransGen.mono le_sup_left) _ _ (c₁ (.single hab) hac)
  · exact Join₂.mono le_rfl (ReflTransGen.mono le_sup_right) _ _ (c₂ (.single hab) hac)

name: Relation.Commute.join_confluent
statement:
theorem Commute.join_confluent (c₁ : Confluent r₁) (c₂ : Confluent r₂) (comm : Commute r₁ r₂) :
    Confluent (r₁ ⊔ r₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Commute.to_confluent]
  apply_rules [join_left, symm]

  classical
  by_contra! h
  apply three_contra (r := r)
  have ⟨_, hcard⟩ := Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq α 3
  have ⟨a, b, c, _, _, _, _⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hcard
  use a, b, c

  apply three_contra (r := r)
  have ⟨a, b, c, _⟩ := Fintype.two_lt_card_iff.mp h
  use a, b, c

name: Relation.dom_cod_leftEuclidean

theorem dom_cod_leftEuclidean (eq : dom r = cod r) [equiv_dom : IsEquiv (dom r) r] :

proof:
:= by
    have cb : r c b := equiv_dom.symm ⟨_, _, bc⟩ ⟨c, by grind⟩ bc

    have ba : r b a := equiv_dom.symm ⟨a, _, ab⟩ ⟨b, by grind⟩ ab

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.reflTransGen
statement: theorem RelatesInSteps.reflTransGen (h : RelatesInSteps r a b n) : ReflTransGen r a b
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ _ _ _ h ih => exact .tail ih h

/
of steps. -/

name: Relation.ReflTransGen.relatesInSteps
statement: theorem ReflTransGen.relatesInSteps (h : ReflTransGen r a b) : ∃ n, RelatesInSteps r a b n
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, .refl a⟩
  | tail _ _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, _⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨n + 1, by grind [RelatesInSteps]⟩

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.single
statement: lemma RelatesInSteps.single {a b : α} (h : r a b) : RelatesInSteps r a b 1
proof:
:=
  tail a a b 0 (refl a) h

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.head
statement:
theorem RelatesInSteps.head (t t' t'' : α) (n : ℕ) (h₁ : r t t')
    (h₂ : RelatesInSteps r t' t'' n) : RelatesInSteps r t t'' (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  induction h₂ with
  | refl =>
    exact single h₁
  | tail _ _ n _ hcd hac =>
    exact tail _ _ _ (n + 1) hac hcd

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.head_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem RelatesInSteps.head_induction_on {motive : ∀ (a : α) (n : ℕ), RelatesInSteps r a b n → Prop}
    {a : α} {n : ℕ} (h : RelatesInSteps r a b n) (hrefl : motive b 0 (.refl b))
    (hhead : ∀ {a c n} (h' : r a c) (h : RelatesInSteps r c b n),
      motive c n h → motive a (n + 1) (h.head a c b n h')) :
    motive a n h
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hrefl
  | tail t' b' m hstep hrt'b' hstep_ih =>
    apply hstep_ih
    · exact hhead hrt'b' _ hrefl
    · exact fun h1 h2 ↦ hhead h1 (.tail _ t' b' _ h2 hrt'b')

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.zero
statement: lemma RelatesInSteps.zero {a b : α} (h : RelatesInSteps r a b 0) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma RelatesInSteps.zero_iff {a b : α} : RelatesInSteps r a b 0 ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact RelatesInSteps.zero
  · intro rfl
    exact RelatesInSteps.refl a

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.trans
proof:
:= by
  induction h₂ generalizing a n with
  | refl => simp [h₁]
  | tail t' t'' k hsteps hstep ih =>
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
    exact .tail _ t' t'' (n + k) (ih h₁) hstep

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.succ
statement:
lemma RelatesInSteps.succ {n : ℕ} (h : RelatesInSteps r a b (n + 1)) :
    ∃ t', RelatesInSteps r a t' n ∧ r t' b
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | tail t' _ _ hsteps hstep => exact ⟨t', hsteps, hstep⟩

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.succ_iff
statement:
lemma RelatesInSteps.succ_iff {a b : α} {n : ℕ} :
    RelatesInSteps r a b (n + 1) ↔ ∃ t', RelatesInSteps r a t' n ∧ r t' b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact RelatesInSteps.succ
  · rintro ⟨t', h_steps, h_red⟩
    exact .tail _ t' b n h_steps h_red

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.succ'
statement:
lemma RelatesInSteps.succ' {a b : α} {n : ℕ} (h : RelatesInSteps r a b (n + 1)) :
    ∃ t', r a t' ∧ RelatesInSteps r t' b n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t', hsteps, hstep⟩ := succ h
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_iff] at hsteps
    subst hsteps
    exact ⟨b, hstep, .refl _⟩
  | succ k' =>
    obtain ⟨t''', h_red''', h_steps'''⟩ := succ' hsteps
    exact ⟨t''', h_red''', .tail _ _ b k' h_steps''' hstep⟩

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.succ'_iff
statement:
lemma RelatesInSteps.succ'_iff {a b : α} {n : ℕ} :
    RelatesInSteps r a b (n + 1) ↔ ∃ t', r a t' ∧ RelatesInSteps r t' b n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact succ'
  · rintro ⟨t', h_red, h_steps⟩
    exact h_steps.head a t' b n h_red

/
If `h : α → ℕ` increases by at most 1 on each step of `r`,
then the value of `h` at the output is at most `h` at the input plus the number of steps.
-/

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.apply_le_apply_add
statement:
lemma RelatesInSteps.apply_le_apply_add {a b : α} {m : ℕ} (hevals : RelatesInSteps r a b m)
    (h : α → ℕ) (h_step : ∀ a b, r a b → h b ≤ h a + 1) :
    h b ≤ h a + m
proof:
:= by
  induction hevals with
  | refl => simp
  | tail t' t'' k _ hstep ih =>
    have h_step' := h_step t' t'' hstep
    lia

/
If `g` is a homomorphism from `r` to `r'` (i.e., it preserves the reduction relation),
then `RelatesInSteps` is preserved under `g`.
-/

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.map
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact RelatesInSteps.refl (g _)
  | tail t' t'' m _ hstep ih =>
    exact .tail (g _) (g t') (g t'') m ih (hg t' t'' hstep)

/-! ## Translating between `RelatesInSteps` and chains (`List.IsChainFromTo`) -/

/
starting at `a` and ending at `b`.
This is similar to `List.exists_isChain_ne_nil_of_relationReflTransGen`, but also provides
a length guarantee. -/

name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.exists_isChainFromTo
statement:
lemma RelatesInSteps.exists_isChainFromTo {a b : α} {n : ℕ} (h : RelatesInSteps r a b n) :
    ∃ chain : List α, chain.IsChainFromTo r a b ∧ chain.length = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction h using RelatesInSteps.head_induction_on with
  | hrefl => exact ⟨[b], List.isChainFromTo_singleton, rfl⟩
  | @hhead a c n h' h ih =>
    obtain ⟨l, hchain, hlen⟩ := ih
    use a :: l, hchain.cons h'
    simpa

/
chain. -/

name: List.IsChain.relatesInSteps_getElem
statement:
lemma _root_.List.IsChain.relatesInSteps_getElem {chain : List α} (hc : chain.IsChain r)
    (i k : ℕ) (hik : i + k < chain.length) :
    RelatesInSteps r chain[i] chain[i + k] k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact .refl _
  | succ k ih =>
    apply RelatesInSteps.tail _ (chain[i + k]) _ k (ih (by lia))
    apply List.IsChain.getElem hc

/
to each other in `n` steps. -/

name: List.IsChainFromTo.relatesInSteps
proof:
:= by
  have hrel := _root_.List.IsChain.relatesInSteps_getElem hc.isChain 0 n (by lia)
  have hlast : chain[n]'(by lia) = b := by simpa [hlen] using hc.getElem_length_sub_one
  simpa [hc.getElem_zero, hlast] using hrel

/
from `a` to `b`. -/

name: Relation.relatesInSteps_iff_exists_isChainFromTo
statement:
lemma relatesInSteps_iff_exists_isChainFromTo :
    RelatesInSteps r a b n ↔ ∃ chain : List α, chain.IsChainFromTo r a b ∧ chain.length = n + 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨RelatesInSteps.exists_isChainFromTo, fun ⟨_, hc, hlen⟩ => hc.relatesInSteps hlen⟩

/-! ## RelatesWithinSteps - only requires an upper bound on the number of steps -/

/
`RelatesWithinSteps` is a variant of `RelatesInSteps` that allows for a loose bound.
It states that `a` relates to `b` in *at most* `n` steps.
-/

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.of_relatesInSteps
statement:
lemma RelatesWithinSteps.of_relatesInSteps {a b : α} {n : ℕ} (h : RelatesInSteps r a b n) :
    RelatesWithinSteps r a b n
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, Nat.le_refl n, h⟩

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.refl
statement: lemma RelatesWithinSteps.refl (a : α) : RelatesWithinSteps r a a 0
proof:
:=
  RelatesWithinSteps.of_relatesInSteps (RelatesInSteps.refl a)

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.single
statement: lemma RelatesWithinSteps.single {a b : α} (h : r a b) : RelatesWithinSteps r a b 1
proof:
:=
  RelatesWithinSteps.of_relatesInSteps (RelatesInSteps.single h)

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.zero
statement: lemma RelatesWithinSteps.zero {a b : α} (h : RelatesWithinSteps r a b 0) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hm, hevals⟩ := h
  simp_all

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma RelatesWithinSteps.zero_iff {a b : α} : RelatesWithinSteps r a b 0 ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact RelatesWithinSteps.zero
  · rintro rfl
    exact RelatesWithinSteps.refl a

/

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.trans
statement:
@[trans]
lemma RelatesWithinSteps.trans {a b c : α} {n₁ n₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : RelatesWithinSteps r a b n₁) (h₂ : RelatesWithinSteps r b c n₂) :
    RelatesWithinSteps r a c (n₁ + n₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, hevals₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, hevals₂⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨m₁ + m₂, by lia, hevals₁.trans hevals₂⟩

/
`n₁ ≤ n₂`, then they are also related in at most `n₂` steps. -/

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.mono
statement: lemma RelatesWithinSteps.mono {a b : α} : Monotone (RelatesWithinSteps r a b ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro n₁ n₂ hn ⟨m, hm, hevals⟩
  exact ⟨m, Nat.le_trans hm hn, hevals⟩

/
then the value of `h` at the output is at most `h` at the input plus the step bound. -/

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.apply_le_apply_add
statement:
lemma RelatesWithinSteps.apply_le_apply_add {a b : α} {m : ℕ}
    (hevals : RelatesWithinSteps r a b m)
    (h : α → ℕ)
    (h_step : ∀ a b, r a b → h b ≤ h a + 1) :
    h b ≤ h a + m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hevals_m⟩ := hevals
  have := RelatesInSteps.apply_le_apply_add hevals_m h h_step
  lia

/
If `g` is a homomorphism from `r` to `r'` (i.e., it preserves the reduction relation),
then `RelatesWithinSteps` is preserved under `g`.
-/

name: Relation.RelatesWithinSteps.map
statement:
lemma RelatesWithinSteps.map {α α' : Type*} {r : α → α → Prop} {r' : α' → α' → Prop}
    (g : α → α') (hg : ∀ a b, r a b → r' (g a) (g b))
    {a b : α} {n : ℕ} (h : RelatesWithinSteps r a b n) :
    RelatesWithinSteps r' (g a) (g b) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hevals⟩ := h
  exact ⟨m, hm, RelatesInSteps.map g hg hevals⟩

/-! ## Reachability under a bound on the number of reachable elements -/

/
is related to `a` in fewer steps than there are elements reachable from `a`.
Note that this cardinality is an `ℕ∞`, and if it is infinite, no bound on the number of steps
is stated. -/

name: Relation.ReflTransGen.relatesInSteps_lt_encard
statement:
theorem ReflTransGen.relatesInSteps_lt_encard {b : α} (h : ReflTransGen r a b) :
    ∃ n, RelatesInSteps r a b n ∧ (n : ℕ∞) < {x | ReflTransGen r a x}.encard
proof:
:= by
  classical

  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := h.relatesInSteps
  obtain ⟨chain₀, hc₀, -⟩ := hn₀.exists_isChainFromTo
  obtain ⟨chain, hc, h_nodup⟩ := hc₀.exists_nodup
  obtain ⟨n, hlen⟩ : ∃ n, chain.length = n + 1 := ⟨chain.length - 1, by have := hc.length_pos; lia⟩
  refine ⟨n, hc.relatesInSteps hlen, ?_⟩


  have hsub : {x | x ∈ chain} ⊆ {x | ReflTransGen r a x} := fun _ hx => hc.reflTransGen_of_mem hx
  have h_le : (chain.length : ℕ∞) ≤ {x | ReflTransGen r a x}.encard := by
    rw [← List.coe_toFinset] at hsub
    have := Set.encard_le_encard hsub
    rwa [Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup h_nodup] at this

  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by rw [hlen]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n) h_le

name: Set.refl_iff_reflOn
statement:
@[simp, grind .]
theorem refl_iff_reflOn : Std.Refl (α := s) r ↔ s.ReflOn r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨h⟩ a ha ↦ h ⟨a, ha⟩
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ h a ha⟩

name: Set.symm_iff_symmOn
statement:
@[simp, grind .]
theorem symm_iff_symmOn : Std.Symm (α := s) r ↔ s.SymmOn r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨h⟩ a ha b hb ab ↦ h ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ ab
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ ab ↦ h a ha b hb ab⟩

name: Set.ReflOn.of_dom
statement:
theorem ReflOn.of_dom {r} : (dom r).ReflOn r → r a b → r a a
| h, hab => h a (Relation.of_dom hab)

name: Set.ReflOn.of_cod
statement:
theorem ReflOn.of_cod {r} : (cod r).ReflOn r → r a b → r b b
| h, hab => h b (Relation.of_cod hab)

name: Set.SymmOn.of_dom
statement:
theorem SymmOn.of_dom {r} : (dom r).SymmOn r → r a b → r b c → r b a
| h, hab, hbc => h a (Relation.of_dom hab) b (Relation.of_dom hbc) hab

name: Relation.normal_iff
statement: theorem normal_iff (r : α → α → Prop) (x : α) : Normal r x ↔ ∀ y, ¬ r x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Normal, not_exists]

name: Relation.Normal.reflTransGen_eq
statement:
@[grind =>]
theorem Normal.reflTransGen_eq (h : Normal r x) (xy : ReflTransGen r x y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction xy <;> grind

name: Relation.SN_iff_SN_of_rel
statement: lemma SN_iff_SN_of_rel (x : α) : SN r x ↔ ∀ y, r x y → SN r y
proof: := by grind [Acc]

name: Relation.SN.intro
statement: lemma SN.intro : (h : ∀ y, r x y → SN r y) → SN r x
proof: := (SN_iff_SN_of_rel x).mpr

name: Relation.SN.of_rel
statement: lemma SN.of_rel (hx : SN r x) (h : r x y) : SN r y
proof: := Acc.inv hx h

name: Relation.SN.of_rel_reflTransGen
statement:
@[grind →]
lemma SN.of_rel_reflTransGen (hx : SN r x) (h : ReflTransGen r x y) : SN r y
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hx
  | tail _ h ih => exact ih.of_rel h

name: Relation.SN.transGen
statement: lemma SN.transGen (hx : SN r x) : SN (TransGen r) x
proof:
:= by
  have eq : TransGen (Function.swap r) = (fun a b => TransGen r b a) := by
    ext
    exact transGen_swap
  simpa [eq] using Acc.transGen hx

name: Relation.SN.of_le
statement: lemma SN.of_le {r' : α → α → Prop} (hx : SN r x) (h : r' ≤ r) : SN r' x
proof:
:= by
  refine Subrelation.accessible ?_ hx
  exact subrelation_iff_le.mpr fun {x y} => h y x

name: Relation.SN.iff_transGen
statement:
@[simp]
lemma SN.iff_transGen (x : α) : SN (TransGen r) x ↔ SN r x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx => hx.of_le <| fun _ _ => TransGen.single, transGen⟩

/
of reductions starting with `x`. -/

name: Relation.SN.iff_isEmpty_chain
statement:
theorem SN.iff_isEmpty_chain :
    SN r x ↔ IsEmpty {f : ℕ → α | f 0 = x ∧ ∀ n, r (f n) (f (n + 1))}
proof:
:=
  acc_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain

name: Relation.SN.onFun_of_image
statement:
lemma SN.onFun_of_image {r : β → β → Prop} {f : α → β} (hx : SN r (f x)) :
    SN (Function.onFun r f) x
proof: := InvImage.accessible f hx

name: Relation.SN.of_normal
statement: lemma SN.of_normal (hx : Normal r x) : SN r x
proof: := SN.intro fun y hy => (hx ⟨y, hy⟩).elim

name: Relation.SN.normalizable
statement: theorem SN.normalizable (hx : SN r x) : Normalizable r x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx with | intro x h ih =>
  by_cases hy: (∃ y, r x y)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hnormal⟩ := ih y hy
    exact ⟨z, .head hy hz, hnormal⟩
  · exists x

name: Relation.Terminating.apply
statement: lemma Terminating.apply (hr : Terminating r) (x : α) : SN r x
proof: := WellFounded.apply hr x

name: Relation.Terminating.iff_forall_sn
statement: lemma Terminating.iff_forall_sn : Terminating r ↔ ∀ x, SN r x
proof:
:=
  ⟨WellFounded.apply, WellFounded.intro⟩

name: Relation.Terminating.to_transGen
statement: theorem Terminating.to_transGen (ht : Terminating r) : Terminating (TransGen r)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iff_forall_sn, SN.iff_transGen] at ht ⊢
  exact ht

name: Relation.Terminating.to_acyclic
statement: theorem Terminating.to_acyclic (ht : Terminating r) : Acyclic r
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x hx => ht.to_transGen.irrefl.irrefl x hx⟩

name: Relation.Terminating.of_transGen
statement: theorem Terminating.of_transGen : Terminating (TransGen r) → Terminating r
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iff_forall_sn, SN.iff_transGen]
  exact id

name: Relation.Terminating.iff_transGen
statement: theorem Terminating.iff_transGen : Terminating (TransGen r) ↔ Terminating r
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iff_forall_sn, SN.iff_transGen]

name: Relation.Terminating.iff_isEmpty_chain
statement:
theorem Terminating.iff_isEmpty_chain :
    Terminating r ↔ IsEmpty {f : ℕ → α // ∀ n, r (f n) (f (n + 1))}
proof:
:=
  wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain

name: Relation.Terminating.of_le
statement:
theorem Terminating.of_le {r' : α → α → Prop} (hr : Terminating r) (h : r' ≤ r) :
    Terminating r'
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_forall_sn] at hr ⊢
  exact fun x => (hr x).of_le h

name: Relation.Terminating.subtype_sn
statement:
lemma Terminating.subtype_sn (r : α → α → Prop) :
    Terminating (α := {x // SN r x}) (fun a b => r a b)
proof:
:=
  iff_forall_sn.mpr fun x => x.property.onFun_of_image

name: Relation.Terminating.to_normalizing
statement: theorem Terminating.to_normalizing (hr : Terminating r) : Normalizing r
proof:
:=
  fun x => (hr.apply x).normalizable

name: Cslib.FLTS.mtr_nil_eq
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem mtr_nil_eq {flts : FLTS State Label} {s : State} : flts.mtr s [] = s
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.FLTS.mtr_concat_eq
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem mtr_concat_eq {flts : FLTS State Label} {s : State} {μs : List Label} {μ : Label} :
    flts.mtr s (μs ++ [μ]) = flts.tr (flts.mtr s μs) μ
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: Cslib.FLTS.mtr_append_eq
statement:
theorem mtr_append_eq {flts : FLTS State Label} {s : State} {μs1 μs2 : List Label} :
    flts.mtr s (μs1 ++ μs2) = flts.mtr (flts.mtr s μs1) μs2
proof:
:= by
  simp [mtr]

name: Cslib.FLTS.toLTS_tr
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem toLTS_tr {flts : FLTS State Label} {s1 : State} {μ : Label} {s2 : State} :
  flts.toLTS.Tr s1 μ s2 ↔ flts.tr s1 μ = s2
proof:
:= by rfl

/

name: Cslib.FLTS.toLTS_mtr
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem toLTS_mtr {flts : FLTS State Label} {s1 : State} {μs : List Label} {s2 : State} :
    flts.toLTS.MTr s1 μs s2 ↔ flts.mtr s1 μs = s2
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ μ, flts.toLTS.Tr s1 μ (flts.tr s1 μ) := by grind
  constructor <;> intro h
  case mp => induction h <;> grind
  case mpr => induction μs generalizing s1 <;> grind

name: Cslib.LTS.toFLTS_mem_tr
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem toFLTS_mem_tr {lts : LTS State Label} {S : Set State} {s' : State} {μ : Label} :
  s' ∈ lts.toFLTS.tr S μ ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, lts.Tr s μ s'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LTS.toFLTS, LTS.setImage, Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
  grind

/
original `LTS`. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.toFLTS_mem_mtr
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem toFLTS_mem_mtr {lts : LTS State Label} {S : Set State} {s' : State} {μs : List Label} :
    s' ∈ lts.toFLTS.mtr S μs ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, lts.MTr s μs s'
proof:
:=
  ⟨by grind [FLTS.mtr], by grind [FLTS.mtr]⟩

/

name: Cslib.LTS.toFLTS_mtr_setImageMultistep
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem toFLTS_mtr_setImageMultistep {lts : LTS State Label} :
  lts.toFLTS.mtr = lts.setImageMultistep
proof: := by grind

name: Cslib.FLTS.prod_mtr_eq
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem prod_mtr_eq (flts1 : FLTS State1 Label) (flts2 : FLTS State2 Label)
    (s : State1 × State2) (μs : List Label) :
    (flts1.prod flts2).mtr s μs = (flts1.mtr s.fst μs, flts2.mtr s.snd μs)
proof:

  induction μs generalizing s <;> grind

name: Cslib.Frame.r_const_of_diagonal
statement:
@[scoped grind →, modal →]
theorem r_const_of_diagonal {f : Frame World τ} (h : f.diagonal op w w') :

proof: := by grind [Frame.diagonal]

name: Cslib.Frame.diagonal_of_r

theorem diagonal_of_r [PFunctor.Unary τ] {f : Frame World τ} (h : f.r op w ws) :

proof:
:= by grind [Frame.diagonal, PFunctor.Unary.fun_eq_const op ws]

accesses the constant sequence at `w`. -/

name: Cslib.Frame.ofRelations_iff
statement:
@[scoped grind =, modal =]
lemma ofRelations_iff {τ : PFunctor} [τ.Unary] (r : τ.A → World → World → Prop) (i : τ.A)
    (w : World) (ws : τ.B i → World) : (ofRelations r).r i w ws ↔ r i w (ws default)
proof: := by rfl

name: Cslib.Frame.ofRelations_diagonal_iff

@[simp, scoped grind =, modal =]

    (r : τ.A → World → World → Prop) (i : τ.A) (w w' : World) :
    (ofRelations r).diagonal i w w' ↔ r i w w'
proof:

name: Cslib.LTS.toFrame_r_iff_tr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toFrame_r_iff_tr : lts.toFrame.r μ s f ↔ lts.Tr s μ (f default)
proof: := by rfl

name: Cslib.LTS.toFrame_diagonal_iff_tr
statement:
@[simp, modal =]
lemma toFrame_diagonal_iff_tr : lts.toFrame.diagonal μ s s' ↔ lts.Tr s μ s'
proof: := by rfl

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.nil_eq
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem MTr.nil_eq (h : lts.MTr s1 [] s2) : s1 = s2
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.nil_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem MTr.nil_iff (s1 s2 : State) : lts.MTr s1 [] s2 ↔ s1 = s2
proof:
:=
  ⟨nil_eq lts, fun h => h ▸ MTr.refl⟩

/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.single
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem MTr.single {s1 : State} {μ : Label} {s2 : State} :
  lts.Tr s1 μ s2 → lts.MTr s1 [μ] s2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply MTr.stepL
  · exact h
  · apply MTr.refl

/
transition labelled by `μs`. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.cons_iff
statement:
theorem MTr.cons_iff {lts : LTS State Label} :
    lts.MTr s1 (μ :: μs) s2 ↔ ∃ s, lts.Tr s1 μ s ∧ lts.MTr s μs s2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (_ | ⟨htr, hmtr⟩)
    exact ⟨_, htr, hmtr⟩
  · intro ⟨s, htr, hmtr⟩
    exact .stepL htr hmtr

/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.stepR
statement:
theorem MTr.stepR {s1 : State} {μs : List Label} {s2 : State} {μ : Label} {s3 : State} :
  lts.MTr s1 μs s2 → lts.Tr s2 μ s3 → lts.MTr s1 (μs ++ [μ]) s3
proof:
:= by
  intro h1 h2
  induction h1
  case refl s1' => exact MTr.single lts h2
  case stepL s1' μ' s2' μs' s3' h1' h3 ih =>
    apply MTr.stepL
    · exact h1'
    · apply ih h2

/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.comp
statement:
@[scoped grind <=]
theorem MTr.comp {s1 : State} {μs1 : List Label} {s2 : State} {μs2 : List Label} {s3 : State} :
  lts.MTr s1 μs1 s2 → lts.MTr s2 μs2 s3 →
  lts.MTr s1 (μs1 ++ μs2) s3
proof:
:= by
  intro h1 h2
  induction h1
  case refl => assumption
  case stepL s1 μ s' μs1' s'' h1' h3 ih  =>
    apply MTr.stepL
    · exact h1'
    · apply ih h2

/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.single_invert
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem MTr.single_invert (s1 : State) (μ : Label) (s2 : State) :
  lts.MTr s1 [μ] s2 → lts.Tr s1 μ s2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  cases h
  case stepL s1' htr hmtr =>
    cases hmtr
    exact htr

/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.singleton_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem MTr.singleton_iff (s1 : State) (μ : Label) (s2 : State) :
  lts.MTr s1 [μ] s2 ↔ lts.Tr s1 μ s2
proof:
:= ⟨MTr.single_invert lts s1 μ s2, MTr.single lts⟩

/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.split
statement:
theorem MTr.split {lts : LTS State Label} (h : lts.MTr s1 (μs ++ μs') s2) :
    ∃ s, lts.MTr s1 μs s ∧ lts.MTr s μs' s2
proof:
:= by
  induction μs generalizing s1 s2 with
  | nil => use s1, .refl, h
  | cons μ μs ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append] at h
    cases h
    case stepL s htr hmtr =>
      obtain ⟨s', hmtr', hmtr''⟩ := ih hmtr
      use s', .stepL htr hmtr', hmtr''

/
with a common end & start state (respectively). -/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.append_iff
statement: theorem MTr.append_iff : lts.MTr s1 (μs ++ μs') s2 ↔ ∃ s, lts.MTr s1 μs s ∧ lts.MTr s μs' s2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨MTr.split, ?_⟩
  intro ⟨_, h, h'⟩
  exact h.comp lts h'

/

name: Cslib.LTS.mtrInv_of_trInv
statement:
theorem mtrInv_of_trInv {lts : LTS State Label} {p : State → Prop}

proof:

  induction μs generalizing s1 s2 s2' with

name: Cslib.LTS.DeterministicStateLabel.finite_image
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem DeterministicStateLabel.finite_image (h : lts.DeterministicStateLabel s μ) :
    Finite (lts.image s μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hDet := image_char lts h
  cases hDet
  case inl hDet =>
    obtain ⟨s', hDet'⟩ := hDet
    simp only [hDet']
    apply Set.finite_singleton
  case inr hDet =>
    simp only [hDet]
    apply Set.finite_empty

name: Cslib.LTS.Deterministic.traces_of_tr
statement:
theorem Deterministic.traces_of_tr {lts : LTS State Label} [lts.Deterministic]
    (h : lts.Tr s μ s') : lts.traces s' = {μs | μ :: μs ∈ lts.traces s}
proof:
:= by
  ext μs
  constructor
  · intro ⟨s'', hmtr⟩
    use s'', MTr.stepL h hmtr
  · intro ⟨s'', hmtr⟩
    rcases hmtr with (_ | ⟨htr, hmtr⟩)
    rw [←deterministic _ _ _ _ h htr] at hmtr
    exact ⟨s'', hmtr⟩

/
-/

name: Cslib.LTS.Deterministic.traces_of_mTr
statement:
theorem Deterministic.traces_of_mTr {lts : LTS State Label} [lts.Deterministic]
    (h : lts.MTr s μs s') : lts.traces s' = {μs' | μs ++ μs' ∈ lts.traces s}
proof:
:= by
  ext μs'
  constructor
  · intro ⟨s'', hmtr⟩
    use s'', h.comp _ hmtr
  · intro ⟨s'', hmtr⟩
    obtain ⟨smid, hmid, hmid'⟩ := hmtr.split
    rw [Deterministic.eq_of_mTr h hmid]
    use s'', hmid'

bisimulation, then the derivatives are still in the bisimulation. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.HomBisimilarity.of_image_eq
statement:
theorem HomBisimilarity.of_image_eq {lts : LTS State Label} {s₁ s₂ : State}
    (h : lts.image s₁ = lts.image s₂) : s₁ ~[lts] s₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s t => lts.image s = lts.image t, h, ?_⟩
  intro s t h μ
  have htr (s' : State) : lts.Tr s μ s' ↔ lts.Tr t μ s' :=
    Set.ext_iff.mp (congrFun h μ) s'
  exact ⟨fun s' hs' => ⟨s', (htr s').mp hs', rfl⟩,
    fun t' ht' => ⟨t', (htr t').mpr ht', rfl⟩⟩

/

name: Cslib.LTS.IsBisimulationUpTo.isBisimulation
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem IsBisimulationUpTo.isBisimulation (h : IsBisimulationUpTo lts₁ lts₂ r) :
    IsBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ (UpToHomBisimilarity lts₁ lts₂ r)
proof:
:= by
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ
  rcases hr with ⟨s₁b, hr1b, s₂b, hrb, hr2b⟩
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s₁' htr1
    obtain ⟨s₁b', hs₁b'tr, hs₁b'r⟩ := hr1b.follow_fst htr1
    obtain ⟨s₂b', hs₂b'tr, hs₂b'r⟩ := (h hrb μ).1 s₁b' hs₁b'tr
    obtain ⟨s₂', hs₂btr, hs₂br⟩ := hr2b.follow_fst hs₂b'tr
    use s₂', hs₂btr
    obtain ⟨smid1, hsmidb, smid2, hsmidr, hsmidrb⟩ := hs₂b'r
    use smid1, hs₁b'r.trans hsmidb, smid2, hsmidr
    exact hsmidrb.trans hs₂br
  case right =>
    intro s₂' htr2
    obtain ⟨s₂b', hs₂b'tr, hs₂b'r⟩ := hr2b.follow_snd htr2
    obtain ⟨s₁b', hs₁b'tr, hs₁b'r⟩ := (h hrb μ).2 s₂b' hs₂b'tr
    obtain ⟨s₁', hs₁btr, hs₁br⟩ := hr1b.follow_snd hs₁b'tr
    use s₁', hs₁btr
    obtain ⟨smid1, hsmidb, smid2, hsmidr, hsmidrb⟩ := hs₁b'r
    use smid1, hs₁br.trans hsmidb, smid2, hsmidr
    exact hsmidrb.trans hs₂b'r

/

name: Cslib.LTS.IsBisimulationUpTo.le_bisimilarity

  intro s₁ s₂ hr
  exact h.isBisimulation.le_bisimilarity s₁ s₂

transitions. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.Bisimilarity.le_traceEq

@[scoped grind .]
theorem Bisimilarity.le_traceEq : Bisimilarity lts₁ lts₂ ≤ TraceEq lts₁ lts₂
proof:
:= by
  intro s₁ s₂ h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hb⟩ := h
  apply hb.traceEq hr

/- One of the standard motivating examples for bisimulation: `1` and `5` are trace equivalent, but
not bisimilar. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.IsBisimulation.traceEq_not_bisim
statement:
theorem IsBisimulation.traceEq_not_bisim :
    ∃ (State : Type) (Label : Type) (lts : LTS State Label),
      ¬(IsHomBisimulation lts (HomTraceEq lts))
proof:
:= by
  let lts := LTS.mk BisimMotTr
  exists ℕ, Char, lts
  intro h
  have htreq : (1 ~tr[lts] 5) := by
    have htraces₁ : lts.traces 1 = {[], ['a'], ['a', 'b'], ['a', 'c']} := by
      ext μs
      constructor
      case mp =>
        rintro ⟨_, (_ | ⟨⟨_⟩, (_ | ⟨(_ | _), (_ | ⟨⟨_⟩, _⟩)⟩)⟩)⟩
        all_goals simp
      case mpr =>
        rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
        · exact ⟨1, .refl⟩
        · exact ⟨2, MTr.single lts .one2two⟩
        · exact ⟨3, MTr.stepL .one2two <| MTr.single lts .two2three⟩
        · exact ⟨4, MTr.stepL .one2two <| MTr.single lts .two2four⟩
    have htraces₅ : lts.traces 5 = {[], ['a'], ['a', 'b'], ['a', 'c']} := by
      ext μs
      constructor
      case mp =>
        rintro ⟨_, (_ | ⟨(_ | _), (_ | ⟨⟨_⟩, (_ | ⟨⟨_⟩, _⟩)⟩)⟩)⟩
        all_goals simp
      case mpr =>
        rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
        · exact ⟨5, .refl⟩
        · exact ⟨6, MTr.single lts .five2six⟩
        · exact ⟨7, MTr.stepL .five2six <| MTr.single lts .six2seven⟩
        · exact ⟨9, MTr.stepL .five2eight <| MTr.single lts .eight2nine⟩
    exact htraces₁.trans htraces₅.symm
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h htreq 'a'
  obtain ⟨s₂', htr5, cih⟩ := h1 2 (by constructor)
  have htraces₂ : {['b'], ['c']} ⊆ lts.traces 2 := by
    intro μs h
    rcases h with (rfl | rfl)
    · refine ⟨3, MTr.single lts .two2three⟩
    · refine ⟨4, MTr.single lts .two2four⟩
  cases htr5
  case five2six =>
    suffices ['c'] ∉ lts.traces 6 by grind [TraceEq]
    rintro ⟨_, (_ | h)⟩
    cases h
  case five2eight =>
    suffices ['b'] ∉ lts.traces 8 by grind [TraceEq]
    rintro ⟨_, (_ | h)⟩
    cases h

/

name: Cslib.LTS.Bisimilarity.bisimilarity_neq_traceEq
statement:
theorem Bisimilarity.bisimilarity_neq_traceEq :
    ∃ (State : Type) (Label : Type) (lts : LTS State Label),

proof:

  obtain ⟨State, Label, lts, h⟩ := IsBisimulation.traceEq_not_bisim

name: Cslib.LTS.IsBisimulation.deterministic_traceEq_isBisimulation

theorem IsBisimulation.deterministic_traceEq_isBisimulation

    [lts₁.Deterministic] [lts₂.Deterministic] :
    (IsBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ (TraceEq lts₁ lts₂))
proof:

name: Cslib.LTS.Bisimilarity.deterministic_traceEq_bisim

equivalent to one-another. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.Deterministic.bisim_tfae
proof:
:= by

name: Cslib.LTS.HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation
statement:
theorem HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation :
  HomBisimilarity lts =
    fun s₁ s₂ => ∃ r, r s₁ s₂ ∧ Std.Symm r ∧ IsHomSimulation lts r
proof:
:= by
  ext s₁ s₂
  constructor
  · intro h
    use lts.HomBisimilarity, h
    exact ⟨⟨fun _ _ => Bisimilarity.symm⟩, (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation lts lts).isSimulation⟩
  · intro ⟨r, hrel, ⟨hsymm⟩, hsim⟩
    use r, hrel
    have : r = flip r := by grind [flip]
    simpa [IsBisimulation.isSimulation_iff, ←this]

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSWBisimulation.isSimulation
statement:
lemma IsSWBisimulation.isSimulation [HasTau Label] (h : IsSWBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r) :
    IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂.saturate r
proof:
:= by
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ
  exact (h hr μ).1

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSWBisimulation.isSimulation_flip
statement:
lemma IsSWBisimulation.isSimulation_flip [HasTau Label] (h : IsSWBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r) :
    IsSimulation lts₂ lts₁.saturate (flip r)
proof:
:= by
  intro s₂ s₁ hr μ
  exact (h hr μ).2

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSWBisimulation.iff_isSimulation
statement:
theorem IsSWBisimulation.iff_isSimulation [HasTau Label] :
    IsSWBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r ↔
      IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂.saturate r ∧ IsSimulation lts₂ lts₁.saturate (flip r)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨h.isSimulation, h.isSimulation_flip⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ⟨h, hflip⟩ s₁ s₂ hr μ
  exact ⟨h hr μ, hflip hr μ⟩

/
This formalises lemma 4.2.10 in [Sangiorgi2011]. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.isWeakBisimulation_iff_isSWBisimulation
statement:
theorem isWeakBisimulation_iff_isSWBisimulation
    [HasTau Label] {lts₁ : LTS State₁ Label} {lts₂ : LTS State₂ Label} :
    IsWeakBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r ↔ IsSWBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  case mp =>
    intro h
    rw [IsSWBisimulation.iff_isSimulation]
    exact ⟨h.isSimulation.mono lts₁.tr_le_tr_saturate le_rfl,
      h.inv.isSimulation.mono lts₂.tr_le_tr_saturate le_rfl⟩
  case mpr =>
    intro h
    rw [IsWeakBisimulation, IsBisimulation.isSimulation_iff]
    exact ⟨h.isSimulation.isSimulation_saturate_left,
      h.isSimulation_flip.isSimulation_saturate_left⟩

name: Cslib.LTS.IsWeakBisimulation.isSwBisimulation
statement:
theorem IsWeakBisimulation.isSwBisimulation

  IsSWBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r
proof: := isWeakBisimulation_iff_isSWBisimulation.1 h

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSWBisimulation.isWeakBisimulation
statement:
theorem IsSWBisimulation.isWeakBisimulation
    [HasTau Label] {lts₁ : LTS State₁ Label} {lts₂ : LTS State₂ Label} {r : State₁ → State₂ → Prop}
    (h : IsSWBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r) :

name: Cslib.LTS.WeakBisimilarity.weakBisim_eq_swBisim
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
theorem WeakBisimilarity.weakBisim_eq_swBisim [HasTau Label]
    (lts₁ : LTS State₁ Label) (lts₂ : LTS State₂ Label) :
    WeakBisimilarity lts₁ lts₂ =
      fun s₁ s₂ => ∃ r : State₁ → State₂ → Prop, r s₁ s₂ ∧ IsSWBisimulation lts₁ lts₂ r
proof:
:= by
  grind [WeakBisimilarity, isWeakBisimulation_iff_isSWBisimulation.1,
    isWeakBisimulation_iff_isSWBisimulation.2]

statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem length_ss_pos (h : lts.Execution s μs t ss) : 0 < ss.length
proof:
:=
  h.length ▸ Nat.zero_lt_succ μs.length

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.ss_ne_nil
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem ss_ne_nil (h : lts.Execution s μs t ss) : ss ≠ []

statement: theorem start (h : lts.Execution s μs t ss) : ss[0]'(h.length_ss_pos) = s
proof:

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.getLast
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem getLast (h : lts.Execution s μs t ss) :
    ss.getLast h.ss_ne_nil = t
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | stepL htr he ih => rw [List.getLast_cons he.ss_ne_nil, ih]

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.last
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem last (h : lts.Execution s μs t ss) :
    ss[ss.length - 1]'(by lia [h.length_ss_pos]) = t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← h.getLast]
  apply List.getElem_length_sub_one_eq_getLast

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.last'
statement:
theorem last' (h : lts.Execution s μs t ss) :
  ss[μs.length]'(by grind) = t
proof:
:= by simp [← h.last, h.length]

/
`ss`. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.trans
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem trans (h : lts.Execution s μs t ss) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < μs.length) :
    lts.Tr (ss[k]'(by lia [h.length])) μs[k] (ss[k + 1]'(by lia [h.length]))
proof:
:= by
  induction h generalizing k with
  | refl => grind
  | @stepL s₁ s₂ s₃ μ μs ss htr he ih =>
    obtain (rfl | ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩) : k = 0 ∨ ∃ k' < μs.length, k = k' + 1 := by
      rcases k with (_ | k)
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr ⟨k, k.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hk, rfl⟩
    · rw [ss.getElem_cons_zero, μs.getElem_cons_zero, ss.getElem_cons_succ, he.start]
      exact htr
    · exact ih k (by lia)

/
  states and labels. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.mk
statement:
theorem mk {s t : State} {μs : List Label} {ss : List State}
    (length : ss.length = μs.length + 1) (start : ss[0] = s) (last : ss[ss.length - 1] = t)
    (trans : ∀ k (hk : k < μs.length), lts.Tr ss[k] μs[k] ss[k + 1]) :
    lts.Execution s μs t ss
proof:
:= by
  cases ss with
  | nil => simp at length
  | cons r ss =>
    obtain rfl : r = s := start
    induction ss generalizing r μs with
    | nil => convert! Execution.refl r <;> grind
    | cons r' ss ih =>
      simp_rw [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at length
      obtain ⟨μ, μs, rfl⟩ : ∃ μ μs', μs = (μ :: μs') := μs.length_pos_iff_exists_cons.mp (by lia)
      refine (ih r' length (by simpa using last) ?_).stepL (trans 0 (by simp))
      intro k hk
      apply trans (k + 1)
      simpa

/

name: Cslib.LTS.execution_iff_index
statement:
theorem _root_.Cslib.LTS.execution_iff_index :
    lts.Execution s μs t ss ↔
      ∃ (_ : ss.length = μs.length + 1), ss[0] = s ∧ ss[ss.length - 1] = t ∧
        ∀ k (_ : k < μs.length), lts.Tr ss[k] μs[k] ss[k + 1]
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.length, h.start, h.last, h.trans⟩, fun ⟨hl, hs, ht, htr⟩ ↦ .mk hl hs ht htr⟩

/

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.cons_invert

theorem cons_invert (h : lts.Execution s (μ :: μs) t (s :: ss)) :
    lts.Execution (ss[0]'(by grind)) μs t ss
proof:

proof:

  rcases he with (_ | ⟨_, he⟩)
  · contradiction

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.of_mTr
proof:
:= by
  induction h
  case refl t =>
    use [t], .refl t
  case stepL t1 μ t2 μs t3 htr hmtr ih =>

in the underlying unlabelled relation. -/

@[scoped grind =]

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.comp
proof:
:= by
  induction h₁ with
  | refl => simpa [← h₂.head] using h₂

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.take
statement:
theorem take (he : lts.Execution s μs t ss) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ss.length) :
    lts.Execution s (μs.take n) ss[n] (ss.take (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction he generalizing n with
  | refl => simpa using .refl _
  | stepL htr he ih =>
    rcases n with (_ | n)
    · simpa using .refl _
    · simpa using (ih n (by grind)).stepL htr

/

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.drop
statement:
theorem drop (he : lts.Execution s μs t ss) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < ss.length) :
    lts.Execution ss[n] (μs.drop n) t (ss.drop n)
proof:
:= by
  induction he generalizing n with
  | refl =>
    obtain rfl : n = 0 := by simpa using hn
    simpa using .refl _
  | stepL htr he ih =>
    rcases n with (_ | n)
    · rw [← he.start] at htr
      exact .stepL htr (ih 0 he.length_ss_pos)
    · apply ih

/

name: Cslib.LTS.Execution.split
statement:
theorem split (he : lts.Execution s μs t ss) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < ss.length) :
    lts.Execution s (μs.take n) ss[n] (ss.take (n + 1)) ∧
      lts.Execution ss[n] (μs.drop n) t (ss.drop n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨he.take n hn, he.drop n hn⟩

name: Cslib.LTS.sTr_τSTr_iff
statement:
theorem sTr_τSTr_iff [HasTau Label] (lts : LTS State Label) :
    lts.STr s HasTau.τ s' ↔ lts.τSTr s s'
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro <;> intro h
  case mp =>
    cases h
    case refl => exact .refl
    case tr _ _ h1 h2 h3 =>
      exact (.trans h1 (.head h2 h3))
  case mpr =>
    cases h
    case refl => exact STr.refl
    case tail _ h1 h2 => exact STr.tr h1 h2 .refl

/

name: Cslib.LTS.saturate_τsTr_τSTr_iff

  change Relation.ReflTransGen (fun s s' => lts.STr s HasTau.τ s') = _

name: Cslib.LTS.STr.trans_τ

proof:

  rw [sTr_τSTr_iff _] at h1 h2
  rw [sTr_τSTr_iff _]
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h2

name: Cslib.LTS.STr.comp
statement:
theorem STr.comp
    [HasTau Label] {lts : LTS State Label}
    (h1 : lts.STr s1 HasTau.τ s2)
    (h2 : lts.STr s2 μ s3)
    (h3 : lts.STr s3 HasTau.τ s4) :
  lts.STr s1 μ s4
proof:
:= by
  rw [sTr_τSTr_iff _] at h1 h3
  cases h2
  case refl =>
    rw [sTr_τSTr_iff _]
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h3
  case tr _ _ hτ1 htr hτ2 =>
    exact STr.tr (Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 hτ1) htr (Relation.ReflTransGen.trans hτ2 h3)

/

name: Cslib.LTS.saturate_tr_saturate_sTr
statement:
theorem saturate_tr_saturate_sTr [hHasTau : HasTau Label] (lts : LTS State Label) :
    lts.saturate.Tr s μ = lts.saturate.STr s μ
proof:
:= by
  ext s'
  constructor
  · exact STr.single
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | refl => exact STr.refl
    | tr h₁ h₂ h₃ =>
      rw [saturate_τsTr_τSTr_iff] at h₁ h₃
      exact STr.comp ((sTr_τSTr_iff _).mpr h₁) h₂ ((sTr_τSTr_iff _).mpr h₃)

/

statement:

proof: := by grind [LTS.STr, LTS.SMTr]

name: Cslib.LTS.SMTr.comp
proof:
:= by
  induction h₁
  case τ s₁ s₂ htr =>
    cases h₂
    case τ htr' => grind [SMTr]
    case stepL _ _ _ μ s₂' μs hstr hmstr => exact stepL (htr.comp hstr STr.refl) hmstr
  case stepL s₁ μ s₁' μs s₂ hstr hmstr ih =>
    apply stepL hstr (ih h₂)

/

name: Cslib.LTS.SMTr.fromMTr
proof:
:= by
  induction μs generalizing s s'
  case nil => grind [LTS.STr, LTS.SMTr]
  case cons x xs ih =>
    cases h
    case stepL sb htr hmtr => exact SMTr.stepL (STr.single htr) (ih hmtr)

theorem sMTr_τSTr_iff [HasTau Label] {lts : LTS State Label} :

name: Cslib.LTS.saturate_mTr_sMTr_not_nil_iff
proof:
:= by
  induction μs generalizing s
  case nil => contradiction
  case cons x xs ih =>
    apply Iff.intro <;> intro h
    case mp =>
      cases h
      case stepL sb htr hmtr =>
        cases xs with
        | nil =>
          cases hmtr
          apply LTS.SMTr.stepL htr (by grind only [SMTr.fromMTr, MTr.refl])
        | cons x' xs' =>
          exact LTS.SMTr.stepL htr ((ih (by simp)).mp hmtr)
    case mpr =>
      cases h
      case stepL sb htr hmtr =>
        cases xs with
        | nil =>
          cases hmtr
          case τ h_τ =>
            exact LTS.MTr.stepL
              (LTS.STr.comp LTS.STr.refl htr h_τ)
              LTS.MTr.refl
        | cons x' xs' =>
          exact LTS.MTr.stepL htr ((ih (by simp)).mpr hmtr)

name: Cslib.LTS.OmegaExecution.prepend_execution_tr
statement:
theorem OmegaExecution.prepend_execution_tr (he_head : lts.Execution s μl t sl)
    (he_tail : lts.OmegaExecution ss μs) (htr : lts.Tr t μ (ss 0)) :
    lts.OmegaExecution (sl ++ω ss) (μl ++ω μ ::ω μs)
proof:
:= by
  induction he_head with
  | refl => exact he_tail.cons htr rfl
  | stepL h he ih =>
    apply (ih htr).cons h
    simp [append_get_zero_of_ne_nil he.ss_ne_nil, he.head]

name: Cslib.LTS.OmegaExecution.prepend_execution
statement:
theorem OmegaExecution.prepend_execution (he_head : lts.Execution s μl t sl)
    (he_tail : lts.OmegaExecution ss μs) (hm : ss 0 = t) :
    lts.OmegaExecution (sl ++ω ss.tail) (μl ++ω μs)
proof:
:= by
  induction he_head with
  | refl => simpa [← hm]
  | stepL htr he ih =>
    apply (ih hm).cons htr
    simp [append_get_zero_of_ne_nil he.ss_ne_nil, he.head]

name: Cslib.LTS.OmegaExecution.append
statement:
theorem OmegaExecution.append
    (hmtr : lts.MTr s μl t) (hωtr : lts.OmegaExecution ss μs) (hm : ss 0 = t) :
    ∃ ss', lts.OmegaExecution ss' (μl ++ω μs) ∧
      ss' 0 = s ∧ ss' μl.length = t ∧ ss'.drop μl.length = ss
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sl, he⟩ := Execution.of_mTr hmtr
  refine ⟨sl ++ω ss.tail, hωtr.prepend_execution he hm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [get_append_left _ _ _ he.length_ss_pos, he.start]
  · rw [← he.last', get_append_left]
  · rw [← ss.eta, drop_append_of_le_length _ _ _ (by grind), tail_cons,
      ← singleton_append_ωSequence]
    congr
    rw [ωSequence.head, hm, ← sl.take_append_getLast he.ss_ne_nil, sl.take_append_getLast,
      he.length', sl.drop_length_sub_one he.ss_ne_nil, he.getLast]

name: Cslib.LTS.OmegaExecution.flatten_execution'
statement:
theorem OmegaExecution.flatten_execution' [Inhabited Label] [Inhabited State]
    {ts : ωSequence State} {μls : ωSequence (List Label)} {sls : ωSequence (List State)}
    (hexec : ∀ k, lts.Execution (ts k) (μls k) (ts (k + 1)) (sls k))
    (hpos : ∀ k, 0 < (μls k).length) :
    lts.OmegaExecution (sls.map List.dropLast).flatten μls.flatten
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨n, k, hk, rfl⟩ : ∃ n' k, k < (μls n').length ∧ n = μls.cumLen n' + k := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le <|
      segment_lower_bound (cumLen_strictMono hpos) cumLen_zero n
    refine ⟨segment μls.cumLen n, k, ?_, hk⟩
    have := segment_upper_bound (cumLen_strictMono hpos) cumLen_zero n
    simp [cumLen_succ] at this
    grind
  have hlen (k : ℕ) : (μls k).length = (sls.map List.dropLast k).length := by grind
  have hclen : μls.cumLen = (sls.map List.dropLast).cumLen := by ext k; induction k <;> grind
  have hspos (k : ℕ) : 0 < (sls.map List.dropLast k).length := hlen k ▸ hpos k
  convert (hexec n).trans k hk
  · rw [hlen] at hk
    simp [hclen, flatten_get_add _ hk hspos]
  · exact flatten_get_add _ hk hpos
  · obtain (hk | hk) : k + 1 < (μls n).length ∨ k + 1 = (μls n).length := by lia
    · rw [hlen] at hk
      simp [hclen, add_assoc, flatten_get_add _ hk hspos]
    · rw! [add_assoc, hk, ← cumLen_succ, (hexec n).last', hclen, flatten_get_cumLen _ hspos]
      simp [(hexec (n + 1)).start]

name: Cslib.LTS.OmegaExecution.flatten_execution
statement:
theorem OmegaExecution.flatten_execution [Inhabited Label]
    {ts : ωSequence State} {μls : ωSequence (List Label)} {sls : ωSequence (List State)}
    (hexec : ∀ k, lts.Execution (ts k) (μls k) (ts (k + 1)) (sls k))
    (hpos : ∀ k, 0 < (μls k).length) :
    ∃ ss, lts.OmegaExecution ss μls.flatten ∧
      ∀ k, ss.extract (μls.cumLen k) (μls.cumLen (k + 1)) = (sls k).take (μls k).length
proof:
:= by
  have : Inhabited State := {default := ts 0}
  use (sls.map List.dropLast).flatten, .flatten_execution' hexec hpos
  intro k
  have hlen : μls.cumLen = (sls.map List.dropLast).cumLen := by ext k; induction k <;> grind
  rw [hlen, extract_flatten, get_map, (sls k).dropLast_eq_take, ← (hexec k).length']
  grind

/

name: Cslib.LTS.OmegaExecution.flatten_mTr
statement:
theorem OmegaExecution.flatten_mTr [Inhabited Label]
    {ts : ωSequence State} {μls : ωSequence (List Label)}
    (hmtr : ∀ k, lts.MTr (ts k) (μls k) (ts (k + 1))) (hpos : ∀ k, 0 < (μls k).length) :
    ∃ ss, lts.OmegaExecution ss μls.flatten ∧ ∀ k, ss (μls.cumLen k) = ts k
proof:
:= by
  choose sls h_sls using fun k ↦ Execution.of_mTr (hmtr k)
  obtain ⟨ss, h_ss, (h_seg : ∀ k, _ = (sls k).take (μls k).length)⟩ :=
    OmegaExecution.flatten_execution h_sls hpos
  use ss, h_ss
  intro k
  have hsub : 0 < μls.cumLen (k + 1) - μls.cumLen k := by simpa [cumLen_succ] using hpos k
  rw! [← (h_sls k).head, ← (μls.cumLen k).add_zero, ← ss.get_extract hsub, h_seg k,
    List.getElem_take, List.head_eq_getElem]
  rfl

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.toReflTransGen
statement:
theorem MTr.toReflTransGen (h : lts.MTr s1 μs s2) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen lts.UnlabelledTr s1 s2
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | stepL htr _ ih => exact ih.head ⟨_, htr⟩

/
transition relation. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.MTr.toTransGen
statement:
theorem MTr.toTransGen (h : lts.MTr s1 μs s2) (hne : μs ≠ []) :
    Relation.TransGen lts.UnlabelledTr s1 s2
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | refl => contradiction
  | stepL htr hmtr => exact Relation.TransGen.head' ⟨_, htr⟩ (hmtr.toReflTransGen lts)

/
reachability in the LTS. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.reflTransGen_unlabelledTr_iff
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_unlabelledTr_iff :
    Relation.ReflTransGen lts.UnlabelledTr s1 s2 ↔ lts.CanReach s1 s2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨[], .refl⟩
    | tail _ htr ih =>
        obtain ⟨μs, hmtr⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨μ, htr⟩ := htr
        exact ⟨μs ++ [μ], hmtr.stepR lts htr⟩
  · rintro ⟨μs, hmtr⟩
    exact hmtr.toReflTransGen lts

/
nonempty multistep transitions of the LTS. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.transGen_unlabelledTr_iff
statement:
theorem transGen_unlabelledTr_iff :
    Relation.TransGen lts.UnlabelledTr s1 s2 ↔
      ∃ μs, μs ≠ [] ∧ lts.MTr s1 μs s2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | single htr =>
        obtain ⟨μ, htr⟩ := htr
        exact ⟨[μ], by simp, MTr.single lts htr⟩
    | tail _ htr ih =>
        obtain ⟨μs, hne, hmtr⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨μ, htr⟩ := htr
        exact ⟨μs ++ [μ], by simp, hmtr.stepR lts htr⟩
  · rintro ⟨μs, hne, hmtr⟩
    exact hmtr.toTransGen lts hne

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.comp
statement:
theorem IsSimulation.comp
    (r1 : State₁ → State₂ → Prop)
    (r2 : State₂ → State₃ → Prop)
    (h1 : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ r1) (h2 : IsSimulation lts₂ lts₃ r2) :
    IsSimulation lts₁ lts₃ (Relation.Comp r1 r2)
proof:
:= by
  intro s₁ s2 hrc μ s₁' htr
  rcases hrc with ⟨sb, hr1, hr2⟩
  obtain ⟨s₁'', h1'tr, h1'⟩ := h1 hr1 μ s₁' htr
  obtain ⟨s2'', h2'tr, h2'⟩ := h2 hr2 μ s₁'' h1'tr
  use s2'', h2'tr, s₁'', h1', h2'

/

name: Cslib.LTS.Similarity.trans
statement:
theorem Similarity.trans (h1 : s₁ ≤[lts₁,lts₂] s2) (h2 : s2 ≤[lts₂,lts₃] s₃) :
    s₁ ≤[lts₁,lts₃] s₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r1, hr1, hr1s⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨r2, hr2, hr2s⟩ := h2
  use! Relation.Comp r1 r2, s2, hr1, hr2, IsSimulation.comp r1 r2 hr1s hr2s

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.sup
statement:
theorem IsSimulation.sup (hr : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ r)
    (hs : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ s) : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ (r ⊔ s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro s₁ s₂ (hrel | hrel) μ s₁' htr
  · obtain ⟨s₂', htr', hrel'⟩ := hr hrel μ s₁' htr
    use s₂', htr', Or.inl hrel'
  · obtain ⟨s₂', htr', hrel'⟩ := hs hrel μ s₁' htr
    use s₂', htr', Or.inr hrel'

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.sim_trace
statement:
theorem IsSimulation.sim_trace (hr : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ r) (hrel : r s₁ s₂) :
    ∀ μs s₁', lts₁.MTr s₁ μs s₁' → ∃ s₂', lts₂.MTr s₂ μs s₂' ∧ r s₁' s₂'
proof:
:= by
  intro μs s₁' hmtr
  induction μs generalizing s₁ s₂ with
  | nil =>
    obtain rfl := hmtr.nil_eq
    exact ⟨s₂, MTr.refl, hrel⟩
  | cons μ μs ih =>
    cases hmtr
    case stepL s₁'' htr hmtr =>
      obtain ⟨s₂'', htr₂, hrel'⟩: ∃ s2', lts₂.Tr s₂ μ s2' ∧ r s₁'' s2' := hr hrel μ s₁'' htr
      obtain ⟨s₂', hmtr₂, hrel'⟩ := ih hrel' hmtr
      use s₂', hmtr₂.stepL htr₂, hrel'

/
`s2 ≤[lts₂ lts₁] s₁`. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.follow_internal
proof:
:= by
  induction hstr
  case refl =>
    use s₂, .refl
  case tail sb hrsb htrsb ih1 ih2 =>
    obtain ⟨sb2, htrsb2, hrb⟩ := ih2
    have ⟨sb2', htrsb2', hrb'⟩ := h hrb HasTau.τ _ ih1
    use sb2', htrsb2.trans (lts₂.sTr_τSTr_iff.mp htrsb2')

/

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.isSimulation_saturate_left
proof:
:= by
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ s₁' h
  cases h
  case refl =>
    use s₂, .refl, hr
  case tr sb sb' hstr1 htr hstr2 =>
    obtain ⟨sb1, hstr1b, hrb⟩ := IsSimulation.follow_internal h hr hstr1
    obtain ⟨sb2', hstr1b', hrb'⟩ := h hrb μ _ htr
    obtain ⟨s₁', hstr1', hrb2⟩ := IsSimulation.follow_internal h hrb' hstr2
    rw [←sTr_τSTr_iff] at hstr1' hstr1b
    use s₁', STr.comp hstr1b hstr1b' hstr1', hrb2

/
right. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.mono
statement:
theorem IsSimulation.mono (h₁ : lts₁'.Tr ≤ lts₁.Tr) (h₂ : lts₂.Tr ≤ lts₂'.Tr)
    (h : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ r) : IsSimulation lts₁' lts₂' r
proof:
:= by
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ s₁' htr
  obtain ⟨s₂', htr', hr'⟩ := h hr μ s₁' (h₁ _ _ _ htr)
  use s₂', h₂ _ _ _ htr', hr'

in the simulation. -/

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.match_deterministic
statement:
theorem IsSimulation.match_deterministic (hb : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ r) (hr : r s₁ s₂)
    (hdet : lts₂.DeterministicStateLabel s₂ μ) (htr₁ : lts₁.Tr s₁ μ s₁') (htr₂ : lts₂.Tr s₂ μ s₂') :
    r s₁' s₂'

name: Cslib.LTS.IsSimulation.follow_deterministic
statement:
theorem IsSimulation.follow_deterministic (hb : IsSimulation lts₁ lts₂ r) (hr : r s₁ s₂)

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₂', htr₂, hr₂⟩ := follow hb hr htr
  exists s₂'
  grind

name: Cslib.LTS.Bounded.toTerminating
statement: theorem Bounded.toTerminating (h : lts.Bounded) : lts.Terminating
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rw [Relation.Terminating.iff_isEmpty_chain]
  constructor
  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
  change ∀ n, lts.UnlabelledTr (f n) (f (n + 1)) at hf
  obtain ⟨bound, hbound⟩ := h.bounded
  have hpaths : ∀ n, ∃ μs, μs.length = n ∧ lts.MTr (f 0) μs (f n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨[], rfl, .refl⟩
    | succ n ih =>
        obtain ⟨μs, hlength, hmtr⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨μ, htr⟩ := hf n
        exact ⟨μs ++ [μ], by simp [hlength], hmtr.stepR lts htr⟩
  obtain ⟨μs, hlength, hmtr⟩ := hpaths bound
  have := hbound (f 0) μs (f bound) hmtr
  omega

/

name: Cslib.LTS.Acyclic.toBoundedUpTo
statement:
theorem Acyclic.toBoundedUpTo [Finite State] (h : lts.Acyclic) :
    lts.BoundedUpTo (Nat.card State)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite State
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  intro s1 μs s2 hmtr
  obtain ⟨states, hexec⟩ := Execution.of_mTr hmtr
  have hchain : states.IsChain (Relation.TransGen lts.UnlabelledTr) :=
    hexec.isChain.imp_of_mem_imp fun _ _ _ _ htr => .single htr
  let : Std.Irrefl (Relation.TransGen lts.UnlabelledTr) := h.acyclic
  have hcard := hchain.pairwise.nodup.length_le_card
  grind

/

name: Cslib.LTS.totalize.no_sink_to_nonsink
statement:
theorem totalize.no_sink_to_nonsink {μs : List Label} {t : State} :
    ¬ lts.totalize.MTr (none) μs (some t)
proof:
:= by
  induction μs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons μ μs ih =>
    simp only [MTr.cons_iff]
    rintro ⟨_ | s, htr, hmtr⟩
    · exact ih hmtr
    · exact htr

the transitions in the original LTS. -/

proof:

name: Cslib.LTS.totalize.nonsink_mtr_iff

    lts.totalize.MTr (some s) μs (some t) ↔ lts.MTr s μs t
proof:
:= by
  induction μs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp
  | cons μ μs ih =>
    simp [MTr.cons_iff, Option.exists, no_sink_to_nonsink, ih]

name: Cslib.CCS.Context.complete
statement:
theorem Context.complete (p : Process Name Constant) :
    ∃ c : Context Name Constant, p = c<[(Process.nil : Process Name Constant)] ∨
    ∃ k : Constant, p = c<[(Process.const k : Process Name Constant)]
proof:
:= by
  induction p
  case nil =>
    exists hole
    grind
  case pre μ p ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih
    exists pre μ c
    grind
  case par p q ihp ihq =>
    obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ := ihp
    exists parL cp q
    grind
  case choice p q ihp ihq =>
    obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ := ihp
    exists choiceL cp q
    grind
  case res a p ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih
    exists res a c
    grind
  case «const» k =>
    exists hole
    grind

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_par_nil
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind .]
theorem bisimilarity_par_nil : (par p nil) ~[lts (defs := defs)] p
proof:
:= by
  unfold lts at *
  exists ParNil, .parNil
  intro _ _ _ _
  constructor
  case left => grind
  case right =>
    intro s2' htr
    exists par s2' nil
    grind

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_par_comm
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem bisimilarity_par_comm : (par p q) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (par q p)
proof:
:= by
  let defParComm : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant
    | par p q => par q p
    | _ => nil
  use ParComm, ParComm.parComm
  intro _ _ _ _
  unfold lts at *
  split_ands <;> intro p _ <;> exists defParComm p <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_nil_par
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind .]
theorem bisimilarity_nil_par : (par nil p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] p
proof:
:=
  calc
    (par nil p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (par p nil) := by grind
    _ ~[lts (defs := defs)] p := by simp

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_par_assoc
statement:
theorem bisimilarity_par_assoc :
    (par p (par q r)) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (par (par p q) r)
proof:
:= by
  use ParAssoc, ParAssoc.assoc
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  apply And.intro <;> cases hr
  case right.assoc =>
    intro s2' htr
    unfold lts at *
    cases htr
    case parL p q r p' htr =>
      cases htr
      case parL p q r p' _ =>
        exists p'.par (q.par r)
        grind
      case parR p q r q' _ =>
        exists p.par (q'.par r)
        grind
      case com μ p' μ' q' _ htrp htrq =>
        exists p'.par (q'.par r)
        grind
    case parR p q r r' htr =>
      exists p.par (q.par r')
      grind
    case com p q r μ p' μ' r' _ htr htr' =>
      cases htr
      case parL p' _ =>
        use p'.par (q.par r')
        grind
      case parR q' _ =>
        use p.par (q'.par r')
        grind
      case com => grind
  case left.assoc =>
    intro s2' htr
    unfold lts at *
    cases htr
    case parR htr =>
      cases htr
      case parL p q r q' _ =>
        exists (p.par q').par r
        grind
      case parR p q r r' _ =>
        exists (p.par q).par r'
        grind
      case com p q r μ q' μ' r' _ htrp htrq =>
        use (p.par q').par r'
        grind
    case parL p q r p' htr =>
      exists (p'.par q).par r
      grind
    case com p q r μ p' μ' q' _ htr htr' =>
      cases htr'
      case parL q' _ =>
        use (p'.par q').par r
        grind
      case parR r' _ =>
        use (p'.par q).par r'
        grind
      case com => grind
  all_goals grind

/
