name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_pre
statement:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_pre :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (pre μ p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (pre μ q)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpq
  exists @PreBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · grind
  intro s1 s2 hr μ'
  cases hr
  case pre p' q' μ hbis =>
    unfold lts
    constructor <;> intro _ _ <;> [exists q'; exists p'] <;> grind
  case bisim => grind [IsBisimulation, IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity]

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_res
statement:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_res :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (res a p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (res a q)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpq
  refine ⟨@ResBisim Name Constant defs, .res hpq, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | res h =>
    constructor
    · intro _ htr
      cases htr with
      | res hn hn' htr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨_, .res hn hn' htr', .res h'⟩
    · intro _ htr
      cases htr with
      | res hn hn' htr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨_, .res hn hn' htr', .res h'⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
statement:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpq
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim Name Constant defs, .choice hpq, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor
    · intro s htr
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨s', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨s', .choiceL htr', .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR htr => exact ⟨s, .choiceR htr, .bisim (.refl s)⟩
    · intro s htr
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨s', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨s', .choiceL htr', .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR htr => exact ⟨s, .choiceR htr, .bisim (.refl s)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor
    · intro _ htr
      obtain ⟨s', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨s', htr', .bisim h'⟩
    · intro _ htr
      obtain ⟨s', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨s', htr', .bisim h'⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_par
statement:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_par :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (par p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (par q r)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpq
  refine ⟨@ParBisim Name Constant defs, .par hpq, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | par h =>
    constructor
    · intro _ htr
      cases htr with
      | parL htr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨_, .parL htr', .par h'⟩
      | parR htr => exact ⟨_, .parR htr, .par h⟩
      | com hco htrp htrr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htrp
        exact ⟨_, .com hco htr' htrr, .par h'⟩
    · intro _ htr
      cases htr with
      | parL htr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨_, .parL htr', .par h'⟩
      | parR htr => exact ⟨_, .parR htr, .par h⟩
      | com hco htrq htrr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htrq
        exact ⟨_, .com hco htr' htrr, .par h'⟩

/

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_is_congruence
statement:
theorem bisimilarity_is_congruence
    (p q : Process Name Constant) (c : Context Name Constant) (h : p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) :
    (c.fill p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (c.fill q)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | parR r c _ =>
    calc
      _ ~[lts (defs := defs)] (c.fill p |>.par r)  := by grind
      _ ~[lts (defs := defs)] (c.fill q |>.par r)  := by grind [bisimilarity_congr_par]
      _ ~[lts (defs := defs)] (c.parR r |>.fill q) := by grind
  | choiceR r c _ =>
    calc
      _ ~[lts (defs := defs)] (c.fill p |>.choice r)  := by grind [bisimilarity_choice_comm]
      _ ~[lts (defs := defs)] (c.fill q |>.choice r)  := by grind [bisimilarity_congr_choice]
      _ ~[lts (defs := defs)] (c.choiceR r |>.fill q) := by grind [bisimilarity_choice_comm]
  | _ => grind [bisimilarity_congr_pre, bisimilarity_congr_par,
                bisimilarity_congr_choice, bisimilarity_congr_res]

name: Cslib.CCS.not_tr_of_terminated
statement:
@[scoped grind ⇒]
theorem not_tr_of_terminated (h : Terminated p) : ¬(lts (defs := defs)).Tr p μ p'
proof:
:= by
  intro htr
  induction htr <;> grind [Terminated]

/

name: Cslib.CCS.pre_tr
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem pre_tr (h : (lts (defs := defs)).Tr (pre μ p) μ' p') : μ = μ' ∧ p = p'
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  simp

/

name: Cslib.CCS.const_tr
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem const_tr (h : (lts (defs := defs)).Tr («const» k) μ p') :
    ∃ p, defs k = some p ∧ (lts (defs := defs)).Tr p μ p'
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  case «const» p hdef htr =>
    exists p

/

name: Cslib.CCS.pre_deterministicState
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem pre_deterministicState : DeterministicState (lts (defs := defs)) (pre μ p)
proof:
:= by
  grind

/

name: Cslib.CCS.const_deterministicStateLabel
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem const_deterministicStateLabel (hdef : defs k = some p)
    (h : DeterministicStateLabel (lts (defs := defs)) p μ) :
    DeterministicStateLabel (lts (defs := defs)) («const» k) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro p₁ p₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  cases h₂
  case const.const q₁ hdef₁ htr₁ q₂ hdef₂ htr₂ =>
    have hq₁ : q₁ = p := by grind only
    have hq₂ : q₂ = p := by grind only
    rw [hq₁] at htr₁
    rw [hq₂] at htr₂
    apply h p₁ p₂ htr₁ htr₂

/

name: Cslib.CCS.res_deterministicStateLabel
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem res_deterministicStateLabel
    (h : DeterministicStateLabel (lts (defs := defs)) p μ) :
    DeterministicStateLabel (lts (defs := defs)) (res μ' p) μ
proof:
:= by
  intro p₁ p₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  cases h₂
  case res.res q₁ h₁ h₂ htr₁ q₂ h₃ h₄ htr₂ =>
    have hq₁q₂ : q₁ = q₂ := by
      apply h _ _ htr₁ htr₂
    rw [hq₁q₂]

name: Cslib.SKI.Polynomial.elimVar_correct
statement:
theorem Polynomial.elimVar_correct {n : Nat} (Γ : SKI.Polynomial (n + 1)) {ys : List SKI}
    (hys : ys.length = n) (z : SKI) :
    (Γ.elimVar.eval ys hys ⬝ z) ↠ Γ.eval (ys ++ [z])
      (by rw [List.length_append, hys, List.length_singleton])
proof:
:= by
  match n, Γ with
  | _, .term x =>
    rw [SKI.Polynomial.elimVar, SKI.Polynomial.eval]
    exact MRed.K _ _
  | _, .app Γ Δ =>
    rw [SKI.Polynomial.elimVar, SKI.Polynomial.eval]
    trans Γ.elimVar.eval ys hys ⬝ z ⬝ (Δ.elimVar.eval ys hys ⬝ z)
    · exact MRed.S _ _ _
    · apply parallel_mRed
      · exact elimVar_correct Γ hys z
      · exact elimVar_correct Δ hys z
  | n, .var i =>
    rw [SKI.Polynomial.elimVar]
    split_ifs with hi
    · have h : (ys ++ [z])[i]'(by simp [hys]) = ys[↑i] := by grind
      simp_rw [SKI.Polynomial.eval, h, Fin.getElem_fin, Fin.val_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi]
      exact MRed.K _ _
    · replace hi := Nat.eq_of_lt_succ_of_not_lt i.isLt hi
      have app_len : (ys ++ [z]).length = n + 1 := by simpa
      have : (ys ++ [z])[n]'(by rw [app_len]; exact Nat.lt_add_one n) = z := by
        rw [List.getElem_append_right] <;> simp [hys]
      simp_rw [SKI.Polynomial.eval, Fin.getElem_fin, hi, this]
      exact MRed.I _

/

name: Cslib.SKI.R_def
statement: theorem R_def (x y : SKI) : (R ⬝ x ⬝ y) ↠ y ⬝ x
proof:
:=
  RPoly.toSKI_correct [x, y] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.B_def
statement: theorem B_def (f g x : SKI) : (B ⬝ f ⬝ g ⬝ x) ↠ f ⬝ (g ⬝ x)
proof:
:=
  BPoly.toSKI_correct [f, g, x] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.B_tail_mred
statement: lemma B_tail_mred (f g x y : SKI) (h : (g ⬝ x) ↠ y) : (B ⬝ f ⬝ g ⬝ x) ↠ f ⬝ y
proof:
:=
  Trans.trans (B_def f g x) (MRed.tail f h)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.C_def
statement: theorem C_def (f x y : SKI) : (C ⬝ f ⬝ x ⬝ y) ↠ f ⬝ y ⬝ x
proof:
:=
  CPoly.toSKI_correct [f, x, y] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.C_head_mred
statement: lemma C_head_mred (f x y z : SKI) (h : (f ⬝ y) ↠ z) : (C ⬝ f ⬝ x ⬝ y) ↠ z ⬝ x
proof:
:=
  Trans.trans (C_def f x y) (MRed.head x h)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.rotR_def
statement: theorem rotR_def (x y z : SKI) : (RotR ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ z) ↠ z ⬝ x ⬝ y
proof:
:=
  RotRPoly.toSKI_correct [x, y, z] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.rotL_def
statement: theorem rotL_def (x y z : SKI) : (RotL ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ z) ↠ y ⬝ z ⬝ x
proof:
:=
  RotLPoly.toSKI_correct [x, y, z] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.del_def
statement: theorem del_def (x : SKI) : (Del ⬝ x) ↠ x ⬝ x
proof:
:=
  DelPoly.toSKI_correct [x] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.H_def
statement: theorem H_def (f x : SKI) : (H ⬝ f ⬝ x) ↠ f ⬝ (x ⬝ x)
proof:
:=
  HPoly.toSKI_correct [f, x] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.Y_def
statement: theorem Y_def (f : SKI) : (Y ⬝ f) ↠ H ⬝ f ⬝ (H ⬝ f)
proof:
:=
  YPoly.toSKI_correct [f] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.Y_correct
statement: theorem Y_correct (f : SKI) : Join (ReflTransGen Red) (Y ⬝ f) (f ⬝ (Y ⬝ f))
proof:
:= by
  use f ⬝ (H ⬝ f ⬝ (H ⬝ f))
  constructor
  · exact Trans.trans (Y_def f) (H_def f (H ⬝ f))
  · apply MRed.tail
    exact Y_def f

/
It is useful to be able to produce a term such that the fixed point property holds on-the-nose,
rather than up to a common reduct. An alternative is to use Turing's fixed-point combinator
(defined below).
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.fixedPoint_correct
statement: theorem fixedPoint_correct (f : SKI) : f.fixedPoint ↠ f ⬝ f.fixedPoint
proof:
:= H_def f (H ⬝ f)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.ThAux_def
statement: theorem ThAux_def (x y : SKI) : (ThAux ⬝ x ⬝ y) ↠ y ⬝ (x ⬝ x ⬝ y)
proof:
:=
  ThAuxPoly.toSKI_correct [x, y] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.Th_correct
statement: theorem Th_correct (f : SKI) : (Th ⬝ f) ↠ f ⬝ (Th ⬝ f)
proof:
:= ThAux_def ThAux f

/-! ### Church Booleans -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.isBool_trans
statement:
theorem isBool_trans (u : Bool) (a a' : SKI) (h : a ↠ a') (ha' : IsBool u a') :
    IsBool u a
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  trans a' ⬝ x ⬝ y
  · apply MRed.head
    apply MRed.head
    exact h
  · exact ha' x y

/

name: Cslib.SKI.TT_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem TT_correct : IsBool true TT
proof:
:= fun x y ↦ MRed.K x y

/

name: Cslib.SKI.FF_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem FF_correct : IsBool false FF
proof:
:=
  fun x y ↦ calc
    (FF ⬝ x ⬝ y) ↠ I ⬝ y := by apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single; apply red_head; exact red_K I x
    _         ⭢ y := red_I y

/

name: Cslib.SKI.cond_correct
statement:
theorem cond_correct (a x y : SKI) (u : Bool) (h : IsBool u a) :
    (SKI.Cond ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ a) ↠ if u then x else y
proof:
:= by
  trans a ⬝ x ⬝ y
  · exact rotR_def x y a
  · exact h x y

/

name: Cslib.SKI.neg_correct
statement: theorem neg_correct (a : SKI) (ua : Bool) (h : IsBool ua a) : IsBool (¬ ua) (SKI.Neg ⬝ a)
proof:
:= by
  apply isBool_trans (a' := if ua then FF else TT)
  · apply cond_correct (h := h)
  · cases ua
    · simp [TT_correct]
    · simp [FF_correct]

/

name: Cslib.SKI.and_def
statement: theorem and_def (a b : SKI) : (SKI.And ⬝ a ⬝ b) ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ (SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ FF ⬝ b) ⬝ FF ⬝ a
proof:
:=
  AndPoly.toSKI_correct [a, b] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.and_correct
statement:
theorem and_correct (a b : SKI) (ua ub : Bool) (ha : IsBool ua a) (hb : IsBool ub b) :
    IsBool (ua && ub) (SKI.And ⬝ a ⬝ b)
proof:
:= by
  apply isBool_trans (a' := SKI.Cond ⬝ (SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ FF ⬝ b) ⬝ FF ⬝ a) (h := and_def _ _)
  cases ua
  · simp_rw [Bool.false_and] at ⊢
    apply isBool_trans (a' := FF) (ha' := FF_correct) (h := cond_correct a _ _ false ha)
  · simp_rw [Bool.true_and] at ⊢
    apply isBool_trans (a' := SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ FF ⬝ b) (h := cond_correct a _ _ true ha)
    apply isBool_trans (a' := if ub = true then TT else FF) (h := cond_correct b _ _ ub hb)
    cases ub
    · simp [FF_correct]
    · simp [TT_correct]

/

name: Cslib.SKI.or_def
statement: theorem or_def (a b : SKI) : (SKI.Or ⬝ a ⬝ b) ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ (SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ FF ⬝ b) ⬝ a
proof:
:=
  OrPoly.toSKI_correct [a, b] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.or_correct
statement:
theorem or_correct (a b : SKI) (ua ub : Bool) (ha : IsBool ua a) (hb : IsBool ub b) :
  IsBool (ua || ub) (SKI.Or ⬝ a ⬝ b)
proof:
:= by
  apply isBool_trans (a' := SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ (SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ FF ⬝ b) ⬝ a) (h := or_def _ _)
  cases ua
  · simp_rw [Bool.false_or]
    apply isBool_trans (a' := SKI.Cond ⬝ TT ⬝ FF ⬝ b) (h := cond_correct a _ _ false ha)
    apply isBool_trans (a' := if ub = true then TT else FF) (h := cond_correct b _ _ ub hb)
    cases ub
    · simp [FF_correct]
    · simp [TT_correct]
  · apply isBool_trans (a' := TT) (h := cond_correct a _ _ true ha)
    simp [TT_correct]

/- TODO?: other boolean connectives -/

/-! ### Pairs -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.fst_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem fst_correct (a b : SKI) : (Fst ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ a ⬝ b)) ↠ a
proof:
:= by calc
  _ ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ a ⬝ b ⬝ TT := R_def _ _
  _ ↠ a := cond_correct TT a b true TT_correct

name: Cslib.SKI.snd_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem snd_correct (a b : SKI) : (Snd ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ a ⬝ b)) ↠ b
proof:
:= by calc
  _ ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ a ⬝ b ⬝ FF := R_def _ _
  _ ↠ b := cond_correct FF a b false FF_correct

/

name: Cslib.SKI.unpaired_def
statement: theorem unpaired_def (f p : SKI) : (SKI.Unpaired ⬝ f ⬝ p) ↠ f ⬝ (Fst ⬝ p) ⬝ (Snd ⬝ p)
proof:
:=
  UnpairedPoly.toSKI_correct [f, p] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.unpaired_correct
statement: theorem unpaired_correct (f x y : SKI) : (SKI.Unpaired ⬝ f ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ x ⬝ y)) ↠ f ⬝ x ⬝ y
proof:
:= by
  trans f ⬝ (Fst ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ x ⬝ y)) ⬝ (Snd ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ x ⬝ y))
  · exact unpaired_def f _
  · apply parallel_mRed
    · apply MRed.tail
      exact fst_correct _ _
    · exact snd_correct _ _

/

name: Cslib.SKI.pair_def
statement: theorem pair_def (f g x : SKI) : (SKI.Pair ⬝ f ⬝ g ⬝ x) ↠ MkPair ⬝ (f ⬝ x) ⬝ (g ⬝ x)
proof:
:=
  PairPoly.toSKI_correct [f, g, x] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.computes_of_total
statement:
theorem computes_of_total {t : SKI} {f : ℕ →. ℕ} (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (heval : ∀ n, f n = Part.some (g n))
    (hcorrect : ∀ n cn, IsChurch n cn → IsChurch (g n) (t ⬝ cn)) :
    Computes t f
proof:
:= by
  intro n cn hcn m hm; rw [heval] at hm; obtain rfl := Part.mem_some_iff.mp hm
  exact hcorrect n cn hcn

/

name: Cslib.SKI.comp_computes
proof:
:= by
  intro n cn hcn m hm
  obtain ⟨intermediate, hint_mem, hm_mem⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp hm
  exact isChurch_trans _ (B_def tf tg cn)
    (hf intermediate (tg ⬝ cn) (hg n cn hcn intermediate hint_mem) m hm_mem)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.pair_computes
statement:
theorem pair_computes {f g : ℕ →. ℕ} {tf tg : SKI}
    (hf : Computes tf f) (hg : Computes tg g) :
    Computes (S ⬝ (B ⬝ NatPair ⬝ tf) ⬝ tg)
      (fun n => Nat.pair <$> f n <*> g n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n cn hcn m hm
  simp only [Seq.seq, Functor.map, Part.mem_bind_iff, Part.mem_map_iff] at hm
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hm
  exact isChurch_trans _ ((MRed.S _ _ _).trans (MRed.head _ (B_def _ _ _)))
    (natPair_correct a b _ _ (hf n cn hcn a ha) (hg n cn hcn b hb))

name: Cslib.SKI.ParallelReduction.le_reflTransGen_red
statement:
theorem ParallelReduction.le_reflTransGen_red :
    (· ⭢ₚ ·) ≤ (· ↠ ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro a a' h
  cases h
  case refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  case par a a' b b' ha hb =>
    apply parallel_mRed
    · exact ha.le_reflTransGen_red
    · exact hb.le_reflTransGen_red
  case red_I => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single (Red.red_I a')
  case red_K b => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single (Red.red_K a' b)
  case red_S a b c => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single (Red.red_S a b c)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.Red.le_parallelReduction
statement:
theorem Red.le_parallelReduction :
    (· ⭢ ·) ≤ (· ⭢ₚ ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro a a' h
  cases h
  case red_S => apply ParallelReduction.red_S
  case red_K => apply ParallelReduction.red_K
  case red_I => apply ParallelReduction.red_I
  case red_head a a' b h =>
    apply ParallelReduction.par
    · exact h.le_parallelReduction
    · exact ParallelReduction.refl b
  case red_tail a b b' h =>
    apply ParallelReduction.par
    · exact ParallelReduction.refl a
    · exact h.le_parallelReduction

/

name: Cslib.SKI.reflTransGen_parallelReduction_mRed
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_parallelReduction_mRed :
    ReflTransGen ParallelReduction = ReflTransGen Red
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact reflTransGen_le_of_le ParallelReduction.le_reflTransGen_red
  · exact ReflTransGen.mono Red.le_parallelReduction

/-!
Irreducibility for the (partially applied) primitive combinators.

TODO: possibly these should be proven more generally (in another file) for `↠`.
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.I_irreducible
statement: lemma I_irreducible (a : SKI) (h : I ⭢ₚ a) : a = I
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: Cslib.SKI.K_irreducible
statement: lemma K_irreducible (a : SKI) (h : K ⭢ₚ a) : a = K
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: Cslib.SKI.Ka_irreducible
statement: lemma Ka_irreducible (a c : SKI) (h : (K ⬝ a) ⭢ₚ c) : ∃ a', a ⭢ₚ a' ∧ c = K ⬝ a'
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  case refl => use a, .refl a
  case par b a' h h' => rw [K_irreducible b h]; use a'

name: Cslib.SKI.S_irreducible
statement: lemma S_irreducible (a : SKI) (h : S ⭢ₚ a) : a = S
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: Cslib.SKI.Sa_irreducible
statement: lemma Sa_irreducible (a c : SKI) (h : (S ⬝ a) ⭢ₚ c) : ∃ a', a ⭢ₚ a' ∧ c = S ⬝ a'
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  case refl =>
    exact ⟨a, ParallelReduction.refl a, rfl⟩
  case par b a' h h' => rw [S_irreducible b h]; use a'

name: Cslib.SKI.Sab_irreducible
statement:
lemma Sab_irreducible (a b c : SKI) (h : (S ⬝ a ⬝ b) ⭢ₚ c) :
    ∃ a' b', a ⭢ₚ a' ∧ b ⭢ₚ b' ∧ c = S ⬝ a' ⬝ b'
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  case refl => use a, b, .refl a, .refl b
  case par c b' hc hb =>
    let ⟨d, hd⟩ := Sa_irreducible a c hc
    rw [hd.2]
    use d, b', hd.1

/
The key result: the Church-Rosser property holds for `⭢ₚ`. The proof is a lengthy case analysis
on the reductions `a ⭢ₚ a₁` and `a ⭢ₚ a₂`, but is entirely mechanical.
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
statement: theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction
proof:
:= by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use a' ⬝ b'
      exact ⟨.refl (a' ⬝ b'), .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      let ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      use a₃ ⬝ b₃
      constructor
      · exact .par ha.1 hb.1
      · exact .par ha.2 hb.2
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      use b', .red_I b'
    case red_K =>
      let ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      rw [ha₂'.2]
      use a₂'
      exact ⟨.red_K a₂' b', ha₂'.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      let ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a'' ⬝ b' ⬝ (c' ⬝ b'), .red_S a'' c' b'
      apply ParallelReduction.par <;>
        apply ParallelReduction.par <;>
        grind
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .red_I a₁⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      use a₁'
      exact ⟨ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      let ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [h'.2]
      use a₁'
      exact ⟨h'.1, .red_K a₁' c'⟩
    case red_K =>
      use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c)
      exact ⟨.refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c')
      constructor
      · apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.left hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc
      · exact .red_S ..
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _,⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.join_parallelReduction_equivalence
statement:
theorem join_parallelReduction_equivalence :
    Equivalence (Join (ReflTransGen ParallelReduction))
proof:
:=
  Confluent.equivalence_join_reflTransGen <| Diamond.to_confluent parallelReduction_diamond

/

name: Cslib.SKI.join_mRed_equivalence
statement: theorem join_mRed_equivalence : Equivalence (Join (ReflTransGen Red))
proof:
:= by
  rw [←reflTransGen_parallelReduction_mRed]
  exact join_parallelReduction_equivalence

/

name: Cslib.SKI.MRed.diamond
statement: theorem MRed.diamond : Confluent Red
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c hab hac
  apply join_mRed_equivalence.trans (y := a)
  · exact join_mRed_equivalence.symm (Join.single hab)
  · exact Join.single hac

name: Cslib.SKI.applyList_concat
statement:
lemma applyList_concat (f : SKI) (ys : List SKI) (z : SKI) :
    f.applyList (ys ++ [z]) = f.applyList ys ⬝ z
proof:
:= by
  simp [applyList]

/

name: Cslib.SKI.Red.ne
statement:
lemma Red.ne {x y : SKI} : (x ⭢ y) → x ≠ y
  | red_S _ _ _, h => by cases h
  | red_K _ _, h => by cases h
  | red_I _, h => by cases h
  | red_head _ _ _ h', h => Red.ne h' (SKI.app.inj h).1
  | red_tail _ _ _ h', h => Red.ne h' (SKI.app.inj h).2

name: Cslib.SKI.MRed.S
statement: theorem MRed.S (x y z : SKI) : (S ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ z) ↠ (x ⬝ z ⬝ (y ⬝ z))
proof: := .single <| red_S ..

name: Cslib.SKI.MRed.K
statement: theorem MRed.K (x y : SKI) : (K ⬝ x ⬝ y) ↠ x
proof: := .single <| red_K ..

name: Cslib.SKI.MRed.I
statement: theorem MRed.I (x : SKI) : (I ⬝ x) ↠ x
proof: := .single <| red_I ..

name: Cslib.SKI.MRed.head
statement: theorem MRed.head {a a' : SKI} (b : SKI) (h : a ↠ a') : (a ⬝ b) ↠ (a' ⬝ b)
proof:
:= by
  induction h <;> grind

name: Cslib.SKI.MRed.tail
statement: theorem MRed.tail (a : SKI) {b b' : SKI} (h : b ↠ b') : (a ⬝ b) ↠ (a ⬝ b')
proof:
:= by
  induction h <;> grind

name: Cslib.SKI.parallel_mRed
statement:
lemma parallel_mRed {a a' b b' : SKI} (ha : a ↠ a') (hb : b ↠ b') :
    (a ⬝ b) ↠ (a' ⬝ b')
proof:
:=
  Trans.simple (MRed.head b ha) (MRed.tail a' hb)

name: Cslib.SKI.parallel_red
statement: lemma parallel_red {a a' b b' : SKI} (ha : a ⭢ a') (hb : b ⭢ b') : (a ⬝ b) ↠ (a' ⬝ b')
proof:
:= by
  trans a' ⬝ b <;> grind

name: Cslib.SKI.join_mRed_head
statement:
theorem join_mRed_head {x x' : SKI} (y : SKI) :
    Join (ReflTransGen Red) x x' → Join (ReflTransGen Red) (x ⬝ y) (x' ⬝ y)
  | ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ => ⟨z ⬝ y, MRed.head y hz, MRed.head y hz'⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-09-12")] alias mJoin_red_head
proof: := join_mRed_head

name: Cslib.SKI.join_mRed_tail
statement:
theorem join_mRed_tail (x : SKI) {y y' : SKI} :
    Join (ReflTransGen Red) y y' → Join (ReflTransGen Red) (x ⬝ y) (x ⬝ y')
  | ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ => ⟨x ⬝ z, MRed.tail x hz, MRed.tail x hz'⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-09-12")] alias mJoin_red_tail
proof: := join_mRed_tail

name: Cslib.SKI.evalStep_right_correct
statement:
theorem evalStep_right_correct : (x y : SKI) → (x.evalStep = Sum.inr y) → x ⭢ y
  | S ⬝ x, a, h =>
    match hx : x.evalStep with
    | Sum.inl _ => by simp only [hx, evalStep, reduceCtorEq] at h
    | Sum.inr x' => by
        simp only [evalStep, hx, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
        rw [←h]
        exact .red_tail _ _ _ (evalStep_right_correct _ _ hx)
  | K ⬝ x, a, h =>
    match hx : x.evalStep with
    | Sum.inl _ => by simp only [hx, evalStep, reduceCtorEq] at h
    | Sum.inr x' => by
        simp only [evalStep, hx, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
        rw [←h]
        exact .red_tail _ _ _ (evalStep_right_correct _ _ hx)
  | I ⬝ x, a, h => Sum.inr.inj h ▸ red_I _
  | S ⬝ x ⬝ y, a, h =>
      match hx : x.evalStep, hy : y.evalStep with
      | Sum.inl _, Sum.inl _ => by simp only [hx, hy, evalStep, reduceCtorEq] at h
      | Sum.inl _, Sum.inr y' => by
          simp only [hx, hy, evalStep, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
          rw [←h]
          exact .red_tail _ _ _ <| evalStep_right_correct _ _ hy
      | Sum.inr x', _ => by
          simp only [hx, hy, evalStep, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
          rw [←h]
          exact .red_head _ _ _ <| .red_tail _ _ _ <| evalStep_right_correct _ _ hx
  | K ⬝ x ⬝ y, a, h => Sum.inr.inj h ▸ red_K ..
  | I ⬝ x ⬝ y, a, h => Sum.inr.inj h ▸ (red_head _ _ _ <| red_I _)
  | S ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ z, a, h => Sum.inr.inj h ▸ red_S ..
  | K ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ z, a, h => Sum.inr.inj h ▸ (red_head _ _ _ <| red_K ..)
  | I ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ z, a, h => Sum.inr.inj h ▸ (red_head _ _ _ <| red_head _ _ _ <| red_I _)
  | a ⬝ b ⬝ c ⬝ d ⬝ e, x, h =>
      match habcd : evalStep (a ⬝ b ⬝ c ⬝ d), he : evalStep e with
      | Sum.inl _, Sum.inl _ => by simp only [habcd, he, evalStep, reduceCtorEq] at h
      | Sum.inl _, Sum.inr e' => by
          simp only [habcd, he, evalStep, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
          rw [←h]
          exact red_tail _ _ _ <| evalStep_right_correct _ _ he
      | Sum.inr abcd', _ => by
          simp only [habcd, he, evalStep, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
          rw [←h]
          exact red_head _ _ _ <| evalStep_right_correct _ _ habcd

name: Cslib.SKI.redexFree_of_normal_red
statement: theorem redexFree_of_normal_red {x : SKI} (h : Normal Red x) : x.RedexFree
proof:
:= by
  match hx : x.evalStep with
  | Sum.inl h' => exact h'.down
  | Sum.inr y => rw [normal_iff] at h; cases h _ (evalStep_right_correct x y hx)

name: Cslib.SKI.RedexFree.normal_red
statement: theorem RedexFree.normal_red {x : SKI} (hx : x.RedexFree) : Normal Red x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [normal_iff]
  intro y hy
  match x, hx, y, hy with
  | S ⬝ x, hx, S ⬝ y, red_tail _ _ _ hx' => rw [RedexFree] at hx; exact hx.normal_red ⟨_, hx'⟩
  | K ⬝ x, hx, K ⬝ y, red_tail _ _ _ hx' => rw [RedexFree] at hx; exact hx.normal_red ⟨_, hx'⟩
  | S ⬝ _ ⬝ _, ⟨hx, _⟩, S ⬝ _ ⬝ _, red_head _ _ _ (red_tail _ _ _ h3) => exact hx.normal_red ⟨_, h3⟩
  | S ⬝ _ ⬝ _, ⟨_, hy⟩, S ⬝ _ ⬝ _, red_tail _ _ _ h3 => exact hy.normal_red ⟨_, h3⟩
  | _ ⬝ _ ⬝ _ ⬝ _ ⬝ _, ⟨hx, _⟩, _ ⬝ _, red_head _ _ _ hq => exact hx.normal_red ⟨_, hq⟩
  | _ ⬝ _ ⬝ _ ⬝ _ ⬝ _, ⟨_, hy⟩, _ ⬝ _, red_tail _ _ _ he => exact hy.normal_red ⟨_, he⟩

/

name: Cslib.SKI.redexFree_iff
statement: theorem redexFree_iff {x : SKI} : x.RedexFree ↔ Normal Red x
proof:
:=
  ⟨RedexFree.normal_red, redexFree_of_normal_red⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.redexFree_iff_evalStep
statement: theorem redexFree_iff_evalStep {x : SKI} : x.RedexFree ↔ (x.evalStep).isLeft = true
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  case mp =>
    intro h
    match hx : x.evalStep with
    | Sum.inl h' => exact rfl
    | Sum.inr y => cases h.normal_red ⟨_, (evalStep_right_correct _ _ hx)⟩
  case mpr =>
    intro h
    match hx : x.evalStep with
    | Sum.inl h' => exact h'.down
    | Sum.inr y => rw [hx] at h; cases h

name: Cslib.SKI.redexFree_iff_mred_eq
statement: theorem redexFree_iff_mred_eq {x : SKI} : x.RedexFree ↔ ∀ y, (x ↠ y) ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  case mp => grind [RedexFree.normal_red]
  case mpr =>
    intro h
    rw [redexFree_iff]
    intro ⟨y, hy⟩
    specialize h y
    exact Red.ne hy (h.1 (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hy))

/

name: Cslib.SKI.join_mRed_redexFree
statement:
theorem join_mRed_redexFree {x y : SKI} (hy : y.RedexFree) (h : Join (ReflTransGen Red) x y) :
    x ↠ y
proof:
:=
  let ⟨w, hyw, hzw⟩ := h
  (redexFree_iff_mred_eq.1 hy _ |>.1 hzw : y = w) ▸ hyw

name: Cslib.SKI.confluent_redexFree
statement: lemma confluent_redexFree {x y z : SKI} (hxy : x ↠ y) (hxz : x ↠ z) (hz : RedexFree z) : y ↠ z
proof:
:=
  let ⟨w, hyw, hzw⟩ := MRed.diamond hxy hxz
  (redexFree_iff_mred_eq.1 hz _ |>.1 hzw : z = w) ▸ hyw

/
If `x` reduces to both `y` and `z`, and both `y` and `z` are in normal form, then they are equal.
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.unique_normal_form
statement:
lemma unique_normal_form {x y z : SKI}
    (hxy : x ↠ y) (hxz : x ↠ z) (hy : y.RedexFree) (hz : RedexFree z) : y = z
proof:
:=
  (redexFree_iff_mred_eq.1 hy _).1 (confluent_redexFree hxy hxz hz)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.eq_of_join_mRed_redexFree
statement:
lemma eq_of_join_mRed_redexFree {x y : SKI} (h : Join (ReflTransGen Red) x y)
    (hx : x.RedexFree) (hy : y.RedexFree) : x = y
proof:
:=
  (redexFree_iff_mred_eq.1 hx _).1 (join_mRed_redexFree hy h)

name: Cslib.SKI.sk_nequiv
statement: lemma sk_nequiv : ¬ Join (ReflTransGen Red) S K
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨z, hsz, hkz⟩
  have hS : RedexFree S := by simp [RedexFree]
  have hK : RedexFree K := by simp [RedexFree]
  cases (redexFree_iff_mred_eq.1 hS z).1 hsz
  cases (redexFree_iff_mred_eq.1 hK _).1 hkz

/

name: Cslib.SKI.isBool_injective
statement:
theorem isBool_injective (x y : SKI) (u v : Bool) (hx : IsBool u x) (hy : IsBool v y)
    (hxy : Join (ReflTransGen Red) x y) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  have h : Join (ReflTransGen Red) (if u then S else K) (if v then S else K) := by
    apply join_mRed_equivalence.trans (y := x ⬝ S ⬝ K)
    · apply join_mRed_equivalence.symm
      apply Relation.Join.single
      exact hx S K
    · apply join_mRed_equivalence.trans (y := y ⬝ S ⬝ K)
      · exact join_mRed_head K <| join_mRed_head S hxy
      · apply Relation.Join.single
        exact hy S K
  grind [sk_nequiv, join_mRed_equivalence.symm h]

name: Cslib.SKI.TF_nequiv
statement: lemma TF_nequiv : ¬ Join (ReflTransGen Red) TT FF
proof:
:= fun h =>
  (Bool.eq_not_self true).mp <| isBool_injective TT FF true false TT_correct FF_correct h

/

name: Cslib.SKI.churchK_church
statement:
lemma churchK_church : (n : Nat) → churchK n = Church n K K
  | 0 => rfl
  | n+1 => by simp [churchK, Church, churchK_church n]

name: Cslib.SKI.churchK_redexFree
statement:
lemma churchK_redexFree : (n : Nat) → RedexFree (churchK n)
  | 0 => trivial
  | n+1 => churchK_redexFree n

@[simp]

name: Cslib.SKI.churchK_size
statement:
@[simp]
lemma churchK_size : (n : Nat) → (churchK n).size = n+1
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [churchK, size, size, churchK_size, Nat.add_comm]

name: Cslib.SKI.churchK_injective
statement: lemma churchK_injective : Function.Injective churchK
proof:
:=
  fun n m h => by simpa using congrArg SKI.size h

/

name: Cslib.SKI.isChurch_injective
statement:
theorem isChurch_injective (x y : SKI) (n m : Nat) (hx : IsChurch n x) (hy : IsChurch m y)
    (hxy : Join (ReflTransGen Red) x y) : n = m
proof:
:= by
  suffices Join (ReflTransGen Red) (churchK n) (churchK m) by
    apply churchK_injective
    exact eq_of_join_mRed_redexFree this (churchK_redexFree n) (churchK_redexFree m)
  apply join_mRed_equivalence.trans (y := x ⬝ K ⬝ K)
  · simp_rw [churchK_church]
    exact join_mRed_equivalence.symm <| Relation.Join.single (hx K K)
  · apply join_mRed_equivalence.trans (y := y ⬝ K ⬝ K)
    · apply join_mRed_head; apply join_mRed_head; assumption
    · simp_rw [churchK_church]
      exact Relation.Join.single (hy K K)

/
**Rice's theorem**: no SKI term is a non-trivial predicate.

More specifically, say a term `P` is a *predicate* if, for every term `x`, `P · x` reduces to either
`TT` or `FF`. A predicate `P` is *trivial* if either it always reduces to true, or always to false.
This version of Rice's theorem derives a contradiction from the existence of a predicate `P` and the
existence of terms `x` for which `P · x` is true (`P · x ↠ TT`) and for which `P · x` is false
(`P · x ↠ FF`).
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.rice
statement:
theorem rice {P : SKI} (hP : ∀ x : SKI, ((P ⬝ x) ↠ TT) ∨ (P ⬝ x) ↠ FF)
    (hxt : ∃ x : SKI, (P ⬝ x) ↠ TT) (hxf : ∃ x : SKI, (P ⬝ x) ↠ FF) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hxt
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hxf
  let Neg : SKI := P ⬝' &0 ⬝' b ⬝' a |>.toSKI (n := 1)
  let Abs : SKI := Neg.fixedPoint
  have Neg_app : ∀ x : SKI, (Neg ⬝ x) ↠ P ⬝ x ⬝ b ⬝ a :=
    fun x => (P ⬝' &0 ⬝' b ⬝' a) |>.toSKI_correct (n := 1) [x] (by simp)
  cases hP Abs
  case inl h =>
    have : (P ⬝ Abs) ↠ FF := calc
      _ ↠ P ⬝ (Neg ⬝ Abs) := by apply MRed.tail; apply fixedPoint_correct
      _ ↠ P ⬝ (P ⬝ Abs ⬝ b ⬝ a) := by apply MRed.tail; apply Neg_app
      _ ↠ P ⬝ (TT ⬝ b ⬝ a) := by apply MRed.tail; apply MRed.head; apply MRed.head; exact h
      _ ↠ P ⬝ b := by apply MRed.tail; apply TT_correct
      _ ↠ FF := hb
    exact TF_nequiv <| MRed.diamond h this
  case inr h =>
    have : (P ⬝ Abs) ↠ TT := calc
      _ ↠ P ⬝ (Neg ⬝ Abs) := by apply MRed.tail; apply fixedPoint_correct
      _ ↠ P ⬝ (P ⬝ Abs ⬝ b ⬝ a) := by apply MRed.tail; apply Neg_app
      _ ↠ P ⬝ (FF ⬝ b ⬝ a) := by apply MRed.tail; apply MRed.head; apply MRed.head; exact h
      _ ↠ P ⬝ a := by apply MRed.tail; apply FF_correct
      _ ↠ TT := ha
    exact TF_nequiv <| MRed.diamond this h

/

This version of Rice's theorem proves (classically) that any SKI predicate `P` either is constantly
true (ie `P · x ↠ TT` for every `x`) or is constantly false (`P · x ↠ FF` for every `x`).
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.rice'
statement:
theorem rice' {P : SKI} (hP : ∀ x : SKI, ((P ⬝ x) ↠ TT) ∨ (P ⬝ x) ↠ FF) :
    (∀ x : SKI, (P ⬝ x) ↠ TT) ∨ (∀ x : SKI, (P ⬝ x) ↠ FF)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, b, hb⟩ := h
  exact rice hP ⟨b, (hP _).resolve_right hb⟩ ⟨a, (hP _).resolve_left ha⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.isChurchList_trans
statement:
theorem isChurchList_trans {ns : List ℕ} {cns cns' : SKI} (h : cns ↠ cns')
    (hcns' : IsChurchList ns cns') : IsChurchList ns cns
proof:
:= by
  match ns with
  | [] =>
    intro c n
    exact Trans.trans (parallel_mRed (MRed.head c h) .refl) (hcns' c n)
  | x :: xs =>
    intro c n
    obtain ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs, hred⟩ := hcns' c n
    exact ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs, Trans.trans (parallel_mRed (MRed.head c h) .refl) hred⟩

/

name: Cslib.SKI.isChurchListPair_trans
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem isChurchListPair_trans {prev curr : List ℕ} {p p' : SKI} (hp : p ↠ p')
    (hp' : IsChurchListPair prev curr p') : IsChurchListPair prev curr p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply isChurchList_trans (MRed.tail Fst hp)
    exact hp'.1
  · apply isChurchList_trans (MRed.tail Snd hp)
    exact hp'.2

name: Cslib.SKI.List.nil_def
statement: theorem nil_def (c n : SKI) : (Nil ⬝ c ⬝ n) ↠ n
proof:
:=
  NilPoly.toSKI_correct [c, n] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.nil_correct
statement: theorem nil_correct : IsChurchList [] Nil
proof:
:= nil_def

/-! ### Cons: Consing an element onto a list -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.cons_def
statement:
theorem cons_def (x xs c n : SKI) :
    (Cons ⬝ x ⬝ xs ⬝ c ⬝ n) ↠ c ⬝ x ⬝ (xs ⬝ c ⬝ n)
proof:
:=
  ConsPoly.toSKI_correct [x, xs, c, n] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.cons_correct
proof:
:= by
  intro c n
  use cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs
  exact cons_def cx cxs c n

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.singleton_correct
statement:
theorem singleton_correct {x : ℕ} {cx : SKI} (hcx : IsChurch x cx) :
    IsChurchList [x] (Cons ⬝ cx ⬝ Nil)
proof:
:=
  cons_correct hcx nil_correct

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.toChurch_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toChurch_nil : toChurch [] = Nil
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.toChurch_cons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toChurch_cons (x : ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) :
    toChurch (x :: xs) = Cons ⬝ (SKI.toChurch x) ⬝ (toChurch xs)
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.toChurch_correct
statement: theorem toChurch_correct (ns : List ℕ) : IsChurchList ns (toChurch ns)
proof:
:= by
  induction ns with
  | nil => exact nil_correct
  | cons x xs ih => exact cons_correct (SKI.toChurch_correct x) ih

/-! ### Head: Extract the head of a list -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.headD_def
statement: theorem headD_def (d xs : SKI) : (HeadD ⬝ d ⬝ xs) ↠ xs ⬝ K ⬝ d
proof:
:=
  HeadDPoly.toSKI_correct [d, xs] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.headD_correct
statement:
theorem headD_correct {d : ℕ} {cd : SKI} (hcd : IsChurch d cd)
    {ns : List ℕ} {cns : SKI} (hcns : IsChurchList ns cns) :
    IsChurch (ns.headD d) (HeadD ⬝ cd ⬝ cns)
proof:
:= by
  match ns with
  | [] =>
    simp only [List.headD_nil]
    apply isChurch_trans d (headD_def cd cns)
    apply isChurch_trans d (hcns K cd)
    exact hcd
  | x :: xs =>
    simp only [List.headD_cons]
    apply isChurch_trans x (headD_def cd cns)
    obtain ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, _, hred⟩ := hcns K cd
    exact isChurch_trans x hred (isChurch_trans x (MRed.K cx _) hcx)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.head_def
statement: theorem head_def (xs : SKI) : (Head ⬝ xs) ↠ xs ⬝ K ⬝ SKI.Zero
proof:
:=
  headD_def SKI.Zero xs

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.head_correct
statement:
theorem head_correct (ns : List ℕ) (cns : SKI) (hcns : IsChurchList ns cns) :
    IsChurch (ns.headD 0) (Head ⬝ cns)
proof:
:=
  headD_correct zero_correct hcns

/-! ### Tail: Extract the tail of a list -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.tailStep_def
statement:
theorem tailStep_def (h p : SKI) :
    (TailStep ⬝ h ⬝ p) ↠ MkPair ⬝ (Snd ⬝ p) ⬝ (Cons ⬝ h ⬝ (Snd ⬝ p))
proof:
:=
  TailStepPoly.toSKI_correct [h, p] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.tail_def
statement:
theorem tail_def (xs : SKI) :
    (Tail ⬝ xs) ↠ Fst ⬝ (xs ⬝ TailStep ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ Nil ⬝ Nil))
proof:
:=
  TailPoly.toSKI_correct [xs] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.tail_init
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tail_init : IsChurchListPair [] [] (MkPair ⬝ Nil ⬝ Nil)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply isChurchList_trans (fst_correct _ _); exact nil_correct
  · apply isChurchList_trans (snd_correct _ _); exact nil_correct

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.tailStep_correct
proof:
:= by
  apply isChurchListPair_trans (tailStep_def cx p)
  exact ⟨isChurchList_trans (fst_correct _ _) hp.2,
         isChurchList_trans (snd_correct _ _) (cons_correct hcx hp.2)⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.List.tailFold_correct
statement:
theorem tailFold_correct (ns : List ℕ) (cns : SKI) (hcns : IsChurchList ns cns) :
    ∃ p, (cns ⬝ TailStep ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ Nil ⬝ Nil)) ↠ p ∧
         IsChurchListPair ns.tail ns p
proof:
:= by
  induction ns generalizing cns with
  | nil =>

    use MkPair ⬝ Nil ⬝ Nil
    constructor
    · exact hcns TailStep (MkPair ⬝ Nil ⬝ Nil)
    · exact tail_init
  | cons x xs ih =>



    obtain ⟨cx, cxs, hcx, hcxs, hred⟩ := hcns TailStep (MkPair ⬝ Nil ⬝ Nil)

    obtain ⟨p_xs, hp_xs_red, hp_xs_pair⟩ := ih cxs hcxs

    have hstep := tailStep_correct hcx hp_xs_pair


    use TailStep ⬝ cx ⬝ p_xs
    constructor
    · exact Trans.trans hred (MRed.tail _ hp_xs_red)
    · exact hstep

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.tail_correct
statement:
theorem tail_correct (ns : List ℕ) (cns : SKI) (hcns : IsChurchList ns cns) :
    IsChurchList ns.tail (Tail ⬝ cns)
proof:
:= by

  apply isChurchList_trans (tail_def cns)

  obtain ⟨p, hp_red, hp_pair⟩ := tailFold_correct ns cns hcns

  apply isChurchList_trans (MRed.tail Fst hp_red)

  exact hp_pair.1

/-! ### Prepending zero to a list (for Code.zero') -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.prependZero_def
statement: theorem prependZero_def (xs : SKI) : (PrependZero ⬝ xs) ↠ Cons ⬝ SKI.Zero ⬝ xs
proof:
:=
  PrependZeroPoly.toSKI_correct [xs] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.prependZero_correct
statement:
theorem prependZero_correct {ns : List ℕ} {cns : SKI} (hcns : IsChurchList ns cns) :
    IsChurchList (0 :: ns) (PrependZero ⬝ cns)
proof:
:= by
  apply isChurchList_trans (prependZero_def cns)
  exact cons_correct zero_correct hcns

/-! ### Successor on list head (for Code.succ) -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.List.succHead_correct
statement:
theorem succHead_correct (ns : List ℕ) (cns : SKI) (hcns : IsChurchList ns cns) :
    IsChurchList [ns.headD 0 + 1] (SuccHead ⬝ cns)
proof:
:= by
  have hhead := head_correct ns cns hcns
  have hsucc := succ_correct (ns.headD 0) (Head ⬝ cns) hhead
  apply isChurchList_trans (.trans (B_tail_mred _ _ _ _ (B_def .Succ Head cns)) (C_def Cons Nil _))
  exact cons_correct hsucc nil_correct

name: Cslib.SKI.precStep_def
statement:
theorem precStep_def (tg a cn prev : SKI) :
    (PrecStep tg ⬝ a ⬝ cn ⬝ prev) ↠
      tg ⬝ (NatPair ⬝ a ⬝ (NatPair ⬝ (Pred ⬝ cn) ⬝ prev))
proof:
:=
  (PrecStepPoly tg).toSKI_correct [a, cn, prev] (by simp)

/
    `λ n. Rec (tf (left n)) (PrecStep tg (left n)) (right n)` -/

name: Cslib.SKI.precTrans_def
statement:
theorem precTrans_def (tf tg cn : SKI) :
    (PrecTrans tf tg ⬝ cn) ↠
      Rec ⬝ (tf ⬝ (NatUnpairLeft ⬝ cn))
          ⬝ (PrecStep tg ⬝ (NatUnpairLeft ⬝ cn))
          ⬝ (NatUnpairRight ⬝ cn)
proof:
:=
  (PrecTransPoly tf tg).toSKI_correct [cn] (by simp)

/
    `λ n. RFindAbove ⬝ (NatUnpairRight ⬝ n) ⬝ (B ⬝ tf ⬝ (NatPair ⬝ (NatUnpairLeft ⬝ n)))`
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.rfindTrans_def
statement:
theorem rfindTrans_def (tf cn : SKI) :
    (RFindTrans tf ⬝ cn) ↠
      RFindAbove ⬝ (NatUnpairRight ⬝ cn)
                 ⬝ (B ⬝ tf ⬝ (NatPair ⬝ (NatUnpairLeft ⬝ cn)))
proof:
:=
  (RFindTransPoly tf).toSKI_correct [cn] (by simp)

/-! ### Translation from Nat.Partrec.Code to SKI -/

/

name: Nat.Partrec.Code.toSKI_correct
statement: theorem _root_.Nat.Partrec.Code.toSKI_correct (c : Code) : Computes c.toSKI c.eval
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => exact zero_computes
  | succ => exact succ_computes
  | left => exact left_computes
  | right => exact right_computes
  | pair f g ihf ihg =>
    simp only [Code.toSKI, Code.eval]; exact pair_computes ihf ihg
  | comp f g ihf ihg =>
    simp only [Code.toSKI, Code.eval]; exact comp_computes ihf ihg
  | prec f g ihf ihg =>
    simp only [Code.toSKI]; exact prec_computes ihf ihg
  | rfind' f ihf =>
    simp only [Code.toSKI]; exact rfind_computes ihf

/-! ### Main result -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.natPartrec_skiComputable
statement:
theorem natPartrec_skiComputable (f : ℕ →. ℕ) (hf : Nat.Partrec f) :
    SKI.Computable f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Code.exists_code.mp hf
  exact ⟨c.toSKI, hc ▸ c.toSKI_correct⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.Church_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma Church_zero (f x : SKI) : Church 0 f x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Cslib.SKI.Church_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma Church_succ (n : Nat) (f x : SKI) : Church (n+1) f x = f ⬝ Church n f x
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.SKI.church_red
statement:
lemma church_red (n : Nat) (f f' x x' : SKI) (hf : f ↠ f') (hx : x ↠ x') :
    Church n f x ↠ Church n f' x'
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hx
  | succ n ih => exact parallel_mRed hf ih

/

name: Cslib.SKI.isChurch_trans
statement:
theorem isChurch_trans (n : Nat) {a a' : SKI} (h : a ↠ a') :
    IsChurch n a' → IsChurch n a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsChurch]
  intro ha' f x
  calc
  _ ↠ a' ⬝ f ⬝ x := by apply MRed.head; apply MRed.head; exact h
  _ ↠ Church n f x := by apply ha'


/-! ### Church numeral basics -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.zero_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem zero_correct : IsChurch 0 SKI.Zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsChurch SKI.Zero Church
  intro f x
  calc
  _ ↠ I ⬝ x := by apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single; apply red_head; apply red_K
  _ ⭢ x := by apply red_I

/

name: Cslib.SKI.one_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem one_correct : IsChurch 1 SKI.One
proof:
:= by
  intro f x
  apply head
  exact .single (red_I f)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.succ_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
theorem succ_correct (n : Nat) (a : SKI) (h : IsChurch n a) :
    IsChurch (n+1) (SKI.Succ ⬝ a)
proof:
:= by
  intro f x
  calc
  _ ⭢ B ⬝ f ⬝ (a ⬝ f) ⬝ x := by apply red_head; apply red_S
  _ ↠ f ⬝ (a ⬝ f ⬝ x) := by apply B_def
  _ ↠ f ⬝ (Church n  f x) := by apply MRed.tail; exact h f x

/

name: Cslib.SKI.toChurch_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma toChurch_zero : toChurch 0 = SKI.Zero
proof:
:= rfl
/

name: Cslib.SKI.toChurch_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma toChurch_succ (n : ℕ) : toChurch (n + 1) = SKI.Succ ⬝ (toChurch n)
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.SKI.toChurch_correct
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem toChurch_correct (n : ℕ) : IsChurch n (toChurch n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact zero_correct
  | succ n ih => exact succ_correct n (toChurch n) ih

/
To define the predecessor, iterate the function `PredAux` ⟨i, j⟩ ↦ ⟨j, j+1⟩ on ⟨0,0⟩, then take
the  first component.
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.predAux_def
statement: theorem predAux_def (p : SKI) :  (PredAux ⬝ p) ↠ MkPair ⬝ (Snd ⬝ p) ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ (Snd ⬝ p))
proof:
:=
  PredAuxPoly.toSKI_correct [p] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.isChurchPair_trans
statement:
theorem isChurchPair_trans (ns : Nat × Nat) (a a' : SKI) (h : a ↠ a') :
    IsChurchPair ns a' → IsChurchPair ns a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsChurchPair]
  intro ⟨ha₁,ha₂⟩
  constructor
  · apply isChurch_trans (a' := Fst ⬝ a')
    · apply MRed.tail; exact h
    · exact ha₁
  · apply isChurch_trans (a' := Snd ⬝ a')
    · apply MRed.tail; exact h
    · exact ha₂

name: Cslib.SKI.predAux_correct
statement:
theorem predAux_correct (p : SKI) (ns : Nat × Nat) (h : IsChurchPair ns p) :
    IsChurchPair ⟨ns.2, ns.2+1⟩ (PredAux ⬝ p)
proof:
:= by
  refine isChurchPair_trans _ _ (MkPair ⬝ (Snd ⬝ p) ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ (Snd ⬝ p))) (predAux_def p) ?_
  constructor
  · exact isChurch_trans ns.2 (fst_correct _ _) h.2
  · refine isChurch_trans (ns.2+1) (snd_correct _ _) ?_
    exact succ_correct ns.2 (Snd ⬝ p) h.2

/

name: Cslib.SKI.predAux_correct'
statement:
theorem predAux_correct' (n : Nat) :
    IsChurchPair (n.pred, n) <| Church n PredAux  (MkPair ⬝ SKI.Zero ⬝ SKI.Zero)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
    | zero =>
      apply isChurchPair_trans ⟨0,0⟩ _ (MkPair ⬝ SKI.Zero ⬝ SKI.Zero)
        (by rfl)
      constructor <;> apply isChurch_trans 0 ?_ zero_correct
      · exact fst_correct _ _
      · exact snd_correct _ _
    | succ n ih =>
      simp_rw [Church_succ]
      apply predAux_correct (ns := ⟨n.pred, n⟩) (h := ih)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.pred_def
statement: theorem pred_def (a : SKI) : (Pred ⬝ a) ↠ Fst ⬝ (a ⬝ PredAux ⬝ (MkPair ⬝ SKI.Zero ⬝ SKI.Zero))
proof:
:=
  PredPoly.toSKI_correct [a] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.pred_correct
statement: theorem pred_correct (n : Nat) (a : SKI) (h : IsChurch n a) : IsChurch n.pred (Pred ⬝ a)
proof:
:= by
  refine isChurch_trans n.pred
    (pred_def a) ?_
  refine isChurch_trans _ (a' := Fst ⬝ (Church n PredAux (MkPair ⬝ SKI.Zero ⬝ SKI.Zero))) ?_ ?_
  · apply MRed.tail
    exact h _ _
  · exact predAux_correct' n |>.1


/-! ### Primitive recursion -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.isZero_def
statement: theorem isZero_def (a : SKI) : (IsZero ⬝ a) ↠ a ⬝ (K ⬝ FF) ⬝ TT
proof:
:=
  IsZeroPoly.toSKI_correct [a] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.isZero_correct
statement:
theorem isZero_correct (n : Nat) (a : SKI) (h : IsChurch n a) :
    IsBool (n = 0) (IsZero ⬝ a)
proof:
:= by
  apply isBool_trans (a' := a ⬝ (K ⬝ FF) ⬝ TT) (h := isZero_def a)
  by_cases n=0
  case pos h0 =>
    simp_rw [h0]
    rw [h0] at h
    apply isBool_trans (ha' := TT_correct)
    exact h _ _
  case neg h0 =>
    simp_rw [h0]
    let ⟨k,hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero h0
    rw [hk] at h
    apply isBool_trans (ha' := FF_correct)
    calc
    _ ↠ (K ⬝ FF) ⬝ Church k (K ⬝ FF) TT := h _ _
    _ ⭢ FF := red_K _ _


/
To define `Rec x g n := if n==0 then x else (Rec x g (Pred n))`, we obtain a fixed point of
R ↦ λ x g n. Cond ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ n) ⬝ x ⬝ (g ⬝ a ⬝ (R ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ n)))
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.recAux_def
statement:
theorem recAux_def (R₀ x g a : SKI) :
    (RecAux ⬝ R₀ ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ a) ↠
      SKI.Cond ⬝ x ⬝ (g ⬝ a ⬝ (R₀ ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ a)
proof:
:=
  RecAuxPoly.toSKI_correct [R₀, x, g, a] (by simp)

/
We define Rec so that
`Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ a ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ x ⬝ (g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ a)`
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.rec_def
statement:
theorem rec_def (x g a : SKI) :
    (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ a) ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ x ⬝ (g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ a)
proof:
:= calc
  _ ↠ RecAux ⬝ Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ a := by
      apply MRed.head; apply MRed.head; apply MRed.head
      apply fixedPoint_correct
  _ ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ x ⬝ (g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ a) := recAux_def Rec x g a

name: Cslib.SKI.rec_zero
statement: theorem rec_zero (x g a : SKI) (ha : IsChurch 0 a) : (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ a) ↠ x
proof:
:= by
  calc
  _ ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ x ⬝ (g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ a) := rec_def _ _ _
  _ ↠ if (Nat.beq 0 0) then x else (g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) := by
      apply cond_correct
      exact isZero_correct 0 a ha

name: Cslib.SKI.rec_succ
statement:
theorem rec_succ (n : Nat) (x g a : SKI) (ha : IsChurch (n + 1) a) :
    (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ a) ↠ g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))
proof:
:= by
  calc
  _ ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ x ⬝ (g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ a) := rec_def _ _ _
  _ ↠ if (Nat.beq (n+1) 0) then x else (g ⬝ a ⬝ (Rec ⬝ x ⬝ g ⬝ (Pred ⬝ a))) := by
      apply cond_correct
      exact isZero_correct (n+1) a ha

/
value `r 0` and `step` computes the recursion step pointwise — taking the Church numeral of the
current index `k + 1` and the previous result `r k` to `r (k + 1)` — then `Rec ⬝ base ⬝ step`
computes `r` on every input. This is the primitive-recursion counterpart of `RFindAbove_correct'`
for μ-recursion: it isolates the behaviour of `Rec` from any particular client (such as the
translation of `Nat.Partrec.Code.prec`). -/

name: Cslib.SKI.rec_correct'
statement:
theorem rec_correct' (base step : SKI) (r : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hbase : IsChurch (r 0) base)
    (hstep : ∀ k : Nat, ∀ cb cp : SKI, IsChurch (k + 1) cb → IsChurch (r k) cp →
      IsChurch (r (k + 1)) (step ⬝ cb ⬝ cp)) :
    ∀ n : Nat, ∀ cn : SKI, IsChurch n cn → IsChurch (r n) (Rec ⬝ base ⬝ step ⬝ cn)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun cn hcn => isChurch_trans _ (rec_zero _ _ cn hcn) hbase
  | succ k ih =>
    intro cn hcn
    exact isChurch_trans _ (rec_succ k base step cn hcn)
      (hstep k cn (Rec ⬝ base ⬝ step ⬝ (Pred ⬝ cn)) hcn (ih (Pred ⬝ cn) (pred_correct _ cn hcn)))


/-! ### Root-finding (μ-recursion) -/

/
First define an auxiliary function `RFindAbove` that looks for roots above a fixed number n, as a
fixed point of R ↦ λ n f. if f n = 0 then n else R f (n+1)
                 ~ λ n f. Cond ⬝ n (R f (Succ n)) (IsZero (f n))
-/

name: Cslib.SKI.rfindAboveAux_def
statement:
lemma rfindAboveAux_def (R₀ f a : SKI) :
    (RFindAboveAux ⬝ R₀ ⬝ a ⬝ f) ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ a ⬝ (R₀ ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ a) ⬝ f) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ (f ⬝ a))
proof:
:=
  RFindAboveAuxPoly.toSKI_correct [R₀, a, f] (by trivial)

name: Cslib.SKI.rfindAboveAux_base
statement:
theorem rfindAboveAux_base (R₀ f a : SKI) (hfa : IsChurch 0 (f ⬝ a)) :
    (RFindAboveAux ⬝ R₀ ⬝ a ⬝ f) ↠ a
proof:
:= calc
  _ ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ a ⬝ (R₀ ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ a) ⬝ f) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ (f ⬝ a)) := rfindAboveAux_def _ _ _
  _ ↠ if (Nat.beq 0 0) then a else (R₀ ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ a) ⬝ f) := by
      apply cond_correct
      apply isZero_correct _ _ hfa

name: Cslib.SKI.rfindAboveAux_step
statement:
theorem rfindAboveAux_step (R₀ f a : SKI) {m : Nat} (hfa : IsChurch (m + 1) (f ⬝ a)) :
    (RFindAboveAux ⬝ R₀ ⬝ a ⬝ f) ↠ R₀ ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ a) ⬝ f
proof:
:= calc
  _ ↠ SKI.Cond ⬝ a ⬝ (R₀ ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ a) ⬝ f) ⬝ (IsZero ⬝ (f ⬝ a)) := rfindAboveAux_def _ _ _
  _ ↠ if (Nat.beq (m+1) 0) then a else (R₀ ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ a) ⬝ f) := by
      apply cond_correct
      apply isZero_correct _ _ hfa

/

name: Cslib.SKI.RFindAbove_unfold
statement:
theorem RFindAbove_unfold (x g : SKI) :
    (RFindAbove ⬝ x ⬝ g) ↠ RFindAboveAux ⬝ RFindAbove ⬝ x ⬝ g
proof:
:= by
  apply MRed.head; apply MRed.head; exact fixedPoint_correct _

/
    function. At the root `m + n`, `f` yields Church 0; below, a nonzero Church numeral. -/

name: Cslib.SKI.RFindAbove_correct'
statement:
theorem RFindAbove_correct' (f x : SKI) (n m : Nat) (hx : IsChurch m x)
    (hf_root : ∀ y, IsChurch (m + n) y → IsChurch 0 (f ⬝ y))
    (hf_below : ∀ i < n, ∀ y, IsChurch (m + i) y → ∃ k, IsChurch (k + 1) (f ⬝ y)) :
    IsChurch (m + n) (RFindAbove ⬝ x ⬝ f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m x
  all_goals apply isChurch_trans _ (RFindAbove_unfold x f)
  case zero =>
    exact isChurch_trans _ (rfindAboveAux_base _ _ _ (hf_root x hx)) hx
  case succ n ih =>
    apply isChurch_trans (a' := RFindAbove ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ x) ⬝ f)
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hf_below 0 (by omega) x (by simpa using hx)
      exact rfindAboveAux_step _ _ _ hk
    · have := ih (SKI.Succ ⬝ x) (m + 1) (succ_correct _ x hx)
        (fun y hy => hf_root y (by grind))
        (fun i hi y hy => hf_below (i + 1) (by omega) y (by grind))
      grind

name: Cslib.SKI.RFindAbove_correct
statement:
theorem RFindAbove_correct (fNat : Nat → Nat) (f x : SKI)
    (hf : ∀ i : Nat, ∀ y : SKI, IsChurch i y → IsChurch (fNat i) (f ⬝ y))
    (n m : Nat) (hx : IsChurch m x) (hroot : fNat (m + n) = 0) (hpos : ∀ i < n, fNat (m + i) ≠ 0) :
    IsChurch (m + n) (RFindAbove ⬝ x ⬝ f)
proof:
:= by
  apply RFindAbove_correct' f x n m hx
  · intro y hy; exact hroot ▸ hf (m + n) y hy
  · exact fun i hi y hy => ⟨fNat (m + i) - 1,
      Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_ne_zero (hpos i hi) ▸ hf (m + i) y hy⟩


/

name: Cslib.SKI.RFind_correct
statement:
theorem RFind_correct (fNat : Nat → Nat) (f : SKI)
    (hf : ∀ (i : Nat) (y : SKI), IsChurch i y → IsChurch (fNat i) (f ⬝ y))
    (n : Nat) (hroot : fNat n = 0) (hpos : ∀ i < n, fNat i ≠ 0) : IsChurch n (RFind ⬝ f)
proof:
:= by
  have :_ := RFindAbove_correct (n := n) (fNat := fNat) (hf := hf) (hx := zero_correct)
  simp_rw [Nat.zero_add] at this
  exact this hroot hpos



/-! ### Further numeric operations -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.add_def
statement: theorem add_def (a b : SKI) : (SKI.Add ⬝ a ⬝ b) ↠ a ⬝ SKI.Succ ⬝ b
proof:
:=
  AddPoly.toSKI_correct [a, b] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.add_correct
statement:
theorem add_correct (n m : Nat) (a b : SKI) (ha : IsChurch n a) (hb : IsChurch m b) :
    IsChurch (n + m) (SKI.Add ⬝ a ⬝ b)
proof:
:= by
  refine isChurch_trans (n + m) (a' := Church n SKI.Succ b) ?_ ?_
  · calc
    _ ↠ a ⬝ SKI.Succ ⬝ b := add_def a b
    _ ↠ Church n SKI.Succ b := ha SKI.Succ b
  · clear ha
    induction n with
      | zero => simp_rw [Nat.zero_add, Church]; exact hb
      | succ n ih =>
        simp_rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Church]
        exact succ_correct _ _ ih

/

name: Cslib.SKI.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (a b : SKI) : (SKI.Mul ⬝ a ⬝ b) ↠ a ⬝ (SKI.Add ⬝ b) ⬝ SKI.Zero
proof:
:=
  MulPoly.toSKI_correct [a, b] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.mul_correct
statement:
theorem mul_correct {n m : Nat} {a b : SKI} (ha : IsChurch n a) (hb : IsChurch m b) :
    IsChurch (n * m) (SKI.Mul ⬝ a ⬝ b)
proof:
:= by
  refine isChurch_trans (n * m) (a' := Church n (SKI.Add ⬝ b) SKI.Zero) ?_ ?_
  · exact Trans.trans (mul_def a b) (ha (SKI.Add ⬝ b) SKI.Zero)
  · clear ha
    induction n with
      | zero => simp_rw [Nat.zero_mul, Church]; exact zero_correct
      | succ n ih =>
        simp_rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_comm, Church]
        exact add_correct m (n * m) b (Church n (SKI.Add ⬝ b) SKI.Zero) hb ih

/

name: Cslib.SKI.sub_def
statement: theorem sub_def (a b : SKI) : (SKI.Sub ⬝ a ⬝ b) ↠ b ⬝ Pred ⬝ a
proof:
:=
  SubPoly.toSKI_correct [a, b] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.sub_correct
statement:
theorem sub_correct (n m : Nat) (a b : SKI) (ha : IsChurch n a) (hb : IsChurch m b) :
    IsChurch (n - m) (SKI.Sub ⬝ a ⬝ b)
proof:
:= by
  refine isChurch_trans (n - m) (a' := Church m Pred a) ?_ ?_
  · calc
    _ ↠ b ⬝ Pred ⬝ a := sub_def a b
    _ ↠ Church m Pred a := hb Pred a
  · clear hb
    induction m with
      | zero => simp_rw [Nat.sub_zero, Church]; exact ha
      | succ m ih =>
        simp_rw [←Nat.sub_sub, Church]
        exact pred_correct _ _ ih

/

name: Cslib.SKI.le_def
statement: theorem le_def (a b : SKI) : (SKI.LE ⬝ a ⬝ b) ↠ IsZero ⬝ (SKI.Sub ⬝ a ⬝ b)
proof:
:=
  LEPoly.toSKI_correct [a, b] (by simp)

name: Cslib.SKI.le_correct
statement:
theorem le_correct (n m : Nat) (a b : SKI) (ha : IsChurch n a) (hb : IsChurch m b) :
    IsBool (n ≤ m) (SKI.LE ⬝ a ⬝ b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← decide_eq_decide.mpr <| Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le]
  apply isBool_trans (a' := IsZero ⬝ (SKI.Sub ⬝ a ⬝ b)) (h := le_def _ _)
  apply isZero_correct
  apply sub_correct <;> assumption

/-! ### Integer square root -/

/
    computes `if n < (k+1)² then 0 else 1`. -/

name: Cslib.SKI.sqrtCond_def
statement:
theorem sqrtCond_def (cn ck : SKI) :
    (SqrtCond ⬝ cn ⬝ ck) ↠
      SKI.Cond ⬝ SKI.Zero ⬝ SKI.One ⬝
        (SKI.Neg ⬝ (SKI.LE ⬝ (SKI.Mul ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ ck) ⬝ (SKI.Succ ⬝ ck)) ⬝ cn))
proof:
:=
  SqrtCondPoly.toSKI_correct [cn, ck] (by simp)

/
    Defined as `λ n. RFind (SqrtCond n)`. -/

name: Cslib.SKI.sqrt_def
statement: theorem sqrt_def (cn : SKI) : (Sqrt ⬝ cn) ↠ RFind ⬝ (SqrtCond ⬝ cn)
proof:
:=
  SqrtPoly.toSKI_correct [cn] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.sqrt_correct
statement:
theorem sqrt_correct (n : Nat) (cn : SKI) (hcn : IsChurch n cn) :
    IsChurch (Nat.sqrt n) (Sqrt ⬝ cn)
proof:
:= by
  apply isChurch_trans _ (sqrt_def cn)
  apply RFind_correct (fun k => if n < (k + 1) * (k + 1) then 0 else 1) (SqrtCond ⬝ cn)
  ·
    intro i y hy
    apply isChurch_trans _ (sqrtCond_def cn y)
    have hsucc := succ_correct i y hy
    have hle := le_correct _ n _ cn (mul_correct hsucc hsucc) hcn
    have hneg := neg_correct _ _ hle
    apply isChurch_trans _ (cond_correct _ _ _ _ hneg)
    grind
  ·
    simp [Nat.lt_succ_sqrt]
  ·
    grind [Nat.le_sqrt]

/-! ### Nat pairing (matching Mathlib's `Nat.pair`) -/

/
    With &0 = a, &1 = b. The condition `a < b` is `¬(b ≤ a)`. -/

name: Cslib.SKI.natPair_def
statement:
theorem natPair_def (ca cb : SKI) :
    (NatPair ⬝ ca ⬝ cb) ↠
      SKI.Cond ⬝ (SKI.Add ⬝ (SKI.Mul ⬝ cb ⬝ cb) ⬝ ca)
               ⬝ (SKI.Add ⬝ (SKI.Add ⬝ (SKI.Mul ⬝ ca ⬝ ca) ⬝ ca) ⬝ cb)
               ⬝ (SKI.Neg ⬝ (SKI.LE ⬝ cb ⬝ ca))
proof:
:=
  NatPairPoly.toSKI_correct [ca, cb] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.natPair_correct
statement:
theorem natPair_correct (a b : Nat) (ca cb : SKI)
    (ha : IsChurch a ca) (hb : IsChurch b cb) :
    IsChurch (Nat.pair a b) (NatPair ⬝ ca ⬝ cb)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.pair]
  apply isChurch_trans _ (natPair_def ca cb)
  have hcond := neg_correct _ _ (le_correct b a cb ca hb ha)
  apply isChurch_trans _ (cond_correct _ _ _ _ hcond)
  by_cases hab : a < b
  · grind [add_correct _ _ _ _ (mul_correct hb hb) ha]
  · grind [add_correct _ _ _ _ (add_correct _ _ _ _ (mul_correct ha ha) ha) hb]

/-! ### Nat unpairing (matching Mathlib's `Nat.unpair`) -/

/

name: Cslib.SKI.natUnpairLeft_def
statement:
theorem natUnpairLeft_def (cn : SKI) :
    (NatUnpairLeft ⬝ cn) ↠
      SKI.Cond ⬝ (SKI.Sub ⬝ cn ⬝ (SKI.Mul ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn) ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)))
               ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)
               ⬝ (SKI.Neg ⬝ (SKI.LE ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)
                    ⬝ (SKI.Sub ⬝ cn ⬝ (SKI.Mul ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn) ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)))))
proof:
:=
  NatUnpairLeftPoly.toSKI_correct [cn] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.natUnpairLeft_correct
statement:
theorem natUnpairLeft_correct (n : Nat) (cn : SKI) (hcn : IsChurch n cn) :
    IsChurch (Nat.unpair n).1 (NatUnpairLeft ⬝ cn)
proof:
:= by
  apply isChurch_trans _ (natUnpairLeft_def cn)
  obtain ⟨hs, hdiff⟩ := natUnpair_church n cn hcn
  have hcond := neg_correct _ _ (le_correct _ _ _ _ hs hdiff)
  apply isChurch_trans _ (cond_correct _ _ _ _ hcond)
  by_cases h : n - n.sqrt ^ 2 < n.sqrt <;> grind [Nat.unpair]

/

name: Cslib.SKI.natUnpairRight_def
statement:
theorem natUnpairRight_def (cn : SKI) :
    (NatUnpairRight ⬝ cn) ↠
      SKI.Cond ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)
               ⬝ (SKI.Sub ⬝ (SKI.Sub ⬝ cn ⬝ (SKI.Mul ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn) ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)))
                            ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn))
               ⬝ (SKI.Neg ⬝ (SKI.LE ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)
                    ⬝ (SKI.Sub ⬝ cn ⬝ (SKI.Mul ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn) ⬝ (Sqrt ⬝ cn)))))
proof:
:=
  NatUnpairRightPoly.toSKI_correct [cn] (by simp)

/

name: Cslib.SKI.natUnpairRight_correct
statement:
theorem natUnpairRight_correct (n : Nat) (cn : SKI) (hcn : IsChurch n cn) :
    IsChurch (Nat.unpair n).2 (NatUnpairRight ⬝ cn)
proof:
:= by
  apply isChurch_trans _ (natUnpairRight_def cn)
  obtain ⟨hs, hdiff⟩ := natUnpair_church n cn hcn
  have hcond := neg_correct _ _ (le_correct _ _ _ _ hs hdiff)
  apply isChurch_trans _ (cond_correct _ _ _ _ hcond)
  grind [Nat.unpair, sub_correct _ _ _ _ hdiff hs]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Term.body_case
statement:
@[scoped grind _=_]
lemma body_case : (case t₁ t₂ t₃).LC ↔ t₁.LC ∧ t₂.body ∧ t₃.body
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  case mp => cases h with | case L t₁_lc h₂ h₃ => exact ⟨t₁_lc, ⟨L, h₂⟩, ⟨L, h₃⟩⟩
  case mpr =>
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := h
    grind [LC.case <| free_union Var]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Term.open_tm_body
statement:
@[scoped grind <=]
lemma open_tm_body (body : t₁.body) (lc : t₂.LC) : (t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂).LC
proof:
:= by
  cases body
  grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, substTm_lc, openTm_substTm_intro]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Term.Value.lc
statement:
@[grind →]
lemma Value.lc {t : Term Var} (val : t.Value) : t.LC
proof:
:= by
  induction val <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Term.Red.lc
statement: lemma Red.lc {t t' : Term Var} (red : t ⭢βᵛ t') : t.LC ∧ t'.LC
proof:
:= by
  induction red
  case abs lc _ | tabs lc _ =>
    split_ands
    · grind
    · cases lc
      grind [
        fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm, fvTy] Var, substTm_lc,
        substTy_lc, openTm_substTm_intro, openTy_substTy_intro]
  all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.preservation
statement: lemma Typing.preservation (der : Typing Γ t τ) (step : t ⭢βᵛ t') : Typing Γ t' τ
proof:
:= by
  induction der generalizing t'
  case app Γ _ σ τ _ _ _ _ _ =>
    cases step
    case appₗ | appᵣ => grind
    case abs der _ _ =>
      have sub : Sub Γ (σ.arrow τ) (σ.arrow τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
      have ⟨_, _, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.abs_inv sub
      grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm, Sub.weaken]
  case tapp Γ _ σ τ σ' _ _ _ =>
    cases step
    case tabs der _ _ =>
      have sub : Sub Γ (σ.all τ) (σ.all τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
      have ⟨_, _, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.tabs_inv sub
      have ⟨X, mem⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [Ty.fv, fvTy] Var
      simp at mem
      have : Γ = (Context.mapVal (·[X := σ']) []) ++ Γ := by grind
      rw [openTy_substTy_intro (X := X), open_subst_intro (X := X)] <;> grind [subst_ty]
    case tapp => grind
  case let' Γ _ _ _ _ L der _ ih₁ _ =>
    cases step
    case let_bind red₁ _ => apply Typing.let' L (ih₁ red₁); grind
    case let_body =>
      grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm]
  case case Γ _ σ τ _ _ _ L _ _ _ ih₁ _ _ =>
    have sub : Sub Γ (σ.sum τ) (σ.sum τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
    have : Γ = [] ++ Γ := by rfl
    cases step
    case «case» red₁ _ _ => apply Typing.case L (ih₁ red₁) <;> grind
    case case_inl der _ _ =>
      have ⟨_, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.inl_inv sub
      grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm]
    case case_inr der _ _ =>
      have ⟨_, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.inr_inv sub
      grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm]
  all_goals grind [cases Red]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
statement: lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t'
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind only [→ wf]
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind only [→ wf]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.wf
statement:
@[grind →]
lemma wf (Γ : Env Var) (σ σ' : Ty Var) (sub : Sub Γ σ σ') : Γ.Wf ∧ σ.Wf Γ ∧ σ'.Wf Γ
proof:
:= by
  induction sub with
  | all => grind [Wf.all (free_union Var), Wf.narrow_cons, cases Env.Wf, cases LC]
  | _ => grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.refl
statement: lemma refl (wf_Γ : Γ.Wf) (wf_σ : σ.Wf Γ) : Sub Γ σ σ
proof:
:= by
  induction wf_σ with
  | all => grind [all (free_union [Context.dom] Var)]
  | _ => grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.weaken
statement: lemma weaken (sub : Sub (Γ ++ Θ) σ σ') (wf : (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ).Wf) : Sub (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ) σ σ'
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ Θ = ΓΘ at sub
  induction sub generalizing Γ
  case all =>
    subst eq
    apply all (free_union [Context.dom] Var) <;> grind
  all_goals grind [Ty.Wf.weaken, <= sublist_dlookup]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.weaken_head
statement: lemma weaken_head (sub : Sub Δ σ σ') (wf : (Γ ++ Δ).Wf) : Sub (Γ ++ Δ) σ σ'
proof:
:= by
  have eq : Γ ++ Δ = [] ++ Γ ++ Δ := by grind
  grind [weaken]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.narrow_aux
statement:
lemma narrow_aux
    (trans : ∀ Γ σ τ, Sub Γ σ δ → Sub Γ δ τ → Sub Γ σ τ)
    (sub₁ : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) (sub₂ : Sub Δ δ' δ) :
      Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) σ τ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ = Θ at sub₁
  induction sub₁ generalizing Γ δ
  case trans_tvar σ _ σ' X' mem sub ih =>
    subst eq
    have p : ∀ δ, Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ ~ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: (Γ ++ Δ) :=
      by grind [perm_middle]
    by_cases X = X'
    · grind only [= append_assoc, = Option.or_some, = dlookup_append, weaken, = dlookup_cons_eq,
        → wf, =_ singleton_append, =_ cons_append, = mem_append, = Option.or_eq_some_iff,
        = Option.mem_some, =_ append_assoc, trans_tvar, cases Or]
    · grind [Sub.weaken, sublist_append_of_sublist_right]
  case all => apply Sub.all (free_union Var) <;> grind
  #adaptation_note
  /
  Moving from `nightly-2025-09-15` to `nightly-2025-10-19`,
  I've had to remove the `append_assoc` lemma from grind;
  without this `grind` is exploding. This requires further investigation.
  -/
  all_goals grind [Env.Wf.narrow, Ty.Wf.narrow, -append_assoc]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.trans
statement:
@[grind →]
lemma trans : Sub Γ σ δ → Sub Γ δ τ → Sub Γ σ τ
proof:
:= by
  intro sub₁ sub₂
  have δ_lc : δ.LC := by grind
  induction δ_lc generalizing Γ σ τ
  case top => cases sub₁ <;> cases sub₂ <;> grind
  case var X =>
    generalize eq : fvar X = γ at sub₁
    induction sub₁ <;> grind [cases Sub]
  case arrow σ' τ' _ _ _ _ =>
    generalize eq : σ'.arrow τ' = γ at sub₁
    induction sub₁ <;> cases sub₂ <;> grind
  case sum σ' τ' _ _ _ _ =>
    generalize eq : σ'.sum τ' = γ at sub₁
    induction sub₁ <;> cases sub₂ <;> grind
  case all σ' τ' _ _ _ _ _ =>
    generalize eq : σ'.all τ' = γ at sub₁
    induction sub₁
    case all =>
      cases eq
      cases sub₂
      case refl.top Γ σ'' τ'' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
        have : Sub Γ (σ''.all τ'') (σ'.all τ') := by grind [all <| free_union Var]
        grind
      case refl.all Γ _ _ _ _ _ σ _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
        apply all (free_union Var)
        · grind
        · intro X nmem
          have eq : ∀ σ, ⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ = [] ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ := by grind
          grind [Sub.narrow_aux]
    all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.narrow
statement:
lemma narrow (sub_δ : Sub Δ δ δ') (sub_narrow : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) :
    Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) σ τ
proof:
:= by
  grind [narrow_aux (δ := δ')]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.map_subst
statement:
lemma map_subst (sub₁ : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) (sub₂ : Sub Δ δ δ') :
    Sub (Γ.mapVal (·[X := δ]) ++ Δ) (σ[X := δ]) (τ[X := δ])
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ = Θ at sub₁
  induction sub₁ generalizing Γ
  case all => apply Sub.all (free_union Var) <;> grind [open_subst_var]
  case trans_tvar σ _ _ X' _ _ _ =>
    have := map_subst_nmem Δ X δ
    have : Γ ++ ⟨X, .sub δ'⟩ :: Δ ~ ⟨X, .sub δ'⟩ :: (Γ ++ Δ) := perm_middle
    have : .sub σ ∈ dlookup X' (⟨X, .sub δ'⟩ :: (Γ ++ Δ)) := by grind [perm_dlookup]
    have := @mapVal_mem Var (f := ((·[X := δ]) : Binding Var → Binding Var))
    by_cases X = X'
    · trans δ' <;> grind [→ mem_dlookup, Ty.subst_fresh, Ty.Wf.nmem_fv, weaken_head]
    · grind
  all_goals
    grind [Env.Wf.to_ok, Sub.refl, Env.Wf.map_subst, Ty.Wf.map_subst]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Sub.strengthen
statement: lemma strengthen (sub : Sub (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty δ⟩ :: Δ) σ τ) :  Sub (Γ ++ Δ) σ τ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty δ⟩ :: Δ = Θ at sub
  induction sub generalizing Γ with
  | all => grind [Sub.all (free_union Var)]
  | _ => grind [to_ok, Wf.strengthen, Env.Wf.strengthen]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.wf
statement:
@[grind →]
lemma wf {Γ : Env Var} {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Var} (der : Typing Γ t τ) : Γ.Wf ∧ t.LC ∧ τ.Wf Γ
proof:
:= by
  induction der <;> let L := free_union Var <;> have ⟨x, nmem⟩ := fresh_exists L
  case tabs ih =>
    cases (ih x (by grind)).left
    split_ands
    · grind
    · apply LC.tabs L <;> grind
    · apply Ty.Wf.all L <;> grind
  case abs ih =>
    cases (ih x (by grind)).left
    grind [LC.abs L, Wf.strengthen]
  case let' => grind [LC.let' L, Ty.Wf.strengthen]
  case case => refine ⟨?_, LC.case L ?_ ?_ ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind [Ty.Wf.strengthen]
  case var => grind [of_bind_ty]
  case app => grind only [LC.app, cases Ty.Wf]
  all_goals grind [open_lc]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.weaken
statement:
lemma weaken (der : Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).Wf) :
    Typing (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ) t τ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ Δ = ΓΔ at der
  induction der generalizing Γ
  case' abs => apply abs ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var)
  case' tabs => apply tabs ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var)
  case' let' der _ => apply let' ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var) (der wf eq)
  case' case der _ _ => apply case ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var) (der wf eq)
  all_goals
    grind [Wf.weaken, Sub.weaken, Wf.of_env_ty, Wf.of_env_sub, Sub.refl, <= sublist_dlookup]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.weaken_head
statement:
lemma weaken_head (der : Typing Δ t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Δ).Wf) :
    Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ
proof:
:= by
  have eq : Δ = [] ++ Δ := by rfl
  rw [eq] at der
  grind [Typing.weaken der wf]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.narrow
statement:
lemma narrow (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) :
    Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) t τ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
  induction der generalizing Γ
  case var X' _ _ =>
    grind [Env.Wf.narrow, List.perm_nodupKeys, => List.perm_dlookup]
  case' abs  => apply abs (free_union Var)
  case' tabs => apply tabs (free_union Var)
  case' let' der _ => apply let' (free_union Var) (der eq)
  case' case der _ _ => apply case (free_union Var) (der eq)
  all_goals grind [Ty.Wf.narrow, Env.Wf.narrow, Sub.narrow]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.subst_tm
statement:
lemma subst_tm (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (der_sub : Typing Δ s σ) :
    Typing (Γ ++ Δ) (t[X := s]) τ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
  induction der generalizing Γ X
  case var σ' _ X' _ _ =>
    have : Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ ~ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: (Γ ++ Δ) := perm_middle
    by_cases eq : X = X'
    · #adaptation_note
      /
      Moving from `nightly-2025-09-15` to `nightly-2025-10-19`,
      I've had to remove the `append_assoc` lemma from grind;
      without this `grind` is exploding. This requires further investigation.
      -/
      grind [→ List.mem_dlookup, weaken_head, Env.Wf.strengthen, -append_assoc]
    · grind [Env.Wf.strengthen, => List.perm_dlookup]
  case abs => grind [abs (free_union Var), openTm_substTm_var]
  case tabs => grind [tabs (free_union Var), openTy_substTm_var]
  case let' der _ => grind [let' (free_union Var) (der eq), openTm_substTm_var]
  case case der _ _ =>
    apply case (free_union Var) (der eq) <;> grind [openTm_substTm_var]
  all_goals grind [Env.Wf.strengthen, Ty.Wf.strengthen, Sub.strengthen]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.subst_ty
statement:
lemma subst_ty (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') :
    Typing (Γ.mapVal (·[X := δ]) ++ Δ) (t[X := δ]) (τ[X := δ])
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
  induction der generalizing Γ X
  case var σ _ X' _ mem =>
    have := map_subst_nmem Δ X δ
    have := @mapVal_mem Var (f := ((·[X := δ]) : Binding Var → Binding Var))
    grind [Env.Wf.map_subst, → notMem_keys_of_nodupKeys_cons]
  case abs => grind [abs (free_union [Ty.fv] Var), Ty.subst_fresh, openTm_substTy_var]
  case tabs => grind [tabs (free_union Var), openTy_substTy_var, open_subst_var]
  case let' der _ =>
    apply let' (free_union Var) (der eq)
    grind [openTm_substTy_var]
  case case der _ _ =>
    apply case (free_union Var) (der eq) <;> grind [openTm_substTy_var]
  case tapp => grind [Ty.open_subst, Env.Wf.map_subst, Ty.Wf.map_subst, Sub.map_subst]
  all_goals grind [Env.Wf.map_subst, Ty.Wf.map_subst, Sub.map_subst]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.abs_inv
statement:
lemma abs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.abs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (arrow γ δ)) :
     Sub Γ γ γ'
  ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ x ∉ (L : Finset Var),
    Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty γ'⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵗ .fvar x) δ' ∧ Sub Γ δ' δ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Term.abs γ' t = e at der
  induction der generalizing t γ' γ δ
  case abs τ L _ _ =>
    cases eq
    cases sub
    split_ands
    · assumption
    · exists τ, L
      grind
  case sub Γ _ τ τ' _ _ ih =>
    subst eq
    have sub' : Sub Γ τ (γ.arrow δ) := by grind
    obtain ⟨_, δ', L, _⟩ := ih sub' (by rfl)
    split_ands
    · assumption
    · exists δ', L
  all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.tabs_inv
statement:
lemma tabs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.tabs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (all γ δ)) :
     Sub Γ γ γ'
  ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ X ∉ (L : Finset Var),
     Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X)
     ∧ Sub (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X) (δ ^ᵞ fvar X)
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Term.tabs γ' t = e at der
  induction der generalizing γ δ t γ'
  case tabs σ Γ _ τ L der _ =>
    cases sub with | all L' sub =>
    split_ands
    · grind
    · exists τ, L ∪ L'
      intro X _
      have eq : ⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ = [] ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ := by rfl
      grind [narrow]
  case sub Γ _ τ τ' _ _ ih =>
    subst eq
    have sub' : Sub Γ τ (γ.all δ) := by trans τ' <;> grind
    obtain ⟨_, δ', L, _⟩ := ih sub' (by rfl)
    split_ands
    · assumption
    · exists δ', L
  all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.inl_inv
statement:
lemma inl_inv (der : Typing Γ (.inl t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (sum γ δ)) :
    ∃ γ', Typing Γ t γ' ∧ Sub Γ γ' γ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : t.inl = t at der
  induction der generalizing γ δ with
  | inl => grind only [cases Sub]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.inr_inv
statement:
lemma inr_inv (der : Typing Γ (.inr t) T) (sub : Sub Γ T (sum γ δ)) :
    ∃ δ', Typing Γ t δ' ∧ Sub Γ δ' δ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : t.inr = t at der
  induction der generalizing γ δ with
  | inr => grind only [cases Sub]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.canonical_form_abs
statement:
lemma canonical_form_abs (val : Value t) (der : Typing [] t (arrow σ τ)) :
    ∃ δ t', t = .abs δ t'
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq  : σ.arrow τ = γ at der
  generalize eq' : [] = Γ at der
  induction der generalizing σ τ with
  | sub _ _ _ => grind only [= Option.mem_def, = dlookup_nil, cases Sub]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.canonical_form_tabs
statement:
lemma canonical_form_tabs (val : Value t) (der : Typing [] t (all σ τ)) :
    ∃ δ t', t = .tabs δ t'
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq  : σ.all τ = γ at der
  generalize eq' : [] = Γ at der
  induction der generalizing σ τ with
  | sub _ _ _ => grind only [= Option.mem_def, = dlookup_nil, cases Sub]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.canonical_form_sum
statement:
lemma canonical_form_sum (val : Value t) (der : Typing [] t (sum σ τ)) :
    ∃ t', t = .inl t' ∨ t = .inr t'
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq  : σ.sum τ = γ at der
  generalize eq' : [] = Γ at der
  induction der generalizing σ τ with
  | sub => grind only [= Option.mem_def, = dlookup_nil, cases Sub]
  |  _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.weaken_aux

proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ Δ = Γ_Δ at der
  induction der generalizing Γ Δ Θ with
  | abs xs => grind [Typing.abs (xs ∪ (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom), List.nodupKeys_cons]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.lc
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
lemma lc (der : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) : t.LC

  induction der <;> constructor
  case abs ih => exact ih
  all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.subst_aux
statement:
lemma subst_aux (h : Δ ++ ⟨x, σ⟩ :: Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) (der : Γ ⊢ s ∶ σ) :
    Δ ++ Γ ⊢ t[x := s] ∶ τ
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : Δ ++ ⟨x, σ⟩ :: Γ = Θ at h
  induction h generalizing Γ Δ der
  case app => grind
  case var x' _ ok _ =>
    subst eq
    cases ((List.perm_nodupKeys (by simp)).mp ok : (⟨x, σ⟩ :: Δ ++ Γ)✓)
    case cons =>
    observe perm : (Γ ++ Δ).Perm (Δ ++ Γ)
    by_cases h : x = x'
    · have := (weaken der ?_).perm perm <;> grind
    · grind
  case abs =>
    grind [Typing.abs <| free_union Var, subst_open_var _ _ _ _ ?_ der.lc]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.typing_subst_head
statement:
lemma typing_subst_head (weak : ⟨x, σ⟩ :: Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) (der : Γ ⊢ s ∶ σ) :
    Γ ⊢ (t[x := s]) ∶ τ
proof:
:= by
  grind [subst_aux]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Typing.preservation_open
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨fresh, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [Term.fv] Var
