name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.FullBeta.preservation
statement:
@[scoped grind .]
theorem preservation : PreservesTyping (Var := Var) (· ⭢βᶠ ·) Base
proof:
:= by
  intro Γ τ t t' step der
  induction der generalizing t' <;> cases step
  case abs.abs xs _ _ _ xs' _ => apply Typing.abs (free_union Var); grind
  case app.base h der _ _ der_l =>
    cases der_l
    cases h with | abs _ cofin => exact preservation_open cofin der
  all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.FullBeta.progress
statement: theorem progress {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Base} (ht : [] ⊢ t ∶ τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᶠ t'
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at ht
  induction ht
  case var => simp_all
  case abs xs mem ih =>
    left
    constructor
    apply Term.LC.abs xs
    intros _ mem'
    exact (mem _ mem').lc
  case app Γ M σ τ N der_l der_r ih_l ih_r =>
    simp only [eq, forall_const] at *
    right
    cases ih_l with

    | inl val => cases val with | abs M _ => use M ^ N, by grind

    | inr step =>
      obtain ⟨M', _⟩ := step
      use M'.app N
      grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.semanticMap_saturated
statement: lemma semanticMap_saturated (τ : Ty Base) : @Saturated Var (semanticMap τ)
proof:
:= by
  induction τ with
  | base => grind [sn_abs_app_multiApp, sn_neutral, open_abs_lc]
  | arrow τ₁ τ₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    constructor
    · let x : Var := fresh {}
      have := ih₁.neutal_lc (fvar x) (.fvar x) (.fvar x)
      grind [cases LC]
    · grind [sn_app_left (Var := Var) (N := fvar <| fresh {})]
    · grind
    · intro M N P _ _ _ s _
      grind [ih₂.multiApp M N (P ++ [s]), multiApp_tail]

/
    is mapped to a term in the corresponding semantic map. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.entailsContext_empty
statement: lemma entailsContext_empty {Γ : Context Var (Ty Base)} : entailsContext [] Γ
proof:
:= by
  have := semanticMap_saturated (Var := Var) (Base := Base)
  grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.entailsContext_cons
statement:
lemma entailsContext_cons (E : Term.Env Var) (Γ : Context Var (Ty Base))
    (x : Var) (τ : Ty Base) (sub : Term Var)
    (h_fresh : x ∉ E.dom ∪ E.fv ∪ Γ.dom)
    (h_mem : sub ∈ semanticMap τ) :
    entailsContext E Γ → entailsContext (⟨ x, sub ⟩ :: E) (⟨ x, τ ⟩ :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  grind [multiSubst_fvar_fresh, subst_fresh, multiSubst_preserves_not_fvar]

/
    semantically valid with respect to a context `Γ` and a type `τ` -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.soundness
statement: lemma soundness {Γ : Context Var (Ty Base)} (derivation_t : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) : entails Γ t τ
proof:
:= by
  induction derivation_t with
  | var Γ xσ_mem_Γ => grind
  | @abs σ Γ t τ L HL IH =>
    intro E _ _ s
    have sat_semMap_σ := semanticMap_saturated (Var := Var) σ
    have sat_semMap_τ := semanticMap_saturated (Var := Var) τ
    have := sat_semMap_τ.multiApp (multiSubst E t) s []
    let := multiSubst E t
    have ⟨x, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| E.dom ∪ free_union [fv, Context.dom, Env.fv] Var
    have := IH (x := x) (E := ⟨x,s⟩ :: E)
    grind [multiSubst_abs, entailsContext_cons, multiSubst_open_var]
  | app => grind [multiSubst_app]

/
    is entailed by any environment, we can conclude that
    a well-typed term is strongly normalizing. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.strong_norm
statement: theorem strong_norm {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Base} (der : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) : SN FullBeta t
proof:
:= by
  apply (semanticMap_saturated τ).sn
  apply (soundness der [] (by grind) entailsContext_empty)

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.openRec_bvar

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_bvar

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes_openRec_fvar
statement:
lemma countRedexes_openRec_fvar (M : Term Var) (k : Nat) (x : Var) :

:= by
  induction M generalizing k with
  | bvar j => simp only [openRec_bvar]; split <;> rfl
  | fvar => rfl
  | abs M ih => grind [openRec_abs]
  | app L R ihL ihR => cases L <;> grind [openRec_bvar, openRec_app, openRec_abs]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.countRedexes_subst_fvar

  induction M with
  | fvar z => simp only [subst_fvar]; split <;> rfl
  | bvar => rfl
  | abs M ih => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.to_step
statement: lemma BetaAt.to_step [DecidableEq Var] (h : BetaAt i M N) (lc : LC M) : M ⭢βᶠ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | outer lc_M lc_N => exact .base (.beta lc_M lc_N)
  | appL _ ih =>
    cases lc with
    | app lc_L lc_R => exact .appR lc_R (ih lc_L)
  | appR _ ih =>
    cases lc with
    | app lc_L lc_R => exact .appL lc_L (ih lc_R)
  | abs xs _ ih =>
    cases lc with
    | abs ys _ h_body =>
      apply Xi.abs (xs ∪ ys)
      intro z hz
      exact ih z (by grind) (h_body z (by grind))

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.le_countRedexes
statement: lemma BetaAt.le_countRedexes (h : BetaAt i M N) : i ≤ countRedexes N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | outer => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | appL step =>
    split
    · rw [countRedexes_app_abs (step.isAbs_r (by assumption))]
      omega
    · exact le_trans (by omega) (countRedexes_app_le _ _)
  | appR =>
    split
    · rw [countRedexes_app_abs (by assumption)]
      omega
    · exact le_trans (by omega) (countRedexes_app_le _ _)
  | abs xs =>
    have := fresh_exists xs
    grind [countRedexes_open_fvar]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.rename
statement:
lemma BetaAt.rename (h : BetaAt i M M') (x y : Var) :
    BetaAt i (M[x := fvar y]) (M'[x := fvar y])
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | outer lc_M lc_N =>
    rw [subst_open x (fvar y) _ _ (.fvar y)]
    exact .outer (subst_lc lc_M (.fvar y)) (subst_lc lc_N (.fvar y))
  | appL _ ih =>
    split
    · exact ih.appAbsL (isAbs_subst_fvar.mpr (by assumption))
    · exact ih.appNoAbsL (mt isAbs_subst_fvar.mp (by assumption))
  | appR _ ih =>
    rw [← countRedexes_subst_fvar _ x y]
    split
    · exact ih.appAbsR (isAbs_subst_fvar.mpr (by assumption))
    · exact ih.appNoAbsR (mt isAbs_subst_fvar.mp (by assumption))
  | abs =>
    apply BetaAt.abs <| free_union [fv] Var
    grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.lc_r
statement: lemma BetaAt.lc_r (h : BetaAt i M M') (lc : LC M) : LC M'
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | outer lc_M lc_N => exact beta_lc lc_M lc_N
  | appL _ ih =>
    cases lc with
    | app lc_L lc_R => exact .app (ih lc_L) lc_R
  | appR _ ih =>
    cases lc with
    | app lc_L lc_R => exact .app lc_L (ih lc_R)
  | abs xs _ ih =>
    cases lc with
    | abs ys _ h_body =>
      apply LC.abs (xs ∪ ys)
      intro z hz
      exact ih z (by grind) (h_body z (by grind))

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.abs_close
statement:
lemma BetaAt.abs_close {x : Var} (h : BetaAt i M M') (lc : LC M) :
    BetaAt i (M⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs) (M'⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs)
proof:
:= by
  apply BetaAt.abs ∅
  intro z _
  have lc' := h.lc_r lc
  have hr : BetaAt i (M[x := fvar z]) (M'[x := fvar z]) := h.rename x z
  grind

:=  by

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_abs_cong
statement:
theorem step_abs_cong (xs : Finset Var) (cofin : ∀ x ∉ xs, (M ^ fvar x) ⭢βᶠ (M' ^ fvar x)) :
    M.abs ⭢βᶠ M'.abs
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨fresh, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
  rw [open_close fresh M 0 ?_, open_close fresh M' 0 ?_]
  all_goals grind [step_abs_close]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.redex_abs_cong
statement:
theorem redex_abs_cong (xs : Finset Var) (cofin : ∀ x ∉ xs, (M ^ fvar x) ↠βᶠ (M' ^ fvar x)) :
    M.abs ↠βᶠ M'.abs
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨fresh, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
  rw [open_close fresh M 0 ?_, open_close fresh M' 0 ?_]
  all_goals grind [redex_abs_close]

/- Reduction is preserved when opening with a locally closed term. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_open_cong_l
statement:
lemma step_open_cong_l
  (s s' t) (L : Finset Var) (step : ∀ x ∉ L, (s ^ fvar x) ⭢βᶠ (s' ^ fvar x)) (h_lc : LC t) :
    (s ^ t) ⭢βᶠ (s' ^ t)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨x, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
  grind [subst_intro, redex_subst_cong_lc]

/- Multiple reduction `λ s ↠βᶠ t` implies `t = λ s'` for some s' -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.invert_steps_abs
statement:
lemma invert_steps_abs {s t : Term Var} (step : s.abs ↠βᶠ t) :
    ∃ (s' : Term Var), s.abs ↠βᶠ s'.abs ∧ t = s'.abs
proof:
:= by
  induction step with
  | refl => grind
  | tail _ step _ => cases step with grind [step_abs_cong (free_union Var)]

/- `λ s ↠βᶠ λ s'` implies `s ^ t ↠βᶠ s' ^ t'` -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.steps_open_cong_l_abs
statement:
lemma steps_open_cong_l_abs
  (s s' t : Term Var) (steps : s.abs ↠βᶠ s'.abs) (lc_t : LC t) :
    (s ^ t) ↠βᶠ (s' ^ t)
proof:
:= by
  generalize eq : s.abs = s_abs at steps
  generalize eq' : s'.abs = s'_abs at steps
  induction steps generalizing s s' with
  | refl => grind
  | tail _ step ih =>
    specialize ih s
    cases step with grind [invert_steps_abs, step_open_cong_l (L := free_union Var)]

/- `t ↠βᶠ t'` implies `s[x := t] ↠βᶠ s[x := t']`.
   There is no single step lemma in this case because x
   may be substituted for n times, so a single step t ↠βᶠ t
   in general requires n steps in `s[x := t] ↠βᶠ (s[x := t'])` -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.step_subst_cong_r
statement:
lemma step_subst_cong_r {x : Var} (s t t' : Term Var) (step : t ⭢βᶠ t') (h_lc : LC s) :
    (s[x := t]) ↠βᶠ (s[x := t'])
proof:
:= by
  induction h_lc with
  | fvar y => grind
  | abs => grind [redex_abs_cong (free_union Var)]
  | @app l r =>
     calc
       (l.app r)[x := t] ↠βᶠ l[x := t].app (r[x := t']) := by grind
       _                 ↠βᶠ (l.app r)[x := t'] := by grind

/- `step_subst_cong_r` can be generalized to multiple reductions `t ↠βᶠ t'`.
   This requires s to be locally closed, locally closedness of t and t'
   can be inferred by the fact t reduces to t' -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.steps_subst_cong_r
statement:
lemma steps_subst_cong_r {x : Var} (s t t' : Term Var) (step : t ↠βᶠ t') (h_lc : LC s) :
    (s[x := t]) ↠βᶠ (s[x := t'])
proof:
:= by
  induction step with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail steps step ih => grind [Relation.ReflTransGen.trans, step_subst_cong_r]

/- When both `t` and `s` reduce to `t'` and `s'`, then `t ^ s` reduces to `t' ^ s'` -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.steps_open_cong_abs
statement:
lemma steps_open_cong_abs (s s' t t' : Term Var)
  (step1 : t ↠βᶠ t') (step2 : s.abs ↠βᶠ s'.abs) (lc_t : LC t) (lc_s : LC s.abs) :
    (s ^ t) ↠βᶠ (s' ^ t')
proof:
:= by
  cases lc_s with
  | abs L =>
    have ⟨x, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
    rw [subst_intro x t s, subst_intro x t' s']
    · trans (s ^ fvar x)[x := t']
      · grind [steps_subst_cong_r]
      · grind [=_ subst_intro, steps_open_cong_l_abs]
    all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBeta.le_parallel
statement:
lemma FullBeta.le_parallel :
    ((· ⭢βᶠ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) ≤ (· ⭢ₚ ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro M N step
  induction step with
  | base h =>
    cases h with | beta abs_lc _ =>
    cases abs_lc with | abs xs _ =>
    apply Parallel.beta xs <;> grind
  | abs xs _ _ => apply Parallel.abs xs; grind
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Parallel.le_reflTransGen_fullBeta
statement:
lemma Parallel.le_reflTransGen_fullBeta :
    ((· ⭢ₚ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) ≤ (· ↠βᶠ ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro M N para
  induction para
  case fvar => exact .refl
  case app L L' R R' l_para m_para redex_l redex_m =>
    have : L.app R ↠βᶠ L'.app R := by grind
    grind [ReflTransGen.trans]
  case abs t t' xs _ ih =>
    apply redex_abs_cong xs
    grind
  case beta m m' n n' xs para_ih para_n redex_ih redex_n =>
    have m'_abs_lc : LC m'.abs := by
      apply LC.abs xs
      grind
    calc
      m.abs.app n ↠βᶠ
      m'.abs.app n :=
        redex_app_l_cong (redex_abs_cong xs (fun _ mem ↦ redex_ih _ mem)) (para_lc_l para_n)
      _           ↠βᶠ m'.abs.app n' := by grind
      _           ⭢βᶠ m' ^ n'       := by grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.reflTransGen_parallel_fullBeta
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_parallel_fullBeta :
    ((· ↠ₚ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) = (· ↠βᶠ ·)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact reflTransGen_le_of_le Parallel.le_reflTransGen_fullBeta
  · exact ReflTransGen.mono FullBeta.le_parallel

/

  | _ => grind
