name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.parallel_diamond
statement: theorem parallel_diamond : Diamond ((· ⭢ₚ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  intros t t1 t2 tpt1
  revert t2
  induction tpt1 <;> intros t2 tpt2
  case fvar x => exact ⟨t2, by grind⟩
  case abs s1 s2' xs mem ih =>
    cases tpt2
    case abs t2' xs' mem' =>
      have ⟨x, qx⟩ := fresh_exists (xs ∪ xs' ∪ free_union [fv] Var)
      simp only [Finset.union_assoc, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at qx
      have ⟨q1, q2, _⟩ := qx
      have ⟨t', _⟩ := ih x q1 (mem' _ q2)
      exists abs (t' ^* x)
      constructor
      <;> [let z := s2' ^ fvar x; let z := t2' ^ fvar x]
      <;> apply Parallel.abs (free_union [fv] Var) <;> grind
  case beta s1 s1' s2 s2' xs mem ps ih1 ih2 =>
    cases tpt2
    case app u2 u2' s1pu2 s2pu2' =>
      cases s1pu2
      case abs s1'' xs' mem' =>
        have ⟨x, qx⟩ := fresh_exists (xs ∪ xs' ∪ free_union [fv] Var)
        simp only [Finset.union_assoc, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at qx
        obtain ⟨q1, q2, _⟩ := qx
        have ⟨t', _⟩ := ih2 s2pu2'
        have ⟨t'', _⟩ := @ih1 x q1 _ (mem' _ q2)
        exists (t'' ^* x) ^ t'
        constructor
        · #adaptation_note
          /
          subst_intro (defined in Properties.lean) stopped working here. -/
          grind [subst_intro]
        · apply Parallel.beta (free_union [fv] Var) <;> grind
    case beta u1' u2' xs' mem' s2pu2' =>
      have ⟨x, qx⟩ := fresh_exists (xs ∪ xs' ∪ free_union [fv] Var)
      simp only [Finset.union_assoc, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at qx
      have ⟨q1, q2, _⟩ := qx
      have ⟨t', _⟩ := ih2 s2pu2'
      have ⟨t'', _⟩ := @ih1 x q1 _ (mem' _ q2)
      refine ⟨t''[x := t'], ?_⟩
      grind
  case app s1 s1' s2 s2' s1ps1' _ ih1 ih2  =>
    cases tpt2
    case app u1 u2' s1 s2 =>
      have ⟨l, _, _⟩ := ih1 s1
      have ⟨r, _, _⟩ := ih2 s2
      exact ⟨app l r, by grind⟩
    case beta t1' u1' u2' xs mem s2pu2' =>
      cases s1ps1'
      case abs s1'' xs' mem' =>
        have ⟨x, qx⟩ := fresh_exists (xs ∪ xs' ∪ free_union [fv] Var)
        simp only [Finset.union_assoc, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at qx
        obtain ⟨q1, q2, _⟩ := qx
        have ⟨t', qt'_l, qt'_r⟩ := ih2 s2pu2'
        have ⟨t'', qt''_l, qt''_r⟩ := @ih1 (abs u1') (Parallel.abs xs mem)
        cases qt''_l
        next w1 xs'' mem'' =>
        cases qt''_r
        case abs xs''' mem''' =>
          refine ⟨w1 ^ t', ?_, para_open_out xs''' mem''' qt'_r⟩
          apply Parallel.beta (free_union Var) <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.confluent_parallel
statement: theorem confluent_parallel : Confluent ((· ⭢ₚ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop)
proof:
:=
  parallel_diamond.to_confluent

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.confluent_fullBeta
statement:
@[wikidata Q1308502]
theorem confluent_fullBeta : Confluent ((· ⭢βᶠ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  change Diamond ((· ↠βᶠ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop)
  rw [← reflTransGen_parallel_fullBeta]
  exact confluent_parallel

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBetaEta.redex_app_l_cong
statement: theorem redex_app_l_cong (redex : M ↠βηᶠ M') (lc_N : LC N) : app M N ↠βηᶠ app M' N
proof:
:= by
  induction redex with
  | refl => grind
  | tail _ h ih =>
    refine .tail ih ?_
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact join_inl (h.appR lc_N)
    · exact join_inr (h.appR lc_N)

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullBetaEta.redex_app_r_cong
statement: theorem redex_app_r_cong (redex : M ↠βηᶠ M') (lc_N : LC N) : app N M ↠βηᶠ app N M'
proof:
:= by
  induction redex with
  | refl => grind
  | tail _ h ih =>
    refine .tail ih ?_
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact join_inl (h.appL lc_N)
    · exact join_inr (h.appL lc_N)

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.stronglyCommute_eta_beta
statement: lemma stronglyCommute_eta_beta : StronglyCommute (@FullEta Var) FullBeta
proof:
:= by
  intro x y₁ y₂ h₁ st_beta
  induction st_beta generalizing y₁
  case base h1_b =>
    cases h1_b
    case beta M N _ _ =>
      cases h₁
      case base h => cases h
      case appL v _ _ =>
        use M ^ v
        grind [step_open_cong_r]
      case appR u st_eta_absM _ =>
        have := step_lc_r st_eta_absM
        cases st_eta_absM
        case base h => use (disch := grind) app u N
        case abs M_eta xs _ =>
          have ⟨_, hz⟩ := fresh_exists (xs ∪ N.fv ∪ M.fv ∪ M_eta.fv)
          use M_eta ^ N
          grind [step_subst_cong_l]
  case appL Z _ N _ _ ih =>
    cases h₁
    case base h => cases h
    case appL _ _ st =>
      use app Z (ih st).choose
      grind [FullEta.redex_app_r_cong]
    case appR z_red _ _ => use (disch := grind) app z_red N
  case appR M _ Z _ _ ih =>
    cases h₁
    case base h => cases h
    case appL z_red _ _ => use (disch := grind) app Z z_red
    case appR _ st _ =>
      use app (ih st).choose M
      grind [FullEta.redex_app_l_cong]
  case abs M N xs st_body_beta ih =>
    cases h₁
    case base h_eta =>
      cases h_eta with | eta =>
        have ⟨w, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
        have st_beta_w : app y₁ (fvar w) ⭢βᶠ N ^ fvar w := by grind [st_body_beta w]
        rcases invert_step_app_fvar st_beta_w with ⟨u', h, st_u⟩ | ⟨u1, _, _⟩
        · use u'
          apply open_eq_app at h <;> grind [FullBeta.step_not_fv st_u]
        · use abs u1
          grind [open_injective w N u1]
    case abs S ys st_body_eta =>
      have ⟨w, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
      obtain ⟨K, h_beta, h_eta⟩ := ih w (by grind) (st_body_eta w (by grind))
      use abs (K ^* w)
      constructor
      · cases h_beta with
        | refl => grind [open_close]
        | single => exact .single (Xi.abs {w} (by grind [FullBeta.redex_subst_cong]))
      · rw [open_close w N 0 (by grind)]
        exact FullEta.redex_abs_close h_eta

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.confluent_beta_eta
statement:
@[wikidata Q1308502]
theorem confluent_beta_eta : Confluent (@FullBetaEta Var)
proof:
:= by
  apply join_confluent
  · exact confluent_fullBeta
  · exact stronglyConfluent_eta.to_confluent
  apply symm
  exact stronglyCommute_eta_beta.to_commute

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.step_lc_r
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
lemma step_lc_r (step : M ⭢ηᶠ M') : LC M'
proof:
:= Xi.step_lc_r (by grind) step

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.step_lc_l
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
lemma step_lc_l [HasFresh Var] (step : M ⭢ηᶠ M') : LC M
proof:
:= by
  induction step with
  | base h_e => cases h_e with | eta => apply LC.abs ∅; grind
  | appL lc_Z _ ih => exact LC.app lc_Z ih
  | appR lc_Z _ ih => exact LC.app ih lc_Z
  | @abs M' _ xs _ ih => exact LC.abs xs M' ih

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.redex_app_l_cong
statement: theorem redex_app_l_cong (redex : M ↠ηᶠ M') (lc_N : LC N) : app M N ↠ηᶠ app M' N
proof:
:= by
  induction redex <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.redex_app_r_cong
statement: theorem redex_app_r_cong (redex : M ↠ηᶠ M') (lc_N : LC N) : app N M ↠ηᶠ app N M'
proof:
:= by
  induction redex <;> grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.invert_step_app_fvar
statement:
@[scoped grind →]
lemma invert_step_app_fvar (step : (app M (fvar x)) ⭢ηᶠ N) :
    ∃ M', N = app M' (fvar x) ∧ M ⭢ηᶠ M'
proof:
:= by
  cases step with
  | appR _ step_M => exact ⟨_, rfl, step_M⟩
  | _ => grind only [cases Xi]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.step_not_fv
statement: lemma step_not_fv (step : M ⭢ηᶠ M') : M.fv = M'.fv
proof:
:= by
  induction step with
  | base => grind
  | abs =>
    have ⟨x, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
    have := open_close x
    grind [open_preserve_not_fvar]
  | _ => grind

/- `s ⭢ηᶠ s'` implies `s[x := N] ⭢ηᶠ s'[x := N]`. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.step_subst_cong_l
statement:
lemma step_subst_cong_l {x : Var} (s s' N : Term Var) (step : s ⭢ηᶠ s') (lc_N : LC N) :
    s[x := N] ⭢ηᶠ s'[x := N]
proof:
:= by
  induction step
  case base h => cases h with | eta lc => exact Xi.base (.eta (subst_lc lc lc_N))
  case abs => apply Xi.abs <| free_union Var; grind
  all_goals grind

/- `steps_subst_cong_l` can be generalized to multiple reductions `s ↠ηᶠ s'`. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.steps_subst_cong_l
statement:
lemma steps_subst_cong_l {x : Var} (s s' N : Term Var) (steps : s ↠ηᶠ s') (lc_N : LC N) :
    s[x := N] ↠ηᶠ s'[x := N]
proof:
:= by
  induction steps with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ step ih => grind [step_subst_cong_l]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.step_abs_close
statement: lemma step_abs_close {x} (step : M ⭢ηᶠ M') : (M ^* x).abs ⭢ηᶠ (M' ^* x).abs
proof:
:= by
  apply Xi.abs ∅
  grind [step_subst_cong_l]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.redex_abs_close
statement: lemma redex_abs_close {x} (steps : M ↠ηᶠ M') : (M ^* x).abs ↠ηᶠ (M' ^* x).abs
proof:
:= by
  induction steps using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on
  case refl => exact .refl
  case head b c st_bc _ ih => exact .head (step_abs_close st_bc) ih

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.redex_abs_cong
statement:
theorem redex_abs_cong {M M' : Term Var} (xs : Finset Var)
    (cofin : ∀ x ∉ xs, (M ^ fvar x) ↠ηᶠ M' ^ fvar x) :
    M.abs ↠ηᶠ M'.abs
proof:
:= by
    have ⟨x, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
    rw [open_close x M 0, open_close x M' 0]
    all_goals grind [redex_abs_close (x := x) (cofin x ?_)]

/- `t ⭢ηᶠ t'` implies `s[x := t] ↠ηᶠ s[x := t']`. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.step_subst_cong_r
statement:
lemma step_subst_cong_r {x : Var} (s t t' : Term Var) (st : t ⭢ηᶠ t') (lc_s : LC s) :
    s[x := t] ↠ηᶠ s[x := t']
proof:
:= by
  induction lc_s generalizing t t' with
  | fvar => grind
  | app hl hr ih_l ih_r =>
    trans
    · exact redex_app_l_cong (ih_l t t' st) (subst_lc hr (by grind))
    · exact redex_app_r_cong (ih_r t t' st) (subst_lc hl (step_lc_r st))
  | abs L body h_lc_body ih =>
    apply redex_abs_cong (L ∪ {x})
    · grind

/- `steps_subst_cong_r` can be generalized to multiple reductions `t ↠ηᶠ t'`. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.steps_subst_cong_r
statement:
lemma steps_subst_cong_r {x : Var} (s t t' : Term Var) (st : t ↠ηᶠ t') (lc_s : LC s) :
    s[x := t] ↠ηᶠ s[x := t']
proof:
:= by
  induction st using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on
  case refl => rfl
  case head _ _ st _ ih => exact .trans (step_subst_cong_r s _ _ st lc_s) ih

/- `t ⭢ηᶠ t'` implies `s ^ t ↠ηᶠ s ^ t'`. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.step_open_cong_r
statement:
lemma step_open_cong_r {s t t' : Term Var} (lc_s : LC s.abs) (step : t ⭢ηᶠ t') :
    (s ^ t) ↠ηᶠ s ^ t'
proof:
:= by
  cases lc_s
  case abs L hL =>
    have ⟨x, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
    grind [step_subst_cong_r (x := x) (s ^ fvar x) t t' step (hL x ?_)]

/- `steps_open_cong_r` can be generalized to multiple reductions `t ↠ηᶠ t'`. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.steps_open_cong_r
statement:
lemma steps_open_cong_r {s t t' : Term Var} (lc_s : LC s.abs) (steps : t ↠ηᶠ t') :
    (s ^ t) ↠ηᶠ s ^ t'
proof:
:= by
  induction steps using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on
  case refl => rfl
  case head _ _ st _ ih => exact .trans (step_open_cong_r lc_s st) ih

/- Closing a sequence of η-reduction steps over a fresh variable preserves the steps. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.FullEta.close_eta_steps
statement:
lemma close_eta_steps (hx_M : x ∉ M.fv) (st_M : ReflGen FullEta (M ^ fvar x) N) :
    ReflGen FullEta M.abs (N ^* x).abs
proof:
:= by
  cases st_M with
  | refl => rw [←open_close_var x M hx_M]
  | single st =>
    exact .single (Xi.abs {x} (by grind [step_subst_cong_l]))

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.stronglyConfluent_eta
statement:
@[wikidata Q1308502]
lemma stronglyConfluent_eta : StronglyConfluent (@FullEta Var)
proof:
:= by
  intro _ y z h₁ h₂
  suffices ∃ w, ReflGen FullEta y w ∧ ReflGen FullEta z w by grind
  induction h₁ generalizing z
  case base h1_b =>
    cases h1_b
    case eta M _ =>
      cases h₂
      case base => use (disch := grind) M
      case abs _ _ st_body =>
        have ⟨w, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
        have ⟨M', _, _⟩ := invert_step_app_fvar <| st_body w <| by grind
        use M'
        grind [→ Eta.eta, step_not_fv, open_eq_app]
  case appL Z _ N _ _ ih =>
    cases h₂
    case base h => cases h
    case appL _ _ st => use (disch := grind) app Z (ih st).choose
    case appR z_red _ _ => use (disch := grind) app z_red N
  case appR M _ Z _ _ ih =>
    cases h₂
    case base h => cases h
    case appR _ st _ => use (disch := grind) app (ih st).choose M
    case appL z_red _ _ => use (disch := grind) app Z z_red
  case abs _ _ _ st_M_N ih =>
    cases h₂
    case base h =>
      cases h with | eta lc_M =>
      have ⟨w, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
      have ⟨M', _, _⟩ := invert_step_app_fvar <| st_M_N w (by grind)
      use M'
      grind [→ Eta.eta, step_not_fv, open_eq_app]
    case abs N _ st_M_N =>
      have ⟨x, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
      have ⟨w, _⟩ := ih x (by grind) (z := N ^ fvar x) (st_M_N x (by grind))
      use abs (w ^* x)
      grind [close_eta_steps]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.ind_on_depth
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected lemma ind_on_depth (P : Term Var → Prop) (bvar : ∀ i, P (bvar i)) (fvar : ∀ x, P (fvar x))
    (app : ∀ M N, P M → P N → P (app M N))
    (abs : ∀ M, P M → (∀ N, N.depth ≤ M.depth → P N) → P M.abs)
    (M : Term Var) : P M
proof:
:= by
  induction h : M.depth using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing M with | _ n ih
  induction M with
  | abs M' => apply abs M' <;> grind
  | bvar | fvar => grind
  | app => apply app <;> grind only [depth, = max_def]

/
 for some free variable. -/
 @[simp, scoped grind =]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.depth_openRec_fvar_eq_depth
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma depth_openRec_fvar_eq_depth (M : Term Var) (x : Var) (i : ℕ) :
    (M⟦i ↝ fvar x⟧).depth = M.depth
proof:
:= by
  induction M generalizing i <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.depth_open_fvar_eq_depth
statement: theorem depth_open_fvar_eq_depth (M : Term Var) (x : Var) : depth (M ^ fvar x) = depth M
proof:
:=
  depth_openRec_fvar_eq_depth M x 0

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_openRec_fvar_iff_lcAt
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem lcAt_openRec_fvar_iff_lcAt (M : Term Var) (x : Var) (i : ℕ) :
    LcAt i (M⟦i ↝ fvar x⟧) = LcAt (i + 1) M
proof:
:= by
  induction M generalizing i <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_open_fvar_iff_lcAt
statement: theorem lcAt_open_fvar_iff_lcAt (M : Term Var) (x : Var) : LcAt 0 (M ^ fvar x) = LcAt 1 M
proof:
:=
  lcAt_openRec_fvar_iff_lcAt M x 0

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_iff_LC
statement: theorem lcAt_iff_LC (M : Term Var) [HasFresh Var] : LcAt 0 M ↔ M.LC
proof:
:= by
  induction M using LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.ind_on_depth with
    | abs =>
      constructor
      · grind [LC.abs ∅]
      · intros h2
        rcases h2 with ⟨⟩|⟨L,_,_⟩
        grind [fresh_exists L]
    | fvar => grind
    | bvar =>
      constructor
      · grind
      · grind only [cases LC]
    | app =>
      constructor
      · grind
      · grind only [cases LC, LcAt]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_openRec_lcAt
statement:
lemma lcAt_openRec_lcAt (M N : Term Var) (i : ℕ) :
    LcAt i (M⟦i ↝ N⟧) → LcAt (i + 1) M
proof:
:= by
  induction M generalizing i <;> grind

/- When `M ^ N` is locally closed, then `M.abs` is locally closed. This is proven by translating LC
   to LcAt, applying lcAt_openRec_lcAt, then translating back to LC -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open_abs_lc
statement: lemma open_abs_lc [HasFresh Var] {M N : Term Var} (hlc : LC (M ^ N)) : LC (M.abs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lcAt_iff_LC] at *
  exact lcAt_openRec_lcAt _ _ _ hlc

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_openRec_above_lcAt
statement:
lemma lcAt_openRec_above_lcAt (M N : Term Var) (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) (lc : LcAt i M) :
    M⟦j ↝ N⟧ = M
proof:
:= by
  induction M generalizing i j <;> grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.lcAt_le
statement: lemma lcAt_le (M : Term Var) (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) (lc : LcAt i M) : LcAt j M
proof:
:= by
  induction M generalizing i j <;> grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaNormal.app_inv
statement:
lemma BetaNormal.app_inv (h : BetaNormal (app L M)) :
    ¬IsAbs L ∧ BetaNormal L ∧ BetaNormal M
proof:
:= by
  cases L <;> grind [countRedexes]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaNormal.abs_open
statement: lemma BetaNormal.abs_open {x : Var} (h : BetaNormal (abs M)) : BetaNormal (M ^ fvar x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [BetaNormal, countRedexes_open_fvar]
  exact h

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.steps_isAbs_r
statement: lemma Leftmost.steps_isAbs_r (h : M ↠ℓ N) (ha : IsAbs M) : IsAbs N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ha
  | tail _ step ih => exact step.isAbs_r ih

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.steps_app_l_cong
statement:
lemma Leftmost.steps_app_l_cong (h : L ↠ℓ L') (hna : ¬IsAbs L') :
    app L M ↠ℓ app L' M
proof:
:= by
  induction h
  case refl => rfl
  case tail P _ _ step ih =>
    have hnb : ¬IsAbs P := mt step.isAbs_r hna
    exact (ih hnb).tail (step.appNoAbsL hnb)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.BetaAt.app_r_cong
statement:
lemma BetaAt.app_r_cong (h : BetaAt i M M') (hL : BetaNormal L) (hna : ¬IsAbs L) :
    BetaAt i (app L M) (app L M')
proof:
:= by
  have := h.appNoAbsR hna
  rwa [hL] at this

/
    normal form. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.steps_app_r_cong
statement:
lemma Leftmost.steps_app_r_cong (h : M ↠ℓ M') (hL : BetaNormal L) (hna : ¬IsAbs L) :
    app L M ↠ℓ app L M'
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ step ih => exact ih.tail (step.app_r_cong hL hna)

/
    non-abstraction normal form. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.steps_app_cong
statement:
lemma Leftmost.steps_app_cong (hL : L ↠ℓ L') (hM : M ↠ℓ M')
    (hnf : BetaNormal L') (hna : ¬IsAbs L') : app L M ↠ℓ app L' M'
proof:
:=
  (steps_app_l_cong hL hna).trans (steps_app_r_cong hM hnf hna)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.of_cbn
statement: lemma Leftmost.of_cbn (h : M ↠ₙ N) : M ↠ℓ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ step ih => exact ih.tail (BetaAt.of_cbn_step step)

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.steps_lc_r
statement: lemma Leftmost.steps_lc_r (h : M ↠ℓ M') (lc : LC M) : LC M'
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact lc
  | tail _ step ih => exact step.lc_r ih

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.steps_abs_close
statement:
lemma Leftmost.steps_abs_close {x : Var} (h : M ↠ℓ M') (lc : LC M) :
    (M⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs) ↠ℓ (M'⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail hs step ih => exact ih.tail (step.abs_close (steps_lc_r hs lc))

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.steps_abs_cong
statement:
lemma Leftmost.steps_abs_cong (xs : Finset Var)
    (cofin : ∀ x ∉ xs, (M ^ fvar x) ↠ℓ (M' ^ fvar x)) (lc : LC (abs M)) :
    abs M ↠ℓ abs M'
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨w, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
  rw [open_close w M 0 (by grind), open_close w M' 0 (by grind)]
  have hstep := cofin w (by grind)
  have hlc := beta_lc lc (.fvar w)
  exact steps_abs_close hstep hlc

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.of_standard
statement: theorem Leftmost.of_standard (h : M ⭢ₛ N) (hn : BetaNormal N) : M ↠ℓ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h
  case fvar x => rfl
  case app _ _ ihL ihM =>
    have ⟨hna, hL', hM'⟩ := hn.app_inv
    exact steps_app_cong (ihL hL') (ihM hM') hL' hna
  case abs xs h_body ih =>
    have lc := (Standard.abs xs h_body).lc_l
    apply steps_abs_cong xs _ lc
    intro x hx
    exact ih x hx hn.abs_open
  case rdx M N M' _ lc_M lc_N cbn std_P ih =>
    have s1 : M.app N ↠ℓ M'.abs.app N := of_cbn (CBN.steps_app_l_cong cbn lc_N)
    have s2 : M'.abs.app N ⭢ℓ M' ^ N := .outer (CBN.steps_lc_r lc_M cbn) lc_N
    exact (s1.tail s2).trans (ih hn)

/
    reduction reaches it. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Leftmost.normalization
statement: theorem Leftmost.normalization (lc : LC M) (h : M ↠βᶠ N) (hn : BetaNormal N) : M ↠ℓ N
proof:
:=
  of_standard (.standardization lc h) hn

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiApp_tail
statement: lemma multiApp_tail {N} : (M.multiApp (Ns ++ [N])) = (M.multiApp Ns).app  N
proof:
:= by
  induction Ns generalizing M with
  | nil => grind
  | cons head tail ih => rw [List.cons_append]; apply ih

/
    and only if the leftmost term and all arguments applied to it are locally closed -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiApp_lc
statement:
@[scoped grind ←]
lemma multiApp_lc : LC (M.multiApp Ns) ↔ LC M ∧ (∀ N ∈ Ns, LC N)
proof:
:= by
  induction Ns generalizing M with grind [cases LC]

/
    of a multi-application step is locally closed -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.step_multiApp_l
statement:
@[scoped grind ←]
lemma step_multiApp_l (steps : M ⭢βᶠ M') (lc_Ns : ∀ N ∈ Ns, LC N) :
    M.multiApp Ns ⭢βᶠ M'.multiApp Ns
proof:
:= by
  induction Ns generalizing M M' with grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.steps_multiApp_l
statement:
lemma steps_multiApp_l (steps : M ↠βᶠ M') (lc_Ns : ∀ N ∈ Ns, LC N) :
    M.multiApp Ns ↠βᶠ M'.multiApp Ns
proof:
:= by
  induction steps <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.step_multiApp_r
statement:
@[scoped grind ←]
lemma step_multiApp_r (steps : Ns ⭢lβᶠ Ns') (lc_M : LC M) : M.multiApp Ns ⭢βᶠ M.multiApp Ns'
proof:
:= by
  induction steps generalizing M <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.steps_multiApp_r
statement: lemma steps_multiApp_r (steps : Ns ↠lβᶠ Ns') (lc_M : LC M) : M.multiApp Ns ↠βᶠ M.multiApp Ns'
proof:
:= by
  induction steps <;> grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.listFullBeta_cons_r
statement: lemma listFullBeta_cons_r (h : Ns ⭢lβᶠ Ns') (h_lc : ∀ M ∈ l, LC M) : (l ++ Ns) ⭢lβᶠ (l ++ Ns')
proof:
:= by
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn generalizing Ns Ns' with grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.listFullBeta_cons_l
statement: lemma listFullBeta_cons_l (h : Ns ⭢lβᶠ Ns') (h_lc : ∀ M ∈ l, LC M) : (Ns ++ l) ⭢lβᶠ (Ns' ++ l)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.invert_abs_multiApp_st
statement:
lemma invert_abs_multiApp_st {Ps} {M N Q : Term Var}
  (h_red : multiApp (M.abs.app N) Ps ⭢βᶠ Q) :
    (∃ M', M.abs ⭢βᶠ Term.abs M' ∧ Q = multiApp (M'.abs.app N) Ps) ∨
    (∃ N', N ⭢βᶠ N' ∧ Q = multiApp (M.abs.app N') Ps) ∨
    (∃ Ps', Ps ⭢lβᶠ Ps' ∧ Q = multiApp (M.abs.app N) Ps') ∨
    (Q = multiApp (M ^ N) Ps)
proof:
:= by
  induction Ps using List.reverseRecOn generalizing M N Q with
  | nil => grind only [cases Xi, multiApp]
  | append_singleton Ps P ih =>
    rw [multiApp_tail] at h_red
    cases h_red with
    | @appL _ _ P' _ P_P' =>
      have : (Ps ++ [P]) ⭢lβᶠ Ps ++ [P'] := by apply listFullBeta_cons_r (.step P_P' ?_) <;> grind
      grind [multiApp_tail]
    | appR _ h =>
      have {Ps'} (h : Ps ⭢lβᶠ Ps') : (Ps ++ [P]) ⭢lβᶠ Ps' ++ [P] := listFullBeta_cons_l h (by grind)
      grind [multiApp_tail]
    | base => induction Ps using List.reverseRecOn with grind [multiApp_tail]


/

      Q = (λ M') N' P'₁ ... P'ₙ

      or

    we first reach an intermediate term of this shape,

      (λ M) N P₁ ... Pₙ ↠βᶠ (λ M') N' P'₁ ... P'ₙ

      then perform a beta reduction and reduce further to Q

      (λ M') N' P'₁ ... P'ₙ ↠βᶠ M' ^ N' P'_₁ ... P'_ₙ ↠βᶠ Q

   where M ↠βᶠ M' and N ↠βᶠ N' and P_i ↠βᶠ P_i' for all i -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.invert_abs_multiApp_mst
statement:
lemma invert_abs_multiApp_mst {Ps} {M N Q : Term Var}
  (h_red : multiApp (M.abs.app N) Ps ↠βᶠ Q) :
    ∃ M' N' Ns', M.abs ↠βᶠ M'.abs ∧ N ↠βᶠ N' ∧ Ps ↠lβᶠ Ns' ∧
                 (Q = multiApp (M'.abs.app N') Ns' ∨
     (multiApp (M.abs.app N) Ps ↠βᶠ multiApp (M' ^ N') Ns' ∧
                                     multiApp (M' ^ N') Ns' ↠βᶠ Q))
proof:
:= by
  induction h_red with
  | refl => grind
  | tail _ step ih =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, h⟩ := ih
    rcases h with heq | _
    · subst heq
      grind [invert_abs_multiApp_st step]
    · grind [Relation.ReflTransGen.single]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiApp_step_lc_r
statement: lemma multiApp_step_lc_r (step : Ns ⭢lβᶠ Ns') : ∀ N ∈ Ns', LC N
proof:
:= by
  induction step <;> grind [FullBeta.step_lc_r]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiApp_steps_lc
statement: lemma multiApp_steps_lc (step : Ns ↠lβᶠ Ns') (H : ∀ N ∈ Ns, LC N) : ∀ N ∈ Ns', LC N
proof:
:= by
  induction step <;> grind [FullBeta.step_lc_r, multiApp_step_lc_r]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.envLC_cons
statement: lemma envLC_cons (lc_sub : LC sub) (lc_E : envLC E) : envLC (⟨ x, sub ⟩ :: E)
proof:
:= by
  grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiSubst_fvar_fresh
statement: lemma multiSubst_fvar_fresh (E : Env Var) : ∀ x ∉ E.dom, multiSubst E (fvar x) = fvar x
proof:
:= by
  induction E with grind

/
    x is also not a free variable of the multi-substitution of Ns into M -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiSubst_preserves_not_fvar
statement:
lemma multiSubst_preserves_not_fvar (M : Term Var) (E : Env Var) :
    (multiSubst E M).fv ⊆ M.fv ∪ E.fv
proof:
:= by
  induction E with grind [subst_preserve_not_fvar]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiSubst_app
statement:
lemma multiSubst_app (M N : Term Var) (E : Env Var) :
    multiSubst E (app M N) = app (multiSubst E M) (multiSubst E N)
proof:
:= by
  induction E with grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiSubst_abs
statement:
lemma multiSubst_abs (M : Term Var) (E : Env Var) :
    multiSubst E (abs M) = abs (multiSubst E M)
proof:
:= by
  induction E with grind

/
    provided that the variable is not in the domain of the environment
    and the environment is locally closed -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.multiSubst_open_var
statement:
lemma multiSubst_open_var [HasFresh Var] (M : Term Var) (E : Env Var) (x : Var)
  (h_ndom : x ∉ E.dom) (h_lc : envLC E) :
    multiSubst E (M ^ fvar x) = multiSubst E M ^ fvar x
proof:
:= by
  induction E with grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_fresh
statement: theorem subst_fresh (x : Var) (t sub : Term Var) (nmem : x ∉ t.fv) : t[x := sub] = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t <;> grind

/- Opening and closing are inverses. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open_close
statement: lemma open_close (x : Var) (t : Term Var) (k : ℕ) (nmem : x ∉ t.fv) : t = t⟦k ↝ fvar x⟧⟦k ↜ x⟧
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing k <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open_close_var
statement: lemma open_close_var (x : Var) (t : Term Var) (nmem : x ∉ t.fv) : t = (t ^ fvar x) ^* x
proof:
:=
  open_close x t 0 nmem

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open_injective
statement:
lemma open_injective (x : Var) (M M') (free_M : x ∉ M.fv) (free_M' : x ∉ M'.fv)
    (eq : M ^ fvar x = M' ^ fvar x) : M = M'
proof:
:= by
  grind [open_close x M 0 free_M, open_close x M' 0 free_M']

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.swap_open_fvar_close
statement:
lemma swap_open_fvar_close (k n : ℕ) (x y : Var) (m : Term Var) (neq₁ : k ≠ n) (neq₂ : x ≠ y) :
    m⟦n ↝ fvar y⟧⟦k ↜ x⟧ = m⟦k ↜ x⟧⟦n ↝ fvar y⟧
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing k n <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.close_rec_fv
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma close_rec_fv {k y} (m : Term Var) : (m⟦k ↜ y⟧).fv = m.fv.erase y
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing k <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.close_var_not_fvar
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma close_var_not_fvar (x) (t : Term Var) : (t ^* x).fv = t.fv.erase x
proof: := close_rec_fv t

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open_preserve_not_fvar
statement:
theorem open_preserve_not_fvar (k) (m n : Term Var) :
    m⟦k ↝ n⟧.fv = m.fv ∪ n.fv ∨ m⟦k ↝ n⟧.fv = m.fv
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing k with
  | app => grind only [= openRec, = fv]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_preserve_not_fvar
statement:
lemma subst_preserve_not_fvar {y : Var} (m n : Term Var) :
    m[y := n].fv = m.fv.erase y ∨ m[y := n].fv = m.fv.erase y ∪ n.fv
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | app => grind only [fv, = subst_app, = Finset.mem_union, = Finset.mem_erase]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_refl
statement: lemma subst_refl (m : Term Var) (x : Var) : m[x := fvar x] = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_intro_openRec
statement:
lemma subst_intro_openRec {x} {t e : Term Var} (mem : x ∉ e.fv) {k : ℕ} :
    e ⟦k ↝ t⟧ = (e ⟦ k ↝ fvar x⟧)[ x := t ]
proof:
:= by
  induction e generalizing k with grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_intro
statement:
lemma subst_intro (x : Var) (t e : Term Var) (mem : x ∉ e.fv) :
    e ^ t = (e ^ fvar x)[x := t]
proof: := subst_intro_openRec mem

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open_lc
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma open_lc (k t) (e : Term Var) (e_lc : e.LC) : e⟦k ↝ t⟧ = e
proof:
:=
  lcAt_openRec_above_lcAt e t 0 k k.zero_le ((lcAt_iff_LC e).mpr e_lc)

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.swap_open
statement:
lemma swap_open (k n : ℕ) (t₁ t₂ m : Term Var) (neq : k ≠ n) (h1 : t₁.LC) (h2 : t₂.LC) :
    m⟦n ↝ t₂⟧⟦k ↝ t₁⟧ = m⟦k ↝ t₁⟧⟦n ↝ t₂⟧
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing k n with grind

/- If opening yields `app m x`, the original term was `app m (bvar 0)`. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.open_eq_app
statement:
lemma open_eq_app {x : Var} {m n : Term Var} (hw_n : x ∉ n.fv) (hw_m : x ∉ m.fv) (lc_m : LC m)
    (h : n ^ fvar x = app m (fvar x)) : n = app m (bvar 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply open_injective x n _ hw_n (by grind)
  grind [open_lc 0 (fvar x) m lc_m]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_openRec
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma subst_openRec (x : Var) (t : Term Var) (k : ℕ) (u e : Term Var) (lc : LC t) :
    (e⟦ k ↝ u ⟧)[x := t] = e[x := t]⟦k ↝ u[x := t]⟧
proof:
:= by
  induction e generalizing k with grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_open
statement:
lemma subst_open (x : Var) (t : Term Var) (u e : Term Var) (lc : LC t) :
    (e ^ u)[x := t] = e[x := t] ^ u[x := t]
proof:
:= by grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_open_var
statement:
theorem subst_open_var (x y : Var) (u e : Term Var) (neq : y ≠ x) (u_lc : LC u) :
    (e ^ fvar x)[y := u] = e[y := u] ^ fvar x
proof:
:= by grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.subst_lc
statement:
@[scoped grind ←]
theorem subst_lc {x : Var} {e u : Term Var} (e_lc : LC e) (u_lc : LC u) : LC (e[x := u])
proof:
:= by
  induction e_lc
  case' abs => apply LC.abs (free_union Var)
  all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.beta_lc
statement:
@[scoped grind ←]
theorem beta_lc {M N : Term Var} (m_lc : M.abs.LC) (n_lc : LC N) : LC (M ^ N)
proof:
:= by
  cases m_lc with
  | abs => grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.close_openRec_to_subst
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma close_openRec_to_subst (m n : Term Var) (x : Var) (k : ℕ) (m_lc : LC m) (n_lc : LC n) :
    m ⟦k ↜ x⟧⟦k ↝ n⟧ = m[x := n]
proof:
:= by
  induction m_lc generalizing k with
  | abs xs t =>
    have ⟨x', _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
    simp only [closeRec_abs, openRec_abs, subst_abs]
    rw [open_close x' (t⟦k+1 ↜ x⟧⟦k+1 ↝ n⟧) 0, open_close x' (t[x := n]) 0]
    · grind [swap_open, =_ swap_open_fvar_close]
    · grind [subst_preserve_not_fvar]
    · grind [open_preserve_not_fvar]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.close_open_to_subst
statement:
@[scoped grind =]
lemma close_open_to_subst (m n : Term Var) (x : Var) (m_lc : LC m) (n_lc : LC n) :
    (m ^* x) ^ n = m[x := n]
proof:
:= close_openRec_to_subst m n x 0 m_lc n_lc

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.close_open
statement: lemma close_open (x : Var) (t : Term Var) (k : ℕ) (t_lc : LC t) : t⟦k ↜ x⟧⟦k ↝ fvar x⟧ = t
proof:
:= by
  grind [subst_refl]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.lc_l
statement: lemma Standard.lc_l (step : M ⭢ₛ N) : LC M
proof:
:= by
  induction step
  case abs xs _ ih => exact LC.abs xs _ ih
  all_goals grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.lc_refl
statement: lemma Standard.lc_refl (M : Term Var) (lc : LC M) : M ⭢ₛ M
proof:
:= by
  induction lc
  all_goals constructor! <;> assumption

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.lc_r
statement: lemma Standard.lc_r (step : M ⭢ₛ N) : LC N
proof:
:= by
  induction step
  case abs xs _ ih => exact LC.abs xs _ ih
  all_goals grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.of_cbn_step
statement: lemma Standard.of_cbn_step (step : M ⭢ₙ N) (lc_N : LC N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction step
  case base h_beta =>
    cases h_beta
    exact rdx (by assumption) (by assumption) .refl (lc_refl _ lc_N)
  case app L _ _ lc_L _ ih =>
    cases lc_N
    exact app (ih (by assumption)) (lc_refl L lc_L)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.cbn_step_trans
statement: lemma Standard.cbn_step_trans (step : M ⭢ₙ P) (std : P ⭢ₛ N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction step generalizing N
  case base h_beta =>
    cases h_beta
    exact rdx (by assumption) (by assumption) .refl std
  case app step_M ih =>
    cases std with
    | app std_L' std_M => exact app (ih std_L') std_M
    | rdx _ lc_Z cbn_m std_body => exact rdx step_M.lc_l lc_Z (.head step_M cbn_m) std_body

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.cbn_trans
statement: lemma Standard.cbn_trans (h1 : M ↠ₙ P) (h2 : P ⭢ₛ N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h1 with
  | refl => exact h2
  | tail _ h_step ih => exact ih (cbn_step_trans h_step h2)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.of_cbn
statement: lemma Standard.of_cbn (step : M ↠ₙ N) (lc_N : LC N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:=
  cbn_trans step (lc_refl N lc_N)

/-! ## Standard sequences -/

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.isAbs_r
statement: lemma StandardSeq.isAbs_r (h : StandardSeq n M N) (ha : IsAbs M) : IsAbs N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ha
  | tail _ step _ ih => exact step.isAbs_r (ih ha)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.head_leftmost
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.head_leftmost (seq : StandardSeq n P N) :
    ∀ {M}, BetaAt 0 M P → ∃ k, k ≤ n ∧ StandardSeq k M N
proof:
:= by
  induction seq with
  | refl => intro M step; exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, StandardSeq.refl.tail step (le_refl 0)⟩
  | tail _ step' hni ih =>
    intro M step
    obtain ⟨k, hkn, hk⟩ := ih step
    exact ⟨_, le_refl _, hk.tail step' (by omega)⟩

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.cbn_head
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.cbn_head (h : M ↠ₙ P) (hseq : StandardSeq n P N) :
    ∃ k, StandardSeq k M N
proof:
:= by
  induction h generalizing n with
  | refl => exact ⟨n, hseq⟩
  | tail _ step ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := hseq.head_leftmost (BetaAt.of_cbn_step step)
    exact ih hj

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_r_abs
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_r_abs (h : StandardSeq n M M') (ha : IsAbs L) :
    StandardSeq (n + countRedexes L + 1) (app L M) (app L M')
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ step hni ih => exact ih.tail (step.appAbsR ha) (by omega)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_r_noAbs
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_r_noAbs (h : StandardSeq n M M') (hna : ¬IsAbs L) :
    StandardSeq (n + countRedexes L) (app L M) (app L M')
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ step hni ih => exact ih.tail (step.appNoAbsR hna) (by omega)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_r_cong
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_r_cong (h : StandardSeq n M M') :
    ∃ k, StandardSeq k (app L M) (app L M') ∧
      k ≤ n + countRedexes L + (if IsAbs L then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, .refl, Nat.zero_le _⟩
  | tail _ step hni ih =>
    have ⟨k, hseq, hk⟩ := ih
    have happ := step.appR (N := L)
    exact ⟨_, hseq.tail happ (by omega), by omega⟩

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.le_countRedexes_of_ne
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.le_countRedexes_of_ne (h : StandardSeq n M N) (hne : M ≠ N) :
    n ≤ countRedexes N
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | refl => contradiction
  | tail _ step _ => exact step.le_countRedexes

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_l_cong
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_l_cong (h : StandardSeq n L L') :
    ∃ k, StandardSeq k (app L M) (app L' M) ∧
      k ≤ n + (if IsAbs L' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction h
  case refl => exact ⟨0, .refl, Nat.zero_le _⟩
  case tail Q _ _ seq step hni ih =>
    have ⟨c, hc, hc_le⟩ := ih
    by_cases hQ : IsAbs Q
    · have hL' := step.isAbs_r hQ
      have hseq := hc.tail (step.appAbsL hQ) (by simp only [ite_eq_left hQ] at hc_le; omega)
      exact ⟨_, hseq, by rw [ite_eq_left hL']⟩
    · have hseq := hc.tail (step.appNoAbsL hQ) (by simp only [ite_eq_right hQ] at hc_le; omega)
      exact ⟨_, hseq, by split <;> omega⟩

/
    count. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_l_cong_of_ne
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_l_cong_of_ne (h : StandardSeq n L L') (hne : L ≠ L') :
    ∃ k, StandardSeq k (app L M) (app L' M) ∧
      k ≤ countRedexes L' + (if IsAbs L' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := h.le_countRedexes_of_ne hne
  have ⟨k, hseq, hk⟩ := h.app_l_cong (M := M)
  exact ⟨k, hseq, by omega⟩

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_r_tail
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_r_tail (h : StandardSeq n (app L M) (app L' N))
    (step : BetaAt i N N')
    (hle : n ≤ i + countRedexes L' + (if IsAbs L' then 1 else 0)) :
    StandardSeq (i + countRedexes L' + (if IsAbs L' then 1 else 0))
      (app L M) (app L' N')
proof:
:=
  h.tail step.appR hle

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_r_trans
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_r_trans (h : StandardSeq n M M')
    (happ : StandardSeq i (app L M) (app L' M))
    (hc : i ≤ countRedexes L' + (if IsAbs L' then 1 else 0)) :
    ∃ d, StandardSeq d (app L M) (app L' M') ∧
      d ≤ n + countRedexes L' + (if IsAbs L' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨i, happ, by omega⟩
  | tail _ step hni ih =>
    have ⟨d, hd, hd_le⟩ := ih happ
    have hseq := hd.app_r_tail step (by omega)
    exact ⟨_, hseq, by omega⟩

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.app_cong
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.app_cong (hL : StandardSeq n L L') (hM : StandardSeq b M M') :
    ∃ k, StandardSeq k (app L M) (app L' M')
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hLL : L = L'
  · subst hLL
    have ⟨k, hseq, _⟩ := hM.app_r_cong (L := L)
    exact ⟨k, hseq⟩
  · have ⟨_, happ, hbound⟩ := hL.app_l_cong_of_ne (M := M) hLL
    have ⟨k, hseq, _⟩ := hM.app_r_trans happ hbound
    exact ⟨k, hseq⟩

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.subst
statement:
lemma Standard.subst (hM : M ⭢ₛ M') (hN : N ⭢ₛ N') (x : Var) (lc_N : LC N) (lc_N' : LC N') :
    (M[x := N]) ⭢ₛ (M'[x := N'])
proof:
:= by
  induction hM generalizing N N'
  case fvar =>
    simp only [Term.subst_fvar]
    split
    · exact hN
    · exact fvar _
  case app ihL ihM => exact app (ihL hN lc_N lc_N') (ihM hN lc_N lc_N')
  case abs m m' _ _ ih =>
    apply abs <| free_union [fv] Var
    grind
  case rdx n m' _ lc_m lc_n cbn_m std_p ih =>
    rw [Term.subst_app]
    have std_p_subst := ih hN lc_N lc_N'
    rw [Term.subst_open x N n m' lc_N] at std_p_subst
    exact rdx (subst_lc lc_m lc_N) (subst_lc lc_n lc_N) (CBN.steps_subst x cbn_m lc_N) std_p_subst

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.of_beta_step
statement: lemma Standard.of_beta_step (step : M ⭢βᶠ N) (lc_M : LC M) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction step
  case base h_beta => grind [rdx, lc_refl]
  case appL Z A B lc_Z _ ih =>
    cases lc_M
    exact app (lc_refl Z lc_Z) (ih (by assumption))
  case appR Z A B lc_Z _ ih =>
    cases lc_M
    exact app (ih (by assumption)) (lc_refl Z lc_Z)
  case abs ih =>
    apply abs <| free_union [fv] Var
    intro x hx
    exact ih x (by grind) (Term.beta_lc lc_M (by constructor))

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.to_redex
statement: lemma Standard.to_redex (step : M ⭢ₛ N) : M ↠βᶠ N
proof:
:= by
  induction step
  case fvar => rfl
  case app step_L step_M ih_L ih_M =>
    exact .trans (redex_app_l_cong ih_L step_M.lc_l) (redex_app_r_cong ih_M step_L.lc_r)
  case abs xs _ ih => exact FullBeta.redex_abs_cong xs ih
  case rdx n m' _ lc_m lc_n cbn_m std_p ih =>
    have step1 := redex_app_l_cong (CBN.to_redex cbn_m) lc_n
    have step2 : m'.abs.app n ↠βᶠ m' ^ n := .single (.base (.beta (CBN.steps_lc_r lc_m cbn_m) lc_n))
    exact .trans step1 (.trans step2 ih)

/
    reduction reaches an abstraction that standardly reduces to the same target. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.abs_inv
statement:
lemma Standard.abs_inv (h : M ⭢ₛ N) (M' : Term Var) (eq : N = Term.abs M') :
    ∃ M'', M ↠ₙ Term.abs M'' ∧ Term.abs M'' ⭢ₛ Term.abs M'
proof:
:= by
  induction h generalizing M'
  case fvar => trivial
  case app => trivial
  case abs m_body m_target xs h_body ih =>
    cases eq
    exact ⟨m_body, .refl, .abs xs h_body⟩
  case rdx m1 n1 m1' p1 lc_m1 lc_n1 cbn_m1 _ ih =>
    have ⟨p'', cbn_body, std_p''⟩ := ih M' eq
    have step1 : m1.app n1 ↠ₙ m1'.abs.app n1 := CBN.steps_app_l_cong cbn_m1 lc_n1
    have step2 : m1'.abs.app n1 ⭢ₙ m1' ^ n1 := .base (.beta (CBN.steps_lc_r lc_m1 cbn_m1) lc_n1)
    exact ⟨p'', .trans step1 (.head step2 cbn_body), std_p''⟩

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.abs_subst
statement:
lemma Standard.abs_subst
    (h_abs : Term.abs M ⭢ₛ Term.abs M') (hN : N ⭢ₛ N') (lc_N : LC N) (lc_N' : LC N') :
    (M ^ N) ⭢ₛ (M' ^ N')
proof:
:= by
  cases h_abs
  case abs h_body =>
    have ⟨y, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
    have := subst (h_body y (by grind)) hN y lc_N lc_N'
    grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.trans_step
statement: lemma Standard.trans_step (h1 : M ⭢ₛ P) (h2 : P ⭢βᶠ N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h1 generalizing N
  case fvar => contradiction
  case rdx lc_L lc_M cbn _ ih => exact .rdx lc_L lc_M cbn (ih h2)
  case abs p_body ih =>
    cases h2
    · grind
    · apply abs <| free_union [fv] Var
      grind
  case app L' _ M _ std_L std_M ih_L ih_M =>
    cases h2
    case appL step_M => exact .app std_L (ih_M step_M)
    case appR step_L _ => exact .app (ih_L step_L) std_M
    case base h_beta =>
      cases h_beta
      have ⟨L, cbn_L1, std_abs⟩ := abs_inv std_L _ rfl
      have std_subst := std_abs.abs_subst std_M std_M.lc_l std_M.lc_r
      have s1 : L'.app M ↠ₙ L.abs.app M := CBN.steps_app_l_cong cbn_L1 std_M.lc_l
      have s2 : L.abs.app M ⭢ₙ L ^ M := .base (.beta (CBN.steps_lc_r std_L.lc_l cbn_L1) std_M.lc_l)
      exact Standard.cbn_trans (.tail s1 s2) std_subst

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.trans_redex
statement: lemma Standard.trans_redex (h1 : M ⭢ₛ P) (h2 : P ↠βᶠ N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h2 with
  | refl => exact h1
  | tail _ step ih => exact trans_step ih step

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.trans
statement: lemma Standard.trans (h1 : M ⭢ₛ P) (h2 : P ⭢ₛ N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:=
  trans_redex h1 (to_redex h2)

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.standardization
statement: theorem Standard.standardization (lc_M : LC M) (step : M ↠βᶠ N) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction step with
  | refl => exact lc_refl M lc_M
  | tail _ h_step ih => exact ih.trans (of_beta_step h_step h_step.step_lc_l)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.iff_redex
statement: theorem Standard.iff_redex (lc_M : LC M) : M ⭢ₛ N ↔ M ↠βᶠ N
proof:
:=
  ⟨to_redex, standardization lc_M⟩

/-! ## Equivalence with standard sequences -/

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.lc_r
statement: lemma StandardSeq.lc_r (h : StandardSeq n M N) (lc : LC M) : LC N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact lc
  | tail _ step _ ih => exact step.lc_r (ih lc)

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.abs_close
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.abs_close {x : Var} (h : StandardSeq n M M') (lc : LC M) :
    StandardSeq n (M⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs) (M'⟦0 ↜ x⟧.abs)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail seq step hni ih => exact (ih lc).tail (step.abs_close (seq.lc_r lc)) hni

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.abs_cong
statement:
lemma StandardSeq.abs_cong (xs : Finset Var)
    (cofin : ∀ x ∉ xs, ∃ n, StandardSeq n (M ^ fvar x) (M' ^ fvar x))
    (lc : LC (abs M)) : ∃ n, StandardSeq n (abs M) (abs M')
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨w, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv] Var
  have ⟨n, hseq⟩ := cofin w (by grind)
  have hlc := beta_lc lc (.fvar w)
  have habs : StandardSeq n (abs M) (abs M') := by
    rw [open_close w M 0 (by grind), open_close w M' 0 (by grind)]
    exact hseq.abs_close hlc
  exact ⟨n, habs⟩

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.to_redex
statement: lemma StandardSeq.to_redex (h : StandardSeq n M N) (lc_M : LC M) : M ↠βᶠ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail seq step _ ih => exact (ih lc_M).tail (step.to_step (seq.lc_r lc_M))

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.to_seq
statement: theorem Standard.to_seq (h : M ⭢ₛ N) : ∃ n, StandardSeq n M N
proof:
:= by
  induction h
  case fvar x => exact ⟨0, .refl⟩
  case app _ _ ihL ihM =>
    have ⟨_, hL⟩ := ihL
    have ⟨_, hM⟩ := ihM
    exact hL.app_cong hM
  case abs xs h_body ih => exact StandardSeq.abs_cong xs ih ((Standard.abs xs h_body).lc_l)
  case rdx K P K' _ lc_K lc_P cbn _ ih =>
    have ⟨_, hk⟩ := ih
    have cbn_full : K.app P ↠ₙ K' ^ P :=
      (CBN.steps_app_l_cong cbn lc_P).tail (.base (.beta (CBN.steps_lc_r lc_K cbn) lc_P))
    exact StandardSeq.cbn_head cbn_full hk

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.StandardSeq.to_standard
statement: theorem StandardSeq.to_standard (h : StandardSeq n M N) (lc_M : LC M) : M ⭢ₛ N
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Standard.lc_refl _ lc_M
  | tail seq step _ ih => exact (ih lc_M).trans_step (step.to_step (seq.lc_r lc_M))

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.Standard.iff_seq
statement: theorem Standard.iff_seq (lc_M : LC M) : M ⭢ₛ N ↔ ∃ n, StandardSeq n M N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Standard.to_seq
  · intro ⟨_, h⟩
    exact h.to_standard lc_M

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_step
statement: lemma sn_step (t_st_t' : t ⭢βᶠ t') (sn_t : SN FullBeta t) : SN FullBeta t'
proof:
:=
  sn_t.of_rel t_st_t'

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_steps
statement: lemma sn_steps (t_st_t' : t ↠βᶠ t') (sn_t : SN FullBeta t) : SN FullBeta t'
proof:
:=
  sn_t.of_rel_reflTransGen t_st_t'

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_fvar
statement: lemma sn_fvar {x : Var} : SN FullBeta (fvar x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SN_iff_SN_of_rel]
  grind only [cases Xi, cases Beta]

/
    as well as all possible future top level abstraction application beta reductions -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_app
statement:
lemma sn_app (t s : Term Var) (sn_t : SN FullBeta t) (sn_s : SN FullBeta s)
    (hβ : ∀ {t' s' : Term Var}, t ↠βᶠ t'.abs → s ↠βᶠ s' → SN FullBeta (t' ^ s')) :
    SN FullBeta (t.app s)
proof:
:= by
  induction sn_t generalizing s with
  | intro t ht ih_t =>
    induction sn_s with
    | intro s hs ih_s =>
      constructor
      intro u hstep
      cases hstep with
      | base h => cases h; grind
      | appL _ h_s_red => apply ih_s _ h_s_red
                          grind [Relation.ReflTransGen.head]
      | appR _ h_t_red => apply ih_t _ h_t_red _ (SN.intro hs)
                          grind [Relation.ReflTransGen.head]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_app_left
statement:
lemma sn_app_left (M N : Term Var) (lc_N : Term.LC N) (sn_MN : SN FullBeta (M.app N)) :
    SN FullBeta M
proof:
:= by
  refine sn_MN.onFun_of_image (f := (·.app N)) |>.of_le fun _ _ => ?_
  exact Xi.appR lc_N

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_app_right
statement:
lemma sn_app_right (M N : Term Var) (lc_M : Term.LC M) (sn_MN : SN FullBeta (M.app N)) :
    SN FullBeta N
proof:
:= by
  refine sn_MN.onFun_of_image (f := M.app) |>.of_le fun _ _ => ?_
  exact Xi.appL lc_M

/
    v is a variable and t₁ … t_n are strongly normalizing terms. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.neutral_step
statement: lemma neutral_step (Hneut : Neutral t) (Hstep : t ⭢βᶠ t') : Neutral t'
proof:
:= by
  induction Hneut generalizing t' with grind only [Neutral, cases Xi, sn_step]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.neutral_steps
statement: lemma neutral_steps (Hneut : Neutral t) (Hsteps : t ↠βᶠ t') : Neutral t'
proof:
:= by
  induction Hsteps <;> grind [neutral_step]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_neutral
statement: lemma sn_neutral (Hneut : Neutral t) : SN FullBeta t
proof:
:= by
  induction Hneut with
  | app => grind only [→ neutral_steps, sn_app]
  | _ =>
    rw [SN_iff_SN_of_rel]
    grind only [cases Xi]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_abs
statement:
lemma sn_abs [DecidableEq Var] [HasFresh Var] {M N : Term Var} (sn_MN : SN FullBeta (M ^ N))
    (lc_N : LC N) : SN FullBeta (abs M)
proof:
:= by
  generalize h : (M ^ N) = M_open at sn_MN
  induction sn_MN generalizing M N with
  | intro =>
    constructor
    intro _ h_step
    cases h_step with
    | abs _ H => grind [step_open_cong_l _ _ _ _ H]
    | base _ => contradiction

/
      1. N is strongly normalizing,
      1. M ^ N P₁ … Pₙ is strongly normalizing,
      1. N is locally closed,
      1. M ^ N P₁ … Pₙ is locally closed -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.sn_abs_app_multiApp
statement:
lemma sn_abs_app_multiApp [DecidableEq Var] [HasFresh Var] {Ps} {M N : Term Var}
    (sn_N : SN FullBeta N) (sn_MNPs : SN FullBeta (multiApp (M ^ N) Ps))
    (lc_N : LC N) (lc_MNPs : LC (multiApp (M ^ N) Ps)) :
    SN FullBeta (multiApp (M.abs.app N) Ps)
proof:
:= by
  induction Ps using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
    apply sn_app
    · grind [sn_abs]
    · exact sn_N
    · grind [→ steps_open_cong_abs, open_abs_lc, sn_steps]
  | append_singleton Ps P ih =>
    rw [multiApp_tail]
    apply sn_app
    · rw [multiApp_tail] at sn_MNPs lc_MNPs
      cases lc_MNPs
      grind [sn_app_left]
    · grind [multiApp_tail, sn_app_right]
    · intro Q' P' hstep1 hstep2
      have ⟨M', N', Ps', h_M_red, h_N_red, h_Ps_red, h_cases⟩ := invert_abs_multiApp_mst hstep1
      rcases h_cases with h_P | ⟨h_st1, h_st2⟩
      · induction Ps' using List.reverseRecOn with grind [multiApp_tail]
      · have innerSteps : (M ^ N).multiApp Ps ↠βᶠ (M' ^ N').multiApp Ps' := by
          trans
          · exact steps_multiApp_r h_Ps_red (by grind)
          · apply steps_multiApp_l
            · apply steps_open_cong_abs M M' N N' <;> grind [open_abs_lc]
            · grind [multiApp_steps_lc]
        refine sn_steps ?_ sn_MNPs
        rw [multiApp_tail]
        · calc ((M ^ N).multiApp Ps).app P
            _ ↠βᶠ ((M ^ N).multiApp Ps).app P' := by grind
            _ ↠βᶠ Q'.abs.app P' := redex_app_l_cong (.trans innerSteps h_st2) (by grind)
            _ ↠βᶠ Q' ^ P' := by
              rw [Relation.reflTransGen_iff_eq_or_transGen] at ⊢ innerSteps h_st2
              right
              refine Relation.TransGen.single (Xi.base (Beta.beta ?_ ?_))
              all_goals grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_eq_sizeOf
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem rename_eq_sizeOf {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} : sizeOf (m.rename x y) = sizeOf m
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> aesop (add simp [Term.rename])

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv_def
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind _=_]
theorem AlphaEquiv_def (m n : Term Var) : m =α n ↔ AlphaEquiv m n
proof:
:= by
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.subst_def
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind _=_]
theorem subst_def (m r : Term Var) (x : Var) : m[x := r] = m.subst x r
proof:
:= by
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.vars_either_fv_or_bv
statement: theorem vars_either_fv_or_bv {m : Term Var} : m.vars = m.fv ∪ m.bv
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_unused
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem rename_unused {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} : x ∉ m.vars → m.rename x y = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_same
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem rename_same {m : Term Var} {x : Var} : m.rename x x = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_vars_used
statement:
theorem rename_vars_used {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} : x ∈ m.vars →
    (m.rename x y).vars = m.vars.erase x ∪ {y}
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | var z => grind
  | abs z m ih =>
    intro hx
    by_cases hxm : x ∈ m.vars <;> grind
  | app m n ihm ihn =>
    intro hx
    by_cases hxm : x ∈ m.vars
    · by_cases hxn : x ∈ n.vars <;> grind
    · grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_remove
statement: theorem rename_remove {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} : x ≠ y → x ∉ (m.rename x y).vars
proof:
:= by
  intro hxy
  by_cases hx : x ∈ m.vars <;> grind [rename_vars_used]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_vars
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem rename_vars {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} :
    (m.rename x y).vars = m.vars \ {x} ∪ (if x ∈ m.vars then {y} else ∅)
proof:
:= by
  grind [rename_vars_used]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_fv
statement:
theorem rename_fv {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} :
    y ∉ m.vars → (m.rename x y).fv = m.fv \ {x} ∪ (if x ∈ m.fv then {y} else ∅)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | var z => grind
  | abs z m ih => grind [vars_either_fv_or_bv]
  | app m n ihm ihn => grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_concat
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
theorem rename_concat {m : Term Var} {x y z : Var} : y ∉ m.vars →
    (m.rename x y).rename y z = m.rename x z
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_comm_fresh
statement:
theorem rename_comm_fresh {m : Term Var} {x y z w : Var} :
    x ≠ z → y ∉ m.vars ∪ {x, z} → w ∉ m.vars ∪ {x, z} →
    (m.rename x y).rename z w = (m.rename z w).rename x y
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.rename_comm
statement:
theorem rename_comm {m : Term Var} {x y z w : Var} :
    y ∉ m.vars ∪ {x, z} → w ∉ m.vars ∪ {x, y, z} →
    (m.rename x y).rename (if z = x then y else z) w = (m.rename z w).rename x y
proof:
:= by
  grind [rename_comm_fresh]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.induction_by_sizeOf
proof:
:=
  WellFounded.fix (r := sizeOfWFRel.rel) sizeOfWFRel.wf step

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.eq_sizeOf
statement: theorem AlphaEquiv.eq_sizeOf {m n : Term Var} : m =α n → sizeOf m = sizeOf n
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | @var x => rfl
  | @abs y x1 x2 m1 m2 hy h ih =>
    simp
    grind
  | @app m1 n1 m2 n2 _ hm hn =>
    grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.same_fv
statement: theorem AlphaEquiv.same_fv {m n : Term Var} : m =α n → m.fv = n.fv
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | var => rfl
  | app => grind
  | @abs y x1 x2 m1 m2 hy h ih =>
    grind =>
      instantiate [rename_fv, vars_either_fv_or_bv]
      have : m1.fv \ {x1} = (m1.rename x1 y).fv \ {y}
      have : (m2.rename x2 y).fv \ {y} = m2.fv \ {x2}

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.refl
statement: theorem AlphaEquiv.refl (m : Term Var) : m =α m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_by_sizeOf with
  | step m ih =>
    cases m with
    | var x => grind [AlphaEquiv.var]
    | abs x m =>
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [vars] Var
      apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := z) <;> grind
    | app m n => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.symm
statement: theorem AlphaEquiv.symm {m n : Term Var} : m =α n → n =α m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | @var x => grind [AlphaEquiv.var]
  | @abs y x1 x2 m1 m2 hy h ih =>
    apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := y) <;> grind
  | @app m1 n1 m2 n2 hwm1 hwn1 hwm2 hwn2 => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.rename_preserve
statement:
theorem AlphaEquiv.rename_preserve (m n : Term Var) (x y : Var) :
    y ∉ m.vars ∪ n.vars → m =α n → (m.rename x y) =α (n.rename x y)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_by_sizeOf generalizing n x y with
  | step m ih =>
    intro hy h
    by_cases hyx : y = x
    · grind
    cases h with
    | @var z => grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
    | @app m1 n1 m2 n2 hm hn => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]
    | @abs z x1 x2 m1 m2 hz hbody =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [vars] Var
      simp at hw hy
      apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := w)
      · grind
      rw [rename_comm, rename_comm]
      case neg.abs.a =>
        apply ih
        · grind
        · grind
        · have hxzw : ((m1.rename x1 z).rename z w) =α ((m2.rename x2 z).rename z w) := by grind
          grind
      all_goals grind

/
    It states that if two abstractions are α-equivalent,
    then their bodies can be renamed to ``any'' fresh variable y and remain α-equivalent.
    This is sometimes easier to use than using by_cases on the equivalence,
    which can only produce the claim for ``some'' fresh y. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.abs_elim
statement:
theorem AlphaEquiv.abs_elim {m1 m2 : Term Var} {x1 x2 y : Var} :
    y ∉ m1.vars ∪ m2.vars ∪ {x1, x2} → (Term.abs x1 m1) =α (Term.abs x2 m2) →
    (m1.rename x1 y) =α (m2.rename x2 y)
proof:
:= by
  intro hy h
  cases h with
  | @abs z _ _ _ _ hz h1 =>
    by_cases hzy : z = y
    · grind
    · have hxzy : ((m1.rename x1 z).rename z y) =α ((m2.rename x2 z).rename z y) := by
        grind [AlphaEquiv.rename_preserve]
      grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.trans
statement: theorem AlphaEquiv.trans {m n p : Term Var} : m =α n → n =α p → m =α p
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_by_sizeOf generalizing n p with
  | step m ih =>
    intro hmn hnp
    cases m with
    | var x =>
      cases hmn with
      | @var x => assumption
    | abs x1 m1 =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [vars] Var
      have hmn' := hmn
      cases hmn' with
      | @abs y x1 x2 m1 m2 hy h1 =>
        have hnp' := hnp
        cases hnp' with
        | @abs z x2 x3 m2 m3 hz h2 =>
          apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := w)
          · grind
          apply ih (n := m2.rename x2 w) <;> grind [AlphaEquiv.abs_elim]
    | app m1 m2 =>
      cases hmn with
      | @app m1 n1 m2 n2 hmn1 hmn2 =>
        cases hnp with
        | @app n1 p1 n2 p2 hnp1 hnp2 =>
          apply AlphaEquiv.app
          · apply ih (n := n1) <;> grind
          · apply ih (n := n2) <;> grind

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.rename_non_fv
statement:
theorem AlphaEquiv.rename_non_fv {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} : x ∉ m.fv → y ∉ m.vars →
    m =α (m.rename x y)
proof:
:= by
  intro hx hy
  induction m with
  | var z => grind [AlphaEquiv.var]
  | app m1 m2 ih1 ih2 => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]
  | abs z m ih =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [vars] Var
    apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := w) <;> grind [AlphaEquiv.refl, AlphaEquiv.rename_preserve]

/
    modulo α-equivalence. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.abs_non_fv
statement:
theorem AlphaEquiv.abs_non_fv {m1 m2 : Term Var} {x1 x2 : Var} :
    m1 =α m2 → x1 ∉ m1.fv → x2 ∉ m2.fv → (Term.abs x1 m1) =α (Term.abs x2 m2)
proof:
:= by
  intro hm hx1 hx2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [vars] Var
  apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := y)
  · grind
  grind [AlphaEquiv.abs, AlphaEquiv.trans, rename_non_fv, AlphaEquiv.symm]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.abs_rename
statement:
theorem AlphaEquiv.abs_rename {m : Term Var} {x y : Var} :
    y ∉ m.vars ∪ {x} → (Term.abs x m) =α (Term.abs y (m.rename x y))
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [vars] Var
  apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := z) <;> grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.Context.complete
statement: theorem Context.complete (m : Term Var) : ∃ (c : Context Var) (x : Var), m = (c.fill (var x))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | var x => exists hole, x
  | abs x n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c', y, ih⟩ := ih
    exists Context.abs x c', y
    rw [ih, fill]
  | app n₁ n₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨c₁, x₁, ih₁⟩ := ih₁
    exists Context.appL c₁ n₂, x₁
    rw [ih₁, fill]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.Context.fill_vars
statement: theorem Context.fill_vars {c : Context Var} {m : Term Var} : (c.fill m).vars = c.vars ∪ m.vars
proof:
:= by
  induction c <;> grind [Context.fill, Context.vars]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.AlphaEquiv.context
statement:
theorem AlphaEquiv.context {m n : Term Var} {c : Context Var} :
    m =α n → (c.fill m) =α (c.fill n)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction c with
  | hole => assumption
  | abs x c ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := fresh_exists (m.vars ∪ n.vars ∪ c.vars ∪ {x})
    apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := y) <;> grind [Context.fill_vars, rename_preserve]
  | appL c m ih =>
    apply AlphaEquiv.app <;> grind [AlphaEquiv.app, AlphaEquiv.refl]
  | appR m c ih =>
    apply AlphaEquiv.app <;> grind [AlphaEquiv.app, AlphaEquiv.refl]

/
-/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.Subst.function_to_relation
statement: theorem Subst.function_to_relation {m r : Term Var} {x : Var} : m.Subst x r (m[x := r])
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_by_sizeOf with
  | step m ih =>
    cases m with
    | var y => grind [Subst.varHit, Subst.varMiss]
    | app m1 m2 => grind [Subst.app]
    | abs y m =>
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · grind [Subst.absShadow]
      · by_cases hyr : y ∈ r.fv
        · let s := {x, y} ∪ m.vars ∪ r.vars
          have hz := fresh_notMem s
          set z := fresh s
          apply Subst.alpha (m := abs z (m.rename y z)) (r := r)
            (n := abs z ((m.rename y z)[x := r]))
          · have h1 : abs z (m.rename y z) = (abs y m).rename y z := by
              simp
            grind [AlphaEquiv.symm, AlphaEquiv.rename_non_fv]
          · grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
          · grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
          · grind [Subst.absIn, vars_either_fv_or_bv]
        · grind [Subst.absIn]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.subst.non_free
statement: theorem subst.non_free {m r : Term Var} {x : Var} : x ∉ m.fv → (m[x := r]) =α m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_by_sizeOf with
  | step m ih =>
    intro hx
    cases m with
    | var y => grind [AlphaEquiv.var]
    | app m1 m2 => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]
    | abs y m =>
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
      · by_cases hyr : y ∈ r.fv
        · simp only [subst_def, eq_2, hyx, ↓reduceIte, hyr, not_true_eq_false, Finset.union_insert,
            Finset.union_singleton, AlphaEquiv_def]
          let s := (insert x (insert y (m.vars ∪ r.vars)))
          have hz := fresh_notMem s
          set z := fresh s
          obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := fresh_exists (m.vars ∪ r.vars ∪ ((m.rename y z).subst x r).vars
            ∪ {x, y, z})
          apply AlphaEquiv.abs (y := w)
          · grind
          apply AlphaEquiv.trans (n := ((m.rename y z).rename z w))
          · grind [AlphaEquiv.rename_preserve, rename_fv]
          · grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
        · simp only [subst_def, eq_2, hyx, ↓reduceIte, hyr, not_false_eq_true, AlphaEquiv_def]
          apply AlphaEquiv.context (c := Context.abs y Context.hole)
          grind

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.subst.abs_fresh
statement:
theorem subst.abs_fresh {m r : Term Var} {x y z : Var} : z ∉ m.vars ∪ r.vars ∪ {x, y} →
    ((Term.abs y m)[x := r]) =α (Term.abs z ((m.rename y z)[x := r]))
proof:
:= by
  grind [subst.abs_fresh_helper]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.subst.preserve_AlphaEquiv
statement:
theorem subst.preserve_AlphaEquiv {m m' r r' : Term Var} {x : Var} :
    m =α m' → r =α r' → (m[x := r]) =α (m'[x := r'])
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_by_sizeOf generalizing m' r r' x with
  | step m ih =>
    intro hmm' hrr'
    have hmm'' := hmm'
    cases hmm'' with
    | @var y => grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
    | @app m m' n n' hm hn => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]
    | @abs z y y' m m' hz h1 =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [vars] Var
      have h2 : ((Term.abs y m)[x := r]) =α (Term.abs w ((m.rename y w)[x := r])) := by
        grind [subst.abs_fresh]
      have h2' : ((Term.abs y' m')[x := r']) =α
          (Term.abs w ((m'.rename y' w)[x := r'])) := by
        grind [subst.abs_fresh]
      have hbody : (m.rename y w) =α (m'.rename y' w) := by
        apply AlphaEquiv.abs_elim <;> grind
      have h3 :
          (Term.abs w ((m.rename y w)[x := r])) =α (Term.abs w ((m'.rename y' w)[x := r'])) := by
        apply AlphaEquiv.context (c := Context.abs w Context.hole)
        apply ih <;> grind [rename_eq_sizeOf]
      grind [AlphaEquiv.trans, AlphaEquiv.symm]

/
    substitution, modulo α-equivalence. -/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.Subst.relation_iff_function
statement:
theorem Subst.relation_iff_function {m n r : Term Var} {x : Var} :
    m.Subst x r n ↔ n =α (m[x := r])
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | varHit => grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
    | varMiss => grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
    | absShadow => grind [AlphaEquiv.refl]
    | app => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]
    | @absIn x y m r m' hy h ih =>
      have hyx : y ≠ x := by grind
      have hyr : y ∉ r.fv := by grind
      simp only [subst_def, subst.eq_2, hyx, ↓reduceIte, hyr, not_false_eq_true, AlphaEquiv_def]
      apply AlphaEquiv.context (c := Context.abs y Context.hole)
      assumption
    | @alpha m m' r r' n n' x hm hr hn h ih =>
      grind [AlphaEquiv.symm, AlphaEquiv.trans, subst.preserve_AlphaEquiv]
  · intro h
    apply Subst.alpha (m := m) (r := r) (n := m[x := r]) <;> grind [AlphaEquiv.symm,
      AlphaEquiv.refl, Subst.function_to_relation]

/

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.Named.Untyped.Term.subst.commutativity
statement:
theorem subst.commutativity {m r1 r2 : Term Var} {x y : Var} :
    x ∉ r2.fv ∪ {y} → ((m[x := r1])[y := r2]) =α ((m[y := r2])[x := (r1[y := r2])])
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_by_sizeOf generalizing r1 r2 x y with
  | step m ih =>
    intro hx
    cases m with
    | var z => grind [AlphaEquiv.refl, AlphaEquiv.symm, subst.non_free]
    | app m1 m2 => grind [AlphaEquiv.app]
    | abs z m =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := fresh_exists (m.vars ∪ r1.vars ∪ r2.vars ∪ (r1[y := r2]).vars ∪ {x, y, z})
      have hl : (((Term.abs z m)[x := r1])[y := r2]) =α
        (Term.abs w (((m.rename z w)[x := r1])[y := r2])) := by
        apply AlphaEquiv.trans (n := (((Term.abs w ((m.rename z w)[x := r1]))[y := r2])))
        · grind [subst.preserve_AlphaEquiv, subst.abs_fresh, AlphaEquiv.refl]
        · grind [vars_either_fv_or_bv, AlphaEquiv.refl]
      have hr : (Term.abs w (((m.rename z w)[y := r2])[x := (r1[y := r2])]))
        =α (((Term.abs z m)[y := r2])[x := (r1[y := r2])]) := by
        apply AlphaEquiv.symm
        apply AlphaEquiv.trans (n := ((Term.abs w ((m.rename z w)[y := r2]))[x := (r1[y := r2])]))
        · grind [subst.preserve_AlphaEquiv, subst.abs_fresh, AlphaEquiv.refl]
        · grind [vars_either_fv_or_bv, AlphaEquiv.refl]
      have hmid : (Term.abs w (((m.rename z w)[x := r1])[y := r2])) =α
        (Term.abs w (((m.rename z w)[y := r2])[x := (r1[y := r2])])) := by
        apply AlphaEquiv.context (c := Context.abs w Context.hole)
        grind
      grind [AlphaEquiv.trans]

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.HML.Model.toModal_toFrame
statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =, modal =]
theorem Model.toModal_toFrame (m : Model State Label Atom) :
    m.toModal.toFrame = m.lts.toFrame
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.hml_atom_iff
statement:
@[scoped grind =, modal =]
theorem Satisfies.hml_atom_iff {p : Atom} : ⇓HML[m,s ⊨ p] ↔ m.v s p
proof: := by rfl

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.hml_dynDiamond_iff_exists
statement:
theorem Satisfies.hml_dynDiamond_iff_exists :
    ⇓HML[m,s ⊨ d⟨μ⟩φ] ↔ ∃ s', m.lts.Tr s μ s' ∧ ⇓HML[m,s' ⊨ φ]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Satisfies.dynDiamond_iff_exists]
  simp [HML.Model.toModal]

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.hml_dynBox_iff_forall
statement:
theorem Satisfies.hml_dynBox_iff_forall :
    ⇓HML[m,s ⊨ d[μ]φ] ↔ ∀ s', m.lts.Tr s μ s' → ⇓HML[m,s' ⊨ φ]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Satisfies.dynBox_iff_forall]
  simp [HML.Model.toModal]

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.hml_dynDiamond_intro
statement:
@[modal ⇒]
theorem Satisfies.hml_dynDiamond_intro (htr : m.lts.Tr s μ s')
    (h : ⇓HML[m,s' ⊨ φ]) : ⇓HML[m,s ⊨ d⟨μ⟩φ]
proof: := by grind [modal]

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.hml_dynBox_elim
statement:
@[modal ⇒]
theorem Satisfies.hml_dynBox_elim (hbox : ⇓HML[m,s ⊨ d[μ]φ])
    (htr : m.lts.Tr s μ s') : ⇓HML[m,s' ⊨ φ]
proof: := by grind [modal]

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.propositions_complete
statement: theorem propositions_complete (s' : m.lts.image s μ) : stateMap s' ∈ propositions stateMap
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_map.mpr
  use s', Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Fintype.complete s')

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.propositions_satisfies_conjunction
statement:
theorem propositions_satisfies_conjunction (htr : m.lts.Tr s1 μ s1')
    (hdist_spec : ∀ s2', ⇓HML[m,s1' ⊨ (stateMap s2')]) :
    ⇓HML[m,s1 ⊨ d⟨μ⟩(⋀(propositions stateMap))]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Satisfies.dynDiamond_iff_exists]
  use s1', htr
  rw [Satisfies.finiteAnd_iff_forall]
  intro φ hφ_mem
  grind [List.mem_map.mp hφ_mem]

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.theoryEq_isBisimulation
statement:
theorem theoryEq_isBisimulation
    [image_finite : ∀ s μ, Finite (m.lts.image s μ)] :
    m.lts.IsHomBisimulation (TheoryEq m.toModal)
proof:
:= by
  intro s1 s2 h μ
  let (s : State) := @Fintype.ofFinite (m.lts.image s μ) (image_finite s μ)
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s1' htr
    by_contra
    have hdist : ∀ s2' : m.lts.image s2 μ, ∃ φ, ⇓HML[m,s1' ⊨ φ] ∧
        ¬⇓HML[m,s2'.val ⊨ φ] := by
      intro ⟨s2', hs2'⟩
      apply not_theoryEq_satisfies
      grind
    choose dist_formula hdist_spec using hdist
    let conjunction := ⋀(propositions dist_formula)
    have hs1_diamond : ⇓HML[m,s1 ⊨ d⟨μ⟩conjunction] := by
      grind [propositions_satisfies_conjunction]
    obtain ⟨s2'', htr2, hsat⟩ := Satisfies.dynDiamond_iff_exists.mp
      (theoryEq_satisfies h hs1_diamond)
    grind [propositions_complete dist_formula ⟨s2'', htr2⟩]
  case right =>

    intro s2' htr
    by_contra
    have hdist : ∀ s1' : m.lts.image s1 μ, ∃ a, ⇓HML[m, s2' ⊨ a] ∧
        ¬⇓HML[m, s1'.val ⊨ a] := by
      intro ⟨s1', hs1'⟩
      apply not_theoryEq_satisfies
      grind
    choose dist_formula hdist_spec using hdist
    let conjunction := ⋀(propositions dist_formula)
    have hs2_diamond : ⇓HML[m,s2 ⊨ d⟨μ⟩conjunction] := by
      grind [propositions_satisfies_conjunction]
    obtain ⟨s1'', htr1, hsat⟩ :=
      Satisfies.dynDiamond_iff_exists.mp (theoryEq_satisfies h.symm hs2_diamond)
    grind [propositions_complete dist_formula ⟨s1'', htr1⟩]

/

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.bisimulation_satisfies
proof:
:= by
  induction φ generalizing s1 s2 with
  | triangle =>
    rw [Proposition.triangle_def, Proposition.unary_triangle_eq_dynDiamond]
    grind only [IsBisimulation, Satisfies.hml_dynDiamond_iff_exists]
  | _ => grind

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.bisimulation_theoryEq
proof:
:= by grind [bisimulation_satisfies]

/

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.theoryEq_eq_bisimilarity
statement:
theorem theoryEq_eq_bisimilarity
    [image_finite : ∀ s μ, Finite (m.lts.image s μ)]
    (hv : ∀ {s1 s2}, s1 ~[m.lts] s2 → ∀ p, m.v s1 p ↔ m.v s2 p := by grind) :
    TheoryEq m.toModal = HomBisimilarity m.lts
proof:
:= by
  ext s1 s2
  apply Iff.intro <;> intro h
  · exact ⟨TheoryEq m.toModal, h, theoryEq_isBisimulation⟩
  · grind [bisimulation_satisfies]

proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | hole => grind [fill]
  | tensorL | tensorR | parrL | parrR => grind [fill, IsMLL, Proposition.IsMLL]
  | _ => grind [IsMLL]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.Proof.isMLL_sequent
statement: theorem Proof.isMLL_sequent {Γ : Sequent Atom} {p : ⇓Γ} (h : p.IsMLL) : Γ.IsMLL
proof:
:= by

  induction h
  case ax =>
    grind [Proof.IsMLL, Multiset.insert_eq_cons, Multiset.mem_singleton]
  case one =>
    simp [Sequent.IsMLL, Proposition.IsMLL]
  case parr | tensor | cut => grind [Proposition.IsMLL, Proof.IsMLL]
  case bot Γ p ih =>
    simp
    grind [Proof.IsMLL]

/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.Proof.isMLL_cutFree
statement:
theorem Proof.isMLL_cutFree {Γ : Sequent Atom} (p : ⇓Γ) (hΓ : Γ.IsMLL)
    (hp : p.cutFree) : p.IsMLL
proof:
:= by
  induction p
  case ax => simp_all
  case one => simp
  case bot _ _ ih =>
    refine ih ?_ hp
    simpa using hΓ
  case parr a b Γ p ih =>
    refine ih ?_ hp
    simp at hΓ
    grind [Sequent.IsMLL]
  case tensor a b Γ Δ p q ihp ihq =>
    simp at hΓ
    refine ⟨ihp ?mll.p ?cut.p, ihq ?mll.q ?cut.q⟩
    case mll | mll => grind [Sequent.IsMLL]
    case cut | cut => grind [cutFree]
  case oplus₁ | oplus₂ | «with» | top | quest | contract | weaken | bang => simp at hΓ
  case cut => simp [cutFree] at hp

/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.MLL.Proof.isMLL_sequent

proof:

/
The tensor product `X ⊗ Y` of two facts,
defined as the dual of the orthogonal of the pointwise product.
-/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.one_tensor
statement: @[simp] lemma one_tensor {G : Fact P} : (1 ⊗ G) = G
proof:
:= by
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [tensor]
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · simp only [dualFact, mkDual, mkSubset, coe_mk]
    rw [dual_dual_subset_Fact_iff]
    grind [SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_mul]
  · exact Set.Subset.trans (orth_extensive _) <| orth_antitone <| orth_antitone <|
      Set.subset_mul_right _ (by simp)

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_comm
statement: lemma tensor_comm {X Y : Fact P} : (X ⊗ Y) = (Y ⊗ X)
proof: := by rw [tensor, tensor, mul_comm]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_one
statement: @[simp] lemma tensor_one {G : Fact P} : (G ⊗ 1) = G
proof: := by rw [tensor_comm, one_tensor]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_assoc_aux
statement:
lemma tensor_assoc_aux {F G : Set P} :
    (F⫠⫠) * (G⫠⫠) ⊆ (F * G)⫠⫠
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_mul, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  rintro _ p hp q hq rfl v hv
  rw [mul_assoc]
  refine hp _ fun f hf => ?_
  have : v * f ∈ G⫠ := fun g hg => mul_assoc v f g ▸ hv _ (Set.mul_mem_mul hf hg)
  grind

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.coe_tensor_assoc
statement:
lemma coe_tensor_assoc {G H K : Fact P} :
    ((G ⊗ H) ⊗ K : Set P) = ((G : Set P) * ((H : Set P) * (K : Set P)))⫠⫠
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensor]
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · simp only [dualFact, mkDual, mkSubset, coe_mk, dual_dual_subset_dual_iff]
    rw [K.eq]
    refine tensor_assoc_aux.trans ?_
    rw [← K.eq]
    grind
  repeat apply orth_antitone
  intro x hx
  rcases Set.mem_mul.mp hx with ⟨g, hg, y, hy, rfl⟩
  rcases Set.mem_mul.mp hy with ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩
  have gh_mem : g * h ∈ ((G : Set P) * (H : Set P)) := Set.mul_mem_mul hg hh
  have gh_mem' : g * h ∈ ((G : Set P) * (H : Set P))⫠⫠ := (orth_extensive _) gh_mem
  exact Set.mem_mul.mpr ⟨g * h, gh_mem', k, hk, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_assoc
statement: @[simp] lemma tensor_assoc {G H K : Fact P} : ((G ⊗ H) ⊗ K) = (G ⊗ H ⊗ K)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective <| by
    grind [SetLike.coe_injective, coe_tensor_assoc, tensor_comm, coe_tensor_assoc]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_rotate
statement: lemma tensor_rotate {G H K : Fact P} : (G ⊗ H ⊗ K) = H ⊗ K ⊗ G
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensor_comm, tensor_assoc]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_le_tensor
statement: lemma tensor_le_tensor {G K H} {L : Fact P} (hGK : G ≤ K) (hHL : H ≤ L) : (G ⊗ H) ≤ (K ⊗ L)
proof:
:=
  orth_antitone <| orth_antitone <| Set.mul_subset_mul hGK hHL

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_of_par

proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective <| by
    simp only [tensor, parr, dualFact, mkDual, mkSubset, coe_mk]
    rw [G.eq, H.eq]
    #adaptation_note
    /
    rfl

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_of_tensor
statement: lemma par_of_tensor {G H : Fact P} : (G ⅋ H) = (Gᗮ ⊗ Hᗮ)ᗮ
proof:

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_le_par
statement: lemma par_le_par {G H K L : Fact P} (hGK : G ≤ K) (hHL : H ≤ L) : (G ⅋ H) ≤ (K ⅋ L)
proof:
:=
  orth_antitone <| Set.mul_subset_mul (orth_antitone hGK) (orth_antitone hHL)

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.bot_par
statement: @[simp] lemma bot_par {G : Fact P} : (⊥ ⅋ G) = G

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_bot
