name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_assoc
statement: @[simp] lemma par_assoc {G H K : Fact P} : ((G ⅋ H) ⅋ K) = (G ⅋ H ⅋ K)
proof: := by simp [par_of_tensor]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_comm
statement: lemma par_comm (G H : Fact P) : (G ⅋ H) = (H ⅋ G)
proof:
:= by simp [par_of_tensor, tensor_comm]

/
Linear implication between facts,
defined as the dual of the orthogonal of the pointwise product.
-/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.linImpl_of_tensor
statement: lemma linImpl_of_tensor {G H : Fact P} : (G ⊸ H) = (G ⊗ Hᗮ)ᗮ
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective <| by
    simp only [linImpl, tensor, coe_neg, dualFact, mkDual, mkSubset, coe_mk]
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm <;> grind

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_of_linImpl
statement: lemma par_of_linImpl {G H : Fact P} : (G ⅋ H) = (Gᗮ ⊸ H)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective <| by simp [parr, linImpl]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_of_linImpl
statement: lemma tensor_of_linImpl {G H : Fact P} : (G ⊗ H) = (G ⊸ Hᗮ)ᗮ
proof: := by simp [linImpl_of_tensor]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.linImpl_of_par
statement: lemma linImpl_of_par {G H : Fact P} : (G ⊸ H) = (Gᗮ ⅋ H)
proof: := by simp [par_of_linImpl]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.neg_tensor
statement: lemma neg_tensor {G H : Fact P} : (G ⊗ H)ᗮ = Gᗮ ⅋ Hᗮ
proof: := by rw [tensor_of_par, neg_neg]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.neg_par
statement: lemma neg_par {G H : Fact P} : (G ⅋ H)ᗮ = Gᗮ ⊗ Hᗮ
proof: := by rw [par_of_tensor, neg_neg]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.mul_subset_tensor
statement: lemma mul_subset_tensor {G H : Fact P} : (G * H : Set P) ⊆ G ⊗ H
proof: := orth_extensive _

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.one_linImpl
statement: @[simp] lemma one_linImpl {G : Fact P} : (1 ⊸ G) = G
proof: := by simp [linImpl_of_tensor]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.linImpl_bot
statement: @[simp] lemma linImpl_bot {G : Fact P} : (G ⊸ ⊥) = Gᗮ
proof: := by simp [linImpl_of_tensor]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_linImpl
statement: @[simp] lemma tensor_linImpl {G H K : Fact P} : ((G ⊗ H) ⊸ K) = (G ⊸ (H ⊸ K))
proof:
:= by
  simp [linImpl_of_tensor]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.linImpl_par
statement: lemma linImpl_par {G H K : Fact P} : (G ⊸ H ⅋ K) = ((G ⊸ H) ⅋ K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [linImpl_of_tensor, par_of_tensor]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.linImpl_par'
statement: lemma linImpl_par' {G H K : Fact P} : (G ⊸ H ⅋ K) = (H ⅋ (G ⊸ K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [par_comm, linImpl_par, par_comm]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.neg_linImpl_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma neg_linImpl_neg {G H : Fact P} : (Gᗮ ⊸ Hᗮ) = (H ⊸ G)
proof:
:= by
  simp [linImpl_of_tensor, tensor_comm]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.linImpl_iff_implies
statement: lemma linImpl_iff_implies {G H : Fact P} : p ∈ G ⊸ H ↔ imp G H p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, linImpl]
  simp only [dualFact_coe, mem_dual, Set.mem_mul, SetLike.mem_coe,
    forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  constructor
  · intro h q hq
    apply of_Fact _
    intro r hr
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact h _ _ hq _ hr rfl
  · rintro h _ r hr s hs rfl
    rw [← mul_rotate']
    exact hs _ (h _ hr)

/
The with (additive conjunction) `X & Y` of two facts,
defined as the intersection of the two facts.
-/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.plus_eq_with_dual
statement: lemma plus_eq_with_dual : (G ⊕ H : Fact P) = (Gᗮ & Hᗮ)ᗮ
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [oplus, withh]
  aesop

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.with_eq_plus_dual
statement: lemma with_eq_plus_dual : (G & H : Fact P) = (Gᗮ ⊕ Hᗮ)ᗮ
proof: := by simp [plus_eq_with_dual]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.neg_plus
statement: lemma neg_plus {G H : Fact P} : (G ⊕ H)ᗮ = Gᗮ & Hᗮ
proof: := by rw [plus_eq_with_dual, neg_neg]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.neg_with
statement: lemma neg_with {G H : Fact P} : (G & H)ᗮ = Gᗮ ⊕ Hᗮ
proof: := by rw [with_eq_plus_dual, neg_neg]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.with_comm
statement: lemma with_comm : (G & H : Fact P) = H & G
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective <| by simp [withh, Set.inter_comm]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.with_assoc
statement: @[simp] lemma with_assoc : ((G & H) & K : Fact P) = G & (H & K)
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [withh, coe_min]
  exact Set.inter_assoc ..

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.top_with
statement: @[simp] lemma top_with : (⊤ & G : Fact P) = G
proof: := SetLike.coe_injective <| by simp [withh]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.with_top
statement: @[simp] lemma with_top : (G & ⊤ : Fact P) = G
proof: := SetLike.coe_injective <| by simp [withh]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.plus_comm
statement: lemma plus_comm : (G ⊕ H : Fact P) = H ⊕ G
proof: := by rw [oplus, Set.union_comm, ← oplus]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.plus_assoc
statement: @[simp] lemma plus_assoc : ((G ⊕ H) ⊕ K : Fact P) = G ⊕ (H ⊕ K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [plus_eq_with_dual]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.zero_plus
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_plus : (0 ⊕ G : Fact P) = G
proof: := by simp [plus_eq_with_dual]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.plus_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma plus_zero : (G ⊕ 0 : Fact P) = G
proof:
:= by simp [plus_eq_with_dual]

/-! ### Distributivity Properties -/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.le_plus_left
statement: lemma le_plus_left {G H : Fact P} : G ≤ G ⊕ H
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦
  subset_dual_dual <| Or.inl hx

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.le_plus_right
statement: lemma le_plus_right {G H : Fact P} : H ≤ G ⊕ H
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦
  subset_dual_dual <| Or.inr hx

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_distrib_plus
statement: lemma tensor_distrib_plus : (G ⊗ (H ⊕ K) : Fact P) = (G ⊗ H) ⊕ (G ⊗ K)
proof:
:= by
  refine SetLike.coe_injective <| Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [tensor, dualFact, mkDual_coe, oplus, dualFact, mkDual_coe]
    rw [dual_dual_subset_Fact_iff, G.eq]
    refine tensor_assoc_aux.trans ?_
    rw [Set.mul_union, oplus, dualFact, mkDual_coe, tensor, dualFact, mkDual_coe]
    exact dual_subset_dual <| dual_subset_dual <|
      Set.union_subset_union subset_dual_dual subset_dual_dual
  · rw [oplus, dualFact, mkDual_coe, dual_dual_subset_Fact_iff, tensor, dualFact, mkDual_coe,
      tensor, dualFact, mkDual_coe, Set.union_subset_iff]
    simp only [dual_dual_subset_Fact_iff]
    exact ⟨(Set.mul_subset_mul_left le_plus_left).trans mul_subset_tensor,
           (Set.mul_subset_mul_left le_plus_right).trans mul_subset_tensor⟩

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.plus_tensor_distrib
statement: lemma plus_tensor_distrib : ((H ⊕ K) ⊗ G  : Fact P) = (H ⊗ G) ⊕ (K ⊗ G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensor_comm, tensor_distrib_plus]; simp [tensor_comm]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_distrib_with
statement: lemma par_distrib_with : (G ⅋ (H & K) : Fact P) = (G ⅋ H) & (G ⅋ K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [par_of_tensor, with_eq_plus_dual, tensor_distrib_plus]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.with_par_distrib
statement: lemma with_par_distrib : ((H & K) ⅋ G : Fact P) = (H ⅋ G) & (K ⅋ G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [par_comm, par_distrib_with]; simp [par_comm]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_semi_distrib_with
statement: lemma tensor_semi_distrib_with : (G ⊗ (H & K) : Fact P) ≤ (G ⊗ H) & (G ⊗ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
  simp only [tensor, withh, coe_min, dualFact_coe, Set.subset_inter_iff]
  exact ⟨dual_subset_dual (dual_subset_dual (Set.mul_subset_mul_left Set.inter_subset_left)),
         dual_subset_dual (dual_subset_dual (Set.mul_subset_mul_left Set.inter_subset_right))⟩

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.with_tensor_semi_distrib
statement: lemma with_tensor_semi_distrib : ((G & H) ⊗ K : Fact P) ≤ (G ⊗ K) & (H ⊗ K)
proof:
:=
  calc ((G & H) ⊗ K : Fact P) = K ⊗ (G & H) := by rw [tensor_comm]
    _ ≤ K ⊗ G & K ⊗ H := tensor_semi_distrib_with
    _ = _ := by simp only [tensor_comm]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.neg_le_neg_iff
statement: lemma neg_le_neg_iff {G H : Fact P} : Gᗮ ≤ Hᗮ ↔ H ≤ G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← neg_neg (G := H), ← neg_neg (G := G)]
    exact PhaseSpace.orth_antitone h
  · exact PhaseSpace.orth_antitone

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_semi_distrib_plus
statement: lemma par_semi_distrib_plus : ((G ⅋ H) ⊕ (G ⅋ K) : Fact P) ≤ G ⅋ (H ⊕ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_le_neg_iff]
  simp only [neg_par, neg_plus]
  exact tensor_semi_distrib_with

/-! ### Absorption Properties -/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.top_par
statement: @[simp] lemma top_par : (⊤ ⅋ G : Fact P) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [coe_top, Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
  intro x w hw
  rcases Set.mem_mul.mp hw with ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩
  rw [mul_left_comm]
  exact hy (x * z) (Set.mem_univ _)

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.par_top
statement: @[simp] lemma par_top : (G ⅋ ⊤ : Fact P) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [par_comm, top_par]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.zero_tensor
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_tensor : (0 ⊗ G : Fact P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tensor_of_par]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.tensor_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma tensor_zero : (G ⊗ 0 : Fact P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensor_comm, zero_tensor]

/-! ### Entailment Distributivity -/

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.plus_entails
statement: @[simp] lemma plus_entails : ((G ⊕ H) ⊸ K : Fact P) = (G ⊸ K) & (H ⊸ K)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [linImpl_of_tensor, with_eq_plus_dual, plus_tensor_distrib, neg_neg]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.entails_with
statement: @[simp] lemma entails_with : (G ⊸ (H & K) : Fact P) = (G ⊸ H) & (G ⊸ K)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [linImpl_of_par, par_distrib_with]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.zero_entails
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_entails : (0 ⊸ G : Fact P) = ⊤
proof: := by simp [linImpl_of_par]

name: Cslib.Logic.CLL.PhaseSpace.Fact.entails_top
statement: @[simp] lemma entails_top : (G ⊸ ⊤ : Fact P) = ⊤
proof:
:= by simp [linImpl_of_par]

statement: lemma valid_with {G H : Fact P} : (G & H).IsValid ↔ G.IsValid ∧ H.IsValid

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.ofPredicates_atom_iff
statement:
@[scoped grind =, modal =]
theorem Satisfies.ofPredicates_atom_iff {P : α → Prop} (f : Frame α τ) :
    ⇓Modal[ofPredicates f,a ⊨ P] ↔ P a
proof:
:= Iff.rfl

/
preserves the predicate map `Ps` from `P`. -/

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.ofPredicates_preservesMap_iff
statement:
@[scoped grind ., modal .]
theorem Satisfies.ofPredicates_preservesMap_iff {P : α → Prop} {Ps : τ.B op → α → Prop}
    (f : Frame α τ) :
    (∀ w, ⇓Modal[ofPredicates f,w ⊨ P → ∇[op](fun i => (Ps i : Proposition τ (α → Prop)))]) ↔
      f.PreservesMap op P Ps
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h w ws hr hP
    have h' := h w
    rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp] at h'
    specialize h' hP
    rw [Satisfies.nabla_iff_forall] at h'
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h' ws hr
    exact ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩
  · intro h w
    rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp, Satisfies.nabla_iff_forall]
    intro hP ws hr
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h w ws hr hP
    exact ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩

modal model induced by `Model.ofContainers f`. -/

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Proposition.equivOfContainers_denotation_eq
statement:
@[scoped grind ⇒]
theorem Proposition.equivOfContainers_denotation_eq
    [Membership α β] {f : Frame α τ} {φ₁ φ₂ : Proposition τ β} :
    (φ₁ ≡[Equiv.OfContainers (β := β) f] φ₂) ↔

theorem Satisfies.t_refl (f : Frame World τ) {op : τ.A} [Nonempty Atom]
    (h : ∀ φ : Proposition τ Atom, Axiom f⇓(φ → Δ[op](PropositionMap.const op φ))) :
    Std.Refl (f.diagonal op) where
  refl w
proof:
:= by
    have a := Classical.arbitrary Atom
    let v := fun (w' : World) (_ : Atom) => w' = w
    have h' := h (v := v) (w := w) (φ := a)
    rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp] at h'
    specialize h' rfl
    obtain ⟨ws, hr, _⟩ := h'
    have hws : ws = fun _ => w := by grind
    grind [Frame.diagonal]

  symm w ws hwws
proof:
:= by
    have a := Classical.arbitrary Atom
    let v := fun (w' : World) (_ : Atom) => w' = w
    let h' := h (v := v) (w := w) (φ := a)
    rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp] at h'
    specialize h' (by grind)

theorem Satisfies.four (f : Frame World τ) [f.Trans op]
    (φs ψs : PropositionMap τ op Atom) (i : τ.B op)
    (hi : φs i = (Δ[op]ψs)) :
    Axiom f⇓(Δ[op]φs → Δ[op]ψs)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := Frame.Trans.trans (f := f) (op := op) (i := i)
  grind only [modal, =_ axiom_def, = triangle_iff_exists]

/

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.four_trans
statement:
theorem Satisfies.four_trans (f : Frame World τ) [Nonempty Atom]
    (e : τ.B op ↪ Atom) (h : ∀ (φs ψs : PropositionMap τ op Atom) (i : τ.B op),
      φs i = (Δ[op]ψs) → Axiom f⇓(Δ[op]φs → Δ[op]ψs)) : f.Trans op where
  trans w ws i ws' h₁ h₂
proof:
:= by
    classical
    let a := Classical.arbitrary Atom

    let ψs : PropositionMap τ op Atom := fun j => e j

    let top : Proposition τ Atom := a → a
    let φs : PropositionMap τ op Atom :=
      fun j => if j = i then Δ[op]ψs else top

    let v : World → Atom → Prop :=
      fun x p => ∃ j, p = e j ∧ x = ws' j
    have hi : φs i = (Δ[op]ψs) := by grind only
    have h' := h φs ψs i hi (v := v) (w := w)
    have hφs : ⇓Modal[⟨f, v⟩,w ⊨ Δ[op]φs] := by
      rw [Satisfies.triangle_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨ws, h₁, ?_⟩
      grind only [modal, of_axiom, axiom_def, = triangle_iff_exists]
    rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp] at h'
    specialize h' hφs
    rw [Satisfies.triangle_iff_exists] at h'
    obtain ⟨xs, hr, hs⟩ := h'
    have hxs : xs = ws' := by grind
    grind only

/

theorem Satisfies.five (f : Frame World τ) [f.RightEuclidean op]
    (φs : PropositionMap τ op Atom) :
    Axiom f⇓(Δ[op]φs → ∇[op](PropositionMap.const op (Δ[op]φs)))
proof:

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.five_rightEuclidean
statement:
theorem Satisfies.five_rightEuclidean (f : Frame World τ) (e : τ.B op ↪ Atom)
    (h : ∀ φs : PropositionMap τ op Atom,
      Axiom f⇓(Δ[op]φs → ∇[op](PropositionMap.const op (Δ[op]φs)))) : f.RightEuclidean op where
  rightEuclidean {w ws₁ ws₂} h₁ h₂
proof:
:= by
    let φs : PropositionMap τ op Atom := fun i => e i
    let v : World → Atom → Prop :=
      fun w' a => ∃ i, a = e i ∧ w' = ws₁ i
    have h' := h φs (v := v) (w := w)
    have hφs : ⇓Modal[⟨f,v⟩,w ⊨ Δ[op]φs] := by grind
    rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp] at h'
    specialize h' hφs
    rw [Satisfies.nabla_iff_forall] at h'
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h' ws₂ h₂
    obtain ⟨ws', hr, hs⟩ := hi
    have hws : ws' = ws₁ := by
      funext j
      have hj := hs j
      simp only [φs] at hj
      rcases hj with ⟨k, hk, hw⟩
      have hjk : j = k := e.injective hk
      simpa [hjk] using hw
    grind only

/
all models in `S` for all worlds.

Corresponds to Definition 1.28 (for classes of models) in [Blackburn2001]. -/

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Satisfies.l
statement:
theorem Satisfies.l (f : Frame World τ) [IsTrans World f.rel]
    (hwf : Relation.Terminating f.rel) (φ : Proposition τ Atom) :
    Axiom f⇓(□(□φ → φ) → □φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w
  let m : Model World τ Atom := ⟨f, v⟩
  simp_rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp, Satisfies.box_iff_forall]
  intro h
  refine (hwf.induction (C := fun w' : World => f.rel w w' → ⇓Modal[m,w' ⊨ φ]) · ?_)
  intro w' ih hww'
  have hImp : ⇓Modal[m,w' ⊨ □φ → φ] := h _ hww'
  rw [Satisfies.imp_iff_imp, Satisfies.box_iff_forall (τ := τ)] at hImp
  apply hImp
  intro w'' hw'w''
  apply ih _ hw'w''
  exact IsTrans.trans _ _ _ hww' hw'w''

/

    ⇓Modal[m, w ⊨ φ]
proof:
:= by
  have hl := Satisfies.of_axiom m _ (Satisfies.l m.toFrame hwf φ) w
  /- We use `grind only` here as a memo and test that the `modal` grind set should be able to derive
    (the modal part of) this proof. -/
  grind only [modal, = box_iff_forall]

name: Cslib.Logic.Modal.Proposition.diamond_and_equiv_of_preserves
statement:
@[scoped grind ⇒]
theorem Proposition.diamond_and_equiv_of_preserves {m : Model World τ Atom}
    [IsTrans World m.rel] {φ₁ φ₂ : Proposition τ Atom} (hd : Diamond m.rel)
    (h₁ : Preserves m.rel (⇓Modal[m,· ⊨ φ₁])) (h₂ : Preserves m.rel (⇓Modal[m,· ⊨ φ₂])) :
    ◇(φ₁ ∧ φ₂) ≡[Equiv m] (◇φ₁ ∧ ◇φ₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [equiv_iff_forall_iff]
  intro a
  constructor
  case mp =>
    grind only [modal, Satisfies.diamond_iff_exists]
  case mpr =>
    intro h
    simp only [Satisfies.and_iff_and, Satisfies.diamond_iff_exists] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hab, hb⟩, ⟨c, hac, hc⟩⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨d, hbd, hcd⟩ := hd hab hac
    rw [Satisfies.diamond_iff_exists (τ := τ)]
    refine ⟨d, IsTrans.trans a b d hab hbd, ?_⟩
    apply Satisfies.and_iff_and.mpr
    exact ⟨h₁ hbd hb, h₂ hcd hc⟩

/

proof:

  rw [equiv_iff_forall_iff]
  intro w
  constructor <;> rw [← Satisfies.imp_iff_imp]
  · grind [Satisfies.unimodal_four]
  · grind [Satisfies.unimodal_t]

/

substitution, which would replace appeals to `A` in `E` by the whole derivation `D`.
-/
def Theory.Derivation.cut {Γ Δ : Ctx Atom} {A B : Proposition Atom}
    (D : T⇓(Γ ⊢ A)) (E : T⇓(insert A Δ ⊢ B)) : T⇓((Γ ∪ Δ) ⊢ B)
proof:
:= by
  refine implE (A := A) ?_ (D.weakCtx Finset.subset_union_left)
  have : insert A Δ ⊆ insert A (Γ ∪ Δ) := by grind
  exact implI (Γ ∪ Δ) <| E.weakCtx this

/

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.DerivableIn.cut
statement:
theorem DerivableIn.cut {Γ Δ : Ctx Atom} {A B : Proposition Atom} :
    DerivableIn T (Γ ⊢ A) → DerivableIn T ((insert A Δ) ⊢ B) → DerivableIn T ((Γ ∪ Δ) ⊢ B)
  | ⟨D⟩, ⟨E⟩ => ⟨D.cut E⟩
proof:
/
on the finset `Δ`. -/

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.DerivableIn.cut_away
proof:
:= by
  induction Γ' using Finset.induction with
  | empty => exact DerivableIn.weakCtx (by grind) hDer
  | insert A Δ hA ih =>
    apply ih
    · intro A' hA'
      exact hΔ A' <| Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hA'
    · apply Finset.union_left_idem Γ Δ ▸ DerivableIn.cut (Δ := Γ ∪ Δ)
      · exact hΔ A <| Finset.mem_insert_self A Δ
      · rwa [← Finset.union_insert A Γ Δ]

/
this implementation is not capture avoiding. -/

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.DerivableIn.substAtom
statement:
theorem DerivableIn.substAtom {Atom Atom' : Type u} [DecidableEq Atom] [DecidableEq Atom']
    {T : Theory Atom}
    (f : Atom → Proposition Atom') {Γ : Ctx Atom} {B : Proposition Atom} :
    DerivableIn T (Γ ⊢ B) → DerivableIn (T.subst f) ((Γ.subst f) ⊢ (B >>= f))
  | ⟨D⟩ => ⟨D.substAtom f⟩

/-! ### Properties of equivalence -/

/
def Theory.derivationTop [Inhabited Atom] : T⇓(⊤ : Proposition Atom)
proof:
:=
  implI ∅ <| ass <| by grind

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.derivableIn_top
statement: theorem derivableIn_top [Inhabited Atom] : DerivableIn T (⊤ : Proposition Atom)
proof: := ⟨derivationTop⟩

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.derivable_iff_equiv_top
statement:
theorem derivable_iff_equiv_top [Inhabited Atom] (A : Proposition Atom) :
    DerivableIn T A ↔ A ≡[T] ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · refine ⟨derivationTop.weakCtx <| by grind, ?_⟩
    let D := Classical.choice h
    exact D.weakCtx <| by grind
  · have := DerivableIn.cut (derivableIn_top (T := T)) (B := A) (Δ := ∅)
    rw [←show (∅ : Ctx Atom) = ∅ ∪ ∅ by rfl] at this
    exact this h.mpr

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.Theory.equiv_iff_equiv_derivableIn
statement:
theorem equiv_iff_equiv_derivableIn {A B : Proposition Atom} :
    A ≡[T] B ↔ ∀ Γ : Ctx Atom, DerivableIn T (Γ ⊢ A) ↔ DerivableIn T (Γ ⊢ B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨e⟩ Γ
    exact ⟨fun D => mapEquivConclusion Γ e D.some, fun D => mapEquivConclusion Γ e.symm D.some⟩
  · intro h
    rw [equiv_iff]
    constructor
    · exact (h {A}).mp ⟨ass <| by grind⟩
    · exact (h {B}).mpr ⟨ass <| by grind⟩

/

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.Theory.equiv_iff_equiv_derivableIn_hypothesis
statement:
theorem equiv_iff_equiv_derivableIn_hypothesis {A B : Proposition Atom} :
    A ≡[T] B ↔
      ∀ (Γ : Ctx Atom) (C : Proposition Atom),
      DerivableIn T ((insert A Γ) ⊢ C) ↔ DerivableIn T ((insert B Γ) ⊢ C)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨e⟩ Γ C
    exact ⟨fun D => mapEquivHypothesis Γ e C D.some, fun E => mapEquivHypothesis Γ e.symm C E.some⟩
  · intro h
    rw [equiv_iff]
    constructor
    · exact (h ∅ B).mpr ⟨ass <| by grind⟩
    · exact (h ∅ A).mp ⟨ass <| by grind⟩

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.Theory.Equiv.refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem Equiv.refl {T : Theory Atom} (A : Proposition Atom) : A ≡[T] A

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.Theory.Equiv.symm
statement:
theorem Equiv.symm {T : Theory Atom} {A B : Proposition Atom} :
    (A ≡[T] B) → B ≡[T] A
  | ⟨e⟩ => ⟨e.symm⟩

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.Theory.Equiv.trans
statement:
theorem Equiv.trans {T : Theory Atom} {A B C : Proposition Atom} :
    (A ≡[T] B) → (B ≡[T] C) → A ≡[T] C
  | ⟨e⟩, ⟨e'⟩ => ⟨e.trans e'⟩

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.Theory.equiv_equivalence
statement: theorem equiv_equivalence (T : Theory Atom) : Equivalence (T.Equiv (Atom := Atom))
proof:
:=
  ⟨Equiv.refl, Equiv.symm, Equiv.trans⟩

/

name: Cslib.Logic.PL.Theory.lem_mem_lem

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsPACLearnerFor.toIsRPACLearnerFor
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := h
  refine ⟨PUnit, inferInstance, Measure.dirac PUnit.unit, inferInstance, fun _ => A, ?_⟩
  intro D _ hD
  refine ⟨measurable_const.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  simp only [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
  exact hA D hD

learner for a larger family `𝒟'` is also a learner for any subfamily `𝒟 ⊆ 𝒟'`. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsPACLearnerFor.antitone_family
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := h
  exact ⟨A, fun D inst hD => @hA D inst (h𝒟 hD)⟩

/
`δ₂ ≥ δ₁`: the failure-probability bound only gets looser. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsPACLearnerFor.mono_δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := h
  refine ⟨A, fun D inst hD => le_trans (@hA D inst hD) ?_⟩
  exact_mod_cast hδ

/
`ε₂ ≥ ε₁`: the bad event `{error > opt + ε}` only shrinks. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsPACLearnerFor.mono_ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := h
  refine ⟨A, fun D inst hD => le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (@hA D inst hD)⟩
  intro S hS
  have hε' : (↑ε₁.val : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ↑ε₂.val := by exact_mod_cast hε
  calc optimalError D C + (↑ε₁.val : ℝ≥0∞)
      ≤ optimalError D C + ↑ε₂.val := by gcongr
    _ < error D (A S) := hS

/
for a larger class `C'` is also a learner for any subclass `C ⊆ C'`, since the agnostic
benchmark `optimalError _ C ≥ optimalError _ C'` makes the error requirement easier. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsPACLearnerFor.antitone_C
statement:
theorem IsPACLearnerFor.antitone_C {m : ℕ} {ε δ : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ≥0) 1}
    {C C' : ConceptClass α β} (hC : C ⊆ C')
    {𝒟 : Set (Measure (α × β))} (h : IsPACLearnerFor m ε δ C' 𝒟) :
    IsPACLearnerFor m ε δ C 𝒟
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := h
  refine ⟨A, fun D inst hD => le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (@hA D inst hD)⟩
  intro S hS
  have h_opt : optimalError D C' ≤ optimalError D C := iInf_le_iInf_of_subset hC
  calc optimalError D C' + (↑ε.val : ℝ≥0∞)
      ≤ optimalError D C + ↑ε.val := by gcongr
    _ < error D (A S) := hS

/
universe of the randomness space `Ω` is pinned so the hypothesis and conclusion share it. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsRPACLearnerFor.antitone_family.
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ω, mΩ, Q, hQ, A, hA⟩ := h
  exact ⟨Ω, mΩ, Q, hQ, A, fun D inst hD => @hA D inst (h𝒟 hD)⟩

/
any weaker confidence `δ₂ ≥ δ₁`. Unlike `mono_ε` or `antitone_C`, this does not touch the
integrand, so it carries the `AEMeasurable` part through unchanged. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsRPACLearnerFor.mono_δ.
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ω, mΩ, Q, hQ, A, hA⟩ := h
  refine ⟨Ω, mΩ, Q, hQ, A, fun D inst hD => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hmeas, hint⟩ := @hA D inst hD
  refine ⟨hmeas, le_trans hint ?_⟩
  exact_mod_cast hδ

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.error_map_eq_hypothesisError
statement:
theorem error_map_eq_hypothesisError (P : Measure α) (h c : Set α)
    (hh : MeasurableSet h) (hc : MeasurableSet c) :
    error (P.map (fun x => (x, decide (x ∈ c)))) (fun x => decide (x ∈ h)) =
    hypothesisError P h c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [error, hypothesisError]
  have hf : Measurable (fun x => (x, decide (x ∈ c))) :=
    Measurable.prodMk measurable_id
      (measurable_to_bool (by convert hc using 1; ext x; simp [decide_eq_true_eq]))
  rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf.aemeasurable]
  · congr 1; ext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ h <;> simp_all [symmDiff_def]
  · convert (hh.prod (measurableSet_singleton false)).union
      (hh.compl.prod (measurableSet_singleton true)) using 1
    ext ⟨x, b⟩; cases b <;> simp

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.SetShatters.subset
statement:
theorem SetShatters.subset {C : ConceptClass α Bool} {W V : Set α}
    (hW : SetShatters C W) (hVW : V ⊆ W) : SetShatters C V
proof:
:= by
  intro V' hV'V
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hc_eq⟩ := hW (V' ∪ (W \ V))
    (union_subset (hV'V.trans hVW) sdiff_subset)
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  rw [show V = W ∩ V from (inter_eq_self_of_subset_right hVW).symm,
    ← inter_assoc, hc_eq]
  ext x
  simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_union, mem_sdiff]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨Or.inl h, hV'V h⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨h1 | ⟨_, h2⟩, h3⟩
  · exact h1
  · exact absurd h3 h2

/
then `C'` shatters `W`. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.SetShatters.superset
statement:
theorem SetShatters.superset {C C' : ConceptClass α Bool} {W : Set α}
    (hW : SetShatters C W) (hCC' : C ⊆ C') : SetShatters C' W
proof:
:= by
  intro W' hW'
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcW⟩ := hW W' hW'
  exact ⟨c, hCC' hc, hcW⟩

name: Finset.Shatters.toSetShatters
statement:
theorem _root_.Finset.Shatters.toSetShatters {𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)} {s : Finset α}
    (h : 𝒜.Shatters s) :
    SetShatters
      {c : α → Bool | ∃ t ∈ 𝒜, ∀ x, c x = decide (x ∈ t)} ↑s
proof:
:= by
  intro W' hW'
  have hfin : Set.Finite W' := s.finite_toSet.subset hW'
  set t := hfin.toFinset
  have ht_eq : (↑t : Set α) = W' := hfin.coe_toFinset
  have ht_sub : t ⊆ s := Finset.coe_subset.mp (ht_eq ▸ hW')
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hsu⟩ := h ht_sub
  have hut : u ∩ s = t := by rwa [Finset.inter_comm] at hsu
  refine ⟨fun x => decide (x ∈ u), ⟨u, hu, fun _ => rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [← ht_eq]
  ext x
  simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_singleton_iff,
    decide_eq_true_eq, Finset.mem_coe]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => hut ▸ Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩,
    fun h => Finset.mem_inter.mp (hut.symm ▸ h)⟩

/
supremum of the cardinalities of finite sets shattered by `C`. Returns `0` when
no finite set is shattered (i.e. the defining set is empty).

**Caveat**: because `sSup` on `ℕ` returns `0` for unbounded sets, this definition
is only meaningful when the VC dimension is finite — see `HasFiniteVCDim`. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.hasFiniteVCDim_iff
statement:
theorem hasFiniteVCDim_iff {C : ConceptClass α Bool} :
    HasFiniteVCDim C ↔ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ W : Finset α, SetShatters C ↑W → W.card ≤ N
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨N, hN⟩ => ⟨N, fun W hW => hN ⟨W, rfl, hW⟩⟩,
   fun ⟨N, hN⟩ => ⟨N, fun _ ⟨W, hWc, hW⟩ => hWc ▸ hN W hW⟩⟩

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.mem_versionSpace_iff
proof:
:= Iff.rfl

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.versionSpace_subset
statement:
theorem versionSpace_subset {m : ℕ} (C : ConceptClass α β)
    (S : LabeledSample α β m) :
    VersionSpace C S ⊆ C
proof:
:= fun _ hh => hh.1

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.versionSpace_empty_sample
statement:
theorem versionSpace_empty_sample (C : ConceptClass α β)
    (S : LabeledSample α β 0) :
    VersionSpace C S = C
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  exact ⟨fun hh => hh.1, fun hh => ⟨hh, fun i => i.elim0⟩⟩

/
version space on `S` is contained in the version space on the reindexed sample
`S ∘ f`. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.versionSpace_reindex
statement:
theorem versionSpace_reindex {m n : ℕ} (f : Fin m → Fin n) (C : ConceptClass α β)
    (S : LabeledSample α β n) :
    VersionSpace C S ⊆ VersionSpace C (S ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hh => ⟨hh.1, fun i => hh.2 (f i)⟩

/
version space on all `n` observations is a subset of the version space on the
first `m` observations. Special case of `versionSpace_reindex` with
`f := Fin.castLE hmn`. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.versionSpace_antitone
statement:
theorem versionSpace_antitone {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (C : ConceptClass α β)
    (S : LabeledSample α β n) :
    VersionSpace C S ⊆ VersionSpace C (S ∘ Fin.castLE hmn)
proof:
:=
  versionSpace_reindex (Fin.castLE hmn) C S

/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.versionSpace_mono_C
statement:
theorem versionSpace_mono_C {m : ℕ} {C C' : ConceptClass α β} (hCC' : C ⊆ C')
    (S : LabeledSample α β m) :
    VersionSpace C S ⊆ VersionSpace C' S
proof:
:=
  fun _ hh => ⟨hCC' hh.1, hh.2⟩

/-! ### Empirical Error -/

/
number of sample points where `h` predicts incorrectly. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.mem_versionSpace_iff_empiricalMiscount_zero
statement:
theorem mem_versionSpace_iff_empiricalMiscount_zero [DecidableEq β]
    {m : ℕ} {C : ConceptClass α β} {S : LabeledSample α β m} {h : α → β} :
    h ∈ VersionSpace C S ↔ h ∈ C ∧ empiricalMiscount h S = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [empiricalMiscount, Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff,
             Finset.mem_univ, true_implies, ne_eq, Decidable.not_not]
  rfl

/
error (measure-theoretic bridge). -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.mem_versionSpace_iff_empiricalError_zero
statement:
theorem mem_versionSpace_iff_empiricalError_zero
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    {m : ℕ} {C : ConceptClass α β} {S : LabeledSample α β m} {h : α → β} :
    h ∈ VersionSpace C S ↔ h ∈ C ∧ empiricalError h S = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
  unfold empiricalError empiricalMeasure error
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
  · subst hm
    simp
  · simp_all [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

/
sample size. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.empiricalError_eq_div
statement:
theorem empiricalError_eq_div [DecidableEq β]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (h : α → β) (S : LabeledSample α β m) :
    empiricalError h S = (empiricalMiscount h S : ℝ≥0∞) / m
proof:
:= by
  have hm_ne : m ≠ 0 := hm.ne'
  unfold empiricalError empiricalMeasure error empiricalMiscount
  rw [dite_eq_right hm_ne, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.finsetSum_apply]
  simp only [Measure.dirac_apply, Set.indicator, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.one_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_boole, ← ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul]

in `C` labels every sample point correctly. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsConsistent.output_mem_conceptClass
statement:
theorem IsConsistent.output_mem_conceptClass {m : ℕ} {A : Learner α β m}

    (hS : Realizable C S) :

every observed point. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsConsistent.output_agrees
statement:
theorem IsConsistent.output_agrees {m : ℕ} {A : Learner α β m}

    (hS : Realizable C S) (i : Fin m) :

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsConsistent.empiricalMiscount_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsConsistent.empiricalMiscount_eq_zero [DecidableEq β]
    {m : ℕ} {A : Learner α β m} {C : ConceptClass α β} (hA : IsConsistent A C)
    (S : LabeledSample α β m) (hS : Realizable C S) :

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.IsConsistent.empiricalError_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsConsistent.empiricalError_eq_zero
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    {m : ℕ} {A : Learner α β m} {C : ConceptClass α β}
    (hA : IsConsistent A C) (S : LabeledSample α β m) (hS : Realizable C S) :

/-! ### Realizable Version Spaces -/

/
`C` and the sample `S` is labeled by `c` (i.e. every `(S i).2 = c (S i).1`),
then `c` itself lies in the version space `VersionSpace C S`. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.mem_versionSpace_of_realizable
statement:
theorem mem_versionSpace_of_realizable {m : ℕ} {C : ConceptClass α β}
    {c : α → β} (hc : c ∈ C) (S : LabeledSample α β m)
    (hS : ∀ i : Fin m, (S i).2 = c (S i).1) :
    c ∈ VersionSpace C S
proof:
:=
  ⟨hc, fun i => (hS i).symm⟩

/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.Realizable.versionSpace_nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.choose, mem_versionSpace_of_realizable h.choose_spec.1 S h.choose_spec.2⟩

/-! ### Probabilistic Realizable -/

/
`x ↦ (x, c x)`, the graph of `c` has measure `1`. -/

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.ae_mem_versionSpace_of_realizable
statement:
theorem ae_mem_versionSpace_of_realizable
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    {C : ConceptClass α β} {c : α → β} (hc : c ∈ C) (hcm : Measurable c)
    (hG : MeasurableSet {p : α × β | p.2 = c p.1})
    (P : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ S : LabeledSample α β m
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => P.map (fun x => (x, c x)))),
      c ∈ VersionSpace C S
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : {S : Fin m → α × β | ¬ c ∈ VersionSpace C S} ⊆
      (Set.univ.pi (fun _ : Fin m => {p : α × β | p.2 = c p.1}))ᶜ := by
    intro S hS hcontra
    exact hS ⟨hc, by simp_all⟩
  have hcompl : (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => P.map (fun x : α => (x, c x))))
      ((Set.univ.pi (fun _ : Fin m => {p : α × β | p.2 = c p.1}))ᶜ) = 0 := by
    rw [prob_compl_eq_one_sub (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun _ => hG),
        pi_map_graph_eq_one hcm P hG, tsub_self]
  exact measure_mono_null hsub hcompl

name: Cslib.MachineLearning.PACLearning.versionSpace_append
statement:
theorem versionSpace_append {m n : ℕ} (C : ConceptClass α β)
    (S : LabeledSample α β m) (T : LabeledSample α β n) :
    VersionSpace C (Fin.append S T) = VersionSpace C S ∩ VersionSpace C T
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  constructor
  · intro hh
    refine ⟨⟨hh.1, fun i => ?_⟩, hh.1, fun i => ?_⟩
    · have hi := hh.2 (Fin.castAdd n i)
      rwa [Fin.append_left] at hi
    · have hi := hh.2 (Fin.natAdd m i)
      rwa [Fin.append_right] at hi
  · rintro ⟨⟨hC, hS⟩, ⟨-, hT⟩⟩
    refine ⟨hC, fun i => ?_⟩
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [Fin.append_left]
      exact hS j
    · rw [Fin.append_right]
      exact hT j

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.bind_pair_apply
statement:
theorem bind_pair_apply (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    (p.bind fun a' => (f a').bind fun b' => PMF.pure (a', b')) (a, b) = p a * f a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [PMF.bind_apply, tsum_eq_single a]
  · rw [PMF.bind_apply]; congr 1; rw [tsum_eq_single b]
    · simp [PMF.pure_apply]
    · intro b' hb'; simp [PMF.pure_apply, hb'.symm]
  · intro a' ha'; rw [PMF.bind_apply]; simp [PMF.pure_apply, ha'.symm]

/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.bind_pair_tsum_fst
statement:
theorem bind_pair_tsum_fst (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (b : β) :
    ∑' a, (p.bind fun a' => (f a').bind fun b' => PMF.pure (a', b')) (a, b) =
      (p.bind f) b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [bind_pair_apply, PMF.bind_apply]

/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv
statement:
theorem uniformOfFintype_map_equiv {γ : Type v} [Fintype α] [Fintype γ] [Nonempty α] [Nonempty γ]
    (e : α ≃ γ) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).map e = PMF.uniformOfFintype γ
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_eq_single (e.symm c)]
  · simp [Fintype.card_congr e]
  · exact fun a ha => ite_eq_right fun h => ha (by simp [h])

/
given `a ← p`, `b ← f a`, and that `b` has positive marginal probability:
the joint distribution's slice at `b`, normalized. -/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.posteriorDist_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem posteriorDist_apply (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (b : β)
    (hb : b ∈ (p.bind f).support) (a : α) :
    posteriorDist p f b hb a =
      (p.bind fun a' => (f a').bind fun b' => PMF.pure (a', b')) (a, b) /
        (p.bind f) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [posteriorDist, PMF.normalize_apply, bind_pair_tsum_fst, div_eq_mul_inv]

/
conditioning on any output with positive probability leaves the prior unchanged. -/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.posteriorDist_eq_prior_of_outputIndist
statement:
theorem posteriorDist_eq_prior_of_outputIndist (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β)
    (h : ∀ a₀ a₁ : α, f a₀ = f a₁)
    (b : β) (hb : b ∈ (p.bind f).support) :
    posteriorDist p f b hb = p
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  have hbind : p.bind f = f a :=
    (congrArg p.bind (funext fun a' => h a' a)).trans (PMF.bind_const p (f a))
  rw [posteriorDist_apply, bind_pair_apply, hbind]
  exact ENNReal.mul_div_cancel_right ((PMF.mem_support_iff _ _).mp (hbind ▸ hb))
    (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.dist_eq
statement:
theorem dist_eq [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α) :
    dist p q = (∑ a, |(p a).toReal - (q a).toReal|) / 2
proof:
:=
  rfl

/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.dist_le_one
statement: theorem dist_le_one [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α) : dist p q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq]
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum fun a (_ : a ∈ Finset.univ) =>
    abs_sub_le (p a).toReal 0 (q a).toReal
  simp only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, sum_toReal] at h
  linarith

/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.dist_eq_one_of_disjoint_support
statement:
theorem dist_eq_one_of_disjoint_support [Fintype α] {p q : PMF α}
    (h : Disjoint p.support q.support) : dist p q = 1
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a, |(p a).toReal - (q a).toReal| = (p a).toReal + (q a).toReal := by
    intro a
    by_cases hp : p a = 0
    · simp [hp]
    · have hq : q a = 0 := by
        by_contra hq
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h ((p.mem_support_iff a).mpr hp)
          ((q.mem_support_iff a).mpr hq)
      simp [hq]
  simp [dist_eq, key, Finset.sum_add_distrib, sum_toReal]

/
statistical distance. -/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.dist_bind_le
statement:
theorem dist_bind_le [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (p q : PMF α) (kernel : α → PMF β) :
    dist (p.bind kernel) (q.bind kernel) ≤ dist p q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dist_eq, bind_apply_toReal]
  gcongr
  calc
    (∑ b, |(∑ a, (p a).toReal * (kernel a b).toReal) -
        ∑ a, (q a).toReal * (kernel a b).toReal|)
        ≤ ∑ b, ∑ a, |(p a).toReal * (kernel a b).toReal -
          (q a).toReal * (kernel a b).toReal| :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ b, ∑ a, (kernel a b).toReal *
        |(p a).toReal - (q a).toReal| := by
      simp_rw [← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, mul_comm]
    _ = ∑ a, |(p a).toReal - (q a).toReal| := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_toReal]

/
([BonehShoup2023], Theorem 3.13). -/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.dist_map_le
statement:
theorem dist_map_le [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (p q : PMF α) (f : α → β) :
    dist (p.map f) (q.map f) ≤ dist p q
proof:
:= by
  simpa [PMF.bind_pure_comp] using dist_bind_le p q (PMF.pure ∘ f)

/
most `ε`. The `ℝ≥0` parameter rules out meaningless negative bounds. -/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.StatisticallyClose.refl
statement: theorem refl [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) : StatisticallyClose p p 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [StatisticallyClose]

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.StatisticallyClose.symm
statement:
theorem symm [Fintype α] {p q : PMF α} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (h : StatisticallyClose p q ε) : StatisticallyClose q p ε
proof:
:= by
  simpa [StatisticallyClose, dist_comm] using h

/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.StatisticallyClose.mono
statement: theorem mono [Fintype α] {p q : PMF α} : Monotone (StatisticallyClose p q)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hεδ h => le_trans h (by exact_mod_cast hεδ)

/
errors. -/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.StatisticallyClose.trans
proof:
:=
  (dist_triangle p q r).trans (by simpa using add_le_add hpq hqr)

/
closeness. -/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.StatisticallyClose.bind
proof:
:=
  (dist_bind_le p q kernel).trans h

/

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.StatisticallyClose.map
proof:
:=
  (dist_map_le p q f).trans h

name: Cslib.Probability.PMF.statisticallyClose_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem statisticallyClose_zero_iff [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α) :
    StatisticallyClose p q 0 ↔ p = q
proof:
:= by
  simp [StatisticallyClose]
